༄tsho/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang mjordod bzhugs/ si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

pod 6sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang‘‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshal du〈khra dge slong tshal raring raming 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 6khrims dar rgyas kyi gsang rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu ༄ deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

11rngad (1 lngardo sdi/ngas 'o/:drob/bzhi byaspurngasno thab/lngazug rta):re ba//sbosprabakhuradra/zug/ na07ston la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshangs sa rig ra no༅gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 6dngul gyi mthan rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshal 'og〈dpe tshogs〉riri pho riri rgyade jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'a phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du‘‘mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min’’ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 5

21rngad 6 :rdo grub 'jigs med bstananyi:regasdo/nga'abuzug/ 007snyotshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs sa 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi ༄ dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 6rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'di ra mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang‘‘mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste’’sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsang chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas te༄bu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 7

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyar mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srang skyob byas dming /drunge///de/ /)tu /rdobyedo'adug da lta bsam na 'a ci goms srol gas tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la/ tha na 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 6 lha/// //bye/ 45rig //bye/ //nge/ /bro/rdo 1)sde/da srol rgyun rag gnas nang ga sa phyogs rer ma na na phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor 9

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4thiyod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris /10 rī

pod 6 rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa rgis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 11

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe/nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta bu la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 12

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 6che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/ 13

21jin (3 lngardo /spyings 'o/:drotha/bzhi byasputshog ngasartagacad rta):re tha//sboḥrdokhuradra/zug/ r+shazungarab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo log pad ma 'bam dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phal ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo rig 3 rari miyul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos khor yug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhag pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glegs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpogs par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 6 gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so//lung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i rnyiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bskyungs te bzhugs/gsang rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tan gsang ba'i snying bo de ri ring ///rgyakho na nyid rnam par nges pa la zur lugs ltar gyi dgongs 'grel spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/ lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cig bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〈gter gyi rnam bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzungs kyi skor la rnam 15

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa zhig bod na med par grags pas/ 〈gzungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgye sa gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang gnang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang〈gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈gzungs rnam〉dang〈gter rnam〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /gzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos su ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/gsung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thung dag la rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //16

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ (11)bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ (1)'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog (64)bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ (94)dbang chen rta skad/ (119)rta skad zin bris/ (255)rta skad bsdus pa/ (318)rta skad dka' gnad/ (340)rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mcho1re me long (345)bka' srung sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma'i sho mo/ (375)zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long (382)sats+tsha sgrub gdab lag len/ (423)zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ (444)
sdus pa'i d+dha

pod/ 6 gyi/ /bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam dge ba'i lo tog spel byed dbyar skyes sprin chen glal ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mgon po snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rgyal byed 'khor lo'i mtshan ma yis/ /bris pa'i 'od snang li khri'i dog pa gsar/ /thub rnams mgo la cod pan bzhin mdzes pa 'od mdzad zhabs pad dang bas lan brgyar mchod/ /blo gsar thar 'dod re ba'i ljon shing rtser/ /legs bshad glu dbyangs len mkhas khu byug cig /yongs dag zhing gi 'byor ba brda sprod kyis/ /gtan bde'i dga' ston 'dod rnams gus pas nyon/ /'dir blo rab 'bring tha ma'i gdul bya rnams kyi spyad bya thun mong bar gyur cing / thos na dga' ba rmad du byung ba skyed par byed pa/ bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba cung zad mdo sde'i rjes su 'brangs te bya ba la gsum/ dgos pa bstan nas bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba 'dzin pa la spro ba bskyed pa/ zhing der skye ba la zhum pa skye ba'i sgo dgag pa/ der skye ba'i rgya tshogs sgrub tshal ri'i rar 1

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lgebastan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar sangs rgyas mchog gi gzi mtha' yas/ /mi dbang gzi brjid phyogs kun lam mer gda'/ /de ltar bdag kyang sangs rgyas chos rgyal gyur/ /skye rgu rga dang 'chi las rab thar bgyi//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rga ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa du mas rtag tu gdung ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen pos yid bskyod pa rnams ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po gcig pu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che don du gnyer bar byed la/ de'i tshe de sgrub byed kyi sgo gnyis pa ni med pas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi phyogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i byang sems kyi spyod pa la slob dgos so/ /spyod pa'i rgya mtsho de ni gting dpag dka' zhing mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ dang por 'jug pa dang / zhugs nas mthar dbyung ba gnyis ka shin tu bya dka' bas rlabs po che'i mgon la brten nas bgrod dgos so//dgos pa de'i phyir du bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gro ba ni 'od mdo las gsungs te/ de nyid las phyogs bcu'i byang sems mang po bde ba can du skye ba 'dzin tshul 'chad pa'i skabs su/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang /2

sbrang nga/:she thab byu5zug 3) stunojing 95ba/ rngakubyudrozugathag nga/:re ba//spezug/ 21rngan/ (2bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / yongs su dri bar bya ba'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la blta bas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dpe dang / zhing dang 'khor gyi phun tshogs mthong ste dad pa'i shugs skye ba dang 'phel bar byed de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byed pa'i gzhi 'o/ /phyag dang bsnyen bkur bya ba ni rnyed pa dang bkur snyi dang rim gro'i sgo nas bsten tshul yin la/ yongs su dri bas gdams pa'i gnad la the tshom chod par byed pa ni gdams don ma nor bar nyams su len pa'i ched yin pas sgrub pa'i nan tan gyis mnyes par byed pa yang sdud do/ /de ltar na mdo 'dis mchog gi sprul sku mngon sam du mnyes par byed tshal gyi khongs sa bshes rig mi raring rigang gnyen bsten pa'i man ngag cha tshang zhig bstan no/ /de'ang 'og tu 'chad pa ltar yul ston pa dang rten zhing de'i 'gro ba gnyis ka tshe dpag tu med pa'i phyir/ der skyes na gdul bya thun mong ba yang lam mthon por sleb sleb tu rang gi ston pa dngos la mi 'bral bar bsten du yod pas dge chos las mi nyams shing yon tan gyi tshogs kyis nyin re bzhin du rgyas par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gzhan yang zhing der rgyal sras mthu chen mang po skye tshul ston pa'i mdo de nyid kyi 'phror/ mi pham pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 3

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpag mid kyi mtshan thos pa'i sems can de dag rnyed pa ji snyed cig legs par rnyed pa la ltos/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing mdor shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na gnas pa'i byang sems 'khor gyi yon tan mang po bshad nas zhing der skye ba'i rgyu la nan tan bya bar gdams pa'i skabs su/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skyes bu dam pa de lta bu dag dang phrad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshegs chung ngus byang chub sems dpa'i bshes gnyen khyad par can rnams dang 'phrad par 'gyur ba'i phan yon ston pa'o/ /ma dag pa'i zhing du ni snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i shugs kyis dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang shes rab la sogs pa'i mthu chung ba dang / longs spyod kyis phongs shing / de'i ched du brel ba dang rtsod pas rgyun du gdung ba dang / skyid cing phyag par gyar na ni des sems bslus te mngon zurigarar ra mi sa pha 40ripar 'byung bar ma nus pa dang / nad dang mya ngan sags kya dbang gis dge ba la 'dod dgur sbyor mi bzod pa dang / chos ltar bcos pa dang grogs po ngan pa mang ba dang / skye 'chi dang 'brel ba'i sdug bsngal du mas yang yang bar du gcod pa la sogs pa'i dbang gis lam bsgrub kyang stobs chung la/ thos pa'i yon tan rnams kyang nyams par sla'o/ /zhing 'di ni de 'dra ba'i nyes 4

tshar bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6pa rnams las ches cher gtsang bas der song nas bsgrub na lam gyi sa chod shin tu che ba yin te/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod kyi mdo las rgyal po'i sbas tshal dang / mtha' 'khob kyi grong gi dpe gsungs pa dang phyogs mtshungs pa yin no/ /yang zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' mang po de dag gis/ /mchod pa byas te dpag med 'od zhabs la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas 'di skad du/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ngo mtshar mdzes zhes 'dzer//dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems ni gzhal yas kyis/ /de dag gis ni me tog snyim gtor nas/ /'dren pa de yi spyan sngar 'di skad du/ /bdag cag zhing yang 'di 'drar gyur zhes smras/ /zhes phyogs bcu nas lhags pa'i byang sems rnams kyis zhing de'i snod bcud kyi 'byor ba'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas rang nyid kyang de ltar yongs su dag pa'i zhing sgrub pa la 'jug par gsungs te/tshul 'di ni 'jam dpal zhing bkod las kyang / shā ri'i bu gzhan yang 'di la byang sems sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar smon cing / de tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyar ///ze ri ringab ste/ de tshul mas yongs su dag pas gang dang gang du smon pa de dang der skyes te/ de der skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa la sems shing rtog ste/ nyan thos kyi phun sum tshogs 5

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i phun sum tshogs pa'am/ longs spyod dang kun tu spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa mtshan mar 'dzin te/des de dag mtshan mar bzung nas gus pa dang bcas/ zhe sa dang bcas shing thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thad du song ste/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas ji ltar sbyang na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa rgya chen po yongs su 'dzin ces kun tu zhus nas de bzhin gshegs pa des kyang de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas gang rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa rgya chen po yongs sa 'grub par 'gyar ba'i rigami skur gnas de dag ston cing yang dag par rab tu 'chad de/ des de thos nas de bzhin du nan tan byed pa'o/ /zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs so/ /tshe phyi ma la zhing dag par skye ba'i sgo nas dgos pa de sgrub pa bzhin du/ tshe 'dir dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa dang /de dag gi rgyu tshogs rnams gzhan las rgya cher nyan pa dang / don de tshul bzhin goms par byed pa'i sgo nas kyang sgrub tu yod de/'di ni 'jam dpal zhing bkod kyi lung de'i gong nyid du gsungs shing / 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa'i mdo las/ dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis ston pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i spyan sngar lo bye ba srid du de bzhin gshegs pa mang po'i zhing gi phun 6

la〉 ba:shebabyu5zud /) stunosprang 95bzhi ngasabyugizugathag nga/:re ba/tazug/ casarngan/ (tshotshogs gsan nas/ gdod rang nyid kyi zhing bzung bar bshad pa rjes 'jug gi nyams len dang sbyar ba'i sgo nas kyang shes par nus so/ /'di dag ni 'od mdor bde ba can gyi zhing gi yon tan dang /sngon dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis zhing de ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul rnams rgyas par bka' bstsal ba'i rgyu mtshan chen po'o/ /de yang 'od mdo nyid las/ gal te bdag zhing rnam pa de 'drar ma gyar la/ /sems can dbul mang nor mang bstsal bar ma gyar ra mi 41〉〉dzodarig ma rig 155ga rigang dzodarigadang / /sdug bsngal gyur pa' ma dag bad bar ma bapyas par/ /ma yi rgyal po dkon mchog tu ni bdag ma gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba rnams dang por mngon mtho'i bde ba/ gnas dang /lus dang / yo byad dang / mi 'jigs pa'i sgo nas ches phul du byung ba la bde blag tu 'god pa dang / de ltar bkod pa'i dus nyid nas de dag yang dag pa nyid la nges pa'i tshogs 'ba' zhig tu mdzad de/ nges legs kyi bde ba myur du ster ba'i rgyal sras dpa' bo'i thabs mkhas dang thugs bskyed kyi shugs sbyangs tshul thun mong ma yin pa 'dis zhing mtha' yas pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang thugs 'phrogs par gsungs pas dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan par byas nas de'i rjes su bslab par bya yi/ dag pa'i zhing gi 'dod yon la chags pas yid gdung nas smon lam 7

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'debs pa tsam la spro ba lhur blang bar mi bya ste/ bsam pa yongs su ma dag pa de 'dra bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnyog pa med par skye bar dka' ba'i phyir te/ mi 'khrugs pa'i mdo'i shes byed kyang snang ngo / /dgos pa gzhan yang zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ mi pham pabyude lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' dag gis the tshom yongs su spangs te byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la myur du sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i stobs bskyed pa'i mthu thob par bya ba'i phyir gang na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs sa bsngo bar bya'o/ /zhes ༄gsungs te/ der skyes nas sems can la phan bde sgrub pa'i mthu 'thob tshul ni/ mdo de nyid las/ rgya chen zhing 'dir lhags par gyur nas kyang / /lha yi mig dang lha yi rna ba dang / /tshe rabs dran dang blo gros mkhas mchog dang / /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyang myur du 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gong 'og tu zhing de'i 'gro ba rnams mngon shes lnga ldan 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pa de'i sgo nas yin te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pas gdul bya'i 'jig rten gar yod du song nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ma dad pa rnams dad 8

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6tha'ipa dang / dad pa rnams phyir zhing 'phel bar byed pa dang / sngon gnas dran pa'i mngon shes kyis rang nyid kyis 'dul ba'i rgyu sngon song can gyi sems can shes par byed cing / rang dang gzhan gyi sngon bde sdug ji ltar myong ba bstan nas skyo ba skyed pa dang / lha'i mig gi mngon shes kyis gdul bya gar yod rtogs pa dang / lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes kyis de dag gis gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgra la sogs pa shes pa dang / pha rol sems shes kyis gdul bya'i bsam pa mchog dman sogs kyi khyad par shes nas de dag dang 'tshams par chos ston nus pa la sogs pa'o/ /des na ma dag pa'i zhing gi 'gro ba la 'phral dang yun gyi bde bas phan 'dogs par 'dod na'ang dang por rang nyid bde ba can du skye ba blangs pa'i sgo nas zhing dag pa'i rgyal sras rnams dang skal ba mnyam par sgrub pa 'di nyid de'i thabs rmad du byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /der ma zad zhing der skyes pa'i rgyal sras rnams snga dro re rer sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir zhing rab 'byams su 'jug cing / de dag gi spyan sngar mang du thos pa'i mdzod tshad med pa bsags pa'i sgo nas rang gi dge tshogs gong 'phel du 'gro bar gsungs pa'ang mngon shes la brten nas byed pa yin no/ /'di 'dra ba'i don gyi 9

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang la gzigs nas 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod mnyan pa'i phyir stong gsum me 'obs kyis gang ba brgal te 'gro dgos pa byung yang mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha gyon dgos par gsungs pa yin te/ 'di la nges pa brtan po btsal dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar don chen po dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye ba 'dzin pa de'ang sa mtshams dma' mo'i ring la mi 'grub na ni/ bde ba can gyi zhing du lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nyung ba dang / mthun rkyen khyad par can bde blag rnyed pa'i dbang gis ma dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa rnams las lam gyi bgrod pa ches myur ba'i yon tan yang las dang po pa la 'ong sa med pas/de'i ched du smon lam btab pa'ang lam mthon po'i ched du smon lam btab pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur la/ rtogs pa mthon po dang khyad par du byang sems mthon pos ni yon tan de gnyis dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa la mi ltos par yang bde blag tu kho nas 'thob par nus so/ /'on kyang 'di ni de ltar ma yin te/ gsung rab las so so'i skye bo lam mthon por ma slebs pa yang zhing der skye ba'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa du ma zhig snang la/ tshul de rnam pa gzhan du 'dren pa'i lung rigs kyang med pa'i phyir dang /mdo'i don 'grel ba'i skyes ba chen po dag gis kyang de kho na'i ༄10

nga〉 /bathedo ngas byu5zud /spre stunorngub 95thag nga/byugazugathag nga/:re ba/tazug/ 21rngad/ ((phyogs ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsung rab las de ltar gsungs pa'ang yin te/ mdo sde dang rtog pa du mar rgyu 'di lta bu zhig bsgrub na bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba 'dzin nus zhes pa ni gsal bar gsungs la/ de dag kyang las dang po pas sgrub tu mi nus par mi snang ba'i phyir dang / 'od mdo dang snying rje pad dkar las de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi mtshan thos nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bde ba can du skye bar bsngos na chos spang dang mtshams med byas pa ma gtogs zhing der skye bar bshad pa'ang rgyud tshod mthon por ma slebs bar du zhing der skye mi nus na de 'dra'i rnam dbye mdzad don med pa'i phyir dang / 'od mdor rgyal ba 'od dpag med rjes su dran par byed pa'i sems can rnams shi 'phos nas zhing der skye bar ma zad/ tshe 'dir yang sangs rgyas mthong bar ston pa na rmi lam du ma thong ba dang / 'chi khar sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa mthong ba gnyis gsungs shing / de dag kyang gzhan rkyen de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyi dbang gis yin par gsungs kyi de las lhag pa ma bshad pa'ang chos rgyan gyi ting 1111 /༷༷/ //khror+sha/༷༷ nge 'dzin ma sab pa sku so skyes la dgongs par snang ba ri ger dang /snying rje pad+ma dkar por/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med 'khor sgyur rtsibs kyi mu khyud du 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ dpal shākya thub pa mdun 11

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/na 'don gyi gtso bor gyar pas byang chub kyi thags dang por 'dzin rig //bye( /bye// ༷༷nidu bstsal tshul bshad pa skabs su/ rgyal sa smras pa/ bram — de bzhin gshegs pa 'di ni skye dgu tshe lo brgyad khri pa rnams kyi nang du 'jig rten du byung na de bzhin gshegs pas ngan song thams cad zhi bar mdzad ma spyod de zhes pa nas/ sems can rnams rang rang gi dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las rnams kyis 'phyan par gyur pas na 'di ltar sems can gcig tsam gyi sdug bsngal yang rab tu zhi bar ma mdzad na bcom ldan 'das kyis btul ba'i sems can gang zhig yin/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ni zhing du gyur pa 'ba' zhig tu zad kyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa'i sems can rnams sdug bsngal las thar bar ni mi mdzad do zhes pa nas/ gal te gang gi tshe kho bo bla na med pa'i byang chub la reg par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der kho bos sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing zhig 'thob par 'gyur ba lta na/ de'i tshe kho bo byang chub tu sems bskyed cing kho bos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang spyad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sngar drangs pa'i 'od mdo'i lung / sems can dbul mang nor mang bstsal bar ma gyur la/ /zhes sogs kyi don yang de dang 'dra ba'i 12

thar400kho bdebacan/) stunong 'a/sa babyugaca/sa pa:re gtazug/ lngasarngan/ 6phyir ro/ /de la snying rje pad dkar gyi lung 'di'i don cung zad bshad na/ ma dag pa'i zhing du ni sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i drung du skye ba len thub kyang de tsam gyis sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag las brgal zin pa min gyi/da dung sangs rgyas nyid dge rtsa skyed pa'i zhing du bzung ste rim gyis ngan 'gro la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal las 'da' bar bya dgos so zhes ston pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ni zhing du gyur pa 'ba' zhig tu zad kyi zhes pa nas/ thar bar ni mi mdzad do zhes pa'i bar te/ de'i snga logs kyi mdo rnams kyang ngo / /bde ba can gyi zhing du ni skye ba blangs pa tsam gyis thams cad kyi thams cad du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rgyun chad pa yin pas de zhi ba la thabs gzhan bsten mi dgos te/ zhing der tshor ba sdug bsngal du gtogs pa tsam yang 'byung mi srid pa ni skyob pa 'od dpag med kyi smon lam dang tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pas sngon nas bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang nang du ngan 'gro la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa las gtan du 'da' nus pa'i tshod kyi lam la ma slebs kyang phyi rol sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i che bas nyams pa med pa'i bde ba de lta bu 'thob par ston pa ni/ gal te gang gi tshe kho bo bla na med pa'i byang chab la reg par 'gyar ba'i rabye rabye13

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/t+yāsogs nas/ thob par 'gyur ba lta na zhes pa ste shin tu gsal zhing / gong du/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'di ni zhes pa nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa'i sems can rnams sdug bsngal las thar bar ni mi mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i zlas drang na/ kho bo ni 'tshang rgya ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa'i sems can rnams kyang sdug bsngal las thar bar bya'o zhes par 'gyur te rnam dpyod yod na ci ste mi mthong / dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa'i don ni bshad ma thag pa ltar yin gyi/ dge rtsa gtan nas ma bskyed pa'i don ye min la/ sdug bsngal las thar bar mi mdzad ces pa'i sdug bsngal yang tshor ba sdug bsngal la bshad zin pa ltar yin te/de bzhin gshegs pas ngan song thams cad zhi bar mdzad ma spyod de zhes gsungs pas mtshon no/ /mdo 'di dag gis ni rang stobs kyis ngan 'gro las 'da' ba dang / gzhan sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa'i stobs kyis 'da' ba gnyis tshul tha dad du phye nas bstan to/ /de ltar byas tshe zhing der skye rgyu'i 'gro ba la ma dag pa'i zhing du skyes na ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i glags dang bcas pa du ma zhig med na mdo de dag la ji ltar 'grigs pa soms shig kha cig bde ba can du 'phags pa min pa mi skye zhes smra ba ltar na/zhing der skyes pa'i byang sems sngon the tshom za ba'i nyes pas 14

〉zur ngas:de rngasga byu5zug 3) stunasprang 95thag thababyugazugathag nga/:re tha//stozug/ 21yid/ (3bsgribs pa rnams pad+ma'i mngal du ring du gnas dgos par gsungs pa'ang byang sems 'phags pa la bya dgos la/ de'i tshe lo lnga brgyar sangs rgyas bsnyen bkur bya ba las nyams pa'i byang 'phags kyang yod par khas blang dgos te ya mtshan no/ /bshad ma thag pa'i byang sems rnams sngon rgyu bsgrubs pa na the tshom za ba'i sgo yang gtso bor zhing 'di 'gangs shin tu che ba dang / skye sla ba gnyis tshogs pa 'di yin par snang ngo / /lung la brten pa'i gnod byed gzhan yang yod de re zhig de tsam mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang la 'dun pa drag pa der skye ba myur la/zhing 'di'i gdul bya rnams ni bde ba can gyi zhing la mos pa shas che bar mthong ba'i phyir dang / ye shes phyag rgya 'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ gang zhig ye shes phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin 'di ni yi ger bris/ /'chang zhing ston la klog cing gang zhig gzhan la rab 'chad na/ /de yi bsod nams phung po dpag tu med cing bsam mi lang / /rgyal ba'i sras po bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams su 'gro/ /zhes dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i mdo'i phan yon gyi skabs su yang / gang zhig byang chub sems dpa'i gnas/ /bde ba can du mchi 'tshal ba/ /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /bsam gyis mi khyab de mthong 'gyur/ / 15

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ zhes gsungs shing / 'phags pa ting 'dzin rgyal po dang / za ma tog bkod pa dang / sman mdo brgyad brgya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis sems can la gzigs shing kun tu ston pa dang / gtsug tor gdugs dkar dang / rnam rgyal ma'i rtog pa dang / tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i gzangs mdo sogs mdo sde dang rtog pa mang por bde ༄ ba can du skye ba'i phan yon gsungs pa dang / lhag bsam bskul bar sems bskyed pa rnam pa bcus zhing der skye ba sgrub tshul dang /yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po'i mdor/ bdag ni 'gum pa'i dus bgyid tshe/ /phyin ci ma log yid kyis su/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med mthong nas/ 'di nas bde ba can du mchi/ /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa las/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /zhes sogs zhing der skye ba 'dzin pa la smon lam 'debs tshul mang du bka' bstsal pa dang / de dag dang mthun par rgyud bla mar yang /des ni 'gro 'di mtha' yas 'od mnga' drang srong tshe dpag med mthong zhing / /zhes dang / bshags bstod las/ 'gro kun bde ba can du phyin par shog /ces sogs bstan bcos las kyang du 16

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6zheshem zhig gsungs te/ rgyal dang de sras kyis chos bstan pa'i bye brag ni gdul bya'i dbang la brten nas 'jug pas/ de'i dus dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i skye bo rnams zhing der skye ba sgrub sla ba la dgongs nas de ltar rjes 'jug la bslab par gdon mi za ba'i phyir smon lam btab na lhag par 'grub pa yin no/ /gal te de lta yin na 'od mdo las bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i byang sems 'khor gyi yon tan 'chad pa na/'phags pa 'ba' zhig gi dbang du byas pa mang du gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing / gzhung gzhan du/ 'phags dang mtshams med byed pa dag /yang dag log pa nyid du nges/ zhes yang dag par nges pa 'phags pa la bshad cing / mdo 'dir bde ba can du skyes pa rnams yang dag pa nyid la nges pa kho nar gsungs pa yang ji ltar bsgrigs she na/ snga ma de ltar byung na'ang skyon med de/ mdo las rgyun gcig la gsungs pa'i yon tan rnams kyang gzhi tha dad kyi steng nas bshad chog pa du ma yod pa'i phyir te/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa/ rig par zhugs pa/ drang por zhugs pa/ mthun par zhugs pa zhes pa'i mdo'i tshig phyi ma gsum nyan thos slob pa 'bras gnas dang / zhugs lam pa dang / mi slob lam pa 17

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/so sor go rim bzhin sbyar nas bshad pa bzhin no/ /phyi ma ni der skyes nas las nyon gyis skye ba gnyis pa brgyud mi dgos par mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyogs su skal ba nges pa tsam la de ltar btags sam snyam ste/ theg pa chen po'i gzhung spyi skad la byang sems skye ba gcig thogs zhe sa pa sa bcu ba pa kho na yin la/ mdo 'dir bde ba can gyi byang sems thams cad smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs par bla med byang chub la skye ba gcig gis thogs pa sha stag tu gsungs kyang / der skyes pa'i byang sems la sa bcu ba pas khyab pa su yang mi 'dod pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang thub pa'i dbang po'i dgongs pa bdag 'dra ba rnams kyis shes par dka' ba sa da dung mkhas pa dag gis dpyad par mdzod cig /gsum pa la/ rgyu sgrub tshul spyir bstan pa dang / rtsa ba dad pa sbyang tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'od dpag med kyi tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras ba'i zhing dang / chos kyi ༄longs spyod la dngos su spyod pa la ni rten gyi ngos nas kyang tshogs de'i cha gcig nges par sgrub dgos te/ gzhan du na de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje dang mthu la phyogs lhung med pas dag pa'i zhing grub pa tsam nas sems can thams cad der phyin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /sngar drangs pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pas 18

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6'gro ba spyi mthun gyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i mdzad pa ma dag pa'i zhing du mi ston par gsungs pa'ang / sems can dge rtsa chung zhing las sgrib shas che ba rnams kyi nang du mdzad pa de bsgrubs ma byung ba'i rgyu mtshan nyid kyis yin no/ /de la rgyu'i khyad par ci tsam zhig bsgrub na don de 'grub pa ni tshu rol mthong ba'i mngon sum dang / dngos stobs kyi tshad mas rtogs mi nus pas drang srong chen po'i lung kho na la brten nas shes dgos so/ /de yang 'od mdo las/ kun dga' bo sems can gang dag kha cig ni de bzhin gshegs pa de rnam pas yang dang yang du yid la byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po dpag tu med pa bskyed pa dang /byang chub tu sems yongs su bsngos te/ 'jig rten gyi khams der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de dge slong gi tshogs du mas yongs su bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas nas bzhugs par 'gyur te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med de mthong nas rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis shi 'phos te 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / kun dga' bo gang dag yang de bzhin gshegs pa de yang yid la byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba 19

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mang po dpag tu med pa rgyun du bskyed la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sems yang dag par gtod pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa de'i kha dog dang /dbyibs dang chu zheng dang / zhabs 'bring ba dge slong gi dge 'dun ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dag mdun du gnas par 'gyur te/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas rab tu dang ba la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin de dang / brjed pa med pa'i dran pas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung snga mas rgyu bzhi dang / phyi mas gsum gsungs so/ /bzhir gsungs pa'i skabs su byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dgos par gsungs pa ni/ de'i 'khor gyi gtso bor skye ba'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ zhing der skye ba bzung ba'i dgos pa sngar bshad pa rnams tshang bar 'thob pa la sems bskyed dgos zhes pa yin gyi/ der skye ba tsam la ni ma yin te/ de na nyan thos kyi 'khor yang mtha' yas pa yod par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang der skye ba tsam 'thob pa la'ang sems bskyed yod med gnyis la tshegs che chung gis 'thob pa'i khyad par ni yod par mngon no/ /zhing der bye brag tu skye ba'i rgyu ston thog gi sa bon lta 20

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6bu ni der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa yin la/ smon lam de rgyun ring la shugs drag pa yod na zhing der skye ba'ang de'i tshod tsam sla zhing / de las bzlog na dka' ba yin no/ /smon lam gyi ngo bo ni 'dun pa yin cing / de'i rtsa ba dad pas byed par gsungs pas/smon lam de ltar 'ong ba ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med rnam pas yang dang yang du yid la byed pa'i dad pa sbyangs pa la ltos te/ de ni rgyu dang po yin no/ /'dir skyob pa 'od dpag med ni yid la bya rgyu dang / de yid la byed pa'i tshul ni rnam pas zhes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rnam pa dang / chos ston pa dang / spyod lam gyi rnam pa dang / nyan thos dang byang sems kyi 'khor gyi rnam pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rnam pa dang / sngon gyi rgyu'i rnam pa sogs rnam pa du ma'i sgo nas sems par mdo gzhan dang gzhan las gsungs pa bzhin te/ 'di ni dad pa sgo du ma nas rgyas pa 'i ched do/ /de'ang lan re zung tsam ma yin par sgom dgos pa ni yang dang yang du zhes pas bstan te/'dis ni dad pa rgyun ring la brtan pa sgrub par byed do/ /bshad ma thag pa'i rnam pa de dag la mkhas na de dag gi sgo nas sangs rgyas yid la byed tshul med pas/ zhing bkod kyi mdo sde rin po che 'bad pa du mas nyan dgos par gsungs te/ stobs bcu mnga' 21

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bas dad pa sbyang thabs kyi man ngag gting thug par byin pa yin par zungs shig /smon lam khyad par can ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub pa la/ de'i rten du gong gi rgyu gnyis pa dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po bsags pa dgos te/ mdo de nyid las/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsngo bar bya'o zhes dang / snying rje pad dkar las kyang /bdag gi ming thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi zhing du yongs su bsngo ba bgyis nas bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar gyur cig /ces smon lam 'debs lugs kyang dge rtsa yongs sgyur gyi bsngo ba'i rnam pa can du byed par gsungs so/ /dge rtsa gsog lugs ni/ sngar drangs pa'i mdo lung phyi mar/dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po dpag tu med pa rgyun du bskyed la/ zhes sgo mang po nas gsog pa dang / zhing dang bsam pa sogs kyi dbang gis skad cig rer yang dpag tu med pa gsog pa dang / de la'ang goms pa rgyun chags su byed par gsungs so/ /sgo mang po nas gsog tshul yang / de nyid las/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan par bya'o/ /thos nas kyang g.yor ma ltung ba'i rgyud kyis bsam pa thag pa nas rjes su dga' bar bya'o/ /chos kyi rnam 22

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6 grangs 'di gzung ba dang / kun chub par bya ba dang / bcang bar bya ba dang / yi ger bri ba dang / bsgom pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rlabs po che chen po brtsam par bya'o/ /tha na ba gcig 'jo ba de srid du gzhan dag la brjod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing /de'i 'phro zhig na/ tha na yi ger bris te mchod pa byed pa de dag kyang bsod nams mang du skyed par 'gyur te/ zhes mchod pa byed pa yang gsungs so/ /dam pa snga ma dag smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyur dge rtsa skyed pa'i sgo rnams phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun du bsdu bar bzhed de/ sdong po bkod pa sogs kyi mdo'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /'od mdor rgyu gnyis pa ston pa'i skabs su/ ji skad smos pa'i khyad par de 'dra ba yang dang yang du sbyar ba sa/ lus 'di bor nas skye srid gzhan bar du mi brgyud par zhing der 'gro ba la dge rtsa shin tu shas che ba dgos par gsal la/de'ang tshul khrims dang ldan pa la 'ong gis/ rgyud nyes par spyod pas zil gyis mnan pa la ches cher dka' ba'i phyir/ mi dge bcu spong la ma mtha' byas pa'i tshul khrims la mang du gnas pa dang / sdig ltung byung yang bshags bsdam 'bad nas byed pa cig ba/la shin tu che bar snang ste/ bsdus don dang po'i thad du drangs pa'i 'jam dpal zhing bkod kyi lung gis kyang tshul khrims dang 23

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/smon lam gnyis zhing dag par skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bor bstan to/ /lhag par yang dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang / mtshams med byed pa gnyis kyis bde smon mi 'grub par gong du brjod zin cing /lhag bsam bskul ba las kyang / sngon dge slong chos smra ba gnyis la skur ba btab pa'i byang sems drug cu las de lhag ma med par ma zad kyi bar la bde ba can du 'gro mi nus par gsungs te/de'i nang nas kyang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa la chags sdang gis ris tha dad du phye nas rtag tu gzhan gyi legs bshad la klan ka tshol ba'i bsam pa can gyi mkhas rloms dang / dri ma med pa'i gsung rab dang dgongs 'grel rin po che rnams la than mthong ba ltar byed pa'i blun po dang / rnyed bkur gyis dbyen spyos nas dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs la zhe sdang ba dang / gzhan yang de dag dang phyogs mthun pa bdag cag lta bu rnams la chos dang chos smra ba la brten pa'i las sgrib 'di dag 'byung shin tu nye bas/ 'phags pa lhag bsam bskul ba dang / rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo sogs zhib tu bltas la/ nyes spyod chen po'i sgo de dag gi rnam dbye shes par byas te mthu ci yod kyis dgag dgos so/ /rgyu bzhi po 'di dag tshal bzhin bsgrubs pa'i skyes bas ni tshe rigi rgyu rig 3'dir yang thub pa 'od dpag med rmi lam du mthong zhing / nam 24

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6 zhig 'chi ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das de byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyis bskor nas mdun du bzhugs pa mthong ste dga' ba dang dad pa'i shugs kyis yid 'dren par 'gyur la/ de'i mthus las kyi sgrib pa rnams byang nas thogs pa med par bde ba can du 'gro ba 'od mdo dang snying rje pad+ma dkar por ci rigs su gsungs so/ /zhing de'i byang sems kyi 'khor du skyes kyang re zhig la sngar bshad pa'i phan yon rnams las nyams pa'i rgyu ni/ rgyu bzhi bsgrubs kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis zhing gi yon tan dang der rgyu ci tsam zhig gis skye ba'i rnam gzhag bka' bstsal pa rnams la the tshom za ba yin te/ de'i nyes pas zhing der pad+ma'i mngal du lo lnga brgyar sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / de las chos nyan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang / de dag dang lhan cig 'bel ba'i chos kyi gtam rnam par nges pa bya ba dang / de'i don nan tan gyis bsgrub pa'i sgo nas rtogs pa khyad par du 'gro ba rnams byar med par gnas dgos pa'i tshal rgya cher 'od mdo las gsangs so/ /de dag risi rgyu dmi bye sangs rgyas mthong ba las nyams kyang chos thos pa las mi nyams zer ba ni mdo dang 'gal lo/ /the tshom 'di 'gog pa la dpal chos kyi grags pas/ mthong dang ma mthong dngos po yi/ /don de 25

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag la mngon sum dang / /rjes dpag rnam pa gnyis kyis kyang / /gnod med 'di yi mi bslu ba'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/de bzhin gshegs pas mthong ba mngon gyur bstan pa'i gsung rab la mngon sum dang / mthong ba lkog gyur bstan pa'i gsung rab la dngos stobs kyi bsal ba mi 'jug pa'i tshul dang / de nas ma mthong ba shin tu lkog gyur ston pa'i gsung rab 'di 'dra ba rnams la rang tshig snga phyi dang / dngos shugs 'gal ba'i gnod pa med tshul shes par byas te/ gsung rab snga ma gnyis mthun dper blangs nas dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung gi rtags kyis mi bslu bar yid ches skyed pa dgos te/ 'di ni 'od mdo nyid las/ de bas mkhas pa rig pa'i rang bzhin mi/ /gang zhig nga yi tshig la yid ches te/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes phung po dpang byas nas/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mkhyen ces tshig tu brjod/ /ces pa'i dgongs par yang snang mod/ 'dir de tsam las ma bshad do//de ltar tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa rlabs po che bde blag tu rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa rmad du byung ba las kyang ches rmad du byung ba 'di lta bu rnyed nas sgrub tu yod pa ni/ da res 'dra ba'i brgya lam brgya lam na thugs rje can gyi ston pa dang /ston pa'i lugs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi drin las dka' dka' 26

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6 ltar rnyed par zad kyi/ yang dang yang du rnyed pa ma yin pa'i tshul legs par bsam nas mdo sde rin po che gdams pa'i mthil du bzung ste don nyams su len pa'i brtson 'grus drag pos rgyal ba sras bcas la byas pa gzo bar bya ste/ mdo de nyid las/ mi pham pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o/ /chos bstan pa rnyed par dka'o/ /dal ba phun sum tshogs pa rnyed par dka'o/ /mi pham pa/ ngas khyod la dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsnyad kyis/ da khyod kyis mngon par sbyor la sgrubs shig /ces bka' ba455 pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam dang / de'i grogs dge rtsa du ma la 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus gnyis ka'i rtsa ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zhing gi 'byor pa la dad pa brtan pa yin pas gtso bor de bsgom pa'i phyir du 'bad dgos te/ de nyid las/ don mchog thob phyir dad pa rtsa ba ste/ /de lta bas na thos nas yid gnyis sol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'ang rgyu 'bras gnyis ka'i sgo nas bsam na blo 'khul stobs che bas de ltar cung zad bshad pa la gnyis/ zhing de dang por ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul dang / grub pa'i zhing gi phun tshogs nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po la'ang / bsam pa smon lam ji ltar btab pa/ sbyor ba tshogs 27

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ji ltar bsags pa/ de dag gi lag rjes ji ltar grub pa'i tshul dang gsum las/dang po ni/ skyob pa 'od dpag med sngon dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa na snying rje'i rtsa ba can gyi byang chub kyi sems rin po ches thugs rgyud bskul bar gyar te phul du byung ba'i zuragazurang (11 4〉〉—rig༄༄mi r+sār 4〉〉 la'isangs rgyas kya zhang ngas su gzung ba' chad du da bzhan gshags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i spyan sngar sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi zhing gi yon tan sgrub byed kyi rgyu dang bcas pa lo bye ba tham par gsan cing / de'i 'og tu rang nyid kyis bskal pa lnga'i ring la ji skad gsan pa'i zhing de dag las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgya khyon dang / rang bzhin dang / 'khor dang / longs spyod kyi bye brag zad mi shes pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing la rtse gcig tu sems shing 'dug nas/ gdod de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar de 'dra ba'i zhing bzung bar 'od mdo las gsungs te/ rgyas par na dang por dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas de theg mchog rigs kyi nus pa khyad par can sad tshul dang / de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor ji lta bus bsten pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen las 'bad pa chen pos gdams ngag ji ltar blangs pa dang / gdams ngag de 28

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6la brten nas bsam pa phun tshogs ji lta bu brnyes pa dang / bsam pa de thog mar bskyed dus nas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i ltas rgya chen po 'jig rten du byung tshul rnam dpyod can gyi 'dun sar gleng bar 'os pa du ma zhig zhing bkod kyi mdo nyid kyi steng nas shod par snang yang mang bas 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /snying rje pad+ma dkar po las ni/ bcom ldan 'das des sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzung ba'i sku tshe'i thog ma 'khor sgyur rtsibs kyi mu khyud du 'khrungs pa de yin par gsungs te/ des lo bdun du g.yeng ba thams cad spangs te nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po'i byin rlabs kyis phyogs bcu'i phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams stong gi rdul snyed rnams kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyan dag mthong bar gyur nas de dag la lta zhing gang du rang nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yon tan phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i smon lam gyi tshul la mkhas par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar smon lam rgya cher btab tshul rnams bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar smon pa tsam gyis chog shes par yang ma mdzad de/ ji ltar smon pa'i don de nyid bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/dus kyi khyad par bskal pa mtha' yas par/ slob tshul gyi khyad 29

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsang 'bam/༄ ༄par rtag tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brang ba'i dran pa dang shes bzhin dang bag yod rnams la gnas te/ bslab bya'i rang bzhin lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes spyod phyogs re tsam ma yin par sdom pa dang tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa phyogs re tsam ma yin par sgrub pa dang / khyad par du de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab tshad bzung dang bral bas mthar 'dzin gyi 'ching ba bcad de/ sbyin pa la sogs pa byang sems kyi spyod pa gzhan rnams kyang shes rab de nyid kyi rgyas btab nas goms par byed pa dang / dge chos de rnams khyad par du 'gro ba'i phyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i bshes gnyen bgrang bas mtha' mi rtogs pa de nyid sgo thams cad nas mnyes par bya ba dang / rang gang la gnas pa'i lam de nyid mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyis dngos dang brgyud nas rtogs par bya ba'i phyir thabs la mkhas pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston pa dang / de dag thams cad kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis bsngo zhing yongs su spel ba ste/ mdor na dge ba'i rtsa ba ma sbyangs pa rnams kyis thos na yid ches pa tsam yang bya dka' ba'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba rnams la bslab par mdzad pa ni/'od mdo las/ kun dga' bo dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas des 30

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po de'i spyan sngar lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mdun du smon lam gyi khyad par rnam pa de lta bu de dag bstan nas/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub pa la gnas par gyur te/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so//gsum pa ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi phung po chen po de dag gi mthu las sku tshe'i phreng ba thams cad du lus mtshan dpes brgyan cing / kha'i sgo dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad las lha rdzas kyi tsan dan dang me tog ut+pa la'i bsung 'byang ba dang / ci dang ci //༷kro ///) ri ri dgos pa yo byad — khyad par thams cad lag pa gnyis nas rang 'byung ba dang / phyogs gang du skyes kyang de dang der gter bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma 'thon pa de lta bu'i dpal gyis mdzes par gyur te/ de yang rim gyis gong nas gong du 'phel te/mthar sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i rgyan ji ltar bzhed pa thams cad 'grub pa'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar du gyur pa yang / de nyid las/ kun dga' bo de ltar dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa na yo byad thams cad la dbang ba'i pha rol tu son par gyur to/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de'ang rgyu'i dge tshogs bzang ba dang / mang ba dang / nyes spyod dang ma 'dres pa dang / sna tshogs pa sogs kyi 31

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsang 'bam/༄ ༄dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bzang ba dang / mang zhing phal che ba dang / snyigs ma thams cad kyis ma sbags pa dang /rgyan sna tshogs pa sogs so sor 'byung bar snang ngo / /rgyu'i gsal ba tha dad las sangs rgyas kyi zhing la lag rjes so sor 'byung ba'i tshul rgyas par ni sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu ba dang / 'jam dpal zhing bkod las shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du mtshan dang /dpe byad dang / 'od dang / sku tshe dang / dbyangs dang / ye shes dang / mdzad pa dang / tha na mtshan gyi yi ge tsam yang gdul bya'i re ba skong ba la yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur rgyu bsam sbyor phun tshogs dus yun ring la rnam pa mtha' yas pas bsgrub tshul rnams zhib tu bsam par bya ste/ 'di dag legs par shes na 'od mdo las/ gang gis phra rab rdul snyed 'jig rten khams/ /bshigs shing btags te rdul du byas gyur pa/ /de bas mang ba'i 'jig rten rnams kyi khams/ /rin chen bkang ste sbyin pa byin pas ni/ /gang gis dpag tu med pa'i 'od mtshan dang / /bde ba can gyi yon tan khyad 'phags rnams/ /thos nas dga' ste thal mo sbyor byed pa/ /bsod nams 'di yi char yang 'gyur ma yin/ /gang gis bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi/ /ming thos pa yi bsod nams de la ni/ /zhing mchog tha gru chen po de dag kun/ /cha dang 32

tshameyangami rngaku:de rngaspro byu5zug /) stunosprang 95bzhi ngasabyugazugabazhi nga/:re ba//spezug/ 21rngad/ /(dper yang 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /zhes sogs gong 'og tu gsungs pa du ma zhig la nges pa yam me ba min par skye'o/ /gnyis pa la/ snod kyi yon tan dang / bcud kyi yon tan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang / sa gzhi dang nam mkha'i gnas bshad pa dang / de dag mdzes byed kyi rgyan bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zhing de na lha dang mi'i gnas ris gnyis las gnas gzhan med la/ lha gnas la rgyal chen ris bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum sogs kyi gnas ris so sor yod kyang /ri rab la brten pa'i lha gnas ni med de/ de na ri rab dang rgya mtsho chen po sogs med par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thams cad kyang nam mkha' la brten pa sha stag ste/ 'di ni kun dga' bos dri ba zhus pa'i lan gyi skabs su rgyu mtshan mthun dpe dang bcas te gsangs so/ /rgya mtsho chen po med pas gling bzhi'i ༄rnam gzhag la yang dpyad par bya'o/ /de la zhing de ni tha gru che zhing shin tu yangs pa/ sa gzhi sdong dum dang / tsher ma dang / gyo gseg dang / ngam grog dang / gad pa dang / rdo ba dang / ri nag po med kyang / 'jig rten na mi spyod pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ ngos lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ gser gyi dra bas khebs pa/ shin tu gzhon zhing 'jam la snyi bas reg na bde ba/33

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bkra zhing shin tu mdzes pa'i 'od zer gyi ri mo can/ legs par phyis pa'i me long gi nang ltar dag pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa'i rgyan gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ste/ 'od mdo'i gong 'og bsgrigs shing mdo gzhan la'ang cung zad brten nas bkod pa'o//gnyi sa pa la/ sa gzhi la 'byung ba'i rgyan dang / nam mkha' la 'byung ba'i rgyan dang / de dag gi khyad par thun mong du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la/ rtag tu gnas pa dang / 'phral dang 'phral la 'byung ba gnyis las/ dang po la'ang / ri'i rgyan ni 'od mdor/ri thams cad kyang rin po che'i ri sha stag go /zhes pa tsam las ma byung yang / mdo gzhan du/ lha yul gyi ri rnams rtse mo sna tshogs pa/ngos yangs shing mtho dman mang pos dga' ba/ rin po che'i snye phang 'khrigs pa'i gsab gseb dang / rin po che'i 'byang khungs riri bye ri glishidu ma can/ nor bu'i phug dang / 'khri shing gi khyim gyi phreng bas mdzes pa yin par gsungs pa dang 'dra'am snyam mo/ /shing gi rgyan ni/ shing ljon pa re re nas ril gyis rin po che sna gcig gi rang bzhin dang / gnyis dang / gsum nas/ gser dang dngul dang be+eḍūr+ya dang / shel dang / spug dang / mu tig dmar po dang /rdo'i snying po ste rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i bar du yod la/de'i nang nas rin po che sna gcig pa la/ gser gyi ljon shing nas 34

〈co tshogatheshe /ba byu5zud /) stunojiṭa khukhuthag rngakubyugazugathag nga/:re pe//stozug/ 21rngad/ (3rdo'i snying po'i ljon shing gi bar bdun dang / rin po che sna bdun las grub tshul la/ rtsa ba/ sdong po/ yal ga lo ma/ 'dab ma/me tog 'bras bu rnams so sor rin po che gzhan dang gzhan las grub pa dang / de bdun re re yang rin po che sna bdun ka las grub pa'i tshul gnyis gsungs shing / de'i snga ma la'ang dbye ba bdun gsungs so/ /shing ljon pa de dag thams cad kyang 'jam zhing reg na bde la dri zhim pa ste/ de dag rlung gis bskyod pa na snyan cing yid du 'ong la mnyan pas chog mi shes pa'i sgra dbyangs dag 'byung ngo / /shing so so'i kha dog so so dang / shing re re yang kha dog mi 'dra ba du mas phye ba de dag gis sa gzhi rnam par bkra ba yin no/ /chu'i rgyan la/ 'bab chu dang / rdzing bu'i rgyan gnyis las/ 'bab chu ni kha zheng dpag tshad gcig pa nas dpag tshad brgya stong pa'i bar du yod la/ zabs su ni thams cad kyang dpag tshad bcu gnyis par mtshungs te/ de dag tu rol rtsed la 'jug pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis chu long bu nub tsam nas/ mid pa nub tsam gyi bar gyi ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'gyur ba ni ma gtogs so/ /chu klung de dag ni 'bab stegs bde ba/ 'dam rdzab med pa/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/dri rab tu zhim pa'i lha rdzas kyi spos kyis bsgos pa/ lha'i me tog gi 35

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshogs kyis khebs pa/ lha'i sil snyan yan lag bye ba brgya stong dang ldan pa rol mo mkhan mkhas pas blangs pa bas kyang lhag pa'i sgra snyan pa sgrogs shing 'bab pa/ 'dod pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i reg bya can 'gram gnyis rin po che'i spos kyi shing ljon pas gang ba sha stag ste/ de dag gi dri dang / dbyangs dang / me tog gi rgyan rnams kyang rnam pa sna tshogs pa yin no/ /klung de dag gi sgra dbyangs rnams ni zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ji ltar 'dod pa'i dbyangs su grags par 'gyur la/ sgra de thos par mi 'dod na ni de'i mod la zhi bar 'gyar ro/ /rdzing ba'i rgyan ni/ra༅ rabu'od mdor/ 'phags pa mi pham pa la dri ba mdzad pa'i skabs su/rdzing bu nyams dga' ba dag dang / zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / zhing bkod kyi mdo chung ba las gsungs te/ gzhi rin po che sna bdun las grub cing / gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/ chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas bya rog gis btung du rung bar gang ba/rin po che'i pad+mas khebs shing / phyogs bzhir rin po che'i them skas bkra ba dang ldan pa/ phyi rol rin po che'i ljon shing gi phreng ba spel legs pas mdzes par byas pa dag go /nags tshal dang chu'i gnas de dag tu de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i bya rnam pa sna tshogs sgra yid du 'ong ba can gyi tshogs rnams gnas par 36

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6trasheka/sungs te/ zhing mdo chung ba las/ de dag nyin re zhing dus gsum du 'dus nas bgro ba byed cing rang rang gi skad dag gis smra ste/ de ltar smra ba na dbang po dang / stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag gi sgra 'byung bar gsungs so/ /pad+ma'i rgyan ni/ rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+ma tshon sna tshogs can dpag tshad phyed kyi tshad tsam dang / dpag tshad gcig gi tshad tsam nas dpag tshad bcu'i tshad kyi bar du yod de/ de thams cad las kyang 'od zer bye ba sto nga phrag sum cu rtsa drug drug dang / 'od zer de rnams kyi rtse las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs dpal dang gzi brjid kyis 'bar ba bye ba stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug drug 'byung ste/ de dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams bgrang ba las 'das pa dag tu gshegs nas sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /gnyis pa la'ang zas kyi yo byad ni/ sems can de dag khams kyi za ba rags pa'i zas ni mi za mod/ 'on kyang kha zas kyi bye brag ji lta bu 'dod kyang de nyid de'i mod la rnyed par 'gyur te/ rnyed ma thag tu lus tshim par gyur nas zas kyi 'dod pa de dang 'bral bar bshad do/ / spos la sogs pa'i yo byad ni/ spos dang / phreng ba dang / byugs pa dang phye ma dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan rnams kyang 'dod pa tsam gyi mod la rnyed de/37

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de'ang yo byad de dang de'i khyad par ci 'dra zhig yid la 'thad pa de kho na bzhin du rnyed pa dang / des sangs rgyas kyi zhing de khyad par 'gyur ba de ltar zad mi shes par rnyed par 'gyur te/ yo byad de dag mngon par mi 'dod pa rnams la ni snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gos dang rgyan gyi yo byad ni/ gos kha dog tha dad pa/rin thang gzhal du med pa dag kyang bsam ma thag tu snga ma ltar rnyed cing / lus la rang bgos par 'gyur ba dang / rgyan gyi bye brag ci lta bu 'dod pa yang skad cig de la rin po che'i shing ljon pa rnams las rnyed de/ de dag gis bdag nyid brgyan par shes pa'o/ /gnas khang gi rgyan ni/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna tshogs kyi ba gam brgya stong gis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i khri lha'i ras bcos bu sna tshogs bting ba/ sngas khra bo bzhag pa dang ldan pa/ dbyibs dang / kha dog dang / chu zheng dang / mtshan ma ji lta bu 'dod pa de 'dra ba rnams sems can de dag gi mdun gyi sa gzhir rang 'byung ste/ de dag gzhal med khang de rnams su lha'i bu mo bdun stong bdun stong dang lhan cig 'dug nas rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /gnyis pa la/ rlung gi 'byor ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der snga dro'i dus sa phyogs bzhi nas rlung ldang ste/ de dag gis rin po ༄38

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6zheche'i shing ljon pa kha dog bkra zhing lha'i spos dri rab tu zhim pa sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa de dag bskyod cing bskul bas lha'i me tog rnam pa mang po'i dri yid du 'ong ba can/ blta na sdug la ka tsa lin da'i gos ltar reg na bde ba dag brul nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de mi 'greng bdun srid tsam du mnyam par khebs par byed de/de la rkang pa 'jog pa dang 'degs pa na sor bzhi tsam gyis dma' ba dang mtho bar 'gyur ro/ /spos dri sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa'i rlung de dag sems can de dag la phog na dge slong 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs pa lta bu'i bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / snga dro 'das ma thag me tog rnying pa de dag ma lus pa med par 'gyur te/ de'i 'og tu zhing de dben pa dang / nyams dga' ba dang / dag par 'gyur la de nas yang sngon bzhin du me tog 'grem pa'i rlung gsar pa dag ldang ste/ snga dro ji lta bar nyi ma'i gung dang / phyi dro dang / srod dang / nam gung dang / tho rangs kyang de bzhin no/ /char gyi 'byor ba ni/ dus dang dus su lha'i spos chu'i sprin gyi char dang / lha'i me tog kha dog thams cad dang ldan pa dag dang / lha'i rin po che sna bdun dang / lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi char mngon par 'bab pa dang / lha'i bla re dag dang / lha'i rin 39

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po che'i gdugs rnga yab dang bcas pa dag kyang nam mkha' la 'dzin cing / lha'i rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dag kyang sgrogs la lha'i bu mo dag kyang gar byed de/ /zhing 'dir char dang 'brug dang glog 'byung ba bzhin no/ /gzhan yang bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'khor rnams las sangs rgyas kyi mthus bde ba can gyi yon tan mngon sum du bstan pa'i thad kyi mdo las/ steng gi bar snang la kun dga'i ra ba nyams dga' ba dag dang / nags tshal dang /skyed mos tshal dang / chu klung dang / rdzing bu nyams dga' ba dang /'og min gyi bar gyi nam mkha'i ngos la rin po che'i me tog bkram pa'i 'byor ba dag kyang gsungs shing / zhing de'i sems can rnams gzhal med khang dpag tshad brgya stong yod pa dag tu zhugs nas bar snang la chags pa med par 'gro ba dag kyang yod par gsungs te/ nam mkha' la 'byung ba'i khang bzang sogs kyang yod la/ sa gzhi la byung ba'i de rnams 'dod pa'i dbang gis nam mkhar bgrod pa yang yod pa 'dra bas tshul gnyis so/ /de dag lha dang mi gnyis ka'i thun mong bar snang ngo / /gsum pa ni/zhing de'i mi rnams kyi gnas lus longs spyod kyang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i 'byor pa dang 'dra bar gsungs shing / mdo 'di las gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi mdun na/40

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6trazhe'akhror los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i spyan sngar mi ma rabs dang / mi dra ma 'dug pa bzhin du spa bkong bar gsungs pa'i/ sum cu rtsa sasum pa'i lha dbang che bar grags pa rnams kyi'ang gnas dang rgyan chas kyi dkar ba la zla ba ston gnam du shar ba'i kha dog gis bcu drug char yang mi phod par dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs te/'dod yon gyi rnam pa gzhan thams cad la'ang khyad par de ltar yod pas/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi rgyan phyogs re tsam yang phal ba'i mis ji bzhin du bsam par dka'o/ /zhing bkod kyi mdo sosas las rgyan gyi khyad par de ltar gsungs pa rnams kyang mtshon byed tsam du zad kyi/ rgyas par ni zhing de'i gzi brjid dang / kha doka dang / 'byor ba'i pha mtha' mngon sum du blta na lha'i mig dang ldan pas kyang mi rnyed la/ tshig gis bstan na sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa sha stag tu gyur pas bskal pa bye bar bsnyad kyang mi rdzogs par mdo nyid las gsung sa so/ / gnyis pa la'ang / bcud kyi yon tan spyir bshad pa dang /satso 'khor so sor phye nas bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/zhing de na lha dang mi'i 'gro ba gnyis las 'gro ba'i ris gzhan pa ni med la/ der skyes nas las dbang gis 'gro ba gzhan gsum du ltung ba yang med do/ /lha mi gnyis kyang ming gi khyad par tsam 41

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyis phye bar gsungs so/ /de na sgo nga dang mngal dang drod gsher las skye ba'i skye gnas ni med kyi/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i pad+ma yangs shing tshon sna tshogs pa reg na bde zhing dri bsung dang ldan pa rnams las brdzus te 'byung ngo / /sems can de dag ni gser gyi kha dog tu kha dog gcig pa dang / lus la mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis tshang ba dang / gshang gci dang snabs la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba dang bral ba dang / rdo rje ltar mkhregs pa'i lus can dang / sred med bu'i stobs dang ldan pa dang /sngar bshad pa'i dmigs bsal ma gtogs pa mngon par shes pa lngas rtse ba dang / shes rab dang spobs pa mtha' yas pa dang /smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs che'i tshad la mtha' mi mngon pa sha stag yin no/ /de dag la gnas dang yo byad yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'du shes ni cung zad kyang med de/ shin tu gya nom pa dang / rgya che ba dang / sna tshogs pa dang / 'dod pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'byor ba rnams la rang dgar rtse bas nyams bde zhing / rang bzhin gyis kyang ma dag pa'i zhing gi lha'i bde ba phal cher las 'das pa'i bde ba dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa la gtso bo de bzhin gshegs pa dang / nyan thos kyi 'khor dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bshad pa gsum las/ dang po la byang chub brnyes 42

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6pa'i gnas/ sku dang 'od kyi khyad par/ mdzad pa'i gtso bo 'jug tshul/ sku tshe phun sum tshogs pa/ snyan grags rgya che ba'i yon tan dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ zhing de'i sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na ston pa 'od dpag med kyi byang chub kyi shing yod de/de'i ming ni rin po che'i pad+mo rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba dang /de'i drung na pad+ma'i gdan yod pa'i ming ni/ dag cing bzang la bkra ba'i 'od zer can zhes bya ba yin par 'chi med rnga sgra las bshad cing / tshad ni dkon brtsegs las byang chub kyi shing 'phang dang rgya tshad dpag tshad stong drug brgya bar mnyam pa dang / rtsa ba'i sbom dang khru na dpag tshad lnga brgya yod par bshad la/ snying rje pad dkar las dpag tshad khrir gsungs te/ pad+ma'i gdan yang de dang 'tshams pa yin no/ /dkon brtsegs las tshad de ltar gsungs pa de'ang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba chung shos yan chad kyis mthong tshod thun mong ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin gyi/ khyab mtha' bzung ba min pa mdo rang gi chos kyi 'byang 'chi zi sna rtsar lag byer tshog laX gnas kya sman lam bstan pa' thad nas shas shang / sbyar da bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi byang chub kyi shing la yang rgya tshad mi 'dra ba du ma 'ong ba mi 'gal ba ni 'jug pa rtsa 'grel dang /dus 'khor 'grel chen sogs las rgya cher bshad pa'i rigs pas 43

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /mdo gnyis 'gal bar mi bsam mo/ /de la shing gi rgyal po de ni rtag tu lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bu chags pa/ mdangs lha rdzas las kyang 'das pa'i kha dog 'bum phrag du mas bkra ba/ lo ma dang / me tog dang 'bras bu'i bye brag tha dad pa/ 'jig rten na mchog tu bya ba'i nor bu rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ gser dang nor bu'i skud pa dang / se mo do dang / rin po che'i chun po dang / rgyan phreng dang /do shal dang ska rags mang po 'phyang ba/ gser dang / mu tig dang / rin po che thams cad kyi dra ba dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i dra bas bla re bres pa/ chu srin dang / bkra shis dang / g.yung drung 'khyil ba dang / zla gam lta bus legs par brgyan pa/ nor bu 'khrol ba dang / gser dang / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du legs par brgyan pa ste/ de rlung gis bskyod pa na sgra dbyangs snyan pa 'byung bas 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa go bar byed do/ /sems can gang gis sgra de thos pa dang / shing gi dbang po de mthong ba dang / de'i dri tshor ba dang / 'bras bu'i ro myong ba dang / 'od lus la phog pa dang / shing de yid la sems pa de dag byang chub kyi mtha'i bar du rna ba dang / mig dang / sna dang / lce dang /44

ra〉 〈co thabathesno rngaku byu5zug 3) stunakhung 95bzhi rngakubyugizugabazhi nga/:re tha//mazug/ 21rngad/ /(lus la nad kyis mi 'debs shing / sems mi g.yeng bar 'gyur ro//gzhan yang rgyal ba des chos ston pa'i gnas la/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa las/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i khang bzang zhes gsungs shing / don zhags kyi cho ga zhib mo sogs las kyang 'od dpag med rin po che'i gzhal med khang na chos ston pa'i bkod pa gsungs te/ de byang chub shing drung yin min sogs sasal bar bshad pa ma mthong ngo gnyis pa ni/ de na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med rdul med cing rnam par dag pa bzhugs te/ de'i sku ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dag cing gsal la mdzes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyis shin tu legs par phye bas/ sems can gang dag sis de dang por mig lam du snang ba dang / gzhan gyis lan brgya phrag du mar mthong ba gnyis 'dra bar mig dang yid tshim par mdzad pa yin no/ /drang srong chen po de ni 'od zer dpag tu med pa'i rgyan 'chang ba ste/ phyogs bcu'i phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag 'od des rtag tu khyab par gyur nas 'dug go /de'ang 'od di ma med cing shin tu gsal ba dang / sgrib thogs kyi dngos po ru 45

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thams cad la mi thogs pa dang / mdzes pa gting mi mngon pa'i phyir lta bas chog mi shes pa dang / mi'i dbang po dang lha'i dbang po nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bar thams cad zil gyis gnon cing mog mog por byed pa dang / lus dang sems bde ba dang /dga' ba'i bdud rtsis tshim pa skyed pa dang sems can dge ba'i bsam pa can rnams la dge ba dang yangs pa dang / rtogs pa dang / mkhas pa dang / blo dang / mchog tu dga' ba skyed pa dang /dkon mchog tā la dang / 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa las gsungs pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu'i khyad par dang ldan pa ste/ de dag gi phyir zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ri'i rgyal po ri rab ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nas mngon par 'phags te/ phyogs thams cad zil gyis mnan nas lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge mdzes pa/ zhes gsungs so//sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan so sor yang / de nyid las/ sems can snying po'i gzugs ni mtha' yas te/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gsung ni mtha' yas dbyangs/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab brtson 'grus kyang / /khyod 'dra 'jig rten 'di na gzhan ma mchis//zab cing shing tu rgyas pa'i chos brnyes pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog gi 46

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6trazhed+kuzhethugs ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /des kyang ston la khengs pa mi mnga' ste/ /tha ba zhe sdang spangs nas pha mthar sgrol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zhib tu bsam par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni/ lus can rgud pa sna tshogs kyis rgyun du gtse ba rnams la thugs rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas/ rgud pa de las skyob pa'i sgo bla na med pa rang gis gang zhig brnyes pa'i rtogs pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi nge nyid so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par bgo bsha' mdzad pa'i ched du yin la/ de ltar mdzad pa'ang lung gi chos bstan pa la nges par rag las par gzigs nas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa'i legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs kyi bdud rtsis rgyun mi 'chad du tshim par mdzad de/ 'di ltar gdul bya theg dman gyi rigs can rnams la ni thob bya thar ba tsam dang / thob byed rten gzhi nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang / brten pa tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab kyi bslab pa mdor bsdus pa las brtsams te chos ston cing / theg pa mchog gi rigs can rnams la ni thob bya bla na med pa'i byang chub dang / thob byed byang chub kyi sems rin po che snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can gyi bsam pa dang / des drangs pa'i sbyor ba 47
