pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/theg pa 'og ma dang thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa las brtsams nas shin tu rgyas pa'i chos 'chad de/ mdzad pa don yod pa bla na med pa brnyes pas chos bstan pa re res kyang gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can ma smin pa smin pa dang / smin pa grol ba dang / grol ba mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de'ang gdul bya rang rang gis chos kyi rnam grangs ji lta bu zhig nyan par 'dod pa de de'i mod kho na la thos par 'gyur bar zhing bkod kyi mdo las gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa la ni pham lhag sogs kyi bcas pa rnam par bzhag pa yang med de/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der ltung ba'i tha snyad bya sa tsam yang med par gsungs pa'i phyir te/ /dkon brtsegs kyi drug par mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing na ltung ba rnam par bzhag pa med tshul rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'dir yang ji bzhin du 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang de ni bslab pa'i gzhi ma rdzogs pa'i nyes par mi 'gyar gyi/༄bstan pa rnyog pa med pa'i yon tan du 'gyur te/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i gsung rab la yang bzang byin gyis bstan pa la chu bur ma byung ba'i sngon du pham lhag sogs kyi bcas pa mdzad pa med kyang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ches phun sum tshogs par 'dod pa yin no/ /48

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6trazheshergyal ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu 'jig rten du gsung rab mang po dang nyung ngu gnas pa ni gdul bya'i blo dang dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par la thug cing / zhing de'i gdul bya rnams ni shes rab dang spobs pa mtha' yas pa dang / dge rtsa 'thug pa 'ba' zhig tu bshad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa des ni mya ngan las 'das nas kyang gsung rab kyi mdzod ma nyams ma god par gnas par 'gyur bar mngon te/ 'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las kyang / rigs kyi bu/ 'od dpag med yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+ma dag dang shing ljon pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa des ji ltar chos ston pa de bzhin du chos kyi sgo brgya phrag du ma 'byung ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas mtshon no/ /bshad ma thag pa'i rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ zhing der ston pa 'das nas mdo'i don phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa dang / tshul khrims 'chal bar spyod pa la sogs pas bstan pa dri ma can du byed pa rnams kyang med par gsal te/ lung de'i gong nyid du/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de yongs su myang ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ ji ltar bzhugs pa de bzhin du yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 49

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'grub ste/ lhag chad med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / dkon brtsegs las kyang / kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na mi dge ba'i ming yang med do/ /sgrib pa'i sgra yang med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa la lnga brgya phrag bcu'i rnam dbye byas pa lta bu'i bstan pa dwangs snyigs kyi rim pa'ang med pa 'dra'o/ /bstan pa gnas pa'i yun tshad ni/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gnyis kyi bye ma snyed du 'ga' zhig bzhed de/ snying rje pad dkar las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying pos rje btsun spyan ras gzigs byang chub mchog tu lung bstan pa'i thad na/ rigs kyi bu khyod ni 'od dpag med yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas bskal pa grangs med pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gnyis pa lus pa na 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs pa 'di la bsam par snang yang mdo de'i don de ltar 'chad rgyu yin min dpyad dgos so/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las ni/ rgyal ba de mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir dam pa'i chos gnas par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sku che'i tshad ni bskal pa 'di snyed dang / bskal pa brgya phrag 'di snyed nas/ bskal pa 50

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6trabye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig tu bzhugs so zhes pa'i bar du brtsi tshul rgya che chung ji lta bu'i sgo nas gzhal kyang mtha' mi rtogs par 'od mdo las gsungs shing / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdor/ de'i sku tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi bar du bshad kyang rtogs par sla ba ma yin zhes brtsi ba'i yun tshad kyi sgo nas gsungs te/ mdor na dpag tu med pa yin no/ /de'i phyir rgyal ba'i dbang po de'i mtshan yang tshe dpag med ces bya'o/ /zhing der byang chub brnyes pa'i mdzad pa bstan nas da lta yun ji tsam 'das pa ni/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten 'di ba'i lugs kyi bskal pa bcu lon par 'od mdo las gsungs te/ phal chen che'i le'ur mi mjed kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gi yun tshad de bde ba can gyi nyin zhag gcig tu byed par gsungs pas/ zhing de pa rnams kyi ngor ni nyin zhag bcu las ma song bar gsal te/ dbyar gyi lang tsho thog ma la babs pa'i dga' ba lta bu'i tshod du snang ngo / /ston pa'i sku tshe da pag tu med pa 'di ni zhing gi 'byor ba ches mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ zhing rab 'byams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyun mi 'chad par 'du ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul sngon ma mthong ba mthong ba dang / byang sems lung ston pa la sogs pa'i 51

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dga' ston la nyin re bzhin spyod du yod pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i mthu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga ba ni/ thub pa'i dbang po de'i mtshan thos pa ni gdul bya la don chen po'i sgor 'gyur bar gzigs nas/ mtha' dang mu med pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyis rang rang gi zhing rnams su de'i snyan grags sgo du ma nas lan gcig ma yin par gsal bar mdzad par gsungs te/ zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ de'i mtshan de yang sgrib pa med par phyogs bcur grags te/ phyogs re re na yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gsung chags pa mi mnga' zhing gsung thogs pa mi mnga' ba gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag lan 'ga' ma yin par bsngags pa brjod cing bstod de/ snyan par gsung ngo / /zhes so/ /de don chen po'i sgor 'gyar ba'i tshal ni/ bcom ldan 'das de'i ra rabyematshan thos nas sems dang bas thal mo sbyor ba tsam la yang /gang gis phra rab rdul snyed 'jig rten khams/ /zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa 'thob cing /der ma zad bde ba can du skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khya ba pa la longs spyod pa'i rgyu ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams kyang / bcom ldan 'das de dang de'i zhing yongs su dag pa'i yon tan thos pa 52

khyotshan bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ porwaskrezi/ las byung ba sha stag go /gzhan yang mtshan de thos pa'i mod la byang chub kyi bar gyi tshe rabs thams cad du rigs mthon por skye ba dang / skyes pa'i dbang po 'thob pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang / rtag tu tshangs spyod la gnas pa dang / byang sems kyi spyod pa la dga' zhing mchog tu dga' ba dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bste bstang byed pa dang / gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang bzod pa'i sgo rlabs che ba rnams la sbyor ba dang /bla med byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gya nom pa skye tshul rgya cher gsungs so/ /de dag ni phyir rgyal ba'i dbang po de'i mtshan yongs su sgrogs pa ni sems can rnams la lha 'i rgyal srid byin pas kyang bsgrun du med pa'i phan btags pa dang / grangs med pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyi phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs byas pa dang / mgon po 'od dpag med la gdul bya'i skyes phul bar 'gyar ba'i tshul la ba sams te 'bad pa thams cad no༅ :she :de//bye) 1(dokyis bslab par bya yi/ skyi dag ma pa rgan dang rgan mo rnams la dgos kyis/ bdag cag lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa'am/mkhas pa ni de tsam la mi re zhes rang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'gro 'dul gyi thabs mkhas mthil phyin pa la go ba phyogs mthong tsam yang ma skyes par mna' bor nas/ de la rmad du byung ba'i 53

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyad par 'phags chos su sgom par ni mi bya ste/ de ltar byed pa ni dam pa rnams kyi mdun sar bzhad gad kyi phyir du rang gis rang la tho 'tshams pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de'i nyan thos kyi 'khor ni yongs su dag cing grangs mang bas 'phags te/ 'di ltar/ de na so skye'i nyan thos khyim gyi yongs su bzung ba la chags nas mngon par mi 'byung ba ni ye med de/ nga yir bya ba med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams sa skye ba'i phyir te/ sngar bshad zin to/ /thab pa'i ri ring riri shibacas mtshams 'dral bar byed pa yang med de/ snyigs ma med pa'i zhing gi nyan thos yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni dkon brtsegs kyi drug par mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing la sbyar nas gsungs pa rigs pa 'dra'o/ /brtson 'grus chung bas lam sgrub tu mi nus pa yang med de/ thams cad yang dag pa nyid la nges par gsungs pa'i phyir ro //zhing de'i byang sems kyi 'khor rnams skye ba gcig thogs su gsungs pa'i rigs pas/ nyan thos la yang lan bdun pa dang rigs nas rigs skye sogs med dam brtag go /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun yod kyang rigs skye sogs kyi rnam gzhag byar med pa mi 'gal ba ni mi 'khrugs pa'i 'khor gyi nyan thos thams cad mthong chos zhir gsungs pa bzhin no/ /nyan thos de dag gi grangs ni/54

ra〉 thab:do ngas byu5cad /) stunorngab 95bzhi rnganathegasbubathag nga/:re ba//mezug/ 21jid/ /(stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad rang sangs rgyas sha stag tu gyur pas bskal ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi bar du bgrangs kyang mtha' mi rnyed par gsungs te/ de'ang gcig gis gang bgrang ba de gnyis pas ma bgrang / gnyis pas gang bgrang ba de gsum pas ma bgrang ba de 'dra ba'i tshul gyis bgrang ba la dgongs so/ /der ma zad 'phags pa mo 'gal gyi bu chen pos stong gsum na skar ma'i gzugs ji snyed yod pa thams cad nyin zhag gcig gis bgrang bar nus te/ de lta bu'i rdzu 'phral dang ldan pa bye ba /sde ///tho //bye/ ༷||/khrag ga brgya nga snyed —sa lo bye ba khrag ga brgya stong du las gzhan mi byed par bcom ldan 'das de'i nyan thos 'dus pa dang po gcig pu bgrangs kyang bye ba brgya'i cha tsam yang rtsis kyis mi chod par gsungs so/ /de dag thams cad kyang 'od 'dom gang ba dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ dul ba dang nye bar zhi ba'i dpal gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dgod pa bzhin du byed do/ /gsum pa la byang sems 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / rgyal sras kyi 'khor spyir bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'od dpag med las rgyal tshab kyi cod pan blangs pa dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / mthu chen thob gnyis te/ go rim bzhin du sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i lta stangs sbyangs pa 55

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / rlabs po che'i thugs stobs mnga' ba'i cha nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying pos mtshan de ltar btags par snying rje pad dkar las so/ /de gnyis kyi sku'i 'od kyis ni 'a jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de ma lus par bkang ste gnas la/ byang sems kyi 'khor gang dag de gnyis las zhag bdun du 'dri ba'i lan nyan pa de dag de'i mod kho nar sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni skyes ba dam pa 'di ༄gnyis las sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i rgyal sras kyi tshogs kyis gang bar mdo gzhan las gsung sa so/ /de'i phyir de dag ni mnyam pa med pa'i gzi brjid kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa ste/ rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med bzhugs pa dang yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas skabs kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang na rab mchog tu bsngags pa yin no//gnyis pa ni/ zhing de'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi grangs ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma gtogs pa gzhan sus kyang bgrang ba'i rngo mi thogs par snying rje pad dkar las gsungs shing / zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tu brtsis kyang grangs kyi mtha' mi mngon pa de snyed kyi de bzhin 56

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6gshegs pa rnams kyi drung nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dag bde ba can du skye ba 'dzin par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i drung nas kyang byang sems bye ba phrag du ma 'gro bar gsungs so/ /de ni zhing gzhan nas shi 'phos te 'gro ba'i dbang du mdzad la/ mngon shes kyi mthu thob pa'i rgyal sras chen po rnams zhing dag pa'i 'byor ba gzigs pa dang / chos kyi dga' ston la rtse ba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyis 'du ba'i grangs ni de bas kyang ches mang ste/ ji ltar bdag cag gi ston pas blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo gsungs pa na gling bzhi ba'i 'jig rten 'di na rdzu 'phrul gyis chos nyan du lhags pa'i byang sems kho nas gang bar ma gyur pa'i sa phyogs 'khar ba 'dzugs sa tsam yang med par gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de la zhing der skyes pa'i byang sems rnams kyi lus kyi bongs tshod ni dpag tshad stong yin par snying rje pad dkar las te/thams cad kyang 'o da dpag tshad bye ba brgya stong pa 'ba' zhig tu zhing bkod kyi mdo las gsungs so/ /sngon the tshom zos pa'i nyes pas bsgribs pa rnams ma gtogs pa thams cad rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus rnam par rtse ba kho na yin te/ de dag snga dro re rer sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang por de bzhin gshegs 57

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa rnams la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byed du 'gro ste/ nam mkha' ltar yangs shing tshad med pa'i mchod pa/ 'jig rten thams cad ngo mtshar bar byed pa dag gis bsnyi stangs byed do/ /der de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams so so nas sngon gyi smon lam dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / chos bshad pa'i rnam grangs dang / mdzad pa'i sgo sna tshogs kyis khams dbang mos pa mi 'dra ba'i sems can ji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams mthong zhing legs par khong du chud nas zang zing med pa'i dga' ba rgya che zhing gya nom pa ches rmad du byung ba thob ste/ slar yang snga dro de nyid la rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can nyid du phyin par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i thad kyi 'od mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyis rlabs kyis yongs su zin pa dang / sngon chos mnyan pa byin pa dang /sngon gyi rgyal ba la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam 'byor zhing yongs su rdzogs pa dang / mi nyung ba dang / shin tu rnam par phye ba dang / shin tu bsgoms pas smon lam btab pa 'grub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ zhing de'i byang sems kyi 'khor phal cher de lta bu'i mthu ma thob pa med pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sngon smon dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthu yin zhes ston par mngon 58

ne thab:she rngaku byu5zud /) stunaspyang 95thag thabathegazugathag nga/:re tha//snozug/ 21rngan/ (3no/ /sngar bshad pa ltar de na byang sems yin min thams cad mngon shes lnga ldan du 'byung mod kyi/ 'od mdo las/ zhing mtha' yas par rdzu 'phrul gyis 'jug tshul 'di dag byang sems 'khor 'chad pa'i skabs kho nar rgyas bshad mdzad pa ni/ dkon brtsegs kyi mya ngan med kyis byin pas zhus par/ rgya mtsho chen po dang bum pa chus mi ngoms pa dang ngoms pa'i dpes gsungs pa ltar/ nyan thos ni rang gi don nyi tshe sgrub pa'i bsam pa can yin pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad med pa 'tshol ba lhur mi len pa la dgongs sam snyam mo/ /gzhan yang sems dpa' chen po de dag gi yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams der skyes pa de dag la gzhan gyi 'du shes med/ rang gi 'du shes med/ bdag gi 'du shes med/ 'thab pa med/ rtsod pa med/ mi mthun pa med/ mi mnyam pa'i sems med de/ de dag ni sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa dang / phan pa'i sems dang /byams pa'i sems dang / mnyen pa'i sems dang / 'jam pa'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / rab tu dang ba'i sems dang / brtan pa'i sems dang / sgrib pa med pa'i sems dang /'khrugs pa med pa'i sems dang / snyogs pa med pa'i sems dang 59

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa spyod pa'i sems dang /sems kyi rgyud sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la blo rab tu zhugs pa/ shes rab rgya mtsho chen po dang mnyam pa/ blo ri rab dang mtshungs pa/yon tan du ma bsags pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis mi gos pa'i phyir pad+ma dang 'dra ba/ chos dang chos ma yin pa mngon par sgrog pas dus kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'brug chen po dang mtshungs pa/ chos kyi chu'i char mngon par 'bebs pas char pa chen po dang 'dra ba/ tshogs chen po zil gyis gnon pas khya ༄mchog dang mtshungs pa/ sems shin tu mchog tu dul bas glang po che chen po dang 'dra ba/ shin tu dul bas rta cang shes bzang po dang mtshungs pa/ rtsal dang mi 'jigs pas skrag pa med pa'i phyir ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge dang 'dra ba/ sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pas shing gi rgyal po n+ya gro dha dang mtshungs pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi g.yo bas ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang 'dra ba/ byams pa tshad med pa bsgom pas nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi dbang du bya ba'i sngon du 'gro bas tshangs pa chen po dang 'dra ba/ gnas su gsog pa med pas bya dang mtshungs pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pas bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding dang 'dra ba/ 'byung 60

〈li rngan:she rngab byu5zud /) stunosprang khukhuthag thababyugazugathag nga/:re ba//tozug/ rjesprorngad/ (2bar dka' ba'i phyir u dum wā ra'i me tog dang mtshungs pa/glang po che ltar shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas rnam par g.yeng ba med pa/ dbang po rmugs pa med pa/ rnam par gtan la 'bebs pa la mkhas pa/ bzod pa dang des pa mang ba/ pha rol phun sum tshogs par smon pas phrag dog med pa/ chos kyi gtam rnams la 'jigs pa med pa/ chos yongs su tshol bas ngoms mi myong ba/tshul khrims kyis baiḍūr+ya dang 'dra ba/ thos pas rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang mtshungs pa/ zhes pa nas/ kun dga' bo mdor bsdu na/zhing de'i byang sems rnams ni 'di lta bu sha stag ste/ rgyas par bya na gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshe'i tshad bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du gnas pas bstan kyang skyes bu dam pa de dag gi yon tan gyi mtha' bstan par mi nus/ zhes pa'i bar du rgya cher gsungs so/ /de ltar snod bcud kyi yon tan bzang zhing rlabs che ba byang chub sgrub pa'i rjes su mthan pa rnams la dad pa spel ༄zhing / smon lam dang dge rtsa stobs ldan 'chi khar mngon du 'gyur nges su sbyangs la/ shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang /tshong dpon bzang skyong dang / bu mo zla ba mchog dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa sngon gyi byang sems dpa' bo chen po rnams kyi rjes bzhin du 'gro bar bya ste/ zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ gang 61

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gis 'od mdzad 'jig rten mgon/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong nas ni/ /gus dang bcas pas chos thos pa/ /de dag dga' ba dam pa 'thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i legs tshogs mtha' dag zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba 'dzin pa'i man ngag logs par bshad zin to/ /thub pa'i legs bshad nor bu'i gter kha dang / /zhing mchog bgrod pa'i lam srang ma 'khrugs pa/ /lhan cig dus mtha'i mun rum stug por yang / /'gro 'dis gsal por mthong ba bdag gis byas/ /tshul 'dir mdo don ji bzhin min bshad pa'i//nongs pa gang mchis rgyal la snying nas 'chags/ /dge bas lus can sdug bsngal chu gter las/ /'thon te 'od dpag med kyi gnas bgrod shog /bdag kyang mgo la sangs rgyas cod pan thogs/ /yid ni rnal 'byor dam pa'i bdud rtsis gang / /rab 'byams zhing du 'gro la mchog sbyin phyir/ /thogs med rgyu ba spyan ras gzigs 'drar shog /bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam dge ba'i lo thog spel byed dbyar skyes sprin chen glal ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/byang chub shing gi bshad pa yan chad gser 'phyang gi lor bris kyang / 'phro rnams snyoms 62

bde ba can gyi zhing las brtsams pa'i gtam/ pod/ 6khyelas kyi ngang la yun ring por lus pa las/ slar rang lo so bdun pa 'phar ba'i lo'i ston ka bkra shis kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i tshes la yongs su rdzogs par byas te/ theg pa mchog gi gsung rab la dad pa cung zad skyes pa'i skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas/ bkra legs mdangs chen gyi ri bo'i ngos/ nags tshal dga' ba can gyi mthongs/ dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba 'dis kyang sems can rnams kyi rgyud la 'od dpag med kyi smon lam ma lus pa bde blag tu smin par gyur cig /63

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄khya/ /'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga snying por dril ba rnam par thar ba rgya mtsho'i me tog gi sprin rab tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir 'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga snying por dril te nyams su len par 'dod pa dag gis/ thog mar gnas khang byi dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram pa dang / mchod pa ya yo med cing bkod pas mdzes par bshams pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya ba rnams sngon du btang nas/ tshogs zhing mngon du bya ba ni/ mtshan dpe'i sku mchog shin tu zhi ba ni/ /nyon mongs rnyog pa ngang gis dwangs byed de/ /gang gi yid ni dmigs pa der 'jug pa/ /de yi mdun na rgyal ba rtag tu bzhugs/ /rgyan rab bkod pa 'og min chen po'i gnas/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal bas yongs gang zhing / /grags chen rgyal sras rgya maspyo9) 'byor ba can/ /rnam kun rgyun gyis rtag pa'i 'khor lor rol/ /de dag 'od zer kun snang gzi brjid sprin/ /byang chub pad+ma'i rgyal po'i sprin tshogs can/ /bde dang dge ba'i bdud rtsi mchog sbyin pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sku yi cho 'phrul 'dzad pa med/ /gzhan yang rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed kyi//64

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 607sku dang zhing gi rnam rol mtha' yas te/ /de ltar chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i zhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi dkyil 'khor mu mtha' med/ /ye shes sgyu ma mkha' ltar rab zhi yang / /rgya chen smon lam thugs rje dam pa'i mthu/ /rim dang rim min sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /sems can khams la chu zla bzhin du snang / /de 'dra'i yon tan mchog tshogs mgon po rnams/ /mnyam pa'i chos nyid gcig tu dgyes rol bas/ /mkhas pa gang gis rnam 'dren gcig mchod pa/ /des ni thub chen kun la bya ba byas/ /de ltar rgyal ba de dag rjes dran zhing / /de snyed lus rnams rgya mtshor byin brlabs te/ /bsngags 'os rgyal kun dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gyis//bzang po spyod pa'i rnam thar rgyas par bgyi/ /zhes brjod cing don yid la dran par bya'o/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa'i dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rdul bral bsod nams brgya ba'i ye shes sku/ /phra rags phung po'i bdud las rnam grol zhing / /thub dka' sred med bu yi shugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje'i sku mchog brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yan lag rgya mtsho tshangs pa rnga sgra'i dbyangs/ /zil gyis mi non sgra kun rjes 'jug cing / /gsung gi gdangs rer chos phung kun rdzogs pa'i/ /yon tan dpag med dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba'i chos nyid rnam thar sgo gsum dbyings/ /shes dang shes bya ro mnyam 65

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshul gzigs kyang / /ji snyed chos kun mkhyen pa'i skabs mnga' ba//stobs bcu'i rgyal thabs gnon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag dang ma dag gdul bya'i zhing rnams su/ /mtshan dang sku yi rnam 'gyur tha dad kyang / /sems can gdul ba'i dbang du tshul gcig pa/ /zla med gzhan phan brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba kun gyi sras rnams dang / /rang rgyal slob ma dul ba'i dge 'dun tshogs/ /phyag 'os yon tan du mas mngon 'phags pa/ /de dag kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa mchod pa ni skabs 'dir sa bcad bco lngar phye ste rim bzhin/ 'chi ba med pa'i lam nas lding ba yi/ /sna tshogs mdzes sprin pad+mo'i sbubs 'gying ba/ /dag byed bum bzang 'dzin pa'i me na kas/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams phung por sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/oṃ kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ badz+ra wasta hūṃ/ lha rdzas yid bzhin drwa ba'i pad+mo mchog /'od zer me tog sprin gyi char 'bebs pas/ /ma lus zhing rnams rgya maspyo9re khyon 'geng ba/ /bsod nams sprin gyi rol mor cir yang 'jo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pū ri wa ra puṣ+pe pu tsa me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rgya che dpag bsam spos kyi ljon pa mchog /kun nas dga' ba rgya mtsho'i dri bsung can/ /spos rdul phye ma sna tshogs sprin 'phro ba/ /dpal ldan ngo mtshar 66

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6t+yābakod pa'i mchod sprin 'khrigs/ /oṃ sarba sogs/ dhubla pu tsa྾rin chen nyi zla nor bu'i sgron ma mchog /tshad med 'od zer rgya mtsho'i snang ba ches/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun mun pa'i go 'gog pas/ /rgyal dang de sras dgyes pa'i bsnyen bkur stob/ /a lo ke ྾/spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i byugs pa mchog /yid 'phrog dri rnams rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs shing / /zag med bde ba'i khyad par 'bum sbyin pa/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phung por zad mi shes/ /ghan+dhe྾/ phun tshogs ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas mchog /bza' bca' btung ba'i khyad par rnams mang po/ /bri dang gang ba med par 'byams klas pa/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba mchog gi rnam par rol/ /newi t+ya྾/ bstod sprin yan lag rgya mtsho'i rol mo mchog /sil snyan rnga sgra'i sprin gyi char 'bebs shing / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa'i sgra dbyangs brgyas/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten rgyas par 'gengs/ /shap+ta྾/ nor bu'i chun 'phyangs rgya mtsho mdzes bkod pa/ /'od kyis 'jig rten rnam par snang ba'i gdugs/ /rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon ltar rgya che zhing / /rgyal rnam sa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /ts+tsha tram̐ ka྾/ yid bzhin nam mkha'i rgyan gyur bla bre che/ /dril g.yer drwa ba brgya stong bres pa'i gzugs/ /kun bzang rnam mthar rgya mtsho'i tshul sgrog pa/ /sangs 67

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyas gtsug tor mdzes pa'i ngo mtshar rdzogs/ /bi tā rna྾/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba/ /rnam mang lha rdzas dar gyi lda ldi can/ /phyogs bcu zhing kun bsgreng ba'i rgyal mtshan sprin/ /chos dbyings mu mtha' med par 'byams su klas/ /dh+wa dza྾/ lha rdzas reg na bde ba'i gos mchog sprin/ /gzi ldan sgron me'i tshogs ltar rab 'bar ba/ /'dres dang ma 'dres rgya mtsho'i kha dog can/ /mtshan dpe sgyu ma mchog gi 'khor lor sim/ /wasta྾/gdu ba cod pan rna kor phreng ba sogs/ /sna tshogs nor ba bkod riri ༅ riri byepa'i rgyan mang po/ /rin chen me tog rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs shing //kun bzang mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor rab snang byed/ /a lam̐ kā ra྾/rnam mang dpag bsam ljon pa'i dga' tshal dang / /yid 'ong zla ba nor bu'i brag skyibs can/ /dka' thub gnas rnams rgya mtsho rnam phye ba/ /bsam gtan bde ba'i dga' ston sbyin pa'i dpyid/ /ba na ṣa māṃ྾/ gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen drwa ba can/ /glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bebs shing / /mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro ba/ /kun bzang smon lam rgya mtsho'i rol mor 'bar/ /pra sā da྾/ rlabs chen bsod nams sprin gyi 'jug pa can/ /srid zhi'i dge mtshan 'khyil ba'i bum pa bzang / /bsam yas 'dod dgu'i gru char rnam 'bebs pa/ /'og min sprul 68

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mash+ka me tog pod/ 64d+ku snyeba'i zhing kun bkrag pa'i rgyan/ /ni dhi kā la sha྾/ de nas mchod pa'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ mdor na bskal mang rgya mash+ka 'khor lo can/ /dus gsum rgya mtsho blo yis mi thug par/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur mchod sprin rgya mtsho kun/ /ma lus yongs rdzogs rnam thar rgya mtsho rgyan/ /zhing rnams thams cad 'gro 'ong med pa'i dbyings//rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo'i tshul 'jug pas/ /bde gshegs mchod pa'i 'dun khang re rer yang / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho mig 'phrul bzhin du snang / /lus rnams thams cad sgyu ma sprul pa'i rgyan/ /bri dang gang ba med pa'i tshul 'jug pas/ /gtsug gi bla ma rim gro'i gangs chen mtsho/ /ye shes me tog rgyal la lhag par mos//rdul rnams thams cad rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /snang dang stong pa mnyam pa'i tshul 'jug pas/ /sgyu ma'i rdul rer nam mkha' rgyas 'gengs pa'i/ mchod sprin bkod pa'i rgya mtsho bsam mi khyab/ /sgrib bral mar+ṣa pa gnyis ldan ye shes che/ /dmigs med byams pa/'i stobs mchog mtha' yas pas/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /phun tshogs rig dang brtse ba'i dga' ston phyo/ /bi shwa྾/ da ni yan lag lhag ma lnga'i nang tshan phung po gsum gyi tshigs su bcang pa bco lngar phye ba las dang po bshags pa ri/ thal mo sbyar te/ gang sngon tshe yi rgyud rnams rgya mtsho ru/ /kun rmongs nyes pa'i 'ching ba brtan 69

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyur pas/ /sdig to'i nongs pa mi bzad gang bgyis pa/ /de kun snying nas 'gyod pa mthol zhing 'chags/ /gang zhig spang na 'dren pa kun spong zhing / /bsten na byang chen lag rtser sbyin pa yi//mkhas pa'i bshes gnyen yon tan mig gcig pu/ /tshul bzhin mnyes par ma bgyis mthol zhing 'chags/ /bstan pa kun gyi nang nas snying po mchog /byang chub spyod pa rgya mtsho'i lam snang ba/ /don zab shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod chos/ /spangs pa'i nyes spyod che rnams mthol zhing 'chags/ /thub rnams bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid gsungs te/ /sems can zhing rnams rgyal ba ltar bsngags na//bdag gis de dag yongs 'dzin ma bgyis shing / /'khrugs dang gdung ba bskyed rnams mthol zhing 'chags/ /brtan pa rnams kyi pha rol phyin drug dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan snang rnam bzhi sogs/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho la/ /sgrib par gyar ༄ba'i las kun snying nas 'chags/ /gnyisapa yi rang ni/ ngan 'gro log par nges pa'i phung po rnams/ /spangs pa'i mtho ris ngal 'tsho la sbyor ba/ /chos dkar dge ba'i brtul zhugs mngon spyod pa'i/ /legs smon tshul khrims rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yi 'jug ldog la/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab kyis/ /srid las rnam grol zhi ba mchog sgrub pa'i/ /70

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 64nges 'byin thar lam rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas chos rtogs nas/ /sems can rgya mtsho rnam par dgrol slad du/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab gsog pa'i/ /theg mchog brtul zhugs rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /grangs med rgyal la blta dang chos nyan sogs/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi khyad par du ma yis/ /sgrib pa med pa'i gnas rab snang byed pa/ /sa bcu'i yongs sbyong rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /bdag don dag pa gnyis ldan sa brnyes nas/ /'bad rtsol spros pa'i 'jug ldang nyer zhi ba'i/ /gzhan phan srid pa ji srid mi 'gong ba/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa'i rgya mtshor rjes yi rang / /gsum pa bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/kang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing mang rgya mtsho ru/ /'jig rten sgron ma bskul ba'i sar gzhes pa/ /de dag rnams la bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye 'i/nga / /chos rnga'i sgra chen 'byin pa'i bskul ma 'debs/ /shing rgyal drung na rigs gsum mngon mdzad de/ /mi smra'i brtul zhugs la dgyes mgon po rnams/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun la sman slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul/ /bdag rtog mtshan ma'i spros pa rab gcod cing / /yang dag bden don rtogs pa'i snang ba can/ /rmad byung 'phags lam rgya mtsho'i chos 'khor che/ /rigs gsum mos pa'i nam mkhar rab snang mdzod/ /71

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gang gis 'jig rten mya ngan khang bu ru/ /mchi ma'i rgyun mang rab tu blag byed pa'i/ /mya ngan 'da' ba ston mdzad mgon po rnams/ /'gro sgrol 'khor ba ji srid gzhugs gsol 'debs/ /yid can rgya mtsho'i bsod nams zhing slad du/ /'dren pa mchog rnams sku tshe dpag med cing / /mtshan dpe'i mchod sdong mig gi bdud rtsi ru/ /spyod pa'i dge mtshan nyams pa med gyur cig /rjes su bsngo smon gyi rim pa ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba blo yul du bzhag ste/ bdag ni skye zhing skye ba'i phreng ba kun/ /rmad byung 'khor lo bzhi yi khyad nor can/ /dal 'byor yon tan rdzogs pa'i rten rnyed nas/ /sngon gnas tshe rabs rjes su dran gyur cig /'jigs rung 'khor ba me yi 'obs bzhin du//mthong nas thar ba 'dod pas yid drangs te/ /ston pa zla med rjes su rab 'byung zhing / /bslab pa rgya mtsho'i 'dun khang mdzes gyur cig /khyad par gsung rab lta ba'i mig sbyin pa/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes 'dzin zhing / /gdams ngag gsung gi bdud rtsi btung ba las/ /mi zad spobs pa'i gter chen rnyed par shog /thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs te / /than min skyes bu chen po'i nyams len gnad/ /bcos ma min niri mi//bye ma ri //re/ //sdu/ che/rdordopa ༄ byang chub gams 'byong nga / /rgyal sras spyod pa ni rgya mater 'jug par shog /shin tu zhi ba dben pa'i nags khrod du/ /rtse 72

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6gcig rnam g.yeng med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /lus sems las su rung ba'i mchog grub ste/ /'dod nyon 'ching ba ngang gis zhi bar shog /nyes kun rtsa ba 'gog pa'i thabs kyi mchog /stong dang rten 'byung zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas/ /sgrib pa lnga las 'das pa'i lhag mthong gi /rtogs pa'i nyi ma nang nas 'char gyur cig /chos la chos mig rdul bral rab skyes nas/ /byang chub don dam zab mo'i sems ldan zhing / /grangs med 'bum phrag bcu yi smon lam gyis/ /'phags pa'i sa nas sa mtho gnon gyur cig /de mthus rgyal ba'i sras kyi ting 'dzin mdzod/ /gzungs stobs mngon par shes dang yang dag rig /bsam yas brjod du med pa'i rnam par thar/ /grub nas lam gyi bgrod pa rdzogs gyur cig /mthar thug bla na med pa'i ye shes sku/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs rgya mtsho'i mdzod brnyes te/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum mthar phyin bden pa yis/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byor gyur cig /ces 'a dun pa rtse gcig tu bya'o/ /'di ni theg pa chen po'i mdo sde phal po che'i snying po bsdus pa/ yin pas don ji lta ba bzhin du bsam na rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam mtha' dag la nyams len byas par 'gro zhing gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi legs tshogs tshad med pa'i gangs chen mtshor 'gyur pa'i tshul la bsams te skal bzang rnams kyis yi dam du bya bar rigs so/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med bstan rgyam du 'bod pa'i ban de snyoms las pas rang lo nyer gcig pa sa skyong gi lo khrum stod zla ba'i yar tshes zla ba gro 73

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin gyi dga' ma dang rtse zhing drang srong ri ṣi 'char ba'i tshe bris shing spel ba maṅga lo/gang zag gzu bor gnas shing mdo sde mthong ba'i rnam dpyod can gyis dpyad na tshigs su bcad pa re re la'ang mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshul mang po zhig yod par shes par gyis shig /sarba dā kā l+ya ṇi bha ba tu/ /༄khya/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la na mo/ mchod sprin me tog rab 'byung gi 'phyong zur du bkol ba ni/ dang po gnas khang byi dor gyi tshe/ sems kyi rnyogs pa bgrungs shing lha rnams dga'/ /mdzes pa'i lang tsho rab 'thob mtho ris skye/ /rdul bral zhi ba'i mchog kyang 'dis sbyin te/ /las 'dir ngal ba bsten rnams don yod yin/ /zhes brjod de dkon mchog bla mar bya ba'i 'du shes bskyed nas bsang shing gi dud pas rdul mnan te phyag dar dngos la 'jug /de'i 'og tu spos chab dri zhim pos brlan la me tog sil ma bkram ste gud du mchod pa'i stegs bang rim can bla bre dang 'phan gdugs sogs kyis mdzes par dkon mchog gi rten bzhugs su gsol zhing mtha' bskor du spos dang mar me sogs mchod pa'i yo byad rgya cher bstar/ rang nyid stan bde ba la spyod lam zhi bas 'khod de/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lta bus skyabs sems bya/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab/phyag 'tshal gyi tshig shwa lo ka lnga po gang nus bskyar zhing phyag bya/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs dang rten 'brel snying pos gnas yo byin gyis brlabs te rol mo 'khrol/ khrus gsol kyi tshe bzed zhal du zhabs bsil sbreng zhing shabha'i skabs la sogs par rol mo spel bas kyang mchod/ mchod pa grangs gsog lta bur maṇ+ḍal kho nas don 'grub pas don bsdus rjes su tshom bu so bdun ma 'di nyid 'bul bar bya ste/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi byi dor legs par bya zhing ba byung gi dri lngas byugs bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi a waṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas me tog gi tshom ba zhig dkyil 'khor gyi dbas sa bzhag 1rwab/ rigazin riri mi rimi mi riri miste/ oṃ badz+ra re khā+e ā k+shi/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ dbyig mchog brgya las legs bris sa yi gzhir/ /ri rab rin chen lhun po lus 74

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6'phags gling / /dzam bu na dā'i gling dang ba lang spyod/ /sgra mi snyan gling bzhi yis rab brgyan pa/ /lus dang lus 'phags rnga yab rnga yab gzhan/ /g.yo ldan lam mchog 'gro dang sgra mi snyan/ /sgra mi snyan zla zhes bya'i nye gling bcas/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i phreng / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos lo tog tshal//gser sbyangs 'khor lo dri med nor bu'i mchog /bde sbyin bud med khyim bdag lha mig grub/ /cang shes glang po shugs 'chang dul ba'i rta/ /dmag mi rin chen 'dod 'byung gter gyi bum/ /phas rgol zil gnon ral gri pags pa 'jam/ /rab dga'i nags tshal yid rjes 'gro ba'i gos/ / mthu ldan mchil lham gzhal med khang ba bzang / /bde ba'i mal stan mtshan ma bzang po'i dung / /nyi ma zla ba nor bu'i gdugs mchog dang / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ /lha mi'i 'byor tshogs yid bzhin sprin phung can/ /'dzad pa'i pha mtha' yong ye mi dmigs pa/ /lhag par mos so ting 'dzin yid kyi 'phral/ /thags rjes bzhes ༄ ༄shig mgon po sras dang bcas/ /bzhes nas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /i rda gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kai nir+ya ta ya mi/ zhes tshom bu rnams gsal zhing mdzes par bkod la phul/ spro ba bskyed pa'i yan lag tu phan yon gyi tshigs su bcad pa ni za ma tog lta bu'i gtam dang sems rin po che rnam par sbyang 75

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i phrin yig sogs nas 'byung ba rnams don la khyad mi snang zhing / de nyid mthong ba'i lam las lhag po gcig kyang gsungs pas 'dir de rnams bsdom na/ ba yi lci ba chur bcas sbyin pa yang dag byi dor tshul khrims dang / /srog chags phra mo'ang bsal ba bzod pa bya ba nyer gnas brtson 'grus te/ /skad cig de'i sems rtse gcig bsam gtan ri mo mdzes 'bar shes rab nyid/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bgyis pas pha rol phyin drug 'di dag thob 'gyur la/ /kha dog gser du 'gyur zhing nad kun las ni rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag 'gyur dang zla ba lta bur mdzes pa 'bar /'byor ldan rgyal rigs gser gyi tshogs mang bde gshegs mchod pa'i khyim du skye/ /rdul dang thal ba shin tu rnam spangs sangs rgyas zhing mang 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa phyi ma gnyis la 'phri bsnon cung zad bgyis pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyi 'jam dpal mchod chog nas byung ba'i tshig yin la/'di dag maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes su klog par dze ta ris bshad cing / 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir sngon du btang yang mi 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang rgyas par skyed na yan lag bdun po re re nas gzhung tshig dang bzang po spyod pa'i tshigs bcad spel mar bya bas mtshon te shes nus so/ /zhes snga sor rang lo nyer gcig par mchod gzhung dkyus ma tsam bris pa las slar yang kha skong maṇ+ḍal gyi 'phyong 'di me phag zla 3pa'i nyer gsum la spel ba'o// //gyi/ /bde ba can du skye ba 'dzin pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa zhing mchog bgrod pa'i bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ bde chen zhing chog mdor bsdus byed na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snang brnyan dang 'od mdo'i glegs bam sogs rten gsum gyi mdun/ 'byor ba dang bstun pa'i mchod pa gang 'byor bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ sras 76

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6sgezhe bcas rgyal ba'i bsod nams phung po dang / /sgrib bral chos dbyings zab mo'i bden mthu yis/ /phyogs 'dir nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'byor ba ltar/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing mdzes gyur cig /mchod pa'i sprin gzungs bzla/ mi mjed 'jig rten 'di nas nub phyogs su/ /sangs rgyas zhing mang 'das pa'i pha mtha' na//rgyal sras smon lam gaṅga'i rdul snyed dang / /rgya chen bsod nams ye shes phung po las/ /grub pa'i zhing mchog phul byung bde ba can//'a sa mthil ltar mnyam tha gru kun nas yangs/ /rin chen ri bo nor bu'i nags tshal dang / /lha rdzas me tog tshal dang bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /dbyangs snyan spos chu'i chu klung 'bab pa dang / /nam ma/khar rgyu ba'i gzhal med khang pa sogs/ /gzhan 'phrul 'chi med dga' ba'i grong khyer ltar/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i khyad par 'byams klas pa'i/ /snying po byang chub shing rgyal mdzes pa'i drung / /rin chen seng khri pad+mas brgyan pa'i steng / /sa gsum chos kyi rgyal po nyag gcig pu/ /snyan grags chos kyi dbyings mthar khyab pa yi/ /mgon po 'od zer dpag med tshe mtha' yas/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zhing / /ri rab rgya mtsho che las 'thon pa bzhin/ /rnam mang 'khor gyi nang nas mngon 'phags te/ /bsod nams nyi ma brgya ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /rab 'byams zhing 77

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gi dkyil 'khor 'geng bzhin du/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i yan lag yongs rdzogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis sgra kun zil mnan nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob pa ste/ /rgyal sras 'khor gyi gtso bo rnam gnyis sogs/ /zhing der pad+mo'i skye gnas bzung ba dang / /sangs rgyas zhing mang dag nas lhags pa yi/ /dag pa'i 'khor la gdams ngag ston cing bzhugs/ /gzugs sku bde chen zhing nas mi g.yo bzhin/ /mkhyen brtse ris med gdul bya'i rjes zhugs pa'i/ /rgyal dang de sras spyod yul bsam mi khyab/ /dpang du bgyis nas gsol 'dir brtse bas dgongs/ /zhes tshogs zhing mngon du byas pa rtse gcig tu bsgom/ de nas langs la kha nub tu blta bar 'od mdo las gsungs pa bzhin byas nas phyag 'tshal bzhin du/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /'od dpag med mgon zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing / /byang chub snying po ji srid skyabs su mchi/ /lan bdun brjod/snying rje'i mnga' bdag rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu chen thob sogs rgyal sras rgya mtsho dang / /bgrang yas slob ma dul ba'i dge 'dun la/ /gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ lan bdun nam gsum brjod/ mchod yon me tog bdug pa mar me dri/ /zhal zas sil snyan la sogs dngos bshams dang / /gzungs rig 78

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6mos pa las byung mchod pa'i sprin/ /nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te gus pas mchod/ /'khor tshe thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung bgyis so 'tshal/ /gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags slan chad kyang / /mi bgyid sdom sems brtan po yang dag bzung / /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das rang gzhan gyi/ /dus gsum dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang / / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma gang bzhugs rnams/ /bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /lhar bcas skye rgu'i mgon por yun ring du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'de bas/ /'dis mtshon dge bas ma rgan sems can kun/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes la 'god shog /ces tshogs bsags/ slar yang snyim pa me tog dang bcas te/ 'od mdzad stobs bcu mnga' ba sras bcas kyi/ /mtshan mchog brjod dang phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus/ /gang zhabs dran pas byang chub mtha' bar du/ /dbang po tshang zhing rigs mthor skye ba dang / /bad med mi 'gyar 'jig rten no༅ ra kun gyis bkur/ /'chi tshe bde gshegs 'khor bcas mdun bzhugs shing / /skye ba kun tu tshangs spyod dngos po thob/ /rtag par byang chub spyod la dga' ba dang / /gzungs dang ting 'dzin bzod la yang dag sbyor/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon 'jog pa 79

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs/ /mdor na rgyal sras chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung / /zhal bzhes smon lam 'gyur ba mi mnga' dang / /gzhan yang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs/ /rgyal sras so so'i sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang / /bden gzigs nyan thos che rnams bden pa dang / /gzungs dang mdo sde'i phan yon tshad med pa'i/ /dbang du mdzad nas deng 'dir bdag cag rnams/ /gnas skabs tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med cing / /mi dang mi min 'jigs pa kun las grol/ /dpal 'byor snyan grags gang gā'i rgyun ltar 'phel/ /shugs drag bcos ma min pa'i thar 'dod dang / /gzhan phan snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed dang / /'khrul med nges don rtogs pa'i lta ba sogs/ /theg mchog lam gnad rdzogs par rnyed pa dang / /tshe 'phos bde ldan zhing du skye bas mtshon/ /ji ltar smon pa'i re 'bras yid bzhin du/ /gegs med 'phral du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes me tog nub phyogs su 'thor/ de nas sems bskyed blang ba ni/ ji ltar bde gshegs khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /yongs dag zhing dang 'khor dang mdzad pa dang / /mtshan dang sku tshe dpag med ci 'dra ba/ /bdag kyang ma 'ongs de 'drar 'gyur bgyis nas/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i mar gyur rigs drug 'gro/ /'jigs rung srid 80

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6pa'i chu bor bying ba rnams/ /zhi 'gog bdud rtsi'i dbyings su dbags 'byin pa'i/ /sems mchog bskyed do mi nyams 'a phel ༄gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ sems bskyed 'dzin lugs 'di ni las dang po pas kyang byar rung bas 'jug pa bde ba zhig yin no/ /skabs 'dir 'od dpag med kyi gzungs ring thung ci rigs pa bzla zhing / spro na 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyis bkod pa'i mdo'ang klog /rtse gcig bzlas pas rgyal ba 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul sku las 'od zer byung / /rang gzhan sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi byas nas/ /smon don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzungs bum yod na 'od zer bsdu 'bebs kyi dmigs pa dang sbrags nas/ slar yang gzungs ci nus bzla zhing rang gzhan la khrus bya/ gang ltar yang rjes la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ sho lo ka gnyis po tshar re dang / yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin btang mthar/ gdan 'dzoms rgyal ba sras bcas spyan snga ru/ /phyag mchod thugs dam bskul sogs bgyis pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gnas skabs bsam pa kun 'grub cing / /mthar thug rdzogs byang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ga/zhan yang ris med rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan dgra nag phyogs rgol ba mtha' dag zhi/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa'i mgon rnams zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan rtsa dge 'dun 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de mthus yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde zhing skyid/ /81

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ skye rgu thams cad legs lam dpal la spyod/ /phun tshogs rdzogs ldan zla ba gsar 'char ba'i/ /dge mtshan sa gsum snang bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhesagasol ba btab/ gang 'dir bdag cag sbyor ba dman pa dang / /de bzhin rdzas dang bsam pa ma dag sogs/ /nongs zhing 'khrul pa ci dang ci mchis pa/ /brtse ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar snying nas 'chags/ /zhes nongs bshags dang / de ltar legs gsung mdo yi rjes 'brangs te/ /zhing mchog sbyong ba'i cho ga tshul bzhin du/ /bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams zla ltar dkar ba des/ /'gro kun bde chen zhing du skye bar shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i 'du byed sdud pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs sku yi snang ba legs shar nas/ /de mthas na gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byang zhing / /dga' dang spro ra mi — ri'i ba'i ngang la 'pho bar shog /shi 'phos skye srid gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bde ldan zhing du pad+ma'i snying po las/ /brdzus te skyes nas rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /dus kun mthong ba'i rab dgas 'tsho bar shog /de las zab dang rgya che'i gdams ngag gi /bdud rtsi thob nas rgyal sras mchog rnams dang / lhan cig theg mchog bgro ba la dbang bas/ /thos pa'i chu gter nyin bzhin 'phel bar shog/skyes ma thag par mngon shes stobs thob ste/ /bsam yas zhing du sangs rgyas blta ba dang / /ba snyen bkur bya phyir thogs pa med rgyu 82

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6zhing / /rgyal ba kun gyi chos mdzod 'dzin par shog /rlabs chen zhing gi 'byor ba mthong nas su/ /rnam dag smon lam de 'dra'i rjes slob cing / /ma dag zhing du rgud pas nyen pa yi/ /'gro kun sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dren par shog /mdor na sa bcu lam lnga'i spangs rtogs kun/ /phul byung zhing gi khyad par la bsten nas/ /mthong ba'i chos la mig 'phral bzhin bgrod de/ /zla med mgon ༄po khyod 'drar 'gyur bar shog /ces dang smon lam gzhan yang bklag par bya'o/ /tshar grangs gsog na tshogs bsags dang gsol 'debs kho na la tshar grangs bzung yang rung mod/ cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa la grangs bzung na bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi cha tshang ba'i steng nas nus pa thon par snang bas shin tu legs/ de ltar zhag bdun la sogs par rtse gcig tu 'bad na nges par bde ba can du skye ba'i tshul ni dri ma med pa'i lung dang rigs pa las shes par mdzod cig /ces tshig nyung la 'dril bas khyer bde/ don 'dus la gsal bas go sla/ gdul bya mchog dman med pas sgo yangs/ khungs mdo sde dang 'brel bas byin rlabs che/ phyag len bltas chog tu bkod pas 'jug pa bde ba'i 'od chog 'di yang blo gsal bstan 'dzin gyis dar dkar gyi skyes dang bcas te bskul ba ltar/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas lcags stag dbyug pa'i nya ba'i thun gseng du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// //༄/ /bde ldan dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can/ /smon lam dpung pas 'dzin bzod 'od dpag med/ /mos pa'i yid la mngon sum rab byas te/ /bde chen zhing gi cho ga'i tshul 'di dbye/ /de'ang 'phags pa da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang ste/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams yid la bya ba'i tshul chog khrigs dang bcas pa 'god pa la/ thog mar mdun du 83

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'od dpag med kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur ci ltar rigs pa bshams pa'i spyan sngar mar me sogs mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs bstar legs su bkod/ de nas bdag nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i byams pa chen po mngon du bzhag cing de bzhin gshegs pa de yid la byas te tshig 'di skad ces/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la byang chub snying po'i bar du rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi'o/ /lanagasum/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang rin po che mngon du bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyis brten pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yid la byas te byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho yongs su bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho grangs med pa mnga' ba rnams kyi rnam par grol ba'i phung po lnga shin tu mthar phyin pa'i bden pa dang /84

tra 'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mcho1) me tog pod/ 6bden pa'i tshig 'dis deng bdag gis mchod rdzas su bstar ba'i mchod yon la sogs pa 'di dag 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i sprin bkod pa bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu khyab cing zad pa'i mtha' mi mngon pa yid bzhin rin po che'i gter du 'byang bar gyar cig ces brjod cing //༷////de/ ri ri niri mi10de/ /rdore/ /byebye/ma chod pa sken gzungs gsum mam bdun brjod/ / nas nga khams ba na par bucas pa yid la bya ba'i tshul dngos ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ chos thams cad rang bzhin rnam par dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi klong las ma g.yos bzhin du dag chen rten 'byung gi snang char de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam las sprul pa'i zhing khams rmad du byung ba bde chen pad+mo bkod pa shin tu tshad med cing smon lam mtha' yas pas mngon pa/ra 'phags pa/ bde ba'i rgyu'i tshogs grangs med pa dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang mi khom pa'i sgra thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ gzhi kun tu mnyam zhing rin po che rnam pa du mas yongs su gang ba/ lha'i spos kyi chu dri rab tu zhim pas phyogs thams cad legs par bgos pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing sna tshogs nga/sa brgyan cing gser gyi dra bas khebs pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyu las grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa kun tu rgyas pa/ pad+ma de dag las kyang 'od zer kha dog tha dad pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya 85

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stong du ma 'tsher ba/ phyogs tha dad pa dag nas 'bab pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu klung yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas gang ba/ chu klung de dag gi sgra dbyangs lha'i rol mo chen po'i sgra skad las kyang mngon par 'phags shing chos zab mo rab tu 'byung ba/ theg pa chen po mchog gi gtam ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i bya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa nam mkha'i lam nas lding zhing 'gro ba/bsod nams kyi gzi brjid chen pos khyad par 'phags pa'i lha dang mi'i tshogs kyis rnam par brten pa/ de'i dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams las byung ba'i byang chub kyi shing 'phangs su dpag tshad stong dang drug brgyas spags shing / 'dab ma dpag tshad brgyad brgyar 'phyangs pa/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pa rtag tu chags shing kha dog tha dad pa bkra ba/nor bu rin po che'i drwa bas bres pa/ dar gyi lda ldi dang mu tig gi rgyan phreng du mas 'phyang ba/ lus dang sems dga' ba bskyed pa'i 'od zer grangs med pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ sangs rgyas kyi seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rang bzhin can gyi nye logs na gnas pa/de'i 'gram na ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pa mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan zhing bsod nams chen po'i dpal 86

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6gyis lhang nge lhan ne lham mer 'phags pa/ nor bu rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar gzi brjid kyi dpal rab tu 'bar ba/'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab ma brgya ba ltar rgyas pa dri ma med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ zhabs zung mnyam pa'i skyil krung gis rin po che seṅge'i khri la bzhugs shing chos gos rnam pa gsam gyis mdzes ༄par klubs pa/ lus dang sems dga' ba bskyed cing chos kyi snang ba chen po kun tu ster ba'i 'od zer bye ba phrag 'bum du 'phro ba/zab cing rgya che ba'i tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi rgyud zad mi shes pas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dun par mdzad pa/ de'i 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dang / mthu chen thob pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i gang zag tshad med cing dpag tu med pa/de dag kun kyang sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa la mnga' dbang 'byor ba/ blo ri rab ltar brtan zhing shes rab nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/sems can gyi khams smin par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa tshad med pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ yon tan mtha' yas shing mu med pa sha stag go /de ltar bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag med 87

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ pa sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dran zhing yon tan yid la byas te 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'dun pa'i shugs gtong ba dang bsod nams kyi sgo 'phar ji ltar bya ba de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyis sngon gyi smon lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa deng bdag la mngon sum du 'gyur ba ci gnang / zhes brjod cing bsam nas yun ring por dmigs pa de kho na la nan tan bya/ de nas spro na phyag dang mchod pa bya ste/ gang zhig lus pa med pa'i sems can khams/ /bskal pa du mar snying rjes rab bzung ba/ /de dag don slad bla med byang chub che/ /mngon mdzad 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gang dag sdug bsngal mtshor ltung zhing / /rnam mang mya ngan nad kyis rab gzir ba/ /de dag don phyir zhing khams bde ba can/ /smon lam skal pas bzung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis chos kun mnyam pa nyid gzigs shing / /mnyam pa'i chos nyid mngon sam ma gyar pa'i/ /rabye ༄shi'agro bar sna tshogs thabs kyis chos ston pa/ /mnyam nyid don ston de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin pa'i thabs mkhas mchog brnyes shing / /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam mthar phyin te/ /bde ldan zhing na mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /rdzogs smin sbyangs pa mthar son der phyag 'tshal/ /tshul khrims ting nge 'dzin gyis 88 ji

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6byin brlabs pa'i/ /khyod mtshan rna bar lan gcig grags pas kyang / /mtho ris bdud rtsi'i sgo mo rnam dbye ba/ /'dren pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsol dang rtog pa'i 'ching ba brtul zin kyang / /rtsol med lhun grub chen po'i phrin las kyis/ / nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba'i don spyod pa/ /mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen sems de sogs/ spyod 'jug las byung ba'i mchod phreng snyan la dal bar brjod/ de nas 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs/bzang spyod kyi yan lag phyi ma lnga'ang 'don/ de nas mtshan sngags bzla bar 'dod pas/phal byang ye shes rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' klas gzags sku'i ni mi rig mi rir mirol mor snang mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs 'od dpag med pa rjes dran gyis/ /bdag yid 'phags pa'i lam la bsgyur du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i blo bzhag ste/ /lha khyod mos pa'i yul du rab byed na/ /snying la ye shes snang ba 'bum stsol zhing / /byin rlabs mchog gi dus ston sbyin mdzod cig /'gro la bdud rtsi'i chos char ngas ster zhes/ /khyod kyis sngon smon phul byung gang btab pa/ /de dag de ring bdag la mngon sum du/ /snang ba'i 'phrul chen myur bar 'du mdzod cig /ye shes nyi ma 'bar ba'i byin rlabs gzis/ /bdag yid sgrib pa'i mun nag bsal mdzad de/ /'phags lam yan lan brgyad kyi me tog tshal/ /'dzum pa'i 89

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dga' ston cir yang snang bar mdzod/ /cesabarjod/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ thun mthar/ mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing rnams kun/ /phul byang mchod pa'i ༄sprin gyis rab bkang ste/ /bla ma 'od dpag med pa sras bcas mchod/ /'gro kun bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā bo dhi satwa ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shabha pū tsa ho/ mtha' yas zhing na rgyal dang rgyal sras tshogs/ /gang gi yon tan bsngags pa lhur bzhes pa'i/ /'dren pa stobs bcu'i dbang phyug 'od dpag med/ /'phags tshogs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /cesabarjod nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdul bral shin tu rnam par dag pa sogs/ bde ba can gyi smon lam gdab/ de rjes bkra shis brjod pas mtha' bsdu ba tsam ma gtogs bsdu rim sogs mi dgos te/ de ni da ltar gyi zhing khams bde ba can yid la byas pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du bgrod pa'i thabs/ /don zab mdo yi rjes su 'brang ba 'dis/ /srid na bkra shis snang ba stong stsol zhing / /sa gsum dge legs mchog gis khyab byed shog /ces pa'ang btsun pa tshe phyug gi ngor/ sprang smyon 'jigs med pas gang dran mgyogs bris su byas pa'o/ /dge'o// //༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang yang dran no zhing khams bde ba can/ /snying nas dran no 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /rtse gcig dran no rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 90

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6zhe'akhor/ /byin gyis rlobs shig skyabs med skyob pa'i tshogs/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid mgon po khyed rnams la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor bzhin mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /bdag gis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /sang sa rgyas zhing khams yongs su sbyong ba yi/ /rnam thar smon lam rgya mtsho rdzogs gyur cig /'dis mtshon dge bas bdag sogs yid can kun/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can/ /rmad byung ngo mtshar bkod pas rab mdzes par/ /skyes nas theg mchog dga' ston myong bar shog /ces pa'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen o ṭi ya na'i ngor 'jigs med pas so//༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang mtshan grags pa dkar po'i ga bur rdul/ /mtha' yas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i khyon yangs por/ /rna lung dpyangs pa'i mod la srid pa'i smag /skrag mdzad 'od mtshan stong 'bar la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis grangs med bskal ba'i sngon rol nas/ /bgrang yas byang chub spyod pa'i khur bzung nas/ /'phags pa'i smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthar son pas/ /bde ldan zhing khams bzung la phyag 'tshal lo /91

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gang dag nga yi ming tsam thos pa yang / /phun tshogs dag pa'i zhing der drang bya zhes/ /bden gsung seng ge'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags mdzad pa'i/ /thugs bskyed bden pas bdag sogs skyong mdzod cig /sangs rgyas gaṅga'i bye snyed du ma'i zhing / /yon tan phung po bsdus 'dra'i 'jig rten khams/ /bde ba can zhes mngon brjod ma 'khrul pa/ /der ni bdag cag smon pa'i sgo 'phar phye/ /lag mthil ltar mnyam yid bzhin bkod pa'i zhing / /rin chen dbyig brgya'i lid kyis rnam sgegs shing / /man ra ba'i 'khyad mos nyer ((35 rwa pare riri byebacings pa/ /bde ldan dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog /lha rdzas rin chen ljon pa'i gar stabs dang / /spos chu'i chu klung 'bab pa'i snyan 'gyur glu/ /'gran pa bzhin du kun nas snang ba'i dpyid//bde ldan dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i gnyis skyes gzhon nu yang / /'phags pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs las/ /dam pa min pa'i glu ru mi mdza' ba'i/ /bde ldan dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog /sdug bsngal 'jigs pa'i ming yang mi grags shing / /bde ba'i rgyu tshogs nam yang 'dzad med pa'i/ /zhing gi yon tan sus kyang gzhal dka' ba/ /bde ldan dag pa'i zhing der skye bar shog /gang na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i 'dren pa mchog /kun gzigs skyob pa mtshungs med 'od mtha' 92 nga

'phags tshogs mchod pa'i cho ga rnam thar rgya mtsho'i me tog pod/ 6t+yāyas/ /blo mchog sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ /lta ba'i skal bzang snang ba rnyed gyur cig /kun shes bzod pa thob cing rigs pa brgyas/ /chos nyid zhi ba rtogs pa'i ye shes can/ /rgyal sras tshogs mchog 'du sa pa'i lha gral du/ /bsod nams gzi brjid chen po'i mthus gnas shog /mdor na kun bzang spyod pa rmad byung bas/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob nas slar/ /rdzogs smin sbyangs pa'i yon tan mi zad pas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang don gnyer can blo ldan dang lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma dag gi ngor sprang smyon 'jigs med pas gang dran rdol thabs su smras pa'i yi ge pa ni shākya'i btsun pa 'jigs med bzang pos bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /93

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ / bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad blo gsal dga' ba'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs/brtan ma bcu gnyis bzhi tshan gsum du byed tshul la/ mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang grags che ba ni/ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan lha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /zhes dang /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /kha rag khyang btsun rdo rje ༄dpal gyi yum/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang / /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /zhes dang / kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun ugs chos rdo rje g.yar mo gsil/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sman mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de dag gi cho dang 'brang smos na/ lugs mang yang / grags can gcig bshad na/pha gnam gyi rdzi skan dang / ma nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud 94

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6zhemo bzhi/ pha gnam gyi glog chen dang / ma dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin mo bzhi/ pha gnam gyi skya 'od dang / ma dkar sham bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo sman mo bzhi ste mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi zab gter sogs nas bstan no/ /'di dag spyi'i gtso mo ni bkra shis tshe ring ma yin par nyang gter brtan ma'i mdos chog sogs las bshad/ 'di dag ni bod kyi yul bdag ches che ba ste/kater bdag gling pas brtan ma'i dbang bshad du/ ngo bo ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro/ /rnam pa dam tshig gi ma mo/ phrin las myur mgyogs kyi pho nyar grub pa/ dam can brtan ma bcu gnyis su grags pa 'di nyid/ nges pa'i don du dpal chen po he ru ka'i bka' 'khor du gnas shing / dkyil 'khor yongs kyi srung ma/'e/sa pa nas/ spyir bod khams sde dang bcas pa mtha' dag dang /khyad par gsang chen bstan pa'i snying po de 'dzin dang bcas pa gces pa'i bu bzhin du skyong zhing / phrin las rnam pa bzhi la thogs pa med pa'i mthu can/ nang du snying nye la bkra shis pa/ phyi ru rno myur tshan che ba/ rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i dbang gi rgyal po lta bu/ zhes dang / tshul bzhin du mchod na/ snyigs ma'i dus su bod yul gyi ljongs 'dir thub bstan spyi dang khyad par o rgyan chen po'i sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa 95

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams gces par skyong ba dang / chos bzhin spyod pa rnams kyi 'dod pa'i phrin las sgrub pa la/ rang gi dam tshig srog tu gyur pa nyid kyis mthu dang byin rlabs gzhan las myar ba'i phyir nan tan 47 char ming ra༅char 05du bslab / /zhas gsungs shang / bla ma sa chan byas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis 'di dag la mchod gtor byed pa mnal lam du gzigs nas/ de phyin gtor 'bul ma chags par mdzad ces 'byung ngo / /gnas nyer bzhi na brtson 'grus chen mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/de dag sngags rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gnas chen du 'dod pa ltar/ bod kyi yul 'dir rtag chags su bzhugs pa'i sngags bla med kyi rnal 'byor ma chen mo ni 'di dag yin te/ gter phyogs khungs ldan ches mang por 'di rnams phyi nang gi dus sbyor dag pa dang / bden don bcu gnyis kyi ngo bo nyid dang (sman mo'am dkar mo rnams shwa na ma/ bdud mo'am nag mo bzhi bdag nyid ma/ gnod sbyin mo'am dmar mo bzhi bse mo ste phur srung bcu gnyis kyang 'di dag go) bde mchog gi ma mo bcu gnyis gzugs gzhan du bsgyur bar bshad cing / rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ bod yul du ni lhan skyes te/ /zhi zhing gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan lag na thogs/ /brag gi khyim la brten te gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa de'ang 'di dag gi 96

〈me theduḥd/ /spyo1pa( thababastacad can//bye( bya/zug thabasdonastan/ sturngosarngarwa// (3nang na bzhugs par grags so/ /snang tshul than mong gi skye rgyud ltar na'ang / slob dpon chen ༄po bod yul du ma byon pa'i gong nas/ grub chen nag po spyod pa sogs las dbang dang gdams ngag nod de rim gnyis kyi lam gyis rgyud yongs su dag zin par mi la'i mgur 'bum sogs kyis thes pas/ phyis su slob dpon rin po cher tho brtsams pa sogs ni gu ru'i che ba 'don pa'i ched tsam mo/ /de la mkhan slob chos sasum gyis bod yul du bstan pa'i srol thog mar btsugs pa'i skabs su spyir dge bsnyen nyer gcig sogs kyang gangs ljongs spyi'i srung mar bskos mod kyi/ mthil gtad sa brtan ma bcu sanyis yin te/ gter gzhung rnams las 'di dag bod spyi'i srung ma/ra mchod tshul mang du gsungs pa 'dra ba yul lha gzhan la mi 'byung zhing snga 'gyur bka' ma'i tshogs mchod rnams su'ang /bod kyi gzhi bdag gzhan mchod tshul ma gsungs par/ 'di dag la/ bod khams skyong ba'i che zhe chen mo rnams/ /bran g.yog mang ngo/'i 'khor dang bcas/ /sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /'es phu dud che brjod dang bcas te mchod tshul gsungs so/ /de ltar 'di rnams bod kyi yul bdag gong na med par mnga' gsol ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bod yul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams pe har la 97

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bcol gtad mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs kyis dpags na 'di ltar mngon te/ srid pa'i lha chen gzhan la gtad kyang btsan phyug dang 'phan dar sogs 'byung ba yod kyang / 'di dag la gtso bor gtad na (yul 'di gsang sngags sgrub pa rnams la bkra shis par bya ba dang /'dir gsang sngags spyod pa'i skal ldan mang po 'byung bar bya ba dang / yul mi thams cad kyang sngags bstan la dad cing ri mor byed pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i nying khu ring du gnas par bya ba dang / sgrub po rnams la bde ba chen po'i dngos grub myur zhing mang bar bya ba'i ched yin/ des na bod brtan ma la gtad pa ni slob dpon rin po ches bod du sngags bstan 'dzugs pa'i cha lag tu rtogs so/ /)gsang sngags snying po'i bstan pa mi nub cing 'phel rgyas sa 'gyar ba'i gnad than dag ༄༄mi ni mimodza ma yin pa yod pas/ slob dpon pad+ma rten 'brel gyi gnad mkhyen pa des/ rgya bal gyi sa mtshams a su ra'i brag phug tu ma mo 'di rnams zhing lpags kyi stan la bkod/ lag tu rdo rje gtad/rdo rje bod khams skyong sogs rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur nas bsil ljongs 'di'i snod bcud gnyis ka gnyer gtad mdzad pa yin no/ /de 'dra'i rten 'brel las phyogs 'dir gsang sngags 'grub pa'i gnas chen mang po byung zhing / paṇa grub dbang po rnams kyi drin las sngags kyi rgyud sde dang / rgyud sde'i man ngag mang po dang / de dag las dngos grub brnyes pa'ang brgyud mar 98

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6trashebyon/ mtsho dang gangs brag thams cad kyang rdo rje theg pa'i chos sater gyis gang bar gyur te/ dpal nā len+d+rar me dgra byung ba na/nang rgyud sde lnga'i byin rlabs kyis gsung rab bco lnga cha gcig ma nub par grags pa dang / rdzogs chen gyi rgyud du bstan pa'i btsas gsum gyi che ba gsungs pa ltar/ sa gter 'di rnams bstan pa gnas pa'i rtod phur du bzhugs(rgya gar du mu stegs yod kyang sa/ngas rgyas pa rnams dad pa dang shes rab che bas rang tshugs thub cing / bod de las sdonu cing gsar ngas che ba dang / bod na sngags mkhan yod kyang mu stegs kyi rig snganus zil gyis gnon nus su sgrub nus mkhan nyung zhing mu stegs kyi sngags sgrub sla ba'i dbang gis/ mu stegs nus pa can bod du zhugs na bstan pa spyi dang khyad par sngags bsta na gyi phrin las la gnod tshabs che bas mu stegs kyi rgyu srang bkag par gsung pa red bam/ dpyad dgos/ ) pa'ang yin no/ /de 'dra ba ni 'dzam gling 'di'i rgyal bstan gar yod du yod pa'ang min te/ rgya nag gi yul du chos byung ba na/ nyan thos dgra bcom sogs bdag nyid chen po mang du byon kyang / sngags kyi rgyud sde ni da lta'i bar du yang ma byon pa bzhin no/ /brtan ma 'di dag ni bde chen gyi ye shes ster bas byin rlabs dang dngos grub che zhing / rnam pa 'jig rten gyi ma mo'i tshul du bzhugs pas bkol yang bde/ rgyal ba klong chen pa dang / rje thang stong zhabs/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa/ rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang sogs rig 'dzin brgyud pa 99

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams la dngos su phrin las bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus nges tig can yang shin tu mang ngo / /brtan ma gcig bsnyen na gzhan rnams kyang nye bar 'gyur ba ni/ byang gter brtan ma'i lo rgyus las/khyod sgrub cing mchod pa'i tshe: brtan ma thams cad grogs su bos la ci bcol ba'i las gyis shig: ces gsungs shing / mid la'i dbyangs 'bum las kyang gsal te/ zhar byung ngo / /de ltar na bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad rtsad mi chod cing / rang yul gyi gzhi bdag la phyogs zhen byas pa'i mchod bstod phal cher yang don chung bas/ de kun gyi tshab tu brtan ma mchod pa la 'bad par bya'o / /'di kho nas dgos pa mang po byed tshul yang / brtan gsol las/ bod du ma stegs rtag chad kyi/ /chos log ma btang khyed ༄kyis srungs/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /bar chad ma gtong khyed kyis srungs/ /gnas chen byin gyis brlabs pa'i gter/ /ma nyams smon lam btsan par gyis/ /dmag dang 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzod/ /nad dang mu ge ma btang zhig /sad sel btsa' dang 'bu srin srungs/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dben pa'i gnas dang sgrub pa po/ /ma lus bu bzhin skyong ba dang / /dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes 100

raḥmi the(1snang/ /spyo1sprang /ba/chertacad cang//bye/ cod65/ /ba46/ཿdo// 1rngosasprerwa// /kyi khyad par gyi las bcol 'byung ba ltar/ yon tan gter mdzod du'ang / bod yul bstan pa srung ba dang: mtha' yi dmag dpung phyir la zlogs: nad gdon gnod pa srung ba dang: o rgyan nga yi gter rnams srungs: khri srong lde'u btsan brgyud pa skyongs: sad ser mu ge shwa chu sdoms: btsa' dang skya yug dal yams zlogs: dmag 'khrugs byad kha phur kha zlogs: dus su char phobs 'bru phyugs spel: rigs brgyud bu nor spel ba dang:dam chos klog bshad sgrub brgyud spel: mdo rgyud bstan bcas dar ba dang: dge 'dun sde dpung thos bsam dar: 'jig rten legs dgu kun 'grub mdzod: ces dam bsgrags skabs su nusu/ngas so/ /de 'dra la dgongs nas bod khams spyi'i bde thabs la'ang / lha srin dbang sdud dang dam bsgrags zab par spyi lung las gsungs te/ mchims phur dbang chen 'dus pa'i sgrub pa bya:bod kyi lha srin dbang sdud dam bsgrags bya: zhes rgyal dbang lnga bas drangs so/ /slob dpon rin po che'i bka' nyan yin phyin/spyir yang bod khams bde thabs la mi brtson pa me da kyang /pada'i gdung 'tshob gter ston gter slob brgyud 'dzin dang 'dibacas pa rnams dang / pad+ma'i bka' nyan bstan srung chen po rnams nags dang nags kyi seng ge ltar phan tshun dpung grogs 101

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dang rtsa lag tu 'gyur ba yin pas/ brtan ma sogs la gsol mchod las kyi gnyer gtad byed pa'i rig 'dzin med na/ de dag kyang btsan rdzong dmag mi dang bral ba lta bur 'gro bas/ sngon yang mi rabs re bzhin lha srin dam bsgrags bka' nan rab brjid/ gnas chen byin 'bebs sogs byed pa'i rig 'dzin mtha ༄ldan re byung snang ngo / /brtan ma'i cho ga ni gtso cher gu ru zhi ba dang sbrel bar gsungs te shin tu grags che/ rta mchog rol pa la'ang 'brel chags tshabs che ste/ yon tan gter mdzod las/ tsha shod mang yul dpal mo'i mtshor: dbang chen rol ba'i skur bstan nas:dam la btags pa'i dge bsnyen dang: phud bdag brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: zhes dang / grol thig gshog rgod mar/ bstan skyong rdo rje gshog rgod ma: 'khor 'das dregs pa dpag med bcas: bsam yas dpal gyi mchims phu ru: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis:rta mgrin khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du: dbang bskur bka' dang dam la bzhag: de tshe gsang ba'i mtshan btags pa: dpal ldan rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: zhes gsungs shing / tshe sgrub ye shes 102

pha'i 25cad /skyi1khung tsho'echenacad rtson/:re :dezug thabasdonacad/ ྅rngosasprerwa// (3 'od mchog gi brtan ma'i gtor chog tu'ang / drag po dbu dgu'i dab re re bzhin las rta zhal gyi gdengs ka phyangs te/ rta skad kyi riri 3 ri ri rngam sgras brtan ma bcu gnyis so so'i 'khor 'bum 'bum dang bcas pa dbang du bsdus/ zil gyis mnan nas/ dam la bzhag par bya/ zhes gsungs pa dang / gru gu'i rta mgrin dregs sgrol las/slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brag dmar bsam yas ār+ya pa gling du: man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bshad pa'i tshe:bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan dam la btags nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i las rnams bya bar ma chad dam: zhes 'byung ngo / /mdo tshogs chen 'dus pa'i gtso bo dang / ma mo rbod gtong gi gtso bo gnyis ka'i srid pa ma mo dbang sdud kyi zhal ras rta mgrin gyi zhal gyi ngo bo dang rnam par bya bar gsungs pa sogs khungs shin tu mang ngo / /srid pa ma mo rtsa rlung thig le'i sgo nas 'chad tshul ltar bshad na/ 'dod khams dag pa sman mo bzhi sku rdo rje sprul sku'i pho nya mor nges pa'i sgo nas gnas pa rtsa sbyong zhing dbang du sdud pa dang /lus kyi smad kyi cha'i rtsa rlung thig le rnams khyad par du sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor dang / gzugs khams dag pa gnod sbyin mo bzhi 103

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsung rdo rje longs sku'i pho nya mor nges pa'i sgo nas g.yo ba rlung rnams sbyong zhing dbang du sdud pa dang / lus kyi rked pa'i rtsa rlung thig le rnams khyad par du sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor dang / gzugs med dag pa bdud mo bzhi thugs rdo rje chos sku'i pho nya mor nges pa'i sgo nas bkod pa byang chub kyi sems rnams sbyong zhing dbang du sdud pa dang / lus kyi stod kyi cha'i rtsa rlung thig le rnams khyad par du sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor la slob pa dang / de ltar brtan ma bcu gnyis po thams cad nang gi rdo rje phag mo tsaṇ+ḍa li'i rol par 'dus shing / rang sems lhan skyes kyi rig pa gcig po'i cho 'phrul du rdzogs par shes te/ bzhi tshan gsum pos rim bzhin/snang ba sku/ grag pa gsung / dran rtog thugs kyi 'khor lor rgyas 'debs pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag bden don bcu gnyis rtogs/ ye shes ma mo bcu gnyis bde chen gyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur bas na/ rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum brtan ma'i bla rdor bcangs nas/de dag la dbang thob par byas te 'khor 'das sre ba'i gnad la goms par byed pa ni ches zab pa'i man ngag tu mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches bshad do//gzhung 'dir brtan ma'i cho ga ston tshul ni/ rkang pa dang po 104

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6zheganyis kyis brtan ma'i de nyid ston/ de nas gcig gis brtan ma'i rnam grangs ston te/ sprul gzhi brtan ma bcu gnyis/ de'i sprul pa skyong ma bcu gnyis/ de'i sprul pa ya ma bcu gnyis zhes 'byung / de nas gcig gis phrin las la spyan drangs pa/ de nas gnyis kyis sngon gyi tha tshig gleng ba/ de nas gcig gis gtor ma bsngo ba/ de nas gnyis kyis rnal 'byor pa'i sgos kyi las bcol ba de nas gsum gyis bstan 'gro spyi'i don du phrin las gsol ba/de nas sngags kyis gtor ma stob pa/ thog mar srog (ma mo dang bh+yo gnyis gang la bshad kyang nyan/ rgyu mtshan 'dra yang yod) nas drang ba dang bcas pa'o/ /bzlas pa 'dod na bh+yo bsnyen la tshang bar gsol lo/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi bdud mo bzhi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ma rig pa sogs rten 'brel bzhi dag pa/ ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ gnod sbyin mo bzhi kha gdong ma sogs sgo ma bzhi skye mched sogs bzhi dag pa/ dga' ba bzhi/ sman mo bzhi gshin rje brtan ma sogs mtshams ma/ len pa sogs bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi dag pa dang sbyor tshul rang re'i bsang brngan ltar/ 'di ltar shes na ye shes mchog gi dngos grub ster la/rang rgyud par bzung na gnas skabs kyi 'dod don tsam la sa mi 'byung bar mnga' ris paṇa chen gsungs/ phrin las kyi sprul pa 105

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brtan ma bcu gnyis zhes dang / tshe ring srog gtad kyi lo rgyus su dbyings phyug e ka dza ṭi spun drug 'di dag tu sprul par rgyas par bshad cing / nam zhig sngags kyi bdag mo'i yang sprul ni/ /zhing skyong ḍā ki'i dbang mo tshe ring mas/ /zhes sogs sngags srung ma'i gzugs 'gyur kho nar gsungs/ re ma ti ni 'dod khams spyir srung bas/ kla klos kyang mchod par bshad cing / des mchod na yang sangs rgyas par 'tshe ba sogs kho rang tshos gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'byung bar grags/ de nyid bod yul la sgos su nye ba'i srung ma dang / dkar phyogs kho na'i lha mgon du bzhengs pa ni 'di dag ste/ phyogs 'dir re ti las kyang 'di dag nye zhing bsngags par gsal/ de'ang re ma ti brtan ma'i rnam par sgrub ces pa'o/ /'di dag rnal 'byor bla med kyi gdams pa mchog mnga' ba'i rnal 'byor mar rje btsun tsong kha pa'ang bzhed de/des tshe ring mched lngar mid las gnang ba'i bar do 'phrang sgrol gzigs nas gsang 'dus kyi bsre ba'i gnad la nges pa chen po 'khrungs te yi ge de la mchod 'bul rgya cher mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyis shes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan jo mo lha rir bzhugs dus gnas kyi byin rlabs yin nam gnyid 'od gsal lta bu 'char ba dga' mo byung gsungs/106

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6brtan ma zer ba'i sgra bshad la/ brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten skyong ma zhes pa ra brtan gyi steng nas dang / bod du mu stegs mi gtong bar rgyal bstan srung ba mo zhes sa bstan gyi bshad tshul yod ces skyabs rje gsung / ra brtan la brtan gnas pa'am zhes pa ltar rtag chags kyi yul lha zhes bshad lugs kyang yod e gsung snyam ste brjed/ brtan skyong zhes par yang / brtan ma bshal chus skyong zhes dang / brtan skyong ma mchod pa zhes bshad lugs so sor yod gsungs snang 'dra mo 'dug de'ang sa paṇa gyis/rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'di/ /slob dpon/ pad+ma 'byang gnas kyis//༄brtan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas/ /zhes te/ sham po dang / thang lha sogs gu ru'i bka' sdod phal cher/ /gter phyogs na/ru bzhi bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mtho mtho dgung la reg pa dang / /sogs ltar gtso cher ru bzhi'i srung mar bshad la/brtan ma bcu gnyis ni ru bzhi kho na'i yul lha min te/ bstan kanyis skor gsum du/ bod khams mtha' dbus kun na gnas pa yi/ /brtan skyong ya ma 'bum phrag 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes te/mnga' ris na tshe ring ma/ kong yul na de mo/ mdo smad na drag rgyal ma sogs kyis shes/ de dag gi spyi mdzad rdzong btsan pa'i/btsan rgod 'bar bas dgra srog chod/ /ces pa'i dod ni/ mtha' 107

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yi dmag dang rgya 'dre'i 'tshub/ nas/ 'gong po spun dgu'i nad dal srang / /zhes dang / bod khams srang zhing skyong ba dang / /rabyezir rwa〉〉za rwar raba'adrirnal 'byar sgrub pa' grags bya kais/ /ja ltar khas blang dam bcas pa'i/ /zhes te/ 'di 'drar dgongs nas smin gter rjes gsungs tshul zur bris ltar/ so so'i sgos mdzad ni/ rdo rje kun grags mas bdud dpung zlog pa dang / g.ya' ma skyong gis gza' bdud dang / kun bzang mos btsan thong 'dul ba/ kha rag khyung btsun gyis gshin rje'i gdon dang dgra dpung 'joms pa/ rdo rje klu mos rmi ltas mtshan ngan zlog pa/ drag rgyal mas glo bur sems kyi ye 'drog zhi ba/ de mos sa bdag klu'i nad gdon zhi ba/g.yar mo bsil gyis dam nyams gnad la 'bebs pa/ btsan la la ros gtad zlog cing gnod sbyin gdug pa'i nad gdon zhi ba/'brog chen 'khor 'dul gyis bgegs kyi bar chad sel ba/ spyan gcig mas dgra bgegs 'gug pa/ gzugs legs mas phung byed nag mo'i gdon zlog pa sogs te las rgya mtsho'i rgyud las gsungs/'di rnams kyi phyag tu gu ru rin po ches bod yul mtha' dag gtod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ pho rgyud las myur/ mo rgyud bkra shis/klu rgyud tshan che zhes shis pa'i don du yin byas kyang byar yod mod/zer rgyu gang rnyed tsam mo/ /dgongs pa ni 'ja' tshon gter khar 108

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6kong btsun de mo lha srin 'dul ba'i las rgyar bzhes tshul dang /brtan ma bcu gnyis po thams cad gu ru'i gsang yum du bshad pa/sngar bshad sogs bsgrigs na/ 'di rnam dpal he ru ka'i rang snang gi phyi nang dus sbyor bcu gnyis sgrib bral du gyur pa'i rang rig gi dag ldog las sprul zhing / phyis gu ru rin po che he ru kar bzhengs te/ nyid kyi rten 'brel dus sbyor dag pa'i bde stong shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ldog cha bcu gnyis lha srin 'dul ba'i pho nya mor shar bar brlabs shing / snyoms 'jug bde ba'i rol mos bod khams thams cad zil 'og tu bcug dbang du byas nas he ru ka'i zhing khams su mdzad de/ 'di ni bde ba chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis sa gzhi btul ba'i tshul lo/ /de nyid bshad ma thag pa'i brtan ma'i de kho na nyid sher phyin gyi dbyings su rgyas btab cing sbas nas brtan par mdzad pa'i drang don rtags kyi snang char bod yul brtan ma la gtad nas mi dang mi min 'byung po'i g.yo 'khrugs gsum ldang med du mdzad pa'o/ /tshul des 'di rnams bod khams mtha' dbus kyi srung ba rdo rje'i btsan rdzong bla med du grub bo/ /sangs rgyas kyis 'phrog ma la chang bu sbyin par bcas pa ltar/ gu rus bod kyi sa btul skabs sa 'dul gyi phrin las rgyun skyong ba'i mkha' 'gro chen mo 'di rnams rgyun du mchod 109
