pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgos zhes rjes 'jug la khrims su bcas pa'i tshod na snang ste/de ltar brtan ma mchod pa ni 'jig rten gtso mo drug cha'i dpya thang gis bkur ba'i tshul du bod khams bstan 'gro bskyang ba'i sngar byas kyi gtang rag dang / phyis mdzad kyi gnyer zan yin la/'di nyid gu ru'i zab gter gyi sgrub gzhung kun tu 'byung zhing /bod kyi lha srung gzhan su la'ang de 'dra ma gsungs pas gangs can bstan 'gro skyong ba la 'di dag dang brtson 'grus mnyam pa'i yul lha gzhan med par shes nus so/ /der yang ma zad mi dang sha za rang bzhin bskal bas sha zas mi la 'tshe nus pa skrag dang dogs pa'i 'du shes kyi mtshams sbyor sogs la ltos pa bzhin du brtan ma'i srung skyob kyi phrin las rang cag la snang nas phan thogs pa'ang /rang re'i blo ngor brtan ma'i srung mtshams kyi nang du yod par shes pa la ltos pas gtor 'bul las bcol sogs kyi sgo nas 'di rnams kyi srung 'og tu chud pa'i 'du shes rgyun du bzhag dgos so/ /de med na ni srang skyob kyi phrin las kyang rang bzhin bskal don du ༄'gro nyen yod do/ /yang 'di dag mkha' 'gro ma chen mor yang yang bshad de/de'ang drang don du/ nam mkha' stong la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /zhes pa ltar myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyis nam mkha' la rlung 110

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6traltar thogs med du rgyu zhing 'phyo ba ste/ lha mo mgyogs ma zer ba ltar rbod gtong myur mgyogs kyi pho nyar bsngags shing / nges don du 'od gsal chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' la gya gyur 'gro ba'am gang dgar spyod pa ste/ des na kun rtog tshun chad kyi las nyon dang / de las byung ba'i snyigs ma lnga'i rtsub 'gyur ri brag dang chu dang g.yang sa sogs kyi rnam par lta bu gang gis kyang dgag tu med pa'i spyod yul can te/ rgyu mtshan 'dis sems rig shan phyed nas rig thog nas brtan ma dang dam sre nus na me chen rlung rgod dang 'dzoms pa bzhin du gnyis ka 'i phrin la sa kyi rtsal shugs 'ur chil gyis 'gro'o/ /lha mi dang 'dres ma thag rnal 'byor bar chad kyi 'phrang las grol ba'i gnad cig der yod do/ /'khor ba la nyam nga med pa'i brtul zhugs kyi rnal 'byor de tsam mnga' na 'jig rten sman mo'i rdzu bag bzung nas ci bya zhe na/ ye shes dag pa'i sku ni 'gro ba phal ba dang rnam pa ches khyad ring bas 'khor sgyur la sprang pos 'dris dung gi mos zhen mi skye ba bzhin bsnyen dka' la/ yul lha 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung na mthun pas mthun pa 'dul zer ba ltar phal pa rnams kyang yid nye zhing bag 'bebs pas lha mi 'dris sla ba'i ched yin te/ dus mthar 'das pa'i sngags las 'jig rten pa'i sngags 'grub sla bar 'jam 111

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpal rtsa rgyud du bshad pa sogs bsgrig 'on kyang sems can bsod nams dman pas mchod 'os mchod mkhan cher dkon na/mi gcig gis brtan ma bsnyen na mang pos mchod pa'i go chod dam zhe na/ gser 'od dam par mi'i rgyal pos mdo sde nyan nas 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la chos sbyin gyi bsngo ba byas na de'i mnga' ris ril gyis srung bar 'gro tshul 'byung ba ltar mi rjes mchod na go de ltar chod snang / rgyal khams spyis re ltos 'cha' yul gyi bla chen lta bus mchod kyang phyogs 'dra'am snyam/ 'dir zur tho nas len rgyu'ang yod/ tshe ring ma'i thad du/ klong snying srog dbang las/ gangs can bod kyi yul lha yin: sus brten dngos grub sna re 'thob: rdo rje theg pa'i bka' srung yin: rnal 'byor yongs la snying yang nye: snying thig gnyan po'i srung ma ste:tshar gcod rjes 'dzin rno la myur: zhes te/ de'i lo rgyus su/'dir zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo tshe ring mched lngar grags pa0 ni/ nang du rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la snying nye la bkra shis/ 'chi med kyi bcud len ster bas tshe ring / rnam bzhi'i phrin las la mnga' mdzad pas ci bcol gyi las rno la myur/ phyi ltar du snod bcud kun la dbang bsgyur bas tshan che/ mdor na bsam don gyi re ba skong ba la yid bzhin gyi nor bu gcig tu lhun gyis grub pa'i 112

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6trakhu74srung ma khyad par can/ zhes gsungs/ ma mgon lcam dral las/gsung sprul mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga: zhes pa tshe ring mched lnga kho na'o/ /'di la mid las mdzad pa'i gtor chog tu/ khyod kyi cho dang 'brang smos na/ /yab ni lho lha 'thing po yin/ /yum ni 'brang yum sman gcig ma/ /ming po bdun la sring mo lnga/ /lnga tshigs dbus kyi gtso mo ste/ /zhes gsungs/ mched lnga'i nang tshan mthing gi zhal bzang ma ni rdo rje g.yu sgron ma dang gcig par bshad/'di'i rten gnas mthon mthing gangs ni rje btsun mid las/rked pa yan chad rtse mo mtho/ /zur gsum dung gi bshos bzang 'dra/ /mgur chu dngul gyi dra ba la/ /nyi 'od 'char ba gzhan pas snga/ /cod pan shel gyi zur phud la/ /rgyun du sprin dkar lding ba yin/ /rked pa man chad rmang gzhi la/ /na bun skyi bun rgyun du 'thibs/ char mi drag dal bu rtag tu 'bab/ /'ja' 'od mchod sprin rtag tu 'char/ /de phyugs kyi rma g.yang 'dzoms pa'i rtags/ /ri dwags mang po rgyun du 'khor/ /me tog spang rgyan tshon tshogs bkra/ /sman nus pa can rnams de la skye/ /de lha sman gangs kyi che brjod yin/ /zhes pa ltar de bal bod kyi sa mtshams na yod/yang / lha bzang po tshe ring spun lnga de/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo yin/ /'jig rten mig bsgyur mkha' 'gro ste/ /bal bod 113

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnyis kyi skad bsgyur ma/ /chu bar brin gyi yul bdag mo/ /lha ru mchod na mgon skyabs byed/ /sogs dang / tshe ring dbang che bskal par gnas/ /de srog gcod spang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /longs spyod rnam thos bu dang mnyam/ /de ser sna spang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /'khor bzang bka' bgo nyan pa de/ /bzod la nan tan bya ba byas/ /de nas dge la spro ba de/ /brtson 'grus le lo med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di dag gi bshad pa'ang sngar smos pa'i khongs su tshang la/ dus sbyor zhes pa'i gnas su 'byung ba lnga zhes kyang sbyar bar bya'o/ /gsol kha las/ phyi ltar sman btsun mched lnga la: nang ltar rigs lnga'i ḍāk+ki ni: gsang ba dbyings kyi yum chen mo: zhes dang / rdo grub rjes/ phyi ltar zo dor tshul 'dzin sha za lnga/ /nang ltar mkha' spyod gnas bgrod ḍā ki ni/ /gsang ba 'byung lnga gnas gyur yum chen lnga/ /zhes dang / rtsa gsum kun 'dus ye shes lha mo lnga/ /zhes gsungs shing / spyan 'dren dus/ mkha' spyod dang / rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing nas spyan 'dren par bshad pa sogs la brtags na'ang dag pa'i zhing gi dngos grub khyad par can rnams la dbang bsgyur ba'i ye shes grub pa mor go nus/ dpal chen gyi bud med rin po che ni/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 114

ra〉〉khur 21sgyusno /gluspreng thabashenacad zug:re cesazug thabasdonarngasno/ 2sdo/shāḥ// (rngo'ajoms pa zhes sogs ltar bu rgyud bzang mang spel ba la bsngags shing / gtso mos srid srung bu'i dngos grub stsol bar gab yig dang mid la'i dbyangs 'bum du 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyis 'di nyid sgrub sde mo'i tshal du bsnyen na chos kyi brgyud 'dzin 'phel ba'i ༄sgos khyad kyang yod par mngon te/ mid las/ bstan pa spel ba la mi min las mi stobs che/ 'on kyang tshe ring ma 'di mi kha cig las stobs che/ nga'i chos rgyud mi las dbus pa ston pa dang / mi min las tshe ring mas rgyas par byed gsungs shing / kun mkhyen phyi mar yang khrid yig chen mo rtsom dus/ zhing skyong ḍa ki'i dbang mo tshe ring mas/ /hi hi'i bzhad sgra g.yo ba'i lung bstan bcas/ /chos 'dis 'gro la phan pa'i gnyer blangs shing / /zhes pa ltar/rgya gar dang nye ba'i mon dang 'brug yul/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi/dag kong / sde dge lho byang / nyag hor/ 'gu gser gnyis/reb kong / rgyal rong / mi nyag sbrag nag sog yul/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i bar du snying thig gi bstan pas khyab par byung ba de'o/ /yang mkha' 'gro'i g.yang 'gug tu/ khyad par g.yang can nor gyi lha/ /jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /zhes sogs g.yang lhar bsngags te/ zas nor gyi gzhi 'dzin bud med yin pas nor lha 115

21rngad/ (2 jordo sdispyingagu 'o/:drob/ba byasputshod ngape/stazud rta):re ba/sdo/pa( 'o/dra/zug/ r+sha07zhegazhan sgrub dus kyi rmi rtags la'ang bud med bzang mos zas byin pa 'ong bar nor sgrub kyi gzhung las gsungs te/ 'jig rten na sris sme mi sme dang / zas bcud bzang ngan sogs gzhi 'dzin bud med kyi dpal g.yang che chung gi khyad las byung bar grags so/ /srog gtad du/ sman mo grogs su bsgrubs pas 'du ba gsum gyi dngos grub ster bar bshad pa'i nang nub tu zas 'du ba'i tshul yang de ltar ro/ /'du ba gsum gyi thad 'dir 'khor gyi sman mo phal pa'i rigs tsam las ma grub na mtshan mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas su mo chags tha mal pa 'khri ba'i nyen dogs yod pas gtso mo lnga dbang du gyur ba cis kyang gces te/ rang rig gi stong srog thob na rab/ min yang gong non gyi bsnyen sgrub legs par them pa dang / dam tshig dag pa gal che'o/ /'byung ba chen po kun la khyab/ /ces ri rab/ gser ri/ rol mtsho/ khyim gyi me dang (nyi ma)rta gdong gi me/ rlung gi phung po sogs 'byung bzhi'i dbyings thams cad khyab ste/ 'di 'dra mdo sde nas kyang mang du bshad la/khyad par 'dir he ru ka'i phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi 'byung ba ro mnyam du dag pa'i cha las sprul tshul sngar bshad kyis rtogs par nus so/ /snod bcud 'byung ba'i byed pa mos: dus bzhi kun gyi drod kyang 'dzin: zhes dang / ma mo rtsa rlung gi bdag mor 116

bod skyong brtan ma'i rnam bshad/ pod/ 6gsungs pa ltar/ 'byung ba'i dwangs snyigs/ nam zla'i 'phel zad/rtsa rlung gi skyed sdud thams cad la dbang che'o/ /srog gtad las/da lta rje mo'i tshul du sgrubs: sogs bsten lugs gsum gsungs pa gal che zhing / go rim yang de kho na ltar dgos/ tsi dmar dkyus mas bsten dus pha khu ltar bsten gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang pha ma la ches cher gus pa'i rigs chos can gyi bu mdzangs ma la bsnyen pa lta ba'i tshal gyis gong du 'khar ba'i rje mor bsten ༄༄mi ༄༄ rastan lugs bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ltar sgrub pa dang / 'jig rten brtan ma ltar 'bod pa'i sngags gnyis te/ gsol kha dang srog dbang las so/ /tshe sgrub ye shes 'od mchog tu/ brtan ma rang gi sems su shes pa dang / /rten 'brel rig pa chos skur thag chod nas/ /kun bzang thig le gcig tu smin pa ni/ /mi 'gyur mi g.yo brtan pa'i cho ga'o/ /zhes te brtan ma rang rig gi rtsal du thag chod nas 'gyur med rig pa'i gshis las gzhan du med par ngo 'phrod de rba rlabs mtsho la thim pa ltar klong chen dgongs pa'i dbyings su sre ba ni mkha' 'gro ma dang rang gi srog sre ba dang /dam tshig sre ba'i gnad do/ /da dung phyi nang gsang ba'i brtan ma sum sbrags kyi gnad kun mkhyen phyi ma'i thang ga'i rgyab byang dang /g.yu sgron mnga' gsol/ khyad par ye shes 'od mchog la brten 117

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nas 'chad lugs yod de ma bris/ yul lha ltar shes pas mchod bstod byas kyang / dregs pa mchod dang bstod pas 'grub/ /ces dang / sus bsten dngos grub sna re 'thob/ /ces pas 'go zhing sdong grogs mdzad par nges kyang / dngos bstan gtso bo ni/bka' srung sman mo ltar sgrub pa'i zhes bka' srung du shes pas sgrub lugs te/ phyi ma 'di ltar bsten mkhan la srung rgyu'i bka' de 'dzin pa zhig dgos la/ snga ma tsam la de mi dgos kyang chos brgyud dang sel ma zhugs pa zhig dgos snyam/ /118

pod/ 6༄/ /dbang chen rta skad ces bya ba bzhugs/pad+ma dbang chen glu gar gyi sgo nas 'chad pa'i bshad pa rgyas shos ni bde 'dus gsang sngags bka'i tha ram yin kyang de'i dpe dag pa ma rnyed pas dngos 'bri bar ma 'bad/ bcud dril tsam ni pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa thams cad rta skad thang gsum gyi dgongs par 'dus par bstan pa la/ tha ram rnam pa bzhis bshad de/theg pa rim par bgrod pa'i rta skad rta yi 'gros dgus theg pa dgu rtser chub par bshad pa dang / sa dang lam la sbyar ba'i rta skad rta'i skad bcu gsum dang sbyar te bshad pas sa bcu lam lnga myur du bgrod par bshad pa dang / gsang sngags la shan 'byed pa'i rta skad rta mgo ljang zhur gyis dpal rta mgrin che ba'i yon tan gzhan las 'phags pa'i sgo nas bshad pa dang / gdul bya thabs kyi rta skad dpal dang ma mo 'bum brda phrad klong rdol dbang bsgyur ba'i sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rta'i 'gros la/ sum lag sgrog gi 'gros dang /sdom pa lcags kyi 'gros dang / pho nya srun gyi 'gros dang /1 19

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mtshams legs gzengs kyi 'gros dang / gom bu nyol gyi 'gros dang / spyang mo 'dur gyi 'gros dang / rol mo stabs kyi 'gros dang / 'jom mo dkyas kyi 'gros dang / dkyas su tshang ba'i ra me1rngo/ 1de zuranganorami'agros dang dgu'o/ / rnams don ga pa ram dgu dang sbyar ba ni/ 'gros dang po ltar lha mi'i theg pa ni/ ma skyes mnyam pa'i lta ba la ni sgrib/ dge ba bcu sogs dam pa'i chos khrims sgrog dang 'dra bas ni bsdam te/ bag yangs pa'i lta spyod kyi dbang ma thob pas sgrog tu tshud pa dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ltar/ nyan thos kyis gang zag gi bdag med par rtogs pas snga ma las 'phags kyang /theg chen gyi don ma rtogs pas yog tu lci ba 'dul ba lcags dang 'dra bas bsdam pas mnyam pa nyid kyi don la bag yangs su spyod ma shes pas lta spyod kyi chos la dbang ma thob ste shin tu sdug bsngal che'o/ /gsum pa ltar rang rgyal ni gong ma gnyis las khyad par du gzugs phung bdag med pa lta bas 'phags te/ rang byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i dus na nyan thos ltar dge ba'i gshes gnyen la mi ltos par sngon goms pa'i shugs kyis rten cing 'brel 'byung bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'khor ba thog ma dang tha ma med par rtogs shing rang byung thob par nus na yang theg pa chen po mnyam pa nyid kyi chos/ thams cad sems su 'dus par ma mthong bas gnyis su 120

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6zhemed pa'i sa la myur du phyin pa'i thabs chung ste lam myur ba'i rtsal med do/ /bzhi ba ltar theg pa chen po mdo sde'i theg pa ni/ chos dang gang zag gi bdag gnyis ka ma skyes par rtogs pas mnyam pa nyid kyi don thugs su chud de/ 'og ma las kyang byang chub myur ba'i phyir 'phags so/ /lnga ba ltar mdo sde bas kyang kri ya 'phags te/ mnyam pa nyid kyi don thugs su chud par mtshungs kyang /kun rdzob tu 'di bas bdag dam tshig sems dpa' bran/ ye shes sems dpa' jo bo'i tshul du rigs gsum gyi skur bsgom ste/ sku mtshan ma/ gsung bzlas brjod/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis gtsang sbra dang dus tshigs dang gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa rgyu rkyen gtso bor tshogs pa'i mthu las tshogs chen po skye bas khyad par du 'phags so/ /drug pa ltar u pa ya de las kyang 'phags te/kun rdzob tu lha ye shes sems dpa' rigs bzhir 'dod pas lha'i ting nge 'dzin yig 'bru las yan lag bzhi dang ldan par sgom zhing /ting nge 'dzin dang yo byad rgyu rkyen gnyis ka la brten nas sgrub pa'o//bdun pa ltar/ de bas kyang lta spyod ma hā yo ga 'phags te/ ci'i phyir na/ sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings las rig rtsal gyi thabs cho 'phrul yi ge 'phro 'dus bdag gzhan gyi don bya ba ni bsod nams kyi tshogs/ yi ge las skyes 121

casangad/ (1 zardo lnga/ba 'o/jigs thegarngasno bstan nyilnga/ gasdo/nga khuradra/ma/ lo344stanapa'i zhi khro rnam gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs gzugs dang bcas pa nyid/ yi ge ma ('diskor dpyad) skyes pa'i sgo nas mtshan nyid du snang ba'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyang ma skyes pa'i sgo nas rang bzhin med pa chu zla bzhin spyod la ma chags par rtogs pa'i dus nas ye shes rdzogs te/ tshogs gnyis dus gcig/ la rdzogs so/ /brgyad pa ltar/ de bas kyang a nu yo ga 'phags te/ rgyu dag pa'i dbyings nas 'bras bu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du snang bas so/ /de'ang gang ltar na snga ma ltar yig 'bru las bskyed mi dgos te/ phung po lnga rigs lnga/ rnam shes brgyad sems dpa' brgyad/ yul brgyad sems ma brgyad sogs su ye nas gnas te/phung khams skye mched thams cad ni rtsa ba byang chub sems su 'du la/de chos kyi dbyings las mi gzhan pas ye nas sangs rgyas pa'o/ /dgu ba ltar/ a ti yo ga bya rtsol thams cad dang bral ba bde ba chen po'i don lhun gyis grub pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang sems su 'du la/ sems kyi de kho na nyid ni gdod ma nas ma byung ma skyes te/ ma byang ba ni 'byang ba'i rgyu med la/ ma skyes pa yig chag rtsa'i char de pa char05 bye (pe chag charan skya ba' gnas mad da/ /da' phyar na shas 'byung 'jug mad pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /ngang gis ma skyes pa'i thig le chen po'o/ /yongs kyis 'od gsal ba'i ye shes dang / thams cad bdag gi 122

rdze dbangachenarta skad/ pod/ 6dbang du gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po zhes bya'o/ /rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rta'i skad la yon tan bcu gsum ste/ rta yi skad snyan pa dang / 'jam pa dang / gting ba dang / gsang ba dang / ring ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / 'brel ba dang /bar ma chad pa dang / zil che ba dang / rtsal che ba dang /gdangs che ba dang / ngar che ba dang / phul du phyin pa'o/ /dang po ltar dpal rta mgrin yang 'gro ba'i don la dga' ste/ sa dang po rab dga' dang sbyor/ lam ni tshogs lam dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ltar dpal rta mgrin 'gro ba'i don la thugs 'jam zhing brtse bar mdzad de/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa dang / lam sbyor lam dang sbyar ro/ /gsum pa ltar dpal rta mgrin 'gro ba'i don la mi thos pa med par gnas pa ste/ sa 'od byed pa dang sbyor/bzhi ba ltar dpal 'gro ba'i don la thugs sangs shing 'gro don mdzad de/ sa 'od 'phro dang sbyor/ lnga ba ltar dpal 'gro ba'i don la ring pa ste/ sa sbyang dka' dang sbyor/ lam ni mthong lam dang sbyor/ drug pa ltar dpal thams cad la thugs rje mnyam pa ste/sa mngon du gyar pa dang sbyar/ bdun pa ltar dpal gyi thugs chi 4 ༄ da 4 da rurjas 'gra ba rnams la rgyun chad mad par gzags pa sta/ sa rang 123

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/d+kudu song ba dang sbyar/ brgyad pa ltar dpal gyi thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don rgyun chad med pa ste/ sa mi g.yo ba dang sbyor/ lam ni sgom lam dang sbyor/ dgu ba ltar dpal gyis 'gro ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms shing zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /sa legs pa'i blo gros dang sbyor/ bcu ba ltar dpal 'gro ba'i don la rtsal dang ldan pa ste/ sa chos kyi sprin dang sbyor/ lam ni mi slob lam dang sbyar ro / /bcu gcig pa ltar dpal gyi thugs rje 'khor ba na gdangs che ba ste/sa kun tu 'od dang sbyor/ bcu gnyis pa ltar dpal gyi thugs rje 'gro ba sgrol ba la ngar dang ldan pa ste/ ma chags pad+ma can gyi sa dang sbyar/ bcu gsum pa ltar dpal rta mgrin gyis 'gro ba'i don phul du phyin pa ste/ sa bcu gsum pa yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa dang sbyor ro/ /de ltar dpal rta mgrin gyi rta skad thang gcig la sa bcu gsum ma bgrod par rdzogs/ lam lnga ma bgrod par bgrod do/ /gsum pa ni/ rta shugs che/ 'gro mgyogs pa ltar/ 'khor ba bsgral shugs che/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro ba mgyogs/ des na rta skad ces bya/ rta yi rang bzhin bgrod mkhas te/ /theg pa dgu dang sa lam bgrod/ /mkhas shing rtse mor phyin pas na/ /rta mgrin zhes ni de la bya/ /rta yi rang bzhin kha rtsal che/ /de bzhin rta 124

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6mchog gsang sngags 'di/ /gsang sngags gzhan pas kha rtsal che/ /rta mgrin zhes ni de la bya/ /rta ni drag po'i rngam tshul las/ /rta ni las ni byed pa'o/ /rta mgrin drag po'i ngar dang ldan/ /mgrin ni gdug pa 'dul ba'o/ /rta ni rdzu 'phrul rkang par ldan/ /mgrin ni sangs rgyas sa gnon pa'o/ /phyi ni rta mgrin khro bo'i sku/ /nang gi rta mgrin rnal 'byor sku/ /gsang ba'i rta mgrin rang sems 'di/ /sems las logs na sgrub tu med/ /sems nyid rta mgrin yin shes na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'thob/ /yid bzhin nor bu rang la rnyed/ /cir snang cir rtog cir thos pa/ /rta mgrin nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sku yi cho 'phrul rta mgrin sku ru gsal/ /skye 'gags med pa'i ngang du mya ngan 'das/ /gsung gi rang bzhin rta skad cir sgrogs pa/ /ma skyes mi 'gag gsung du mya ngan 'das/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin rta mgrin cir gsal yang chos sku mtshan med klong du mya ngan 'das/ /de ltar rtogs na rta mgrin rnal 'byor yin/ /gsang sngags la shan 'byed pa khyad par 'phags/ /ces gsungs/bzhi ba la/ dpal rta mgrin gyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la brda sprad pa dang / ma mo'i 'gying skad thengs gsam gyis dpal rdo rje'i ming sring brda phrad de dgongs ༄125

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/klong rdol ba dang / rnal 'byor pa'i brda skad thengs gsum gyis snang srid ma mo'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur te las byed pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rta skad dang po bos pas snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad ye nas ma bcos ma sbyang bar dpal ('di dzab dgongs kyi mchan ltar ma mo mkha' 'gro la dbang sdud zil gnon gtong tshul yin pas/mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog na 'di thad bshad pa rnams gsang rdzogs sogs kyi rta skad kyi steng du bshad nas 'di dang yang gnad gcig pa tsam du byas na legs sam snyam) rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub par rtogs pa'o/ /rta skad bar ma bos pas khams gsum srid gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sha chen gyi phung po dang / khrag gi rgya mtsho dang /keng rus kyi ri rab tu gyur pas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes pa'i longs spyod rgyun mi 'chad par bsam/ rta skad tha ma bos pas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad bka' 'og tu bsdus nas phrin las rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa ci bcol ba'i las rdzogs par byed de/ bka' nyan gsung sdod ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/dpal gyi rta skad thengs gsum bos pa'i dus na/ ma mo rnams 'gyings shing dam tshig dang sngon gyi tha tshig las mi 'da' ba'i glu/bdag cag nam mkha'i dbyings nas mchi/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas mi ma chi ru/ /bdag cag gnas ni nam mkha' lags/ /126

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6zhed+ku bdag cag 'theng zhing grum zhing mchi/ /'theng zhing grum zhing mi mchi ru/ /keng rus ri rab rtse mo tsha/ /bdag cag 'bog cing brgyal zhing mchis/ /'bog cing brgyal zhing mi mchi ru/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho gting re zab/ /bdag cag thang cig yud la mchi/ /thang cig yud la mi mchi ru/ /ming po rdo rje'i bka' lung gnyan/ /zhes len no/ /gsum pa ni/ thal mo dang po brdab pas/ chos la dgra byung / sangs rgyas ra mda' zlog /ces pa'i brda skad kyis dpal khrag 'thung rnams dbyings nas skul/ thal mo bar ba brdab pas phra men rnams dbyings nas skul/ thal mo tha ma brdab pas las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams las la bskul te btsud pa rnams so/ /de dag thams cad bsdu na gnyis te/ rta skad lta bar dgongs pa dang / spyod par dgongs pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ngo bo don gyi rta skad/ /gsang sngags gnad kyi rta skad do/ /dang po ni gsum ste/ rang bzhin ngo bo don gyi rta skad snang srid thams cad ye nas ma bcos ma sbyangs lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal rta mgrin/de ltar rtogs pa'o/ /rig pa ngo bo nyid kyi rta skad rang rig pa dpal chen po'i skur ye nas ma bcos par gnas pa'o/ /gnyis su med pa ngo bo nyid kyi rta skad thabs shes gnyis su med pa'am/127

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/don dam pa dang kun rdzob gnyis su med pa'am/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'am/ /snang ba dang stong ba dbyer med pa la bya ste/ de yang snang srid thams cad dpal rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor du snang tsam na snang zhing stong ste snang la rang bzhin med/de nyid rig pa byang chab kyi sems sa rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la ༄༄ dmi gsum ste/ theg pa rim pas bgrod pa'i rta skad kyis theg rim dgu'i nang nas dpal rta mgrin gyi rnal 'byor sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro ba mgyogs par bstan pa rta'i 'gros dgu dang sbyar nas so/ /sa lam dang sbyar ba'i rta skad/ rta skad bcu gsum dang sbyar te/'di'i rnal 'byor pas lam myur du bgrod pa'i che ba bstan pa/gsang sngags la shan dbye ba'i rta skad/ gsang sngags gzhan las dpal rta mgrin che ba'i yon tan rta mgo dang sbyar nas bstan pa'o//rta skad spyod par dgongs pa la gnyis te/ /gdul bya thabs kyi rta skad dang / dpal chen che ba'i rta skad do/ /dang po la gsum las//dpal gyi rta skad thengs gsum ni/ rta skad dang po dam tshig rjes su bskul ba/ bar ba bka' la drangs pa/ tha ma don byed pa'o/ /ma mo'i 'gying skad thengs gsum ni/ rang rgyud che ba'i rngam skad /byin brlab rdzas len gyi gdangs skad/ drag po las la chas pa'i 'gying skad do/ /rnal 'byor pa'i brda skad thengs gsum ni/ lus 128

yanga'e 3pa///pa/15pa /bye/shā()// //// ////snyepa/// /rdo//sprerwaḥ// // nakyi brda (thal mo dang se gol sogs) ngag gi brda (bshugs pa'i glu sogs)yid kyi brda (dgongs pa gtod pa) dang gsum mo/ /dpal chen che ba'i rta skad ni/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung khros pa'i sku/ /thams cad dbang du sdud par byed/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad la/ /bsnyen pa byas pas nyer ma 'dod/ /bsgrub pa byas pas rtags ma thon/ /bsgos pas las byed ma 'dod na/ /sde brgyad srid pa dkrugs par byed/ /spyod bag shong ba'i dben gnas sa/ /lus ngag yid ༄ ga/sum khros kyis kyang / /dmar nag gzhi gcig dmigs pa bskyed//yul gsum gsal bar gyur pa dang / /pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin sku/ /ting 'dzin brtan pos bsgrub pa las/ /dbang chen phyag rgya byas nas ni/ /khros pa'i rta skad thengs gsum 'don/ /khros pa'i rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /snang srid lha srid sde brgyad kyang / /'brong rgod 'drogs pa bzhin du ni/ /rang dbang med par had kyis dngangs/ /rta skad lan gsum bton pa yis/ /sha rul dong du bcug pa la/ /sha sbrang la sogs 'du ba bzhin/ /rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus/ /rta skad thengs gsum bton pa yis/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyang / /rgyal khrims dam pa'i dmangs rnams bzhin/ /rang dbang med par 'dur gyis btang / /de ni rta mgrin rnal 'byor ro/ /pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa'i tha ram bshad 129

༄drajud/ 52 ༄rdo ༷)ngas (ri)rngosgyunabs ྅'icad ngasad1skud lhan3re can༄/pange (ridra/mun) tshamazin to/ /zhes pa'o/ /gsang sngags bka'i lde mig las/ pad+ma gsung gi sgrub thabs cung zad cig bshad de: pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po dpal rta mgrin la gsum ste: mtshon pa dpe'i rta mgrin dang: chos nyid don gyi rta mgrin dngaḥ 'khor ba rtags kyi rta mgrin no: mtshon pa dpe'i rta mgrin la ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba gsum mo: ngo bo ni: rta'i mgo ljang gur snang ba'o: nges tshig ni: rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang ldan: bgrod mkhas: skad ring: shugs che bas: dpal rta mgrin kyang 'khor bar thugs rje'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan la: theg dgu'i sa lam bgrod mkhas:'khor bar thugs rje'i skad ring la: sangs rgyas kyi sa la bgrod pa la shugs che'o: dbye na: rta mgo ljang gu: dpral ba zhur po: rngog ma le brgan: phum phum ser po: don gcig la rtags bzhi tshang ba'o: chos nyid don gyi rta mgrin la'ang: ngo bo:nges tshig: dbye ba gsum mo: ngo bo ni: chos nyid byang chub sems gzhi ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa'o: nges tshig ni: chos nyid byang chub sems rta ltar mgyogs pa'i sems can gyi don la phrin las skad cig gis mdzad pas rta mgrin zhes bya'o: dbye na:phyi'i rta mgrin: nang gi rta mgrin: gsang ba'i rta mgrin dang gsam mo0 phyi'i rta mgrin ni0 rang gi rig pa rta mgrin gyi skur rig me the5 the5130

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6snang ba'o: nang gi rta mgrin ni: rang gi lus rta mgrin gyi skur snang ba'o: gsang ba'i rta mgrin ni: sems nyid rta mgrin gyi ngo bor ye nas grub pa'o: 'khor ba rtags kyi rta mgrin la yang gsam ste0 ngo bo0 nges tshig0 dbye ba gsam moX ngo bo niXdag the5 the5 35 racing 35 35longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o: nges tshig ni: 'khor ba'i sems can la thugs rje rta ltar chags pa che bas dbang gi rigs su sku mdog dmar por bstan pa'o: dbye ba ni: phyi zhi ba spyan ras kazigs thugs rje chen po la: nang pad+ma dbang chen gyi skur bstan pa'o: rta mgrin pad+ma gsung gi lde mig tsu tsu: zhes gsungs so/ /sgrub pa lung gi bka' sgo las/ pad+ma gsung gi sgrub par gdags pa yang: 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rta skad thengs gsum du 'dus te: rta skad lta bar dgongs pa dang: rta skad spyod par dgongs pa'o: rta skad lta bar dgongs pa ni: rta skad thengs gcig bton pas snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus: gnyis kyis pad+ma'i rang bzhin du gyur: gsum gyis bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi sa la sbyangs so: rta skad spyod par dgongs pa ni: rta skad thengs gcig gis lha 'dre thams cad sngangs: gnyis kyis sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran:gsum gyis dbang du 'dus pa'o: de bas na snang srid thams 131

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cad rta skad thengs gsum du 'du la: rta skad pad+ma dbang chen gyi gsung du gnas pas: pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: pad+ma thams cad kyi mtha' gar thag na rta skad thengs gsum gyi dgongs ༄par thug ces kyang de la bya'o: zhes bshad/ ma tshang kha skong gi rgyu dang / mdo rgyud rtog pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma sogs gzhan du yang gsungs mod kyi/ de tsam las ma bris so/ /bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud kyi le'u brgyad pa las/ 'khor 'das snang stong dbyer med rta skad gsum: rang sems dri med rnam dag sa lam bcad: snang stong grag stong dran stong so mar zhog: 'khor 'das zil gnon rta skad dgongs pa yin:zhes gsungs/ drag po rang byung rang shar gyi rdzogs rim snying tika/ rnam pa bcu'i nang tshan gnyis pa ni/ nyon cig gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin: rang rig dri ma med pa de: rnam dag sangs rgyas kun gyi lam: cir snang rtog pas ma ded par: snang srid nga bdag med pa ru: gzugs snang thams cad snang stong yin:sgra rnams grag stong ngo bo med: dran rtog 'gyu ba rlung dang 'dra:thams cad dbyer med so mar zhog: de tshe 'khor ba zil gyis gnon: pad+ma gsung gi dgongs pa yin: zhes gsungs so:zhes pa 'di yin no/ /grol tig thugs sgrub pad+ma rā gar/ rta mabo 132

phuḥmi ཿཿ///spros/rwaspro/ /bye/shā()// //// ////snapa/// /rdo/rgosgyuḥ// //phra ljang zhur rlung lnga ye shes ldan: rta skad rngam sgras chos kyi phung po sdud: phag zhal nag mo ngur sgra phyogs bcur sgrogs: khams gsum dbang sdud phyogs bcu'i dregs pa 'dul: gnyis med hrīḥhūṃ dug lnga'i rtog pa 'joms: zhes gsungs shing skyabs rjes phag rno/'i khrid gnang skabs shig tu yang / phag zhal gyi ngur sgras khams gsum ma lus pa bde ba chen po'i dbyings su sdud nus pa:zhes bka' bstsal pa dran no/ /pra bha ka ras mdzad pa'i rta mgrin sgrub thabs las/ pa la sha'i mdog can gyi rta gdong gsungs nas/rta'i gdong ba ni gzhan pa med pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'di chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / lam rnam par dag par sazhol bar mngon par brjod do/ /zhes dang / thogs pa med pa 'i ye shes kyi sems dud 'gro'i zhal du bstan to/ /zhes so/ /sa/ngas rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel par/ rta ma/grin zhes su grags zhes pa ni chos la 'bigs pa'i ye shes myur 'ing mgyogs pa rta dang 'dra ba dang / sems can gyi don bya ba la ma/gyogs ('dis ni thugs rje'i shugs myur bar bstan pas/ 'grub thag nye bar thes nus) pa rta dang 'dra ba'i phyir rta mgrin zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang de nyid las/ zhi rgyas dbang gi phrin las gsum mtshon pa'i kha dos/ dkar ser sngon po rnams 'dus pa'i ljang gus ni las sna 133

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/d+kutshogs kyi bdag nyid du mtshon zhes lha mo sgrol ma'i skabs su gsungs so/ /rta zhal steng phyogs ring por bstod de 'tsher bas ni/sa bla'i mthar thug pa'i dregs ldan dbang du byed par jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i rta mgrin sgrub thabs shig tu snang ngo / /('di blo 'chugs yin gyi/ rtogs pa bdun brgya pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs su/ rta zhal sngon po tī tī'i sgra sgrogs pa/ srid rtse'i mthar thug pa'i tshangs pa'i sgo nga'i rtse rta zhal gyis mnan pa/ zhes pa 'di las gzhan mi snang ste/ de'ang jo bo'i gzhung yin par ma bshad/ g.yas phyogs su bltas te 'tsher ba'i rtas sa chen po las rnam par rgyal bar byed par sha lo ho tras bshad pa sogs 'ga' zhig kyang chos mthun sbyor yul du yod dam snyam/ rang mchan) sa gzhi la rta'i mchog tu gyur pa rigs bzang zhing rnam 'gyur med pa ni/ ā dzā ne ya:cang shes rnams te/g.yul du mtshon chas lci bar bsnun kyang bdag po gang yin pa 'dor bar mi byed pa'o/ /zhes 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel par bshad de/ bka' gter mang por gzhan don la spro ba mi 'phrogs pa'i brtson 'grus kyi lhar mtshon pa'i phyir rta zhal 'chang bar bshad pa la mkho/ yang de nyid las/ ā dzā ne ya'i ā mngon par khyab pa ste bgrod bya'i gnas su zhon pa pos bzhon nas shugs kyis phyin par byed pa ni nges pa'i tshig go /gang du legs par khur 'khyer ba'i tshul can bde bar bzhon par byar yod pa de ni pi nī ta:ste rnam par dul ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes bshad de chos mtshungs 134

thopa'e snapa///pa/1ཿ// /bye/mi/bye she //// /////pa/// /rdo//2rwaḥ// // tshosbyor dus mkho'o/ /snyan brgyud rta mgrin snying tig las rta skad thengs gsum gyi don gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang sbyar nas tsho gsungs pa ni zur du shes/rta skad thengs gcig ka dag gi dgongs pa ni dbang bzhi ba'i gzhung 'di zab cing gsal te/ tī tī tī0 rdo rje'i rta skad 'tsher myoba'i dbyangs: gsal zhing brjid pa'i gdangs chen po: rang byung nam mkha'i dkyil nas bsgrags: bde stong nyams kyi ngo bor ltos: de la rtse gcig mnyam bzhag pas: dang po skye med stong sang nge: bar du gnas med zang thal le: tha ma 'gags med rjen ce re: rang bzhin yongs shes dran pa'i ngang: yid mig rlung gsum dbyer med 'jog: 'di don rtogs na don gyi dbang: pad+ma dbang chen tshe 'dir 'grub: dhā tā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃḥ zhes bka' bstsal ba'o/ /dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i la bzla rta skad thengs gcig gi gzhung ni/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu gtsug sprul pa rdo rje rta yi skad//mi skye mi 'gag nam mkha'i rang bzhin can/ /snang srid lo ka thams cad cir mi dmigs/ /don dam kun rdzob mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad rnam shes thugs nyid sems/ /dmigs med chos kyi sku la stong ye gsal/ /da ni dmigs med 135

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyomatshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad gzugs su rnam par te/ / longs spyod sku la gsal la ye shes ni/ /gsal ba rang bzhin med par mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad 'du byed gsung du snang / /cir yang sprul te ye shes so sor rtog /gnyis mtha' dngos med mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad 'du shes phrin las grub/ /mngon par byang chub ye shes nan tan te/ /mthar phyin lhun grub mtshon pa mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad tshor ba yon tan 'byung / /mi 'gyur sku la mnyam pa'i ye shes gsal/ /mi mnyam mnyam par mtshon pas mya ngan 'das/ /kun rdzob sgra dbyangs 'byung ba'i gnas dag ni/ /de nyid las sprul rdo rje rta yi dbu/ /mgrin pa pad+ma'i ye shes 'khor lo ste/ /thabs nyid yab ste ya mgal rtags/ /shes rab yum ste ma mgal mam/ /gnyis med lce ste hrīḥnyid 'byung / /de phyir rdo rje rta yi mgrin par brjod/ /sdo rje rta skad dpe ni nam mkhar bzhag /nam mkha'i rang bzhin ma/ skyes ma 'gags pas/ /snang srid kun kyang mtshon pas mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje rta skad don ni chos nyid de/ /chos nyid bde chen ma skyes mi bskyed pas/ /de phyir chos nyid kun kyang mya ngan 'das/rdo rje rta skad rtags ni sems nyid de/ /sems nyid rang bzhin ma/ skyes mi 'gag pas/ /de bzhin sems can mtshon pa mya ngan 'das //136

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6de ltar gdul bya'i don du gsungs pa yang / /phung po khams dang skye mched ma lus pa/ /pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor ye nas yin/ /yin pa'i don la rig pa gsal bkod nas/ /bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /sems dang ye shes dbyer med don gcig pas/ /rtog pa ye shes sems su kun rtogs na/ /bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /'khor ba'i rgyu nyid thar pa'i lam gyi skabs/ /duḥkha'i rgyu nyid chos nyid byang chub sems/ /ma spangs lhun gyis grub pa'i don rtogs na/ /bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /ye shes rta mgrin rang bzhin rta mgrin dang / /las la sogs pa mang po'i tshig brjod kyang / /bdag ni byin rlabs khro bor snang ba las/ /gzhan na khro bor grub pa ci yang med/ /bdag snang bdag 'khol las kun bdag byed de/ /bdag sis g.yos na phyi nang snod bcud g.yo/ /kun tu che btsan 'gran si zla med pas/ /yongs la thogs med bde 'byams rgya mtsho la/ / tshobade chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so/ /thams cad byang chub sems su rtogs pas gang yang lhun gyis grub/ /rnam rtog ming yang med pas gang bsgral ci mi ltas/ /thabs mkhas rol pa yin pas 'khor ba'i skyon ma gos/ /thugs rje byang chub yin pas thar pa bde chen thob/ /kun gyi bdag nyid yin pas mkha' 'gro 137

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ngang gis 'khor/ /bde chen rgyal po yin pas 'khor gyi rje bo yin//thams cad bdag las byung bas kun gyi bdag po yin/ /nga rgyal rtags su che bas 'gro drug thabs kyis 'dul/ /thugs rje'i 'brag /)(1 zu ri mchingazudar zurarar phozuragasgras khams gsum ngas su ldar/ /thugs rja' byams ldan nya ma' 'od bzhin 'char/ /rnam rtog gnyen por mi rtog ye shes che/ /'khor ba'i gnyen por rang 'byung sangs rgyas te/ /rnam rtog thabs kyi gnyen por gang rtogs na/ /mkha' 'gro 'du bar bya ba'i thabs gzhan med/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i don rtogs nas/ /'khor dgra bsgral zhing tshar bcad bya mi dgos/ /ye shes 'jam dpal mtshan gyis rab rdzogs nas/ /rgyal byed rtags dang phyag rgya bsgrub mi dgos/ /phrin las bya rtsol blo las ye 'das na/ / sgom grub dkyil 'khor bya ba ci yang med/ /'di ltar man ngag rtogs pa'i gdeng gyur na/ /bsgrub na skyon med ma bsgrub 'gal ba med/ /bsgral na skyon med ma bsgral 'gal ba med/ /bsam du med do chos dbyings nam mkha' 'dra/ /sgom du med do rang 'byung klong nas shar/ /bde 'byams dbyings phyug yum gyi rgyal po yin/ /ma 'gags ci bder yin gyis yab kyi mkha'/ /sems la gang yang mi rtog rang 'byung sku/ /thabs la gang yang mi 'gog ma bcos sku/ /don la gang yang mi rtog chos kyi sku/ /chos kyi sku la 138

phuḥze :rdo //spro//:rwa( /bye/shā(1// //// ////ཿpa/// /rdo//2rwapa// //phra g.yo zhing skye ba med/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i klong bzhin sgrub pa med/ /ye shes byang chub sems su dag pa na/ /'du 'dzi byis pa'i rtsed mos ci zhig bya/ /ma 'das klong gi dam tshig bsrung med na/ /nyon mongs bde sdug mya ngan ci la spyod/ /thabs mkhas rol pa'i ting 'dzin shar ba la/ /phung po tshi chad phyo sgrub ci la bya/ /phyi nang snod bcud thig ler sangs rgyas na/ /gzhan nas tshol zhing smo na du ci yang med/ /sku yi cho 'phrul rta mgrin sku la gsal/ /skye 'gags med pa'i ngang du la bzla'o/ /gsung gi rang bzhin rta skad ci sgrogs pa/ /mi skye mi 'gag gsung du la bzla'o/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin rta mgrin ci gsal yang / /chos sku dngos med ngang du la bzla'o/ /'di ltar rtogs na rta mgrin rnal 'byor yin/ /gzhan pas khyad 'phags gsang sngags dam pa'i lam/ /zhes so/ /dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyi rta skad thengs gcig gi dgongs pa rdzogs so/ / a /zhes pa ste dpe skyon ni ches mang bar snang yang re zhig bsdur sa ma rnyed/ nyang rin po che'i mkha' 'gro chen mo'i gsang sgrub kyi yab rkyang gi sgrub pa'i le'u las/ dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang gu niḥ rta 'gro ba mgyogs shing shugs che ba dang 'dra bar: dpal rta mgrin sangs rgyas sa la 'gro ba la lha gzhan pas shugs che zhing 'gro ba mgyogs pa'o: ljang gu ni dbang drag 139

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'o: dpral ba zhur ba ni:thags rje dri ma med par gzigs pa'o: phum phum ser po ni che ༄ ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o: rngog ma le brgan ni dbang gi phrin las mdzad pa'o: g.yas phyogs su lta ba ni 'gro ba'i don la bde ba'o: zhes gsungs te/ de'i phyi ma ni gong du/ dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur g.yas phyogs su lta baḥ zhes gsungs so/ /yang bde 'dus bskul chen las/ g.yas kyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: zhal g.yas mya ngan 'das pa'i chos kyang ston:g.yon gyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: rnal 'byor yal gam can la sid+dhi ster: dbus kyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: srid pa'i ma mo bos shing dam la sdud: ces dang / lho brag phyag rdor snyan brgyud kyi drag po sum sgril las/ rta skad g.yas su bton pas pho rgyud dang / g.yon du bton pas mo rgyud thams cad dbang du sdud pa/ dbus su bton pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba/ zhes 'byung zhing / yang de nyid las/ rta skad lan gsum bton pas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ zhes dang / klong snying bka' brgyad las/ dbu gtsug rta skad lhang lhang 'tsher ba yis: ngan song gnas stong ye shes don la skul: ye shes ma mo mkha' 'gro pho nyar 'gyed: ces kyang 'byung /140

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6trarkyud+ku dbang chen (gdab kha lha gzhung gang du byung yang / phur bu'i sgo nas byed pa lā ra/ bro mnan gang du byung yang rta bro zhes lha 'di'i sgo nas byed pa grags che'o) gyi bro/ phur bu'i gdab kha/ ma mo'i thun/ zhes mkhas grub mus srad ji༈ sogs mang pos bshad pa'i rta bro'i dgongs pa ni/ rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi phyi gnod sbyin pho mo'i bar chad 'dul ba brtul zhukas gsum gyi man ngag tu/ lus kyi brtul zhugs lus rta mgrin gyi skur sgom pa dang / ngag gi brtul zhugs rta sngags drag tu zlo 'ing rta skad bton pas dregs pa thams cad dbang med du 'du bar gsungs pa'i 'phror sems ting nge 'dzin gyi brtul zhugs la bdun las: 'brug ltar che ba 'i brtul zhugs ni: rig pa ngar ngang ldan pas hur 'don: thog ltar drag po'i brtul zhugs ni:bar du gcod pa'i steng du thog babs pa ltar drag tu gtad:klolga ltar 'khyug pa'i brtul zhugs ni: ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal gyu ra bar 'don: nyi zla ltar gsal 'grib med pa'i brtul zhugs ni: ting nge 'dzin la gsal 'grib med par rig pa gsal btab: mi rtog pa sbrul lta bu'i brtul zhugs ni: ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa yun ring la tshan che bar bya: chu bo ltar rgyun mi 'chad pa'i brtul zhugs ni: nyin mtshan med par lha'i nga rgyal bya: rdo rje ltar mi 'gyur ba'i brtul zhugs ni: sems mi 141

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyur ba'i gdeng dang ldan par bya'o: nang dug lnga'i rnam rtog gang skyes kyi steng du yang brtul zhugs 'di dag btang na shin tu zab par snang / bar chad mthar phyin pa ni nang gi bar chad yin pas de 'dul ba la nan tan bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ grol tig rta mgrin dregs 'dul dang de gnyis lha sngags dang bshad tshul gcig tu 'dug pas grol tig gi lung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrogs su bris pa dang bsgrig rgyu yin no/ /rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud gcig po de nyid bka' 'bum gyi skor gnyis su bzhugs pa las snga ma zhal gdams skor pa yin la/sgrub thabs skor pa na/ brtul zhugs gsum gyi dang po gnyis sngar dang ha lam 'dra/ de nas/ sems ting nge 'dzin gyi brtul zhugs kyis mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng bca' ba ni: rang dang lha gnyis dbyer med pas: sems skye med kyi rang bzhin ngar dang bcas la: gang la yang 'jigs pa'i nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba med par gdon bgegs kyi steng du thog brdzis bya'o0 skabs sa rta myo ra miskad 'don zhing brtul zhugs bya'o: lus rta mgrin gyi skur gsal bas lus lha'i gdeng gis zin pas lha mi srin sde brgyad dbang du 'a dus: ngag sngags su gsal bas dregs pa can thams cad bka' nyan gsung sdod: yid chos nyid du gsal bas 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad zil gyis non no: de lta bu'i dgongs 142

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 64pa dang ldan tsa na lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus par 'gyur ro:byang gter gegs sel las/ gsang spyod 'di ni 'dre rdog gcig po ma yin pa'i:mdze lhog nad rims thams cad: nyam nga ba: bag tsha ba: mi gtsang ba: mi sdug pa: skyugs bro ba: nyams dma' ba: shed chung ba: ngo tsha ba la sogs mdor na rtog pa skyes tshad gong bzhin du bcad do: zhes gsungs te pad+ma'i lam rim 'grel bar yang zhu dag pher/ dregs pa can thams cad las la bkol nas bran bzhin du las byed de: sarba bhū ta trig nan zhes pa sngags la btags nas rta bro brdung ngo: bar chad thams cad rdul du 'gro'o: zhes grol tig ltar gsungs so/ /yang bka' 'bum byin rlabs sba chos las/ lha 'dre 'gyur med kyi srang la 'jug pa la sasung ste: ri rab kyi khong gseng du mnan pa dang: rgya mtsho'i sating du mnan pa dang: chu bo'i gzhung la mnan pa'o: ri rab khrong seng la mnan pa ni: 'dre dang gdon rang gi sems su the/sa: sems stong par shes: stong pa la gnod byed ma grub pas: rang lta ba mi 'gyur ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa la lha 'dre ldang mi nus so/ /rgya mcho re gting du mnan pa ni: 'dre rnam rtog yin te rtog pa sems las byung: sems ngo bo stong pa yin: kasal la dwangs pa yin: stong gsal rtog med la lha 'dre ma grub pa de sgom pa yin no: chu bo'i gzhung la mnan pa ni: lha 143

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dre'i rtog pa sems yin: rtog pa rgyun chad med par sems las skyes: lha'i bzang rtog dang 'dre'i ngan rtog thams cad byung yang sems las byung: grol yang sems su grol bas rang shar r+hang grol rgyun chad med pa ni thugs rje chen po'i spyod pa yin no: ci de ltar du rtogs tsa na lha 'dre 'gyur med kyi srang du tshud pa zhes bya'o: 'dre'i 'gyu srung rnam rtog yin pas/ rnam rtog de ro snyom gyi gnad kyis thad kar gcod pa 'di la/ bgegs kyi lam srang gcad pa zhes gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ bro mnan rnams su ba// ra chad rnam thar sgo gsum gyi klong du rgyas 'debs byed par gsungs pa dang / gong gi brtul zhugs bdun pa dang / 'di rnams lto sbyar na bro mnan gyi dgongs pa la nges pa ster ro/ /'gyur med kyi srang du 'dzud ces pa ni skor lnga'i skabs su/ bzlog sgyur yongs grub 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings: mi ldog phyag rgyas 'debs pa'i phrin las mdzod:ces pa dang don 'dra ste/ de'ang dngos 'dzin gzhir bzhag gi steng nas bar chad zlog pa'i thabs mang po 'tshol ba ni/ khyi rdo rjes su rgyug pa'i dpe ltar gnod pa gcig gnyis las thar yang da dung 'dzad med du rting mnan nas yong bas snying po chung la/'dir bshad pa'i zab gnad 'di yod na/ rmi lam du 'jigs skrag chu bo'i gnyer ma ltar 'byung bzhin pa'i 'phro la gnyid gcis 144

phuḥmi ཿpa///ba/ཿཿpu /khro/bye'u)// 2rtan /////pa/// 1rngo//sprerwaḥ// // rdopu de sad na de thams cad kyi rdzun phugs der rdibs nas 'gro ba bzhin yin te/ sgrub pa lung chen 'dus par/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi zlog pa'i gzhung / 'khor 'das chos kun gdod ma nas: stong chen mkha' ltar rnam par dag: don gyi kun bzang he ru ka'i: thig le chen por dbyer med kyang: de nyid ma rig 'khrul pa las: bdag dang gzhan du rnam par brtags: nyon mongs bag chags rim gyis 'phel: 'jigs pa'i gdon dang bzhi brgya'i nad: ldang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: bar chad rkyen ngan ci shar yang: 'khrul pa rmi lam lta bur snang: snang dus nyid nas ma grub pas: sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig pa ltar:rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub sems: stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bh+yo: mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings su zlog: smon pa med pa'i mkha' la bstims: dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa yi/ phyag rgya chen por rgyas thob cig: ces gsungs so/ /tshul de klong du gyar /rdo she ///nge zir shi///shepa na bar chad — chung gang yin yang 'dul dka' sla med /gong gi dpes shes so/ /rtogs pa mthon po la bshad pa bzhin re zhig mi 'ong yang / 'di mos sgom tsam byas kyang stobs gzhan dang ches mi 'dra'o/ /rgya gar gyi paṇa grub du ma'i gzhung dang /ka/ter phyogs mang por don dam pa'i srung ba gsungs pa dang /145

yod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de kho na nyid kyi sbyin sreg 'jog tshul sogs la ltos dang / srung zlog mnan sreg thams cad kyi skabs su/ gtso bo brgya'i nang nas gros thag chod nus gcig zer ba lta bu ni/ dbang chen glu gar gyi de nyid bde stong dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor 'di nyid yin par nges so/ /rta mchog rol pa'i tan+t+ra le'u brgya re gcig par/ tshangs sogs zhing khams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dbyangs drug rtogs pa'i lta bar bzhag /bro drug rdzogs pa'i spyod lam yin/ /dbyangs drug gdangs su blang ba ni/ /grub pa'i dbyangs kyis thugs dam bskang //tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis zhing khams sbyangs/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis ma sring mnyes/ /las kyi dbyings kyis pho nya 'gyed/ /sgyu ma'i dbyangs kyis dgongs rgyud gsal/ /'bar ba'i dbyangs kyis bdud bzhi 'dul/ /hūṃ gi dbyangs kyis 'phro 'du 'khrugs/ /gru gu'i rta mgrin dregs sgrol gyi bro rabs las/ glu drug gsang ba'i dbyings dang sbyor:bro drug 'dul ba'i las dang sbyor: zhes gsungs/ der glu drug kyang / glu drug dbyangs su blang ba ni: tshangs pa'i glus ni zhing khams sbyong: dpal gyi glus ni 'phro 'du gsal: khro bo'i glus ni bdud bzhi 'dul: gsang ba'i glus ni ma sring bsten:hūṃ sgra'i glus ni 'phro 'du 'khrugs: dbu ma'i glus ni dgongs rgyud gsal: zhes byung /gar gyi bro brdung byin rlabs che/ /dbang gyi bro brdung dug gsa' 'joms/ /pad+ma'i bro brdung chags pa med/ /khro bo'i bro brdung dregs pa 'joms/ /phra men bro ni 'gugs sbyong byed/ /rdzogs 146

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6ra〉pa'i bros ni las rnams 'grub/ /ces gsungs/ gru gu yang dbang gi rta mgrin bro rabs las ni/ bro drug rdzogs par ldan par brdung: khro bo'i bro brdung dregs pa 'joms: dpal gyi bro brdung bdud bzhi 'dul: ma sring bro brdung gdug pa 'dul: dbang gi bro brdung srin po 'dul: las kyi bro brdung pho nyar 'gyed:rnal 'khyor bro brdung thugs dam bskul: 'di ni dpal gyi thugs dam yin: 'di ni yu ma gyi gsang tshig yin: 'di ni ma sring dngos grub yin: 'di ni pho nya'i longs spyod yin: zhes bshad do/ /gzhan yang rta rgyud las/ breng nge ba dang /dung nge ba dang / sha ta pa dang / ga ta pa dang / cang ga de'u dang /pang ka de'u'i glu drug dang/ /'di drug la sgyu 'phrul lam rim 'grel par/'bring po gnyis/ ring po gnyis/ thung ngu gnyis zhes bshad do/ /de dag dang so sor sbyar rgyu'i bro drug so so'i yon tan dang bcas te gsungs pa rnams bde 'dus sman sgrub tu yang 'byung la/ bde 'dus kyi skabs der/ sngon gyi rgyal ba glu yis 'grub: rig 'dzin rdo rje glu yis 'dren: rnal 'byor dbang phyug glu yis 'grub: bstan pa rgya mtsho glu yis spel: sman gyi rig 'dzin glu yis 'bebs: srid pa'i bu mo glu yis bsten: bdud dang srin po glu yis 'dul: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho glu yis 'bod: dngos grub rgya mtsho glu yis thob: phrin las rgya mtsho glu yis byed: de phyir glu 'di rtag tu blangs: zhes sogs glu bro'i yon tan rgya cher bshad do/ /dbang chen yang gsang las rta mgrin gyi spyod pa'i 147

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/man ngag tu/ dpal rta mgrin bsgrubs nas: bar chad 'dul ba'i phyir: dur khrod kyi gnas dben par gzhan gyis ma tshor bar rta skad 'don pa'i rngam stabs bya'o: bro brdung gzir mnan bya'o: zhes rgyun spyod kyi nang du'o/ /sgyu 'a phrul las/ spyugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che/ /zhes par/ 'khor sdud pa'i bshugs pa snyan pa dang / gdug pa 'dul ba'i bshugs pa drag pa dang /byin 'bebs pa'i bshugs pa byings che ba'am gdangs 'tsher la yun ring ba ste/ de gsam po'i dbags kyis khams gsam 'thor rigasi༅ rig mi dmi mibar byed pa'i rlung chen pos g.yeng ba 'gran zla med par che ba'o/ /zhes sgrol g.yung gnyis kyis bshad pa'ang rta skad dang tshul mthun no/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo'i bam sgrub las/ bshugs pa'i rta skad 'bod: ces kyang ngo / /nyang gter mkha' 'gro chen mo'i tshogs mchod kyi cho gar/ rta phag yab yum 'khor bcas kyi bro brdung rgyas pa/ dgra ni thal bar rlog pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: de phyir glu bro rgyun mi bcad: ces pa'i 'gres byang can zhig gsungs pa'i mthar/ byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i dus dang: bar chad 'dul ba'i dus dang: gtor gzhong gnon pa'i dus rnams su bro 'di brdung ngo: zhes bshad do/ /rta mgrin gyi gar dgu la bshad tshul bye brag pa ni/ dregs pa 148

ra〉rmāḥmi snang//pa/ཿpa/ /nyebyecanasdo 2rtan rta//cad// sturngosasprerwad/ /skyi9kand 'bebs rgyud las/ lha chen gzhon nu gdong drug gis/ /lha min ba su ka ra bsad/ /de la dpa' bor mtshan btags pas/ /nge/ bcom dpa' bo he ru ka /dbang phyug chen po 'khyud nyams ṣ+pegs/ /de bcom sku la yum 'khril sgegs/ /khyab 'jug phag seng 'jigs gzugs nyams/ /de bcom he ru ka 'jigs rung / /sku yi gar gsum bstan pa ni/ /sku la tshor ba bde sdug nub/ /tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs rta skad snyan/ /de bcom rtags su zhal g.yas bzhad/ /tshogs kyi bdag po glang sna gshe /de bcom zhal sayon khro bar bshad/ /sgra gcan nyi zla khar mid rngam/ /de bcom dbus kyi zhal dmar rngam/ /gsung gi gar gsum bstan pa ni/ /gsung la tshor ba bde sdug nub/ /brgya byin lag na rdo rje thogs/ /lha rnams snying rje'i sems kyis skyong / /de bcom pas ni snying rje mdzad/ /klu chen se sha tsa ra yis/ /'gre ldog byas pas sa 'gul byung / /de bcom klu brgyan ngo mtshar che/ /me lhas stong gsum me yis bshigs/ /de bcom me dadu/nga dbus na bzhugs/ /thags kyi //de/ /spyordordo /jenges ༄༄migar gsum bstan pa / /thugs la ra ba ba sdug nub/ /ces so/ /rngog ma le brgan las ni/ sgeg pa'i nyams kyis sgeg pa'i gar mdzod la/ /'dod chags dbang phyug gdul bar mdzod/ /a ni dpa' bo chen po ste/ /lha min ba su ka ra 'dul bar mdzod//149

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khu sge'ajigs byed chen po 'jigs pa'i sku/ /khyab 'jug chen po 'dul bar mdzod/ /sku yi gar gyis sku yi gar mdzod la/ /bdag gi lus la gar rnams 'char bar mdzod/ /rgod pa'i nyams kyis ha ha bzhad pa ni/ /gzhon nu smin drug rta skad drag pos btul/ /gshe ba'i gar gyis hi hi gshe ba ni/ /tshogs kyi bdag po glang po'i sna can btul/ /rngam pa'i gar gyis hring hring za byed rngam/ /sgra gcan ra hu la ni rngam pas btul/ /gsung gi gar gyis gsung bi gar mdzod la/ /bdag gi ngag la sngags su 'char bar mdzod/ /snying rje'i gar gyis thugs rje'i rol bar mdzad/ /brgya byin glang chen zhon pa sgrol bar mdzod/ /ngo mtshar gar gyis ngo mtshar bskyed par mdzad/ /klu chen se sha ra tsa bsgral bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyis zhi ba 'dul mdzad pa/ /me lha drang srong chen po sgrol bar mdzod/ /thugs kyi gar gyis thugs kyi gar mdzod la/ / bdag gi sems la nyams rnams 'char bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ cung zad mi 'dra'o/ /'chi med mdzod las/ shugs 'gros mdur 'gros gar 'gros dang / /'gros chen gsar 'gros 'di rnams ni/ /rta 'gros 'gro lugs lnga yin te/ /zhes pa'i dang po ni/ khyab par mtshungs par 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de las lhag cing gsal bar 'gro ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor can 150

〈mi〈mi)〈mezhe cad/bcang cesacad bsta rtagacad/ /rdosasprepa// (3 gyi gar gyis 'gro ba'o/ /bzhi ba ni/ shugs kyis 'phen cing yongs su 'gro ba'o/ /lnga ba ni/ myur bar ldem zhing 'gro ba'o/ / 'dod 'jo las so// //mkha' 'gro ma'i gser sgrub kyi 'grel pa las/ dpa' bo ni dbu gtsug rta skad 'gro ba mgyogs: shugs che ba dang 'dra:sa/ngas rgyas kyi sa la 'gro ba mgyogs: 'khor ba sgrol bas shugs che ba'o: yum rdo rje phag mo ni: dpa' mo'i gtsug phag ni rtog pa/ chung zhing: shugs che ba dang 'dra bar: 'khor ba la bzang ngan rtog pa med: 'khor ba rtsad gcod pa shugs che ba yin no:'es so/ /zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs las/ khro zhal dmar mo spyan gsum thar la gzir ba: phag gdong nag mo spyan gsum ༄gyen la gzigs pa: zhes dang / don dam pa chos nyid yang dag pa/ la rtog pas phag zhal: gang gis kyang mi 'gyur bas nag por bstan pa: de yang sems can la thugs rjes rang byung du 'byung bas phag zhal g.yas su byung ba'o: kun rdzob longs sku sprul skus 'gro don mngon du byed pas g.yon khro zhal du byung ba: khams sa/sum thugs rjes gzigs pas spyan gsum thur du gzigs pa:rnam thar gsum gyi gzigs pas phag zhal spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa: zhes so/ /zhal steng 'og gi spyan gzigs tshul 'di 151

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yab la'ang 'dra bar/ mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu'i phrin las chen mo las/ spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang gu 'tsher ba las: rdzu 'phrul myar mgyogs ston pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: khro zhal dmar po cung ༄zad bzhad pa las: bde chen las la khol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: bde chen rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes phag gi zhal dang / kun rtog bag chags dang bcas pa za ba dme ba za ba'i don du mngon/ yab 'dod chags rta'i gdong pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang / yum mi rtog phag gi gdong pas stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshon te/ thabs kyi sku mdog dmar po dang / shes rab mthing khar bstan pa'i don yang des shes/ rta zhal spyan gsum gyen la gzigs pa las:sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i ḍā ki 'bum: khro zhal spyan gsum thur la gzigs pa las: khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhes so/ /yang phag mo'i gsang sgrub las:phag zhal ni: phag gti mug che zhing gtsang btsog med pa dang 'dra bar: gti mug ma spangs par rang sar dag nas thugs rje ye shes kyi brtul zhugs kyis nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa rtsad nas gcod pa'o: zhes dang / yang gsang sgrub cig las/rnam rtog grogs su khyer bas bzang ngan spong len dang gtsang btsog med pas phag zhal: zhes so/ /phag mo rigs 'dus ma'i sgrub thabs las/ rnam rtog gtsang dme med pas phag gdong nag 152

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6zhemo spyi gtsug tu 'thon pa: don dam chos nyid mi 'gyur bas nag mo: sems can don la thugs rjes 'jug pas bde bas g.yas ngos su lta ba: gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod cing 'dul bas phag skad du ngur ba: dregs pa can bdud dang dgra bgegs la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad 'jigs par mdzad pa: bdag gi dbang du bsdus nas bka' nyan las la 'khol bar byedapa: 'jig rten 'das pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa dang 'jig rten ma 'das pa'i dur khrod brgyad kyi na/kha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du sdud pas bka' nyan gsung sdod 'khor du bskor ba: zhes gsungs/ rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i cho gar yang / khro zhal dmar mo bzhad pa'i zhal: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dam la sdud:(mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel bar/ thams cad 'dod chags chen mo'i bdag nyid du za bas na phag mo'o/ /zhes phung khams skye mched thams cad mchog gi dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid du za bas na phag mor bshad de/ 'di phyi nang gsang ba'i phag mo gsum ka la sbyor chog pa 'dra/ yang na/ phyin ci log gi spros pa'i dme ba mtha' dag rnam dbye med par bde stong rang gi ngo bor za bas te/ phag mo shes rab kyi phyogs yin pas stong phyogs gtso snyam) spyi gtsug phag gdong ngur sgra 'don: 'jig rten dregs pa las la 'khol: zhes so/ /phag mo sngon mo'i sgrub thabs las/ phag mo'i ngur sgras gdug pa 153

21rngad/ (9 lngardo sdo/ba khur:drogs ni/da bstan nyi:re gasdo/nga khurabuzug/ tra'adul: srid pa gsum po za bar byed: ces so/ /phrin las chen mo las: kun rdzob rang bzhin khro zhal dmar mo las: snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i ḍa ki 'bum: don dam rang bzhin phag 4rwa ga ///tsā ///rezhal nag mo las: brgyal nad smyo 'bogs ga nga ba ci mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhes so/ /de thams cad mkha' 'gro chen mo'i skor ro/ yang phag mo sngon mo snga ma las/ khro zhal thugs la gzigs pa khams gsum sems can la kun rdzob tu thugs rjes gzigs pa'o:phag zhal sngon mo gyen la gzigs pa ni don dam mya ngan las 'das pa la 'god pa'o: zhes so/ /khros nag gi snyan brgyud 'grel par/ spyi gtsug phag zhal nam mkha'i gnas: zhes pas:spyi gtsug ral pa'i gseb nas phag zhal nag po byung nas gyen du gzigs pas rtog med nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa la dus rtas tu gnas pa'i brda'o: de yang phag zhal steng du ngur bas gzugs med kyi khams thams cad dbang du sdud pa: phag skad bar du ngur bas gzugs khams thams cad dbang du sdud pa:phag skad 'og tu ngur bas 'dod khams thams cad dbang du sdud pa: phag skad phyogs bzhir sgrogs pas mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi dbang du sdud pa'o: zhes gsungs/ khros ma'i mchod gzhung las/phag skad shar du bsgrags pa yis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro pho nyar 154

sbrangashāmi :pa///pa/ཿpa/ /bye/shā(38/ re/// ////ཿpa/// cardo//sgyuḥ// // tsho'asedakya rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i brtul zhugs kyis0 shar phyogs dri nobashālko /rdorngo /35 za'i gdon tshogs dbang du bsdus: shar du dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gnas su/ lho ru/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu/ pad+ma/byang du/ las kyi/ shar lhor/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro/ lho nub/ sna tshogs/ nub byang / thams cad/ byang shar/ 'jig rten/ steng du/ sangs rgyas/ 'og tu/ log 'dren mkha' 'gro/ zhes dang /shar phyogs dri za'i/ zhes par/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i/ klu dbang /byang gnod sbyin/ me lha'i/ srin po'i/ rlung lha'i/ 'byung po'i/steng lha'i/ 'og sa gdon tshogs rnams dbang du sdud: ces bcug pa bshad/ dar sku'i sgrub gzhung las/ spyi gtsug tu phag zhal nag mo tshangs pa'i dbyings su ngur ba: thengs gsum ngur bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa: thengs gsum ngur bas srid sasum zil gyis gnon pa: thengs gsum ngur bas dgos 'dod thams cad char ltar 'bebs pa: zhes gsungs so/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi sgrub tshul las/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbang du sdud mdzad pa: dpa' bo dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po la: zhes dang / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams las la khol mdzad ma: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rdo rje phag mo la: zhes so// /rta mgrin hūm̐ mdzad chen po'i rgyud las/ dang po gsung gi sgra 155

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgrags pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskul/ /bar du gsung gi sgra bsgrags pas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub 'bebs/ /tha mar dbang gi sgra bsgrags pas/ /ngan song 'khor ba gtan nas sgrol/ /bdud srin klu rnams zil gyis mnan/ /zhes sogs/sku phyag rgya/ gsung rig pa/ thugs phyag mtshan/ yon tan bcud len/ phrin las gdab kha'i las sbyor sogs las/ che mchog rin chen nyid ma'i rigs yin pas bdud rtsi'i sgrub lugs dang sbyor ba bzhin/ pad+ma gsung yang rta skad kyi sgrub lugs dang sbyor la/ nga rgyal rdo rje rgyas las la bsngags pas bdud rtsi sgrub skabs dngos grub thams cad rgyas las kyi sgrom du bcug nas sgrub pa ltar/'dod chags rdo rje gsung gi sgrub par dngos grub mtha' dag dbang gi phrin las kyi sgrom du bcug nas sgrub bo/ /che mchog gi skabs su'ang / dngos grub dbang byed la rta mgrin bsngags te/ dkyil 'khor drug dang sbyor ba brgyad las rjes chags kyi 'od zer spro ba/ des 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi bdud rtsi dgug pa/ de nyid dkyil 'khor ba'i sbyor mtshams su bskyil ba/ gsang gnas kyi sgo dbye ba/rdzas la dbab pa rnams grub pa'i 'og tu/ bdud rtsi'i dngos grub de nyid gzhan gyis 'phrog tu med pa dang / sgrub pa pos longs 156

kyi ru'i snyepa///spros157 /bye/mi/tre// //// ////snyepa/// /rdorngo/shāḥ// // rdospyod du btub pa'i ched/ rta mchog dpal gyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang du bya ba'am bcings shing brtan par byas te/gdod dngos grub len par gsungs so/ /'dir dbang las kyi sgo nas dngos grub thams cad byed tshul yang / glu gar gyis sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs chags shing dgyes par spyir skul ba dang /de dag gi thugs dngos grub stsol ba la dgyes par bye brag tu skul ba'i sgo nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub yid bzhin du 'bebs pa dang /bka' sdod ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi snying chags shing dga' bar byas te spyir skul ba dang / de rnams phrin las rgya mtsho sgrub pa la khyad par du spro bar byas pa'i sgo nas gang 'dod kyi las rnams byed pa ste/ zur tho'i rgyud skor na shin tu gsal zhing / 'di ga'i bro gzhung las kyang gsal bor 'byung ngo / /rta skad kyi de nyidabyudang sbyar na'ang / dngos grub ci 'dod du bkol btub pa'i las rung sgrub pa ni/ dngos grub dbang byed kyi sgrub par 'gro bas/ bka' brgyad rang shar sogs ltar rta skad kyi dgongs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dngos grub thams cad rang gi dbang skal du 'gyar nges par byas nas gzhan gyis mi phyed par gyar pa la dngos no༅ char ri tsho lhur lhur ༄shi lhuragrub la dbang bsgyur ba zhas bya'/ /'ad na dbang las kya skabs su sbyor tshul tsam yin gyi/ dbang las dang sbyor dgos pa'i nges 157

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa ni med dam snyam/ nyang gter rta mgrin bde gshegs gcig dril las/ dbang chen bsgrub pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad shugs 'byung du 'grub par gsungs te/ rga shi med pa tshe'i dngos grub/ byin rlabs dbang gi dngos grub/ drag po mthu'i dngos grub/ btsan phyug nor gyi dngos grub/ pu tra mi'i dngos grub/ 'gro bas bkur ba'i dngos grub/ 'tsho ba zas kyi dngos grub/ thun mong du las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i dngos grub dang brgyad do/ /yul gsum gyad du gyur ces pa'i dang po yid kyi yul du gsal ba ni sla/ gnyis pa dbang po'i yul du gsal ba ni lha dngos kyi zhal mthong ba lta bu la mi byed/ sems shin tu goms pa'i dbang gis lha lam stong gzugs lta bu'i lha'i snang ba mthong ba la byed gsungs te lang gshegs las ting nge 'dzin gyi rtags snang la zla ba dang nyi ma 'dra ba sogs mthong bar gsungs pa lta bu'am//rnam 'grel las 'dod 'jigs goms pa'i snang ba lta bu/ zhes/ pas dpogs/ gsum pa lus yul du gsal ba ni ris gzhan gyis kyang lhar mthong du btub pa zhig yin gsungs te/ 'di sgyu ma mkhan pos (nus pa thob tshad sgyu ma mkhan dang 'dra zer ba sogs ni gtan min no)rde shing rta glang sogs su ston pa lta bur mngon/ rta skad gtsug thon yang phyi ma (spyir rta skad gtsug thon la'ang rim pa du ma zhig yod 'dra yang /158

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6'di ma mtha'i mtshams bshad pa'o/ /) 'di la sbyar 'dug pas bskyed rim rags pa mthar son pa na 'ong bar bzhed 'dra// //༄/ /rta dzab skor gyi dran tho dngos grub rgya mtsho'i mdzod khang /gsang rdzogs rgyud las/ ye shes 'jig rten gang bsgrub kyang: srog sdom gzer bzhi ma thebs na: nam yang don med yug sa rkyang: drang don rdzun gyi 'khrul 'khor yin: yongs rdzogs dpal gyi srog 'phrog thabs: gcig shes pas ni kun srog thob: dper na sgra gcan 'dzin gyi khams: nam mkha'i nyi ma gcig zin pas: chu phran stong gi nyi ma kun: ma bzung bar yang stong srog thob: de phyir srog gi gzer bzhi gces:dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal bshams: dbus su mtshan ldan ka pā lar: dpal chen sku gcig gsal bar dgod: bskyed rdzogs gzhung bsrang dzab rdzogs rjes: mi rtog bya bral so mar bzhag: de nas dpal gyi srog 'phrog thabs: ting 'dzin gzer dang snying po'i gzer: dgongs pa'i gzer dang 'phro 'du'i gzer: ting 'dzin gzer ni thod sku la: rtse gcig sems bzung yengs mi bya: yul gsum gyad du gyur ba dang:dpal chen he ru dngos dang mjal: bzlog pa he ru kas mi 159

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/spyod: ting 'dzin mi 'gyur gzer med na: sku ni nam yang mthong mi 'gyur: snying po sngags gzer yongs rdzogs kyi: gtso bo'i sngags dag sel med bzlas: thugs srog hūṃ la rtsa sngags 'khor: gsal ba'i 'phro 'dus srog sngags bgrang: de tshe dpal byon lung yang ston: nus pa'i rtsal rdzogs lha rnams 'khol: srog snying bsnyen rdzogs gzer med na: lha dang dam can khuṭa mi srid: dgongs pa'i gzer ni zhi khro'i lha: yongs rdzogs dpal chen rang sems las: gud na med cing ru tra yang :logs na med do rang gi sems: sems nyid stong pa chos kyi sku:gsal la ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs: sna tshogs rang shar sprul pa'i sku: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: snang stong dbyer med ye shes sku: 'gyus dran rnam rtog bsam yas kyang: yongs sa rdzogs pa dpal gyi 'khor0 bsam gyis mi khyab ye sangs rgyasaXmi rib ///5 ///)rang bzhin nyid las g.yo ba med: dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer med na: dpal chen 'grub kyang thun mong las: mchog mi 'grub cing ru trar gol: 'phro 'du'i gzer ni dmigs pa yi:bsgyur kha shes na 'dod dgur bsgyur: ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phro 'du yis: sems kyi nus pa rtsal rdzogs te: gang ltar bsam pa de ltar snang: sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs mthus: zhi rgyas 160

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6dbang drag la sogs pa: phan gnod las ka gang yang 'grub:dper na nor bu gcig nyid la: mchog gsol rkyen gyi bye brag tu:ji ltar 'dod pa so sor skong: 'phro 'du sna tshogs gzer med na:dmigs gtad gcig las don mi 'grub: 'phro 'du'i las kha bsgyur shes na: the'u rang tha chung gcig gis kyang: phrin las thogs med las kun 'grub: thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin: kha bsgyur gnad kyi man ngag ni: yongs rdzogs dpal chen he ru nas: 'gong po grong rgyug yan chod po'i: ye shes 'jig rten gang yin yang: gcig la bsnyen rdzogs grub thob nas: las kyi kha bsgyur gang yang 'grub: dper na lcags rdo sngar btul nas: go khrab mtshon cha ci bsgyur nyan: rdo ma thul na lags yin kyang 0 bsgyur sogs dngos kyi bzo mi btub0 de the /5 sna//5 ///stobazhin lha 'dre gcig 'grub na: kha bsgyur gang la zhugs kyang 'grub: rang shar gyi rgyud tshig dang yang zhu bsdur pher ro 'di rnams 'og min bgrod pa'i them skas dang bsgrigs nas slob pa gal che/ pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa zhes zer ba ltar/ sgrub lugs 'di la gsung bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gtso bo yin cing / (de nyid bsdus pa'i 'gro 'dul gyi dum bu la chos rgya gtso bo yin par bshad pa dang mthun)sgrub sde gzhan gyi dzab las kyang tshan che la myur ro/ /161

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de la gsang rdzogs kyi dzab dgongs chen mo las/ pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa la dgongs pa rnam pa bzhi ste: drag sngags bsnyen pa bskyal ba'i dgongs pa ni: bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen dpa' bo gcig par bsgom pa'i spyi gtsug gi snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku la phog pas skus mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: sems can gyi lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku'i dngos grub dbyig bsdus: dbu gtsug rta mgrin gyi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros: gsung la phog pas gsung mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: sems can gyi ngas la phog pas ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi dngos grub dbyig bsdus: pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing kha 'phros: bde bar gshegs pa'i thags la phog pas thags mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul:sir+sha ra༅sems can gyi yid la phog pas yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas thugs kyi dngos grub dbyig bsdus par bsgom mo:phar 'phros pa dang tshur 'dus pa'i dpe mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu'o: ye shes kyi 'od zer 'phros pa'i dpe gser gyi ba thag 'dzings pa lta bu'o: drag po sngags kyi 'od zer 'phro ba'i dpe 162

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 64tralcags kyi tsha tsha brdab pa lta bu'o: lha 'dre'i dmag dpung gzhom pa'i dgongs pa ni: bdag pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i zhal nas trīḥ zhes brjod pas: dbyings gting mtha' med pa nas skye 'gro gzugs su snang ba yan chad pad+ma dbang chen ('di ni snang srid thams cad dbang gi rgyal tham gyis mnan nas zil gnon 'phel tshul yin te/ des lha 'dre'i rdzong phrogs pa dang / lha 'dre rnams ri dwags rgya nang du btsud pa ltar byed de/kacod kyi zil gnon dmigs skor dang tshul mthun no/ /) gyi lha tshogs su gyur te: de rnams kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba re re: de'i thugs rdo rje'i lte ba la hrīḥ de'i mtha' la sngags kyis bskor bar bsam la bzlas pa'o: de ltar bzlas pas thugs ka nas pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku tshon gang ba dpag tu med pa 'phros:pa/d+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku la phog pas kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta'i rgyud bskul: sku mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: sprul pa'i phra men gnyis kyi tshogs dang bcas pa 'phros: gnod byed kyi 'byung po rnams lcags kyus bzung zhing zhags pas bcings: lcags sgrog gis bsdams phur bus btab ste rang dbang med par dbang du sdud par bsam mo: khyad par du yang klu pho mo dang klu bsen pho rno/ rnams bsgral nas lha mi srin sde brgyad thams cad brlag par byas te: bdag gi sku la thim nas dbang gi rta skad phyogs bcur 163

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgrags pas: zhing khams thams cad dbang du bsdus nas dbang gi 'od zer bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur lhab lhab gyur par bsgom mo: dam can khyi bzhin du bkol ba'i dgongs pa ni:bdag gis hrīḥhūṃ brjod pa tsam gyis pad+ma dbang chen gyi skur gyur nas: trīḥhūṃ zhes brjod pas khams gsum ma lus zil gyis mnan te: snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad pad+ma dbang chen ('di yang dregs pa zil gnon 'phen tshul yin te/ gong gi mchan las shes so/ /) gyi sku las gzhan rdul tsam yang ma grub ste: ma bcos ma sbyangs lhun gyis grub par rdzogs so: de nas rta mgo ljang gu dpral ba zhur bo rngog ma le brgan phum phum ser po'i zha' nas trīḥ hrīḥtrī brjod pas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma: rdo rje ging pho dang ging mo thams cad bka' 'og tu bsdus nas gcer bu lhags pas btab pa bzhin 'dar yed yed mig rig rig bka' ci bstsal bgyid zer bar bsam mo: de nas bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen shar phyogs sa rta skad thengs gcig bton pas0 rdo rje ri ring ///)ging pho rgyud thams cad dbang du bsdus: lho phyogs su rta skad thengs gcig bton pas gshin rje dang mo rgyud thams cad dbang du bsdus: nub phyogs su rta skad thengs gcig bton pas klu dang sa bdag thams cad dbang du bsdus: byang phyogs su rta 164

tshoneshāmi445〉 ཿpa///pa/ཿpa/ /nyebye/byed/ //// /////pa/// 1rngo//sprerwaḥ// /rtenaskad thengs gcig bton pas gnod sbyin dang gza' thams cad dbang du bsdus nas zhal du bdud rtsi dang : lce la dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ bzhag nas las la bskul bas bstan pa srung ba'i las la thogs pa med par byed de: khyi gsar rbad pa bzhin du 'gro'o: klu'i bar chad srung ba'i dgongs pa ni: bdag pad+ma dbang chen du bsgom pa'i thugs ka nas sku rang kho na 'dra ba grangs med pa spros pas khams gsum srid gsum thams cad dpal rta mgrin gyi skus tham gyis bkang nas klu rigs thams cad zil gyis mnan: phra men byi la pu shud mgo can spros: de las kyang yang sprul mang po spros nas gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i klu dang sa bdag la sogs pa rnam/sa lcags kyas snying nas bzang : phur bus dum bur gtub:༄ ra klad khrag rnams zhal du gsol: phung po lhag ma med par bsgral nas bdag gi sku la thim pas snang grag thams cad pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku dang : gsung du gyur par bsam la bzlas pa bya'o: zhes so/ /bde 'dus dzab bsnyen las (dbang chen 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/sngasas 'dis rnam bzhi'i phrin las thams cad thogs med du byed pa dang / rim dgu'i theka pa'i chos thams cad bsdus par gsungs so/ /) oṃ pad+ma na ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya gri wa hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ ye shes lnga dang ldan pa: pad mi 'gyur 165

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i rigs: ma na byams pa chen po: ta dga' ba chen po: kri ta btang snyoms chen po: badz+ra mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje: gro bdag nyid chen po : ta bdag gi sku: ha bde ba chen po: ya 'dren pa chen po: kṛ gcod pa chen po: ba dag pa'i sku: hūṃ sdud pa chen po: phaṭa gcod pa chen po: de ni don chos nyid dang sbyar te bshad pa'o: oṃ ye shes rnam pa lnga: pad+ma na ta kri ta pad+ma dbang chen gyi snying po: badz+ra gro ta zil gnon khro bo brgyad kyi snying po:h+ya kṛ wa yum rnams kyi snying po'o: hūṃ bka' nyan las byed kyi snying po'o: phaṭa sgo ba bzhi'i snying po: pad+ma dbang chen lha rgyud dang sbyar ba'o: oṃ ye shes rnam pa lnga: pad+ma pad+ma'i rigs: a na ta kri ta rta mgrin: badz+ra rdo rje: kro ta khro bo: h+ya kṛ wa rta mgrin:hūm̐ bsdus: phaṭa sod sreg: lha 'dre'i dmag dpung gzhom par bstan pa'o: oṃ ye shes lngas 'khol ba: pad+ma na ta kri ta pad+ma dbang chen: badz+ra gro dha rdo rje khro bo: h+ya kṛ wa gsung rta skad dang ldan pa: hūṃ sde brgyad las la gzhug cing dbang du sdud pa: phaṭa las la bskul ba'o: dam can khyi bzhin bskul ba dang sbyar ba'o:oṃ ye shes rnam pa lngas bsreg pa: pad+ma na ta kri ta pad+ma dbang chen0 badz+ra kro da rdo rje khro bo0 h+ya kṛ wa rta mgrin0 hūm̐ stobs kyis 35) snabarta/ sne'u) (5)klu gdol thul ba: phaṭa sod: nā ga klu 'dul ba'i don du bzlas 166

zla byi snapa///spro//1ཿ// /bye/shā/tre/sdu //// ////snapa/// /rdo//4ཿཿ// // mopa 'o: de ltar pad+ma dbang chen gyi: bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi don bstan pa: dpal gyi rta skad thengs gsum dang : ma mo'i 'gying skad thengs gsum dang : rnal 'byor brda skad thengs gsum gyi:dang pos snang srid thams cad kun: rta mgrin dbang gi lha ru gyar: gnyis pas snang srid sha khrag 'gyar: gsum pas ma sring ring rig midabyings nas bskul: bstan pa'i mkhar spe'u brtsigs pa'o:'di lta bu yi don rtogs na: rta mgrin dbang gi rnal 'byor yin:lha srin las la 'di yis 'khol: lha 'dre'i dmag dpung 'di yis 'joms: nā ga klu rnams 'di yis thul: drag sngags bsnyen pa 'di yis skyol: gsung gi dngos grub 'di yis 'thob:dbang chen sku yang 'di yis mthong : gsang sngags zab mo'i man ngag 'di: skal med rmongs pa'i gang zag dag: kun la bstan par ma gsungs so: zhes gsungs/ 'di ni phyi ma'i phyi ma sngags kyi rgyud las kyang ji lta ba bzhin gsungs so/ /'on kyang rgyud kyi dpe la 'chad tshul dang por/ ta bde ba chen po: ha bdag gi sku: zhes dang / 'chad tshul gsum par: hūṃ gtub sod: phaṭa skrod sreg: ces snang / (gsang rdzogs gdeng brgyad kyi nang tshan klu sgrub kyi gdeng las/ ru lu ru lu ma mo mkha' 'gro/ hūṃ dam la sdud pa/ bh+yo las/ la 'dzud pa/ hūṃ las la rbad pa'am bskul ba zhes bshad de ha lam 'og tu 'byung 167

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tsharab dang 'dra/ 'di gtso sngags la mi mkho yang spyi dzab skabs sbyor rgyu'o) bde 'dus rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bzhi bar/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gro ta h+ya kṛ wa (sngags 'di la/ dbang chen gtso bo dang rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ yum pad+ma gzi ldan ma/dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum/ zil gnon yab yum bcu drug sgo ma bzhi/khams rgya dmus long sogs pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa tshang bas pad+ma dbang chen yongs rdzogs kyi snying po zhes bshad par gsang rdzogs sngags byang las gsungs) hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: thog mtha' oṃ dang phaṭa bzhag nas: bar na bcu bzhi'i grong mdzes pa: pad+ma'i lha rgyud snying po yin: dbang gi thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing : khrag 'thung lha tshogs dgyes pa dang : rnal 'byor nyams chag sdig sgrib sbyangs: ye shes lha dang gnyis su med: gsung gi rig 'dzin thob par 'gyur: zhes gsungs so / /bde 'dus dbang chen 'dus rgyud ltar sngags don bshad na/oṃ ye shes lnga nyid rtogs pa/ pad+ma dngos po kun la ma chags pa /ta kri ta khro bo'i gar dgu rdzogs pa/ badz+ra kro dha che btsan thams cad 'dul ba'i rdo rje khro bo/ h+ya kṛ wa khams gsum dbang du sdud pa rta mgrin nyid yin zhes pa/ hu lu hu lu khro bo'i tshogs kyi sprul pa 'gyed pa/ ru lu (sngon ru tras rang gi 'khor dbang du sdud pa'i sngags kyang ru lu ru lu zhes pa 'di yin par bsnyen sgrub kyi ti ka las so/ /'di la dpyad na dbang 168

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6phyag nyer brgyad kyi 'bod sngags kyang bh+yo kho na'i nges bzang mi ri brgya risi shidagos pa 'dra/) ru lu khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kun dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbang du sdud pa/ hūṃ dregs pa'i tshogs rnams las la 'bod pa/ bh+yo de dag las la rbad pa/ hūṃ ni dngos grub nye bar bsdu ba/ zhes bya'o/ /pad phrin rje'i rang shar rnam nges su/ hu lu hu lu 'bad pa 'bad pa zhes bsgyur cing / de'ang 'dir las kyi dbang gis 'bad cig 'bad cig ces bsgyur na legs gsung /de ni dngos grub stsol ba la brtson 'grus kyis 'bad pa mdzod cig nga༈'i don te/ 'dir/ chos dbang rta nag sogs las rta zhal brtson 'grus kyi shugs myur ba'i mtshan mar bshad pa dang / byang chub yan lag gi brtson 'grus rta mchog dang sbyar nas mdo rgyan du bshad pa'ang dran par bya'o/ /gur gyi 'grel par/ hu lu (hu luhu 'u zhugs shig zhugs shig par bsgyur ba'ang mang bas/ dpal rta mgrin bdag gi sgo bsu ma la zhugs shig ces bshad na'ang rung bar sems/ mnyam sbyor las so/ /) hu lu zhes pa zhig mdzod cig mdzod cig par bshad/ yang dbang chen 'dus pas/ trīḥni thams cad nga yi ngang du bsam: zhes dang / trīḥdabang du sdud pa'i sgra/ zhes kyang ngo (nyang gi khros ma hrīḥnag mo'i sgrub thabs las/ rdo rje phag mo khros nag gi srog sngags kyang trīraḥbashad do/ /169

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsung rta skad 'byin pa'i dus ni bzlas pa gsung gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs 'di nyid yin te/ bde 'dus dzab bsnyen las shes shing / gsang rdzogs dzab dgongs kyi gsum pas kyang mtshon no/ /des na rta skad zin bris skor yang 'dir sbyar ro/ /sngon rta mchog he ru ka la rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa man chad kyi srid zhi'i gtso bo rnams kyis rang rang gi srog gi snying po phal bar ༄dbang chen 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs te/ de ni 'di'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad kyi dngos grub bde blag tu dbang du 'gyur ba'i ched yin te/ dzab dgongs dang po dang gsum pa la gces so/ /byed las kyi sgo nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam thams cad bsdus pa ni lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin pas/ de brjod byar blang zhing / de'i rang bzhin can gyi rta skad kyang rgyal ba'i chos mdzod mtha' dag bsdus pa yin no/ /(yo ga dang gsang 'dus sogs las bde chen sor rtog ye shes la dam pa'i chos kyi ye shes dang rdo rje gsung rab kyi ye shes su bshad yod/) des na 'di nyid dbang byed kyi dgongs pa zur ba la mi ltos par yang rtsa gsum srung ma dang bcas par rang 'khor ba'i bla rdo mthar thug tu grub ste/ mdo rgyud khyad par can rnams kyi glegs bam tsam bzhugs pa'i phyogs su yang sangs rgyas byang 170

mingaze :pa///spro///rwaspro/ /khro/mi(1// //// ////ཿཿdo// / /rgo4ཿཿ// // nasems dang / rig 'dzin ma mo mkha' 'gro/ sde brgyad dam tshig rnams dbyar skyes kyi sprin bzhin 'du bar gsungs na/ de lta ci smos pa'i phyir/rta skad kyis las dang ye shes kyi dngos grub rab 'byams dbang du byed pa'i mthu skye ba la ni sgrub pa po rang nyid rta mchog dbang gi rgyal por byin gyis brlabs pa zhig dgos te/ rtsa brnga ba dang / zor ba brdar ba'i rigs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar byin rlabs kyi rtsal thon pa la yang / nyer len gyi rgyur dpal gyi snang zhen brtan pa dang / lhan cig byed rkyen du thog ma med pa'i dus nas grub pa'i dpal he ru ka rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa kanyis dgos te/ de gnyis kyang phan tshun grogs su 'jug pa can no/ /de'i phyir dzab dgongs dang po'i sgo nas rdo rje gsam gyi nus ༄pa smin par byed pa 'di ni dngos grub sgrub pa la sne gcig nas zin na kun g.yo 'ong ba'i thabs dam par gzung ngo / /rta mgrin la'ang bskyed rim pa'i rta mgrin nas mi slob zung 'jug gi rta mgrin bar dbye rgyu yod pas shes par gyis/ nyams chag skong ba'i dmigs mde'u sgyur na'ang dzab dgongs dang po 'di la sbyor/ lha sngag sa kyi byin rlabs g.yel ba dang zhud pa gso na'ang dzab dgongs dang po rang zab par mngon te/ rdor gtsug las thun 171

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khuzhud na sngags kyis dbang bskur bas gso zhing ngar ldud par bshad pas mtshon no/ /'bras dus su gsung gi phrin las kyis 'gro don byed pa dang mthun par/ sngags phreng las 'od zer spros pas sems can thams cad he ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god pa ( 'dini/snang ba lha la grag pa sngags sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi don la tshang bar 'di nyid kyi gu ru drag po'i dzab dgongs las gsal por shes shing 'og tu yang bris yod/) yang dzab dgongs dang por bzhugs pa gsang rdzogs su gsal te gal che/tshe dang lang tsho/ mthu stobs gzi brjid/ shes rab dang snying rje/gzungs spobs mngon shes/ ngag gi (de'i bsgo ba las lha rnams kyang 'da' bar mi nus pa'i tshig btsan pa dang / tshig tsam gyis dmag gi sde rengs par bya ba la sogs pa'i las 'grub pa dang / smra ba'i khyu mchog gi gnas thob pa thams cad la sbyor btub) dbang phyug sogs rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub kyi cha shas (rang shar lha khrid las kyang 'dir mthun 'byung) re yin pas dzab dgongs dang po'i mde'u kha sgyur lugs res gang 'dod 'grub('di rngog ma le brgan las/ thun mong grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /mchog gi sku gsum rang gsal ba/ /zhes pa'i thad dang bsgrigs na shin tu legs 'dra)dzab dgongs gsum pa'i skabs kyi rta skad 'don pa na/ rta skad kyi de nyid dang / des 'jig rten gsum gyi srog 'phrog tshul zur 'khod ltar nges pa'i steng nas/ rta dbyangs gsang mthor bsgrags pas sde brgyad kyi 172
