dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6spyi srog dang dgos srog srog rten nyi zla'i dwangs ma dang bcas pa bskul zhing rang dbang med par drangs pas rlung gis bskyod pa'i shing lo ltar lhags par blta ba ste/ dpal chen che ba'i rta skad la sogs pa'i skabs bzhin sbyar ro/ /legs par bsnyen na (bya rgyud legs grub dang bstun na) dam can mthu bo che rnams kyis sangs rgyas dngos las dngos grub bslang ste sbyin pa'ang yod par mngon no/rta skad kyis dbang drag gi las gnyis mdzad tshul ni mi dang mi min gyi 'gro ba'i yid bdag la 'chor ba ni/ de dag gi rnam shes kyi bzhon pa'i rlung gi brtan pa 'phrog pa la thug ste/ rlung gi rta dang bral na shes pa 'phye bo dang 'dra bar gsang rdzogs dang rdzogs chen skor du gsungs pas sems 'gro 'ong ni rlung gis khrid nas byed pa'i phyir ro/ /yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa'i bde ba'i ye shes bskul te spyan 'dren pa bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhom med nā da'i 'tsher glus/ lus can rnams kyi srog tu gyur ba'i rlung de rang dbang med par bskul zhing brlab ste/ de'i gzhan dbang can gyi sems rnams myos pa dang /(mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa'i glus dgra bcom pa rnam thar brgyad ldan rnams kyang rang dbang med par myos nas gar byas par gsungs pa lta bu/) 'phar ba dang /173

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ldeg pa dang / dkrugs pa dang / dbab pa dang / dgug cing drang ba sogs byed do/ /sgyu 'phrul las/ spyugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che/ /zhes dang / mdo las lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i sgras rgya mtsho'i srog chags mang po'i snying 'gas par gsungs pa bzhin/ drag po'i nga ro mi bzad pas gdug pa can rnams kyi srog la sogs pa'i rlung drag tu skul zhing gting 'khrugs par byed la/ des lus sems gtor dkrugs rmongs reng bskrad pa sogs byed do/ /(seng lpags kyi rgyud sgras rgyud gzhan thams cad chad 'gro ba lta bu'ang yin no/ /)ma mo rbod gtong gi dzab dgongs skabs/ mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i spyi gtsag rta mgrin gyi zhal nas 'tsher skad thengs gsam riri ca ri gi༄bsgrags pas ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang bsdus zil gyis mnan zhing srog phrogs te las la 'dzud par gsungs pa'i skabs su/ de yang khams gsum srid pa gsum na dbang che ba ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma yin pas dbang gi ma mor byas nas dbang bsgyur ba dang : sems can gyi tshe srog ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na mnga' bas che'i ma mor byas te tshe sgrub pa dang : nad kyi bdag mo yin pas nad ngan gcod pa dang : dmod pa drag sngags kyi bdag mo yin pas dgra la rbad pa dang : thun mong gi mthu dang 174

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6rdzu 'phrul thams cad kyi bdag mo yin pas thun mong gi las gang 'dod la sbyar ba'o: de lta bu la ma mo rbod gtong gi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: zhes bde gsang gagris kar gsungs te dzab dahongs sa/chi/ma nga/ lnga/ mayo/ 'o// nisgrung lung si/ bheka' sgo lngas/ nga d+ma lnga sgrusgyu sgyu brgyad du bka' bstsal pa'i pad+ma sku'i sgrub pa ni: pad+ma sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i lus pad+ma dbang chen gyi skur gsal ba'i dus na:sku la bgres rgud mi mnga' ste: rang rig pa pad+ma dbang chen gyi skus khams gsum dbang du sdud pa la pad+ma sku'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o:ngag pad+ma dbang chen gyi gsung dri ma med pa rta skad thengs gsum gyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa la pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: yid pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen pos snang srid kyi chos thams cad bsdus pa med par ye nas dbang du 'dus pa la pad+ma thugs kyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: de ltar pad+ma ngabang chen gyi sku gsung thugs che ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'phel 'grib mi mnga' bas pad+ma yon tan gyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: phrin las snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus nas chos nyid skye 'gags med par gsal 'debs pa la pad+ma phrin las kyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: rdo rje'i glus dbang gi che ba bstod pa dang :'khor long ba rgyab 'brel dang : rmun long 'khor ba man chad 175

casarngad/ (1 lngardo sdispyings 'o/:drob/ba/ byaspurngasno ngas/micad rta):re ba//sathab 'o/dra/zug/ sgoradabang gi las la bskul ba la: pad+ma rbod gtong gi sgrub pa zhes bya'o: khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa dang : dug gsum gtan sprugs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang : 'khor ce spyang dmar la dbab pa dang : ro bshal gtod la bor ba dang : rak+ta tsa mun ta'i sku btsa' ba la pad+ma mchod bstod kyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o:khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i sngags dang : sde brgyad las la gzud pa'i sngags la: pad+ma drag sngags kyi sgrub pa zhes bya'o:zhes bshad do/ dzab dgongs gnyis pa'i thad du/ man ngag snying gzer las/ sde brgyad so so la gnyen po stobs kyi lha so sor 'chad pa'i skabs su/ bdud dang rgyal po'i gnyen po ni: rta mgrin pad+ma dbang chen yin: zhes 'byung / nyang gi srid pa'i gter khyim las dregs pa thams cad pho rgyud mo rgyud klu rgyud gsum du bsdus te 'chad skabs/ rgyud gsum dregs pa'i nang na tshan che ba klu rgyud dang / de'i gnyen po stobs kyi lhar bsngags pa rta mgrin du bshad/ klu la shis pa'i lha lngar grags pa'i nang na yang rta mgrin dang khyung gnyis re rer bgrang ngo / /gnyan dang sa bdag gi rigs thams cad klu rgyud du bsdu bar rdor gtsug las so//bde 'dus dbang chen 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ nga ni bde gshegs kun gyi gtso0 nga ni skye 'gro kun gyi yab0 (dus gsam gyi bad+dha thams cad 75) 755 riring zig mi176

raḥr ཿba//spro/ཿpa/ /nyebye(5sdo /rtan rta//ཿda// :sdosaspre ni/ (rte ngasabaskyedapa'iphyir) nganigashinarjekunagyigashed0 (gdulabyaphorgyu re/5 :pa// thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir) nga ni ma mo kun gyi rje: (mo rgyud thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir)dus gsum (gyisnang ba) 'di ni nga yi dbang (du ma gyur ba med do/)zhes gsungs pa sogs mang ngo/ dzab dgongs bzhi po de shangs lugs kyi rta mgrin sgrub gzhung las kyang gsungs te/ zhi khro rab 'byams gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis sgrub pa po'i sdong grogs mdzad cing byin gyis rlobs: zhes dzab dgongs dang po dang / srung ma rnams kyis phrin las dbang med du byed: ces gsum pa/ yang drag po'i sngags bzlas pas snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad po yang bsdad pa'i dbang med par bsam: zhes pas kyang gnyis pa dang gsum pa/ba spu nyag ma re'i rtsa ba nas kyang bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dpag tu med par spros la gdon bgegs thams cad rang srog rang gis bcad pa ltar bsad pa dang : dngangs pa dang :rengs par bsam mo: zhes sogs kyis gnyis pa dang bzhi pa bstan no: der/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs te thams cad bde ba chen por phyam gyis btang bar bsam pa yang bshad do/ de bzhin du gzhung 'dir yang / rtsa gsum zhi khro mchod pas mnyes: zhes dang po bstan te/177

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bla sgrub las de 'brel du/ byin rlabs dngos grub rang la thim:zhes gsungs/ sde brgyad 'byung po zil gyis mnan: dgra bgegs gdug pa tshar thag gcad: ces gnyis pa dang bzhi pa/dam can pho nya las la bskul: zhes gsungs pa bstan no/ /snang ba lha la sogs rkang ba gnyis kyis ni brtan g.yo thams cad dbang chen gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul du lta ba'i dbang byed kyi dzab dgongs khyad par can te/ rta skad zin tig tu blta'o/ /'di'i sgrub sngags 'di la/ sngon 'gro/ las sbyor/ rgyun sngags/ bsnyen sngags dang bzhi gcig tu dril ba'i sngags/ zhes shangs lugs gter gzhung las so/ /dzab dbyangs ni/ bde 'dus bsnyen sgrub kyi pra khrid las/ dbang chen gyi dzab ni seng ge'i 'gying dzab ces bya: bgrang thabs ni skad gdangs la 'gying che bar bgrang :dgos pa ni nus pa rgyas shing dregs pa zil gyis gnon par byed do: zhes so/ /spyi dzab ru lu'i don ni bde 'dus sngags rgyud las yang dag gi skabs su/ oṃ ni ye shes rnam pa lnga'o: ru ni chags pa chen po'o: lu ni kun bzang yum gyi mkha' 'o: ru ni nyon mongs pa dbang du bsdus pa'o: lu ni srid pa gsum dbang du sdud pa'o: hūṃ ni dgyes pa chen pos sprul pa mang po 'gyed pa'o:bh+yo ni chos kyi dbyings su 'jig rten pa gnas gyur pa'o: hūṃ tha ma 178

mdzojibyung mi :pa///spro/ཿpa/ /rengertsonasdo //// rtan/ཿpa/// /rdo//sgyuḥ// //rta ni yon tan rin po che nor bu rin po che'o: phaṭa ni chos kyi dbyings bde ba chen por bskur ba'o0 de ni sngags kyi don dang myosbyar te bstan pa'o: khrag 'thung drug cu rtsa brgyad kyi snying por bstan pa ni: oṃ ni khrag 'thung yab yum bcu'i snying po'o: ru lu bo/nga ma gau ri brgyad: ru lu 'og ma phra men brgyad: hūṃ ni 'jigs byed khro bo bcu: bh+yo dbang phyug ma nyi shu brgyad: hūṃ sgo ma bzhi: phaṭa spro ba'o: zhes gsungs shing / khrag 'thung nga brgyad dang sbyor na gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ hūṃ snga ma sgo ma bzhi: hūṃ phyi ma dbang du sdud par sbyar te gsungs so/ /sngar lgadeng brgyad kyi gzhung sogs drangs pa ltar na/ ru lu tshang ma dam can yongs rdzogs kyi bzlas sngags su byed kyang chog pa la/'dir bh+yo rkyang ma gtogs pa sbyar du med pas ci ste mi 'gal zhe na/ rdo rje'i tshig gcig la'ang don mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bstan rgyu yod pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde spyi'i lugs la yod pas skyon med do/ /gsang rdzogs dzab dgongs las lha nga brgyad dang sbyar te/hūṃ phyi ma la thugs kar sdud pa'o zhes bshad/ yang gsang rdzogs las/ oṃ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin: ru'i ra la nges tshig gis bshad na/ ra me'i sgra las rmongs pa med pa'i mdzad spyod dang thugs rje chen pos dga' bar byed pa dang : ra ga ste chags pa:179

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lu lum bi'i tshal ste/ dga' ba'i nags tshal chen po ltar bde chen gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i yum gyi mkha' dang / hūṃ gi ha he zhes pa dgyes pa'i mchog bh+yo'i ba las/ ba ga can (dpyad)zhesapa chos kyi dbyings su 'jig rten pa gyur pa/ hūṃ tha ma tshad med pa'i yon tan ye shes lnga dang ldan pa/ zhes gsungs pa gong gi bshad tshul dang po dang rags pa zhig 'dra'am snyam ste/ gsang rdzogs kyi glegs bam dag pa rnyed na da dung yang bsdur bar bya'o/ /bde 'dus sogs las ru lu shes pa brgyad sogs bshad tshul khyad par can gzhan yang mang du mdzad do/ /yang oṃ ni sngar ltar dang / ru ni ru dzo zhes pa 'jigs par gyis/ lu ni lu nya ste gcod pa/ hūṃ ni bsdigs par gyis zhes su bshad pa'ang yod do/ /rat+na'i zab gter las/ ru lu nyams chag skong ba'i mthar thug dang / rig 'dzin tshe yi mchog stsol ba la bsngags par gsungs so/ / sgyu 'phral khro bo'i spyi sngags ru lur byed cing / grub thob bka' ༄brgyad las dpal dgu'i spyi dzab 'bum phrag bcu dang / so so'i sngags 'bum phrag re res 'grub par gsungs pa'i spyi dzab kyang ru lu sham ldan rang yin no/ /lung kha cig las ni/ ru lu 'di sngon las kyi srin po'i dam tshig gi gdug pa'i glu/ dpal chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags su bshad de 'di'i steng na go rgyu mang 180

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6 ngo / /yig 'bru so sor lha so so dang sbyar ba na/ gtso sngags kho nar yang gtso 'khor thams cad tshang mod kyi/ de rnams 'dus pa la btags pa'i sngags de gtso sngags nyid du byas nas/ spyi dril zar du bshad pa ni lha'i skabs sa/ gtso bo'i ye shes kyi cha rnams risi mi riri byedakyil 'khor ba gzhan rnams kyi ngo bor gnas pas/ lha de thams cad gtso bo'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du 'du mod kyi cha de rnams tshogs pa la btags pa'i gtso bo nyid mtshan dang rnam 'gyur dang rigs sogs kyi sgo nas 'khor rnams las tha dad pa mi 'gal ba dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rab la ni rgyu mtshan snga ma de nyid kyis/ 'khor rnams gtso bo'i yan lag phyir/ /tha dad par ni bzla mi bya/ /zhes sa ra ha 'i zhabs kyis gsungs pa bzhin du'ang 'gyur ro/ /'di'i zhi khro gnyis ka dang / 'phags ma'i snying tig sogs mang po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum nang gi sgrub pa dang / 'di'i bla ma zhi ba'i sgrub chen skabs sogs su snang srid thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lor khyad par du dmigs tshul gsungs pa ni/ bzlas brjod myur du 'grub pa'i thabs zab rngo/'ang yin te/ 'di ltar des ni gsung rig sngags kyi snang zhen gnyis las snang ba rgyas par 'gyur zhing / de ji ltar rgyas pa de ltar zhen pa rgyas par 'gyur te/ snang bas zhen pa'i grogs byed 181

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ pas so/ /zhen pa de ji ltar lhags pa de ltar dngos grub sgrub pa'i mthu lhag par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gtso 'khor du yod dang / zhal du yod thams cad kyis sngags zlo bar bsam na de snyed kyi 'gyur 'byung bar lwa ba pa sogs grub chen mang pos bshad pa dang /'dir rig sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyang tshul gsungs pa gung bsgrigs na shin tu gsal lo/ /sgyu 'phral las gsungs pa'i tshom bu /bye/phru //bye( risi pho /bye/phrugs sgrub bya ma ran pa sngag sa pas kyang gas sgrub bya tshul gter phyogs na mang du snang yang / drod cung zad thob pa'i sngags pa chig rkyang dang / mang po mthu bsdong byas pa gnyis/'dod pa'i 'bras bu sgrub pa la stobs mi mtshungs par dgongs nas yin la/ mang nyung yang blo ngo gtso bas snga ma dang tshul mthun no/ /'dir mang pos gcig byed pa ni mkhar las bzhin no/ /stobs mi mtshungs pa yang des shes shing / gcig gis bsgul mi nus pa'i rdo ring mang pos bde blag tu drang 'ong bas mtshon no/ / sngags pa so skye lta bur mang nyung la stobs che chung 'thad kyang /sangs rgyas gcig du ma la rgya che chung dang shugs drag zhan mi 'thad pas tshul mthun zhes pa mi rigs zhe na/ sangs rgyas gcig bsgom pa dang / mang po bsgom pa la stobs che chung yod ces smras kyi/ sangs rgyas gcig dang mang po stobs mi mtshungs zer ba ga 182

〉ngamiltekya zug ཿba//spro/ཿpa/ /re)cad //sta ///ཿdo// 111/rngan/ (3mo la yin/ de kun kyang sngags pa lam mthon po pa la bsam pa min no/ /gzhan yang rkang pa gnyis po 'dir sems can gyi don byed pa'i dzab dmigs ('di ni gzhung 'di ga'i bla ma drag po'i dzab dgongs las kyang shin tu gsal lo/ /'di la gzhan phan phrin las kyi rten 'brel gyi gnad chen po yod pas 'jam zhud ma 'then cig) kyang ston te/ zab pa skor bdun las dbang dang dngos grub kyi zab pa rta mgrin dbang gi chos sde/ rta mgrin snying po don 'dus las/ thags kar nyi steng hrī0dmar po0dmi pa 2) 755sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: byin rlabs dngos grub rang la bsdus: ma mo mkha' 'gro las la btsud: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub:gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad nas: thams cad dpal gyi sa ru bkod: 'gro ba rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyangs: snang srid dbang gi sku gsung thugs: ye shes dkyil 'khor chen por bsam: trīḥpad+mān+ta kro ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: bsnyen sgrub las gsum rdzogs pa yi: sngags 'di chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du: rta yi 'gros skad sbyar bas bzla: zhes gsungs pas mtshon no//lung de'i rkang pa tha mas ni rta skad gang gi tshe 'don pa'i dus la'ang sgro 'dogs gcod de/ chos sde de'i rta mgrin yang phyung dmar po las kyang bstod pa'i mthar/ de nas rta skad sgrogs pa ni: hūṃ:183ye

21jid/ (3 lngardo sdispyirngaku khur:drob/thag byaspurngasno ngasastagazud rta):re ba/shākyijing 'o/sdo/zug/ nga〉shes lha tshogs ma lus pa: byin rlabs dbang skur chen po stsol:dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'dus shig0 dbang chen bka' las cam 'da' zhig: i ha ha: hūṃḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: myur du 'dus shig phrin las mdzod: zhi rgyas dbang drag so sor sgrubs: dbang chen bka' las ma 'da' zhig:i ha ha: hūṃ: nga ni dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal: khams gsum/ kun la 'gran zla med: dbang chen rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs:gdug pa'i tshogs rnams rdul du brlag: i ha ha: bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan gyis: oṃ pad+mān+ta kro ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya hṝ ba hūṃ phaṭa: zhes gsungs te dzab dgongs gzhan ma bshad do/ /bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang las kyang rta skad gtong dus dzab kyi skabs yin par bshad de/ 'di ltar/ de'i lugs la/ zhi ba rigs lnga gnas bsgyur te rigs lnga'i he ru kar bskyed la/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag dang mchod pa rnams byed nas dzab la babs pa dang / bud+dha he ru ka gnas bsgyur nas gshed dzab bzla ba yan song ba dang / pad+ma he ru ka rta mgrin du bsgyur te/ oṃ pad+mā na ta kṛd ma hā gro ta h+ya skṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas/ dbus kyi rta skad thengs gcig gis ye shes kyi khro bo dang khro mo thams cad 184

— 3pa///spro//ཿཿ// /bye/mi/byed/ //// ////shāḥ/// / pa/2ཿཿ// // rdo dbang du bsdus/ g.yas kyi rta skad thengs gcig gis srid pa'i gza' klu pho mo dbang du bsdus te/ bka' nyan gsung sdod par bsgom mo/ /mdor na 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa thams cad dbang du bsdu zhing las la gzud do/ /de nas rta mgrin gyi dzab bstod byas la/ karma dang rat+na he ru gnas bsgyur gyi bzlas pa sogs bya bar gsungs so/ /'di la go rgyu gzhan yang snang bas zhib tu bkod do/ /sngags gang bzla yang 'di ltar shes dgos te/ spyir 'gro ba dang yul tha dad kyi skad gang gi dbang du btang yang / sgra 'dis don 'di ston dang / 'di mi ston gyi rnam gzhag thams cad dang por brda sbyor mkhan gyi brjod 'dod dang / de nas de'i rjes su 'brangs nas tha snyad byed mkhan rnams kyi brjod 'dod kho na'i dbang gis byed pa las rgyu mtshan gzhan ci yang med do/ /de bzhin du sngags kyi tshig rnams kyang dang por rtsom zhing byin gyis rlob pa po gang yin pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'don pa dang zlo ba'i bsam pas bzlas na/ bsam pa de nyid kyi dbang gis lha de dang de'i sngags su 'gyar zhing / sngags kyi de nyid dang / mtha ni/rdor 'jug ra mirnams kyang rang rang ga rgyud nas bshad pa bzhan du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa de gsal po med na/ lha de'i sngags bzlas 185

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i go chod tshabs kyang de'i tshod tsam du chung ste/ sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud sde dang / khyab 'jug gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i oṃ yig gnyis la/ zlos mkhan gyi brjod 'dod la ma ltos par yig 'bru'i sgra gdangs rkyang pa'i ngos nas khyad par bstan ga la nus/ des na 'di ltar yin te/ sngon rta mchog he ru kas bde chen sgyu ma'i ye shes rta skad du byin gyis brlabs pa'i trīḥyig rang mtshan de nyid/'dir hrīḥbazlas kyi kun slong rtog pa la don spyi dang 'dres nas dngos su snang bas na/ de rtog pa de'i dngos yul yin la/ de'i gnad kyis rtog pa des ye shes dag/ pa'i rta skad dngos rang mngon sum du brjod mi nus kyang / dngos su brjod nus la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rtog pa des rang gi dngos yul gtso bo de ngag tu brjod pa dang / bzlas te brjod par 'dod nas hrīḥzhes dbyangs su bsgrags pas kyang / ngag des dpal he ru ka'i rta skad dngos nyid dngos su brjod par 'gyur te/ de lta min na ni/ sangs rgyas min pas sangs rgyas kyi bka' dngos su klog mi nus pa dang /lha sbyin gyi gtam mchod sbyin gyis smra ba yang mi srid par thal lo/ /don gyi dbang de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul bral ye shes kyi sku'i mgrin pa dang zhal la gnas pa'i rta skad nyid kyang de'i dus nyid du bzlas brjod byed pa po'i sngags zlo ba'i rlung dang / zlo 186

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6byed kun slong gi sems de dag la 'jug par 'gyur te/ sngon byin gyis brlabs tshul dang / sngon gyi thug sa dam chud mi za ba'i mthu'o/ /de'ang sgrub thabs thog mar sgom pa dang / bzlas pa las su rung ba'i dus gnyis/ gang du zhen nas bzla rgyu'i sngags gcig yin kyang / zhen byed blo'i nus pa che chung la sogs pa'i khyad par gyis lhas byin gyis rlobs mi rlobs sogs kyi khyad par yang 'thad do/ /bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags so so dang / 'khor sngags/las sbyor gyi sngags sogs mtha' dag la'ang de bzhin sbyor te/sla/'o/ /grags pa'i gsang gtam ngo mtshar can no/ /zhi ba'i rgyun khyer zar du mi thon nas 'di ka'i srabs su yig drug cung zad re riringami /༷༷/ mo ༷sa //shes //rngo|bzla bar mos na/ thugs ka zhi ke shes mas dpa' la da gas nas de ltar byas pas chog ste/ gsung gi rig 'dzin gar dbang 'jigs gling gis gsang sgrub kyi rgyun khyer du de ltar gsungs pas so/ /bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi go don thad/ spyir 'di nyid nas bsnyen pa srog sdom gzer bzhi'i sngags kyi gzer dang / sgrub pa 'phro 'du'i gzer la sbyar ba sogs bshad tshul gyi ro nyams tha dad pa mang du mdzad kyang / gnad rig byed rtsal dang shin tu mthun pas/ de ltar bkod na de nyid las/ bsnyen pa nyid gang yin pa ni: rgyud las: nye ba'i phyir na bsnyen pa ste: zhes pas ye shes 187

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyi lha la bsnyen bsring gi rtog pa mi mnga' yang: sgrub pa po'i rtog sgrib sbyang ba'i slad du lha mngon sum du yid la byas te rig pa'i sngags kyis yang yang bskul bas lha sngags la zhen pa skye: des ye shes kyi lha'i thags rje dang sgrub pa po 'brel te nye bar 'gyar bas //blo/ racing //ste/ 1311 lha/bye/ /resan batshon pa zhen bya'o: ba7na pa ma sams na lha dang bar 'gyur: lha dang nye bar ma gyur na dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs med cing: 'dod pa'i don grub pa'i gnas med do: bsnyen pa thems na ni de las ldog pa ste: bsnyen pas lha'i thugs nye bar gyur na dngos grub skul ba la dka' ba med cing: des las dang ye shes kyi don bde blag tu 'thob pa yin no: sgrub pa ni:rgyud las: dbang du 'gyur ba sgrub pa'o: zhes pas lha'i thugs nye bar gyur pa na dngos grub kyi gnas la bskul bas las la ngo mthon gyi tshul du sgrub pas na lha dbang du bya ba'i sgrub pa'o:sgrub pa ma thems na ye shes lha'i thugs rgyud 'khul mi nus shing:las kyi dngos grub las ring du 'gyur ro: thems pa'i yon tan ni: ye shes kyi thugs dam bskul bas byin rlabs rang dbang med par zhugs shing: las brtsams pas rang gzhan gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dngos grub rtsol med du 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do: las sbyor ni: rgyud las/ mngon du byed pa 188

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6las sbyor te: zhes pas bsnyen pa dang sgrub pas dngos grub kyi gzhi bting ba nyid: sgo gsum gyi bya bas las la sbyar ba la brten dngos grub mngon du bya ba ni las sbyor ro: bsnyen cing bsgrubs kyang las la ma sbyar na 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'thob par mi 'gyur bas sgrub pa don med pa ste: gser 'gyur gyi rtsi bsgrubs zin kyang lcags sogs yul la ma sbyar na gser gyi dngos po mi thob pa bzhin no0 bsnyen pas/ ye shes kyi lha'i thags rje //// riri ༅yul la 'jug pa'i skabs phyes shing sgrub pas dbang du byas te las la sbyar bas gnas skabs thun mong gi dngos grub dang mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kyi bar du thob par byed pa ste: lcags la gser 'gyur rtsis sbyar bas rin thang chen por dngos su grub pa dang 'dra'o: zhes so/ /de la las sbyor spu gri'i sgrub pa ni/ khro bo'i sgos mdzad dang mthun par drag sngags kyi sgrub pa zur ba byas te gdug pa tshar gcod kyi dngos grub bye brag tu sgrub pa la dgongs kyi/ dngos grub sgrub pa la de nges par dgos pa ni min te/ rig byed rtsal las/ sgrub sngags bzlas pas phyag mtshan rnyed pa dang gter chen rdol ba sogs dngos grub kyi mtshan ma gsal brtan mthong ba na dngos grub len par bshad pa ltar 'dir yang gur drag tu gsungs pa'i rtags tshad legs par 189

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sgorathon pa na sgrub sngags kyis dngos grub 'khul rtags yin pas dngos grub len chog bya ba'i dus yin cing / dngos grub len chog tshad ldan skabs rang skal dang 'tshams pa'i dngos grub re nges par stsol ba kha skong phrin las su gsungs pa'i phyir dang /gur drag las/ sgrub sngags la/ sgrub dang las sbyor thun mong ba:zhes dngos gru ba kyi las la dngos su sbyor ba'i sngags kyang de las/ zur du mi dgos par gsungs shing / 'dir/ sgrub pa'i bye brag las sbyor ni: zhes pa'ang spyir sgrub sngags nyid kyis dngos grub rab 'byams thams cad sgrub nus mod: de nyid las sngags spu gri dang sbrags te mngon spyod sgrub pa 'di'ang dngos grub sgrub pa'i bye brag ste/ nang gses kyi khyad par gzhan cig yin zhes par snang ba'i phyir dang / skyer sgang lugs las/ 'di yi sgrub sngags 'di la las sbyor tshang bar bshad pa'ang de ltar yi na pas so/ /nge ltar na bdag don du stod las kyi dngos grub blang ba ni sgrub sngags kyi bzlas pa rdzogs mtshams su byed cing / thugs rjes gzhan bsgral zer ba ltar gzhan don du smad las kyi dngos grub khyad par du blang ba ni las sngags kyi bzlas pa rdzogs dus byed na'ang dgongs par 'gro'am snyam/ de'ang gtso bor zhes pa yin gyi spyir sgrub sngags rdzogs dus kyi dngos grub blang ba la'ang / dgra 190

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6zhebagegs gdug pa tshar thag bcad: ces pa dang 'brel ba'i dngos grub len pa los yod snyam pa dpyad rten tho tsam mo/ /las sbyor skabs/ khro bo'i dgos mdzad dang mthun par zhes yang yang bris pa ni/ 'jig rten snyigs ma lngas khebs pas mi dang mi min gyi 'gro ba phal cher shin tu gdug cing gtum la gdul dka' ba/ mi bzad pa'i las rgyun du byed pa/ bstan pa la zhugs kyang dad pa med cing bsam pa phyin ci log tu bltas pa dang / gsang sngags phyin ci log tu spyod pa mang ba/ de'i rgyus nag phyogs kyi 'byung po rnams phyogs che zhing dpung che ba dang sde dang sto/bas 'phel bar gyur te/ bdud kyi gzi byin gyis mnan nas dkar phyogs than sgang gi lo tog lta bur song ba na/ he ru ka'i gdul zhing lhag par rgya che ste/ 'di ltar de rnams mnyam sbyor las/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phanabyupar mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya las/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /ces pa ltar snying rje dang zhi ba'i kun spyod kyis mi 'dul bas 'bar ba khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas mngon spyod kyi las kyis rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pa (tshar gcod rjes 'dzin kanyis su phye ba'i rjes 'dzin mi yang / spyir gdul bya mi gtong zhing yal bar mi 'dor ba'i yongs 'dzin gyi mdzad pa yin no) yin pas/ dpal he ru ka ni gdul 191

21rngud/ (3 jordo sdispyings khur:drob/thag byaspurngasno thababastazug rta):re ba/༷sasprang khuradra/zug/ rtemibya gdug pa can dang gdul dka' ba gtso bor 'dul ba'i phrin las can no/ /de 'dra ba'i 'bras dus kyi mdzad pa yongs su dag pa thams cad la mkhas pa'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa de lam du byas nas gdul bya ma rungs pa gdul dka' ba'i 'jig rten rnams kyi nyes spyod 'bras bu dang bcas pa a bhi tsar+ya'i phrin las kyis rgyun bcad de (bzo shin tu nyes pa gzhi nas bshigs te 'chos pa lta bu)skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul nus pa dang ('jig rten gsum gyi bde skyid ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas gcig pu rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa mthu stobs kyi dpung bas srung ba dang) sems can rnams kyi chos dang / 'dod pa dang / nor dang / thar ba la bgegs med par bya ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs pa'i ched du ting nge 'dzin dang rig sngags bi 4rtsal sbyong ba dang / de la brten nas gnas skabs su rang nyid kyis lam sgrub pa la dngos sam brgyud nas bar du gcod pa'i los 'dren rnams tshar gcod pa'i ched du drag sngags kyi sgrub pa byed na he ru ka'i gdung 'tshob pa zhes bya yi/ rnyed bkur dang grags pa'i ched du dgra gsod pa dang / 'dre rdung bya ba'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i las tshogs rab 'bya mas nges par sgrub na ni/ sngon du bsnyen sgrub kyi rjes su zhag bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs par bla ma zhi ba dang yum ka ste thog mtha' gnyis/ 192

ma mithongashāg :pa///spro/ཿpadro /chenacan/ //// /de//ཿpa/// cardo//2ཿpa// //sgyu las gsungs pa'i las bzhi'i bzlas pa'ang / snga dro zhi rgyas dang /dgong mo dbang sogs legs grub dang sgyu 'phrul las gsungs pa'i dus gnad dang bstun nas bzlas na/ phyis sgrub dus khyad shin tu che'o/ /bsnyen pa song nas sgrub sngags zlo ba na ni mdun rten dgos te/ zur tho ltar ro/ /ci bdag bskyed kho na dang 'brel bar sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi bzlas pa bskyal na mi rung ngam zhe na/ rung mod kyi/ de'i sgrub dang las sbyor ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi nang gi bsnyen pa la gsum du phye ba'i sgrub dang las sbyor tsam du 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa mdun bskyed dang 'brel bar gsungs pa nyid kyang ci la dgongs zhe na/ lha dam ye gnyis las ye shes pa la dam tshig pas dngos grub bslang ba'i sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang du mdzad de/ sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir de lta bu'i dngos grub len chog las su rung bar byas nas/ tshogs sgrub tu cho ga des dngos grub chen po la dngos su sbyor ba dgongs so/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul gzhan yang yod na ci'i phyir mdun bskyed ye shes pa la dngos grub slong ba 'ba' zhig gsung zhe na/brtson 'grus chang ba rnams rjes sa 'dzin pa'i phyir te/ rang nyid riring riring kyi mthus dngos grub rnyed pa ni dka' bas sgrub dgos shing /mthu chen gzhan la slong ba thabs shin tu sla ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /193

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ de'i phyir sgyu 'phrul las thabs sla ba de lta bu gsungs pa brtson 'grus chang ba kho na'i ched min yang / yul mtha' 'khob dang /༄dus tha mar skyes pa'i sngags kyi gdul bya la de las dka' ba bstan yang don du 'gyur dka' bas gter phyogs nas de sha stag rtsal bton du bshad dam snyam/ thugs rje chen po pad+ma zhi khro la brten nas dpyad pa'i tho yig go /yang las sbyor sngags kyi thad/ spyir ni sde brgyad dam tshig can rnams srog 'phrog pa'i ched du 'di'i dbang sdud kyi las sngags blos na'ang rung bar mngon mod/ gzhung rang gi dngos bstan ni/ dbang drag gi las sngags gnyis sbrel te bzla ba nyid yin cing / des dgug 'dren gzir ba sogs bya yul la/ dgra bgegs dam sri gdug pa can: sogs las dkar phyogs skyong ba la sbyar rung tsam yang mi snang bas/ chos lam la ma 'khod pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po ma rung ba spyi la nan tur bstan pa'i phyir/ khro mtshon me phung dang pho nya'i dmag dpung spros la/ de rnams kyi snying nas bzung / srog nas drang bas rang dbang med par gzir te/bka' sdod dang bran du khas blang zhing bro bor du bcug (bstan dgra'i lha srung 'phrogs shing cham la dbab pa'ang 'di ltar bya'o) pa'i sgo nas he ru ka'i dam 'og tu gzhug des mi thul ba rnams bsad bcad gtum 194

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6 tsubastab byas nas brlag par byed pa'i mngon spyod shas che ba'i dbang drag sbrags sgrub yin te/ gter gsar sems nyid ngal gso'i drag po'i las sbyor gyi dzab dgongs dang ji bzhin mthun no/ /'di'i dbang drag gi mdzad pa 'jug yul gnyis ka 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa ltar gdug cing gtum pa dang / khengs shing dregs pa'i sems can bsdigs nas 'dul ba sha stag yin te/'dir dbang gi las kyang yul de drag shul gyi sbyor ba rnon pos gzir nas byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ dper na/ rgyal po chen pos dgra tshan chen 'dul ba na/ pha rol gyi yul khams lung 'og tu gzhug pa dang / cis kyang mi 'dud pa rnams gtan brlag tu gtong ba gnyis ka drag po'i dpung gi thog kho nas btsan thabs su byed pa lta bu'o/ /dgra zhes pa (spu gri'i nang gi sarba sha tru na/zhes pa'ang dgra thams cad ces pa'i skad dod de/ gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra zhes pa de'o) 'dis mi'i 'gro ba 'ang bstan no/ /de dag ni 'di la dbang drag sbrags ma'i gnad de 'dra ba zhig kyang yod pa de bshad kyi/ 'di'i dbang drag sbrags lugs gtso bo ni/ dam can ma/kha' 'gro drag shul can rnams dbang du bsdus nas mngon spyod kyi las la 'gyed pa'i dbang las kyi sgrom nas drag po sgrub tshul nyid yin te/ spyod par dgongs pa'i rta skad kyi thad na rgyas par 195

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trayod cing / 'di'i/ dam can pho nya las la bskul: zhes pa'ang de yin no/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad la drag mo'i gdong can yang bshad de/ gdong brnyan can 'di ni de las kyang khros pa'i shin tu drag khros kyi gzugs yin la/ 'di 'dra ba'i sku'i rnam 'gyur de'i dgos kyi kun spyod ni drag shul gyi las nyid yin pas sngags pa mngon spyod la sdang bar mi bya ste/ dam can rnams kyi gtso bo'i kun spyod la mi mthun par bltas na phan tshun blo mi mthun par song ba yin pas so/ /des na bsam pa rnam dag gis rgyal ba dgyes pa'i drag sngags la mos slob tsam byas kyang he ru ka'i rnam thar dang phrin las kyi rgyun bskyang ba dang / rdo rje'i dam can rna mas dang bsam spyod bsres par 'gyur bas thugs nye zhing /drag po'i lha drag por bsgrubs pas lhag par yang tshan che'o/ /rdo rje phur bar/ smad las dam can nye bar bsnyen pa zhes bshad pa ltar/ dam can la brten nas dbang drag sogs kyi las 'grub pa la/ sngon du dam can las rung gi bsnyen pa gal che la/ de'i chu'/ ni/ dang por gtso bo'i sgrubs sngags skabs/ dam can pho nya las/ la bskul: zhes pa'i steng nas dmigs bzlas cung zad re bya zhing / spyi dzab kyi tshe yang / dbang mo rnams la dmigs nas bzlas bsgom 'tshams pa re rgyun bsring bas/ phyis sger sgrub byeng 196

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6pharan shin tu sgrub sla ba zhig 'byung ngo / /'di'i rgyas bshad ni chu lha 'i sbrul zhags su yod/ /sgrub thabs dang bde 'dus tha ram las rta skad rtsal du 'don lugs ma 'dra zhes bris pa de ni mi 'thad de/ tha ram gyis kyang pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa'am sgrub thabs thams cad rta skad kyi dgongs par 'dus par bstan pa zhes sgrub thabs kyi don nyid 'chad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lam 'bras bu thams cad rta skad kyi da/gongs par byas pa ni gsung rta skad kyi sgo nas lam 'bras de rnams la phar 'jug tshul yin gyi/ lam 'bras de dag gsung rta skad sgrub lugs su tshur 'gro tshul bstan pa'i ched du de ltar bshad pa ni min te/ dper na gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad gsang thams cad rdo rje'i de nyid du byas nas gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ mtshon byed rtags kyi rdo rjes rang gi de nyid la 'jug pa'i ched yin gyi/mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje ni mtshon byed dpe'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i don du sasungs zhes go bzlog nas smra mi rung ba bzhin no/ /des na sgrub thabs phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad rta skad kyi dgongs pa'am de nyid dam blo rtser dril nas dngos grub sgrub pa la pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa zhes bya zhing / don de mtshon pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i zhal yang rta gdong gis mtshan par byed do/ /197

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pharodang po nas dgongs pa de mtshon don dang / spyi bo'i rta skad mtshon rtags su bzung nas bsgrub pas dgongs pa de la rtsal thon pa na/ de'i rtags su spyi gtsug nas rta skad shugs 'byung du thon 'ong ba yang / lo legs na phub ma ltar zhar la 'ong ba dang /ral gri'i grub rtags 'bar ba sogs gsum ltar dgongs pa de'i nus pa'i tshad(rtogs)'dzin byed tsam du zad kyi/ dgongs pa de rta skad thon ched du bsgom pa'i gnad kyis gtan min no/ /bdud rtsi 'chi med kyi dang / phur pa thal 'byin gyi dgongs pa zer ba'i dod ni/ rta skad dbang gi dgongs pa zhes bya ste/ des na rta skad kyi dgongs pa byas kyang don du dbang du sdud kyi dgongs pa ste / de la'ang drang ba dang nges pa'i snang srid dbang byed kyi dgongs nga du ma zhig dbyer yod do/ /gsung gi sgrub pa zhes pa'ang gsung bsgrub bya'i gtso bor byed pa'i don min/ gtso bor gsung gi sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i don yin te/ 'dir dngos grub sgrub byed kyi gtso bo gsung rta skad la byed pa'i don yin/ dper na gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'a khor zhes pa'ang der 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas dngos grub mang po sgrub pa la byed kyi/ 'khrul 'khor kho rang dngos grub tu mi bzhed pa dang / phur bar yang de'i dngos grub gtso bo bdud 'dul mthu'i dngos grub yin la/ phur bu ni 198

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6de sgrub byed kyi byed pa gtso bo yin par 'dod pa bzhin te/ bya byed(las dang byed po zer dgos) gnyis ma 'dzings shīg de 'dra ba'i gsung rta skad de la tha ram sogs las spyi bo'i de min pa mi gsal zhing / de tsam gyis phrin las sgrub tshul la nges pa shugs drag skye ba dbang rnon min na dka'/ thugs tig 'dir dzab kyang rta skad du gsungs pa shin tu legs te/ dzab kyis dngos grub sgrub pa rnams kyang rta skad kyis dgongs pa byed lugs su 'gro bas rgya che/ de ltar na/ mtshon byed brda'i rta skad la/ spyi bo'i rta skad dang /sngags kyi bzlas pa gnyis yod do/ /'dir sngar dge byed lo rnga'i zin ris nas sbyar dgos pa mang / dpe'i rta skad kyis thun mong si dbang las sgrub pa dang / don gyi rta skad kyis thun mchog gi dbang sgyur gyi dngos grub mtha' dag sgrub pa zhes bshad na snyan brgyud phur ba'i thal 'byin bzhi'i lam rim sogs dang 'gros ma/thun/ mchog gi dbang sdud de las bzhi'i nang gi dbang yin nam zhe na/ min te/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur bu'i gdab kha de drag las min pa bzhin rdo/ /'omā kyang nge ngas las kyi nges domā nga bu ri 05 ༷ra 47 ringa'i yir ri ༄4rung ba ltar/ dbang las kya ngas dan du na bya rung nga / /gzhung 'di'i bro mnan sgrub thabs dang / las phreng nas 'byung ba gnyis ka'i sngags su hi gsum re yang dang yang du gsungs pa ni rta skad 199

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhethengs gsum mtshon ched yin pa 'dra/ bro gzhung rgyas pa'i gti mug rdo rje'i thad la mtshon na/ bud+dha rigs kyi rta skad la/ ldir zhing 'tsher ba/ zhes gsungs pa dang / de'i rta sngags la'ang hi gsum byung ba dang / las sgrub kyi rta skad thengs gsum spyi'i gzhung bde 'dus tha ram gyi de yin pas de dag bsgrigs na/ldir zhing 'tsher ba zhi ba'i rta skad nyid dbye gzhir byas pa la'ang /dang pos zil gnon gyi cho 'phrul spro/ gnyis pas dam rdzas kyi gcal bkram/ gsum pas ma mo rnams bsdu zhing rmongs pa'i bdud dang dam sri tshar gcod dang zhi ba'i phrin las la btang ba ste rta skad thengs gsum 'byed par shes sam snyam/ dbang med 'du zhing yid 'phrogs pas: ci bcol las kun thogs med byed: sogs gsungs pa dang sbyar na de 'dra zhig bshad rgyu yod dgos kyang dgos pa 'dra/ rta skad 'di ltar shod pa dang gdod rang nyid thang stong rgyal po'i bu brgyud du ngo 'phrod do/ /༄7/ /bla ma thugs rje'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo pad+ma gsung gi skabs su/ sgrub lugs 'di'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor dang / rdo rje phur ba'i thal 'byin gyi dod po ni rdo rje rta skad kyi dgongs pas khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang phyug sgrub pa nyid yin pas 'di la 200

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6774mkhas par sbyangs te rtsal thon pa gces so/ /de la nyang gter rta mgrin bde 'dus pad+ma gsang ba bkod pa rngog ma le brgan gyi brgyud kyi le'u dgu pa las/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yi/ /yang gsang rmad byung dgongs pa la/ /ba snyen pa thems par gyur pa na/ /chos sku snying po byang chub sems/ /de nyid shes pa spros dang bral/ /sa thob spyod yul gzhal yas nas/ /dgongs pa lta (dpyad)can longs spyod rdzogs/ /mos spyod 'gro la snang gyur pa/ /thub pa chos kyi phung po can/ /rgyal ba sku gsum dag dang mnyam/ /rnal 'byor rab kyi dgongs par gsungs/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /thugs dam rgyud nas bskul ba ni/ /rnal 'byor 'bring gi dgongs pa yin/ /lus ni lha sku'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /ngag ni bzlas pa'i gsang sngags can/ /thugs ni yang dag don du blta/ /rtags tsam 'dzin par rab gnas pa/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi dgongs pa ste/ /rab tu 'bad nas bsgom pa yang / /rnal 'byor tha ma'i dgongs pa yin/ /de dag rnal 'byor brda skad gsungs/ /ma ltar byams la sring ltar gdung / /ma mo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma/ /phem phem hrī yi sgra dag la/ /thal mo'i sgra dang rnge'u chung sgra / /rkang gi gling bu thod pa'i rnga/ /cang te'u sgra rnams bsgrags pa dang / /201

21rngad/ (1 jordo sdispying/ 'o/:drob/ba/ cesarngasno nga/bstazug rta):re po/sdo/nga( 'o/dra/zug/ 〈cozhing gi g.yab mos g.yab pa ni/ /dang po brda yang sprad par bya/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /bde gshegs mkha' 'gro chen mo dang / /rdo rje zhe sdang srog la rngam/ /rin chen nga rgyal sha za mo/ /pad+ma 'dod chags khrag 'thung ma/ /las kyi phrin las chen po rnams/ /nam mkha' bar snang sprin bzhin du/ /klong rdol bya nas 'bab pa ltar/ /gti mug sha yi sa gzhi la/ /'dod chags khrag bi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /zhe sdang rus pa'i ri rab la/ /mi rtog bde gsa'/ nyams skye zhing / /khams gsum gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /sgrol phyir 'gyings shing rngam pa yis/ /rab tu gnas su 'byung ba ni/ /bar du klong rdol byon pa yin/ /dug gsum gtor mas tshim pa dang / /bdud rtsi chen pos tshim pa dang / /rak+ta dmar gyis dgyes pas ni/ /mngag pa'i gnas su yud tsam 'gro/ /dgra dang bgegs rnams rab 'gug pa/ /dper na skyes bu btson bzang zurig mjug zudag zuragarigamibazhan/ /rang dbang mad par 'gug pa na/ /rmad byung dkyal 'khor nang du drangs/ /rlung gi stobs kyis 'ong ba ni/ /tha mar las la bkye ba'o/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor bsam gtan can/ /rta skad thengs gcig bsgrags pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor chen po rnams/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams/ /nyams chag bskangs par gyur nas ni/ /thun mong grub chen brgyad la sogs/ /mchoka 202

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6gi sku gsum rang gsal ba/ /g.yar dam can la dngos grub ster/ /rta skad thengs gnyis bsgrags pa yis/ /rje mo blon mo ma sring dang / /bran dang pho nya bka' nyan dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma/ /dam la gnas pa thams cad kyang / /tshar bcad rjes 'dzin phrin las mdzad/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang drag /drag dbang rgyas dang zhi bar byed/ /rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags pa yis/ /mos pa chung ba'i nyan thos la/ /bden pa bzhi yi chos kyang ston/ /dmigs pa phra ba'i rang rgyal la/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis chos bshad de/ /theg chen byang chub sems dpa' la/ /kun rdzob don dam chos kyang gsungs/ /bya ba las kyi kri ya la/ /rigs gsum mgon por rnam par snang / /u pa ya la rigs bzhi nyid/ /lta ba spyod pa ston pa dang / /yo ga rigs lnga mngon byang chub/ /kun rig rnam snang chen por gsungs/ /rnal 'byor che la thabs chen snang / /rjes su rnal 'byor yab yum che/ /shin tu rnal 'byor chos kyi sku/ /rgyad lung man ngag snang ba'o/ /rta skad thengs gsum /khro/ :nge :jordo /to byebye dgongs pa ting 'a na / /zhes rgya ra gsungs so/ /nyang kater pad+ma dbang chen dregs pa tshar gcod pa'i rgyud kyi le'u dgu ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma dbang chen gyis rta skad thengs gsum gyi le'u 'di bka' bstsal to/ /bde chen don 203

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yis/ /dbang chen sku dang gnyis med rtags/ /dngos su rtogs par snang mdzad de/ /spyod par shong ba'i gnas dag tu/ /rta skad thengs gcig thos pa yis/ /las kyis bskal pa'i dregs pa can/ /'bri rgod 'drog pa bzhin du ni/ /rang dbang med par yid kyis sngangs/ /rta skad thengs gnyis thos pa yis/ /las kyis bskal pa'i mi ma yin/ /sha rul dong du bcug pa la/ /sha sbrang mkha' la 'du ba bzhin/ /rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus/ /rta skad thengs gsum thos pa yis/ /las kyis bskal pa'i mi ma yin/ /bka' khrims dam pa'i bka' 'og bzhin/ /rang dbang med par 'dur gyis btang / /de ni spyod pa'i brtul zhugs te/ /dgongs pa'i gdeng chen de gsum gyis/ /dregs pa pho mo las gzud bya/ /lta ba'i gdeng gsum rta skad lam/ /rta skad thengs gsum dgongs pa'i lam/ /bskyed rdzogs rnam gsum sa la sbyor/ /rta skad thengs gcig bskyed pa'i lam/ /thabs dang shes rab gdan sar sbyor/ /gnyis kyis cig char rdzogs pa'i lam/ /dbyings dang ye shes gdan sar sbyor/ /gsum gyis ye nyid yin pa'i lam/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi gdan sar sbyor/ /ma hā bskyed pa'i rim pa yang sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrul gsum las/ /rim pas bskyed nas rdzogs 204

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6par 'dod/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor thabs kyi mchog /ma skyes spros bral shes rab las/ /gnyis su med par rang sar sbyor/ /a nu rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang / /lha yi dkyil 'khor skad cig gis/ / chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul/ /gtso 'khor dran rig rdzogs par 'dod/ /ma skyes spros bral chos kyi dbyings/ /rig pa'i ye shes gnyis med pas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang sar sbyor/ /a ti ye nas yin pa la/ /dri med snying ngo/ byang chub sems/ /gdod nas ma skyes rang byung bas/ /rang gi ngo bo brjod du med/ /brjod med ji ltar btags par snang / /cir btags der snang dri med pas/ /snying po byang chub ye nas yin/ /gcig dang du mar ro gcig pas/ /de nas gnyis med gdan sar sbyor/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yang / /rta skad thengs gsum thos pa yis/ /lta bas sa gsum mnyam sbyar nas/ /spyod pas dregs pa tshar gcod na/ /rta skad thengs gsum thabs kyi mchog /ces bka' ba455 to/ /zhes pa'o//le'u bcu ba brtul zhugs bzhi'i dang po'i gzhung du/ rta yi brtul zhugs chen po yis/ /khams gsum 'khor ba skyam ling 'debs/ /rta skad thengs gsum bsgom pas ni/ /khams gsum yongs bsgral sa gsum bsgral/ /bde gshegs mi 'gyur gdan gsum ste/ /bskyed rdzogs rnam gsum klong gsum rdol/ /shugs chen rta yi ra 205

21rngad/ (‘ :rdo /spyingape 'o/:drob/thag cesarngasno rngaku/lngacad rta):rno tha/〉〉jib 'o/dra/zug/ ra〉mda' yis/ /'khor ba'i skyam ling dbyings su gdab/ /rta skad thengs gcig rig pa'i lam/ /kun bzang mkha' dbyings klong rdol nas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang sar sbyar/ /gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab ste/ /gsum ni sku gsung thags su sbyar/ /rta skad ༄bzhi ni phrin las bzhi/ /lnga ni ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /drug ni 'gro drug gnas su sbyong / /bdun ni phrin las drag shul bdun/ / brgyad ni sde brgyad dbang du sdud/ /dgu ni theg pa'i sa dgu brtol/ /bcu ni sa bcu zil gyis gnon/ /dbang phyug rol pa'i phrin las de/ /byed spyod rta yi skad kyis sbyong / /gang ltar spyad kyang chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dregs pa gan da 'bebs kyi rgyud pad+ma dang kha che a nan+ta sa bsgyur ba'i le'u lnga ba las/ de nas pad+ma he ru kas dpal gyi rta skad kyis phyogs bcu'i dregs pa can btul lo/ /lo rgyus don gyis phyi rabs yid ches bshad/ /snod kyi 'jig rten lcags ri nag po'i nang / /phyi yi rgya mtsho zho las dkrugs pa'i mar ri rab srub cing klu sbrul srub thag bcas/ /rgyal chen sde bzhis rab tu dkrugs pa las/ /dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi khyab 'jug gza' yis 'thungs/ /phyag rdor 'khor los lus kyang dum bu brgyad/ /snyigs ma dug tu gyur te gnod sel phyir/ /spyan ras sku khros mgur du 206

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6tra thim pa ni/ /khro bo mdog sngon gdug pa ma lus 'dul/ /tshangs pa'i gsung gis chos 'khor bskul ma 'deb sa/ /des 'dul gsung dbyangs drug cu tshangs pa'i skad/ /'jig rten 'khor bar yun ring gnas nas kyang / /rta mchog rin chen yid bsring 'gro don mdzad/ /cang shes rta yis myur du bgrod pa ltar/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren par mdzad/ /de ni 'gro ba lam 'dir gzhug pa'i phyir/ /gdul byar bshad pas 'gro ba 'dul bar byed/ /gti mug can dang nga rgyal can/ /'dod chags can dang phrag dog can/ /zhi ba'i las dang rgyas pa'i las/ /dbang dang drag pos 'dul bar ston/ /ljang gu drag po dmar po dbang //ser po rgyas pa dkar po zhi/ /rta gdong phrin las bzhi mdzad pas//rta mgo la yang rigs bzhi'i mdog /gdul bya ma lus thams cad kun/ /'dul phyir phrin las dag tu bshad/ /zhal nas rta skad sgra sgrogs pas/ /phe dze hri sogs gsang sngags 'dren/ /rta yi skad ces bya ba yang / /rta zhal gsung du sgrogs pa'o/ /brda dang rta skad 'gying skad gsum/ /rnal 'byor dgongs pas ma shes skyon/ //thugs dam mi 'khul dbang mi 'dus/ /dgra bgegs mi thul skyon du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor gang gis rta skad kyi/ /dgongs pa don lda na shes pa ni/ /thugs rjes bzhengs dang khas blangs dran/ /207

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsungaji'abum/phrin las skad cig yud la 'grub/ /de phyir rta skad dgongs pa zab/ /lus ngag yid gsum sku gsum nyid/ /dug lnga ye shes lngar grol nas/ /gang gis gdeng gyur rnal 'byor rab/ /mi zhes byas kyang sangs rgyas yin/ /snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas dbyings/ /bcud kyi sems can ye shes lha/ /'brel bas bde chen sras su rig /rnal 'byor 'bring gi dgongs pa'o/ /lus nyid lha la ngag nyid sngags/ /sems nyid chos nyid tha ma'o/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rten du gyur pas chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin skye med brda sprod go /de nyid chos sku'i gsung yin no/ /longs sku dgongs pa brda yi gsung / /me long nang gi byad lta bu/ /gtso bo'i sku la bltas pa yis/ /rang gi shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /de nas chos sku'i sa ru 'gro/ /byang chub sems dpa' mngon sangs rgyas/ /sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing / /thams cad pa ru gnas pas na/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo che/ /oṃ ni rnam par brjid pa'i sku/ /āḥni smra brjod 'byang bas gsung / /hūm̐ ni 'dod dgur mkhyen pas thags/ / riri ༅ riri shirgyal ba'i zhing khams 'di yis skyong / /tshangs pa'i lha yi gsung bzhin du/ /srin po 'dul yang skyon ma gos/ /dper na me tos pad+ma skyes/ /'dam gyi skyon gyis ga la gos/ /de nyid grogs su gyur 208

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6pa ste/ /'dam med pad+ma gang las skye/ /ri rab rtse ni lha gnas te/ /ri rab khong seng lha min yul/ /gling bzhir mi gnas mtho ris gsum/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho dud 'gro la/ /grong khyer ser skya yi dwags nyid/ /rdo rje gdan 'og dmyal ba'i gnas/ /kun gyi skad du chos ston pas/ /thugs rje'i rta skad rigs drug 'dul/ /lus ngag yid kyi brda sprad na/ /pho mo mthun pa'i dpe bzhin shes/ /dper na khā tas gzan mthong ltar/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro 'grub nas byon//ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs la/ /mthun pa'i sha khrag gtor ma 'bul/ /las bzhi'i phrin las bcol bar bya/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dang / /skyon dang yon tan rang bzhin bshad/ /rta yi 'gros dgu bstan pa yang / /dpung lag sgrog 'gros lha dang mi/ /gdos pa lcags bcug nyan thos 'dra/ /pho nya srun 'gros rang sangs rgyas/ /'jab tshe gzengs ni mdo sde nyid/ /gom bu myol(sngamar nyol)'gros kri ya ba/ /spyang mo mdur 'gros yo ga nyid/ /rol mo'i stabs pa ma hā yin/ /'jol mo dkyas 'gro a nu ste/ /dkyas su tshang 'gros a ti la/ /tshor ༷/// ni//she ni me //de rta spu 'a sa dgur bstan pas/ /pad+ma dbang —na rta gdong zhal//rta skad dgongs par 'dus pas gsungs/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed/ /'khor 'das dbang gi skur rdzogs la/ /theg 209

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i rim pa rtogs pas na/ /dpe dang don du bshad pa'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /dbang chen 'dus pa'i rgyud(rta mgrin dgongs pa lung ston du grags pa)sba dang ngan lam sogs kyis bsgyur ba las le'u bcu bdun pa brtul zhugs chen po bzhi'i skabs su/ rdo rje rta yi brtul zhugs kyis/ /rta skad thengs gsum 'bod par bya/ /dpal gyi rta skad chen po yis/ /yang dag sku gsum dbyings nas bskul/ /ma mo'i brda skad sbran pa yis/ /brda 'phrad klong rdol las la rbad// rnal 'byor gsang ba brda skad kyis/ /mnyam dang bskul dang rtags tsam 'dzin/ /sha rul dong du bcug pa la/ /sha sbrang bzhin du 'du ba dang / /spyang dang lug bzhin bred pa dang / /khyi dang phag bzhin rbad sar 'gro/ /dpal gyi h+phi brdabs hūṃ sgra las/ /bsgrubs pa'i dbyangs dang tshangs pa yis/ /zhing khams ri rab rtse la blangs/ /gsum zhes bya ba dgu yi chos/ /ha dang spyod dang sgom pa dang / /'bras bu bzhin du gar gyur pa/ /rbad pas thal ba bzhin du rlog /lha srin thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpal gyi sku dang gnyis su med/ /'di ni rnal 'byor spyod pa yin/ /zhes/ 'byung ngo / /rta mchog rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ mi gnas myang 'das gsung rab rgya mtsho sgrogs/ /ma bsgrib ma gsal go 'phang mdzes par mthong / /mi ldog yul sgrol stabs drug mdzes par 210

/ne mi :pa///dri/ཿpa/ /bye/shā(1// //// ////15ba// / pa/sprerwaḥ// //phra mgyogs/ /gar yang thogs med byin rlabs shugs dang ldan/ /'tsher skad gdangs snyan ma sring spro ba 'gyed/ /kham dmar ral pa'i dbus nas dbugs 'byang ba/ /dpral ba zhur po brjod pa'i dzor raX zug tshorakhyad par dang / /rta mgran 'ad 'bar gsal ba' khyad par na/ /don mchog khyad par yon tan rmad du byung / /ljang gu me 'bar rta ma/go'i rang bzhin ni/ /'gyur med ye shes (nam mkha')ji bzhin gsal/ /byams pa'i mdangs kyis khams gsum khyab par gzigs//rngog ma le brgan 'bar ba'i khyad par mchog /stug po bkod sogs zhing khams rab 'byams na/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed khro bo kun/ /zhing khams gsum dag ma lus dbang du sdud/ /shes rab thabs su 'brel ba'i rta skad ni/ /grub pa'i dpal tshogs tshangs pa'i rta dbyangs yin/ /dang po'i gdangs kyis rgyal ba'i zhing khams sgrogs/ /gdangs skad ga nyis pa ri rab rtse la 'tsher/ /kasung snyan gdangs gsum snyan pa'i khyad par ni/ /bcu drug slad ma'i ngan rtog thar lam ston/ /spyan mig glog ltar 'gyu ba cher 'phags shing / /sha khrag rlon pa za ba'i srin po 'joms 'tsher can yid la gdung ba'i rta skad ni/ /mun mthu'i 'gro ba ma lus gsal bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di'i glegs bam yig nor gyi phung por snang bas brtags dka' yang dpyod rten tsam mo/ /211

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rta rgyud kha cig tu/ brtson 'grus chung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir dang / mi'am ci'i 'khor rta mgo can rnams 'dul ba'i ched du rta'i glu bro mdzad par bshad de/ mi'am ci de dag ni glu gar gyi pha rol tu son pa yin no/ /kun spyod des 'gro ba gzhan yang 'dul ba ni/ ji ltar srin po ltar khros pa sogs bzhin no snyam ste bsam mo/ /bde 'dus dbang chen 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ e ma 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams nyon: nga yi sku yi ngo bo ni :rang rig byang chub sems las snang: rta mgos skad gsang mthon po yis: bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub sdud: yang das/ nges don chos kyi sku: gzugs su snang ba mtshon pa'i rtags:dper na rta yi 'gros dgu yis: ji ltar smon pa'i sar 'gro bzhin: theg pa'i rim pa ngang gis bgrod: rtsol med rab tu rdzogs par snang: rta skad yon tan mang ba ltar: lam lnga dang ni sa bcu dag: yongs rdzogs de nyid ngang la mnga': dpe dang don gyi rtags rnams kyis: phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi:gsang sngags lam gyi bye brag shes: gdul bya'i thabs su snang ba yang: chos rnams dkyil 'khor lhun grub cing: snang srid ma lus bsgral ba'i rgyu: bka' sdod phrin las rdzogs par mdzad:sngon gyi tha tshig dbyings nas bskul: brda sprad klong rdol dbang 212

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6bsgyur te: ma lus 'dul ba nga yi thabs: ye nas ma bcos nga yi sku: thabs dang shes rab dbyings ye shes: don dam kun rdzob snang dang stong: gnyis med ngo bo'i don yin no: dbang gi rgyal por bsam sbyor bas: khros pa'i phyag rgya gsung gi sgra:'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs chen kun: dbang med skrag pa'i tshul bzung zhing: myur du phrin las gnas bzhin byed:dbyings nas gzugs snang thams cad kun: dbang bsgyur snang ba mnyes mdzad de: 'gal ba de nyid ngang du sbyang: zhes dang /trīX dbang gi rta gdong phrin las mgyogs pa'i mtha0 ye shes /rdoswā ri bca///5myur mgyogs shes rab pha rol phyin: rtsal gyi rlabs kyis sa gsum cig char bgrod: 'tsher skad gdangs snyan gsang ba'i thugs dam bskul: rngam pa'i kha rtsal 'khor tshogs dbang du sdud: stabs drug 'gros kyis rgyud dru ga thabs kyis 'dren:rol pa'i rta bros bdud bzhi thal bar brlag: 'jig rten sgrol mkhas mi bsnyel thabs kyi mchog: rta skad rngam pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bka' bstsal to// //༄/ /gzhung 'di las dbang chen rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la sbyar rgyu'i yan lag gi sgrub lugs bzhi gsungs te/ thun mong drag 213

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngags kyi/ khyad par che'i/ mchog sgrub byin rlabs kyi sgrub pa ste gur drag dang thun mong ba gsum/ bde chen glu gar gyi sgrub pa ni dgos chos te de ltar bzhi'o/ /dang po la'ang / spu gri'i sngags sgrub dang / gtor ma la brten pa'i bsad zlog gnyis gsal bar bstan/ gnyis pa'i skabs su/ che'i lha bskyed pa/ tshe bcud bsdu ba/ de las che'i dbang dang dngos grub len pa/ de mi shigs pa'i srog la brtan par bya ba ste bzhi'i sgrom nas dngos grub rgyud gsum sgrub lugs shes dgos/ gsum pa 'di la/ dngos grub bsdu ba/ sbyor mtshams su bskyil ba/ gsang sgo dbye ba/ rten la dbab pa/ de nyid dbang du bya ba'am brten par bya ba sogs yon tan bdud rtsi'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dngos grub sgrub lugs kyi gnad thams cad/ sgrub gzhi phyi rol gyi sman la byed pa dang / nang rtsa thig rlung sems la byed pa'i khyad tsam ma gtogs ji lta ba bzhin tshang ngo / /de'ang dkyil 'khor thams cad dang /dbang bskur dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / rgyud dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / phrin las kyi khyad par ji snyed pa thams cad bde chen lhan skyes kyi ye shes kho na de dang de'i rnam par shar nas gdul bya'i snying la 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshal de shes nas ༄bde chen byang sems kyi dbang 'di blangs na de dag thams cad 214

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6khyokyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur zhing / lha'am sngags dang sgrub gzhung gang gi ngo bor khyad par du bltas te/ bde chen 'bebs dmigs byas na'ang de dang de'i sgos kyi dbang chog lta bur 'gyur ro/ /nyams chag sogs nang gi rten 'brel log pa sbyong ba'i bya ba brus mthar thug kyang 'di yin/ khrus kyi lha mchog tu bsngags pa'ang dbang lha yin/ dam ye dbyer med kyi phung khams lha rnams sazi brjid rgyas par byed pa dang dgyes pa skong ba'i tshogs mchod khyad par can yang yin/ ngag la dbang skur ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab sogs bye brag re re 'bur dod du dmigs nas de la dbang skur bar dmigs na'ang de dang de rgyas byed du 'gyur/ grub chen bka' brgyad las dbang skur yon tan rdo rje'i rigs su gsungs pa yo ga dang mthun te/ yon tan rigs rgyas ji 'i rigs su bsngags pas/ sngags kyi nus pa dang / 'gro don rgyas pa sogs la rang gi ngag dang bya ba sogs la dbang skur ba 'di thabs zab par shes so/ /bzhi ba 'di lha 'di la bye brag tu bsngags pa'i cho ga yin phyir rgyas spros byed par dga' na/ spyir gru gu yang dbang gi rta mgrin dregs sgrol sogs bro rabs rgyas par bzhugs pa'i gzhung 'ga' re yod na'ang / rje grub chen nyid kyi rtsa ba'i thugs dam shangs chos dang byang gter gnyis yin(pa dang /215

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gter kha rigs mthun yin pa'i gnad kyis) pas grub chen bka' brgyad dang 'brel che ba'i bro chog ni rang shar gyi bro rdung der snang la/ spyi bka'i rigs pa dgos bka' la sbyar chog pa dang / 'di nyid rang las slob ma sta gon grub chen bka' brgyad la zhal 'phangs pa'i rigs pas 'dir yang de nas blang bar bya'o/ /de dag las gzhan pa myur mgyogs pho nya'i sgrub pa'ang yod mod kyi/ sgrub thabs spyi'i khog tu tshang ba yin gyi zur du yod pa min no/ /'gro 'dul zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub pa dang / yum ka bden gnyis zhal can ma'i sgrub pa gnyis kyang 'di dang 'brel chags su gsungs pa yin la/ las kyi phreng ba las tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa'ang gsal bar gsungs te/ bskyed rim gyi chos skor ro/ /de'i steng du ye shes phreng ba las gsungs pa'i dpe dang don gyi ye shes kyi sgrub pa bcas rgya cher bzhugs te/ de dag/ re re zhing ngo mtshar ba'i zab gnad du ma dang ldan pa'i tshul la zhib tu sbyang dgos so///rje grub thob chen po'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub lugs kyi rnam grangs bkod pa'o/ /dzam bu'i gling 'dir pad+ma gsung gi rig 'dzin ches che ba ni mgon po klu sgrub yin te/ 'di ltar gter kha gong 'og byang gter sogs rtsod bral kun nas gsungs so/ /kha cig gis gter phyogs nas de ltar bshad pa'i klu sgrub de phyis kyi bā li a tsar+ya yin 216

phuḥmi snapa///spro/:rwaspro/ /bye/shā()// //// ////ཿpa/// /rdo/rgoshāḥ// // rdozer ba rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas bkag cing / klong snying rtsa rgyud thod dum las/ be+e ta'i yul 'khrungs bram ze'i rigs:blo chen na ga rdzu na la: gsung mchog pad+ma'i sgrom bu gtad:ces 'khrungs yul sogs lang gshegs ltar bshad de/ bde 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud las kyang de bzhin bshad do/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rig pa rma bya chen mo ni/ /bdag nyid chen po des kyang 'grub/ /ces gsungs te/ de'i gleng gzhir rma bya chen mo 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rigs kyi lha mor bshad pas/ lung des kyang pad+ma'i rigs kyi gsang sngags 'grub par bstan no/ /des na mgon po 'dis rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags kyis klu yul du byon par rgya gar pa la grags pa ltar klu rnams btul ba'ang pad+ma gsung gi rig sngags la brten no/ /slob dpon de la bsil ba'i tshal gyi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par pad+ma gsung gi zangs sgrom mkha' 'gro mas dngos su phul zhing / he chen brdal ba'i dur ā+od du rta mgrin bsgrub pas rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub brnyes/gu ru rin po ches kyang dbang chen gsung gi gdams skir rnams 'di las gsan te gtso bor chos rgyal khri srong dang / mchog dbyangs gnyis la bstsal ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i rta mgrin bla brgyud kyi spyi mes de 'di ga'i sgrub gzhung dang 'brel bar thags ༄217

21tshad/ (( therdo sdi/rngaku 'o/:drob/bzhi bya)rngasno nga//nyazud rta):re ba/sdo/khung khuradra/zug/ 2〉rgyud skul ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bye brag tu byed na/ mchog gi byin rlabs dbab pa'i skabs/ thod phreng sde lnga yab yum snyoms/ par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i 'od zer gyis bde ba can nas 'phags/ pa klu sgrub kyi thugs rgyud lhag par bskul/ dbang dang byin rlabs/ dngos grub thams cad bde chen bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus/ nge nyid bla ma thod phreng rtsal gyis rang nyid la bstsal bar dmigs pa'i bzlas sgom bya zhing klu sgrub dang pad+ma'i zhabs tha dad du mi blta'o/ /thog ma'i byin 'bebs skabs kyang lde kha 'dogs pa ni bla ma zhi ba'i zin tho ltar ro// //༄/ /dbang chen las tshogs kyi zin ris yid bzhin rin po che'i sprin/phar ba spu gri'i gzhan don tshom ba 'bam sde'i sgrub pa'i gter ragazi rasmi3 ra༄1mchan dang / phur ba'i spyi sdom jo mo'i zhus len gnyis ka las las tshogs kyi gnad ni dper na gser zhun ma la bzo ci byas nyan pa yin te: bsnyen sgrub mtshan ma thon phan chad sham bu ci 'dod du bsgyur bas 'grub ste: zhi rgyas dbang drag: gso bsad dbab bcad: dgug bskrad: mnan gzir jag chings: cho 'phrul srog thun sogs gang 'dod pa'i phrin las 218

phang〉mdzor ཿpa///pa/:rwa( /nyebye(5sdo 2rtan ////:pa/// /rdo//sprerwaḥ// //7 thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sgrub cing snying po la 'dod gsol sbyar bas 'grub bo: zhes gsungs te/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi sbas pa/ mig 'byed las kyang / mtshan ma ma mthong las brtsams pa:'ja' tshon spar 'dzin don med yin: zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra'o/ /gzhung 'di la srung bzlog gsad gsum tshang bar zin tho ljags dpod mar gsungs pa'i/ srung ba la/ sgom pa'i srung ba ni/bo cha lha lnga dang / khro chung gi go bgo gnyis yin cing / khro bcu'i srung('di rtsal 'don byed na khrag 'thung bde gshegs 'dus pa nas tshur blang ngo)dmigs kyang yod par gtor bzlog tu gsungs/ srung sngags logs su ma bshad kyang / lus dkyil khro bo'i tshogs kyis kyang:zhes sogs skabs go cha'i rta mgrin rnams kyis rang rang gi sngags bzla bar 'chad pa na rta sngags rang bshad pa 'dis rta sngags de rgo cha'i sngags su shes/ gnas lnga'i go cha'i lha dang / khro bo bcu'i sngags ni ru lu yin te/ zur du bris pa dang / chos dbang yang dag las ru lu srung mtshams su shes par gsungs pa sogs dang sgrigs/ gzhan srang ba'i dmigs pa ni/ dmigs bya srang gur du ༄ tro ོchi'i ༄bcug nas srung ba/ 'gal rkyan bar chad rda rja' mkhar du srung:zhes kha skong phrin las su gsungs pa'i dgongs par 'grigs shing /spyi'i lugs kyang yin no/ /srung gur gyi dmigs pa 'dis gdon 219

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhebagegs su ma zad/ yams nad/ shwa 'ud/ dmag 'khrug/ chom rkun/ gcan gzan/ rbab/ skyogs sogs 'phrul 'khor rigs/sad ser/ kha char/ thog rlung / me/ lo tog za ba'i 'bu sogs gzhan yang srung ste/ dkyil chog rdor phreng las rdul tshon 'byung lnga'i gnod pas mi brdzi ba'i phyir srung 'khor sgom par bshad pa lta bu'o/ /bris pa'i 'khor los srung ba ni dkyus su mi gsal yang / byed na skyer sgang lugs 'brel che bas de la/ gzhi dar ras sam shog bu gtsang mar bris rjes su gri kha btang mi dgos pa byas pa la/ ghi haṃ dang ga bur gur gum sogs kyi snag tsha dang / gzugs mo byi thur gyi smyu gus/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/ de'i lte bar trīḥ trī'i steng du oṃ/ 'og tu phaṭa/ de'i mthar steng nas mgo brtsams te g.yas skor du/bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal pos 'chang ba po la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnod pa thams cad las srung du gsol/zhes 'bri/ rtsibs brgyad la steng nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas/pad+mā na/ ta kri ta/ badz+ra/ gro dha/ h+ya/ kṛ ba/ hu lu/ hu lu hūṃ/ zhes pa rnams dang / rtsibs mchan la/rtsibs steng ma'i g.yon nas brtsams te/ oṃ/ badz+ra/ dun/ bh+yo/ trig /nan/ dza dza/ sa ma ya stam/ rnams 'god/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ sa ma ya dza sa ma 220

ma sbyiji ཿpa//ཿpa/15pa/ /bye/mi/rdo sdo //// ////:pa/// /spre/rgo4ཿཿ// // ya zlog /sa ma ya bh+yo/ sa ma ya gtub/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po ma ra ya dza dza/ zhes 'bri/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la rten snying dang / rdo ra/ me ri g.yas 'khor bya/ sngags rnams yig mgo phyir bstan g.yas skor kho nar 'bri/ rab gnas byas la gdags/ 'di steng 'khor rkyang pa'i srung ba ste ('di ni gtso rkyang gi srung ba ste gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi 'khor lo ni ma rnyed/ lcags zam lugs kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag cung zad mi 'dra ba'ang yod par bshad pas tshol/ 'khor lo 'dis ni 'jig rten gsum gyi bgegs thams cad srung bar gzhung gi steng gdon gza' dang 'og gdon klu: sogs kyis mtshon no) gsang sgrub la mkhas pa thu'u bkwan pa'i yig cha ltar bris/ steng 'og sbyar ma'i srung ba sogs 'dir ma bkod/ byed na shangs lugs rang du blta'o/ /'bri gzhi bug rdol/ rtsibs kyi rtsa rtse mu khyad la reg pa/ mu khyad rnams chad 1de/ :jo rang /de /grin skurabapa/ yi 'asde 'phro lus pa ltar ma ngas pa/ snebs dang mu khyud sogs la thug cing yi ge phan tshun 'dres pa/ ma shong ba/ yig phreng 'khyog gcus/ gong 'og 'khrugs pa/ mig zum/ bris bsub/ lhag chad sogs kyi skyon med par bya/ yig mgo ston phyogs/ srung ba phyi dang zlog pa nang / zhi rgyas phyi dang dbang drag nang du ston par bshad pa ltar ro/ /'khor lo ma grub na/ sngon du byams snying rje bsgom/ srung mdud hrīḥlas rta mgrin du bskyed/ lto 221

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhebar gnod byed thams cad bsdus la thar pa'i skabs med par bsams te gdags pa yang shangs lugs las so/ /las sbyor spu gri la dbang sdud dang / mngon spyod sngags gnyis char 'byed rgyu yod pas/ sa gsum dbang sdud kyi bzlas pa dgos su byed na/sa ma ya stam/ yan chad khol byung bzla ba skyer sgang lugs bzhin byed/ dbang sdud sngags 'di grol thig rta mgrin dang / klong snying gi rgyal po lugs kyi nang na'ang snang / sngags don ni/ oṃ zur 'khod ltar/ thun bh+yo rbad pa'i sngags su snying gzer las bshad pas/ khro mtshon me phung gi pho nya 'gyed pa la badz+ra dun bh+yo zhes sbyor ram snyam/ tig nan ni snying gzer las/ trig (shangs lugs su trika nan zhes 'don pa'ang yin) nan gnyis kyis steng nas gzir (mes mar gong ltar gdung bar byed pa'i don) zhes srog (lha srin sde brgyad 'khrugs shing /yul lha nang zhig 'ong ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo gsar skyes kyi 'byung po gdug pa can dang / sh+lau bur du lhags pa'i 'dre srin rnams kyis byed par gsungs pas rgyal khams bde bar 'dod cing nus ldan yin na de dag gzir ba gal che) gzir ba'i sngags su bshad/ dzaḥdzaḥ'aphrogs par byed pa'am 'gugs 'dren/ sa ma ya stam/ dam bsgrags sam/ yang na dam bzhag ces 'chad dam dpyad dgos so/ /tshe sgrub byed na gu ru drag po ltar bya zhing /de'ang dkyus kyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi bzlas pa'i mjug tu 222

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6tragadag par bya'o/ /dbang sgrub lha lnga'i byin 'bebs kyi cho ga yang de nas len/ nad dang / yams nad/ lha 'khrugs sogs gdon rigs/ dam sri sogs bgegs/ sri kegs/ steng grib dang khon grib sogs grib rigs/ byad phur/ me/ chu/ dug mtshon cha/'khrug rtsod/ rgyal po'i chad pa/ gcan gzan/ bshes bral/don nyams/ dbul phongs/ dus min 'chi ba/ pha rol gyi lce 'bab pa sogs zhi bar gti mug rdo rje bskul te/ de gtsor gyur las 'od zer dkar po'i spro bsdu byed/ sgyu 'phrul las ni zhi las pha rol khros pa zhi byed tsam dang sbyar yod/ tshe/ shes rab/ dran pa'i gzungs/ chos dang rigs kyi brgyud 'dzin/ 'khor dang grog/sa/ dbang phyug gzi brjid/ snyan grags/ longs spyod /lus shed dang klung rta sogs kyi mthu stobs/ sems bskyed sogs dge ba'i chos/ rtsi sman lo tog bzhon chu/ de dag dang chang sogs kyi ro nus/ char dang chu mig skal ba bzang po/ nad med pa'i bde ba/ sdil phyogs su bzo dang sgyu rtsal/ chos kyi(bsang 'dus le'u bcu bzhi ba'i 'grel mchan du/ chos rgyas pa zhes pa gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la mkhas pa la bshad) 'byor ba dri med sogs rgyas par ser sna rdo rje bskul te/ 'od ser po/ rgyal blon yul khams/nor dbyig gos rgyan/ bza' btung / spos dang rol mo sogs 223

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhenyer spyad/ zhing khang / skyed tshal/ bud med/ rig pa mkhan /gzhan 'phrul bdag po sogs lha klu gter bdag glegs bam/dge 'dun/ gzhon nu (gang zhig dbang du gyuron bstan 'gro'i don chen po 'grub pa'i mi dbang dang / chos kyi brgyud 'dzin khyad par can lta bu gtso bo yin)sogs dbang byed la 'dod chags rdo rje las 'od dmar/ bya mchu ma sogs bstan pa la gnod pa dang / 'gro ba mang po'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i mi dang mi min bsad pa dang / bsdig pa dang / myos pa dang / brgyal bar byed cing / stobs gzhom pa sogs la phras dog rdo rje las 'od dus kyi mun pa lta bu spro bsdu bya zhing / yum bka'i skabs kyi sngags sham btags/ 'di ni/ rta bro'i cho ga dang /yum bkar/ dmigs pa'i mde'u kha spyi ltar sbyar: zhes gsungs pa la brten pa ste/ rta rgyud kyi khungs kyang che'o/ /glu gar gyis las bzhi sgrub skabs/ rgyas las lta bur mtshon na/ser sna rdo rje 'khor bcas bro rdung ba rnams las yid (rin chen rigs kyi sprul ba gzi brjid 'bar ba'i tshogs dpag med spros pas/ tshe bsod sosas dgos 'dod nam mkha' gang bar 'byung bar bsam pa sgrol g.yung gnyis kyis bshad do) bzhin gyi 'od zer gser mdog tshad med pa spros pas 'bru nor longs spyod kyi char gzi ldan zad mi shes par phab ste dmigs bya'i dbul phongs bsal bar bsam pa klong chen rgyud ṭika las so/ /224

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6des 'gre/ de bzhin du/ spyi dgos kyi de nyid shes pas rin chen rigs kyi rta glu blangs pas glu sgras gar khyab tu dpal 'byor longs spyod kyi char chen po phab par bsam pa sogs 'gre'o/ /rta skad kyis las bzhi byed pa'i dmigs pa 'di ni dzab kyi skabs su sbyar na'ang rung bar sems te/ rta skad thengs gsum dzab dmigs la sbyor zhing / 'di de ltar mi rung ba'i khyad par ci zhig yod/de'ang zhi ba la gti mug rdo rje nas/ drag po la phrag dog rdo rje'i bar du he ru ka so sos glu so sor blang bar bltas la/ sngags sham sngar ltar 'dog te/ tshul gnyis gang yang rung ngo / /las rim kazhan dang ma sprad kyang nam 'dod du rta glus las sgrub pa'ang byar rung ste/ rengs pa la sogs pa'i lta stangs bzhin no/ /las bzhi rab 'byams bros sgrub pa mnan pa dang ma sbyar ba 'di snyan brgyud rta mgrin snying tig na shin tu gsal te zur du bris yod/ yang /yu la 'khor srung zhing bkra shis par byed pa/ gdon bgegs dgra sasum skṛd pa dang dbye ba dang rmongs par byed pa (sri'u gso ba/ ma slo rnams byis pa la brtse zhing byes pa skyong ba la bsngags/ de'ang glang phrug seng ge mos kaso snun byas pa khyu mchog tu 'gyur ba ltar go ba len rgyu yod) kha char dang ser ba sa/cod 'bebs/ gtad hrul(hril)'byin/ 'dun bshigs/ltas dang cho 'phrul gtong ba/ g.yul zlog pa/ sad srung ba/ don 225

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsang 'bam/riri me ni ri phangashāstasgrub pa/ longs spyod spel ba/ chom rkun gcan gzan rngon pa sogs kyi kha 'ching ba/ tshal dang khang bzang sogs gnas ga'i phun tshogs sgrub pa/ bcud len dgug pa/ btson 'grol ba /dbang sdud kyi khyad par mang po sogs las tshogs ches mang po 'is dam can pho nya las la bskul: zhes pas byed de/ sgyu 'phrul ba la yongs grags ltar sbyor na/ dbang mo rnams kyi thugs kar skyo yig res mtshan par gsal btab ste/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul/ de'ang zhi ba la shar gyi ma mo bdun gyi thugs srog la phog pas rgyud bskul te zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du bsgrub par bsam/ de'i 'gres kyis lho'i bdun gyis rgyas las sogs/ ma mo mkha' 'gro de dag gi thugs dgongs lan cig gtad pa tsam res kyang de 'dra dpag med 'grub pa'i phyir te/ gsang rdzogs ma mo'i dzab dgongs las shes so/ /nge/'i tshe las sgrub kyi sngags la'ang rtsa sngags rang gis chog ste/ snga ma/ de de'i dzab dgongs su bshad pas shes pa'i phyir/ dam can pho nya la klu dang gnod sbyin sogs gzhan yang mang ngo / /'di sogs nam rbod gtong gi las grub pa na sngar bcol las kyi gtang raka dus mi yol bar gtang zhing / phyi bcol las kyi gnyer gtod pa/ ni gal che bar mang du gsungs so/ /lha srin bran du 'khol ba'i 226

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6tsharabazlas dmigs la yang sgyur lugs mang du yod de/ 'di ltar/phyogs skyong dang sde brgyad rang rang gi sde ris su gtogs pa'i gdon rnams la bka' nan 'be bas pa dang / so so'i rigs kyi bro dam pos bsgag tu bcug na rgyal bsen btsan 'gong the'u rang sogs thams cad khyi rgod lcags phur la btags pa bzhin 'tshe mi nus par 'gyur te/ 'di ni srung mtshams bcing lugs khyad par can gtso bo dbang du bsdus pas 'bangs rang shugs kyis non pa/'i man ngag go/ /sgrub chen dus phyi mtshams rgyal chen bzhi'i srung ba dang / gsar ma'i dkyil chog du mar/ bgegs srung ba'i phyir phyogs skyong la gtor ma byin na sa lung bgo bar bshad pa sogs dang tshul mthun cing / stong chen rab 'joms na yang phyogs 'dra yod/ gzhan du zho chang lad pa sogs tshun chad la rang thad kyi srung ba re byar ga la lang / de bzhin du gza' skar sa bdag sogs de dag gis dbang byed pa'i lo zla zhag dus sa dgra phyogs ngan sogs 'jam du gtong ba/ rang gzhan gyi bla tshe gtad du bzung ba sogaso phyir sprod du gzhug pa/ klu'i dug dang ma mo'i tshon drug gshin rje'i kha rlangs sogs slar sdud du stsol ba/sde brgyad kyis dbang byed pa'i (khyim gsum tho ltar bstan dgra la sde brgyad bshed du skor ba/ sad ser btsa' than 'bu sogs lo tog gi gnod 'tshe srung ba/227

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/7zhegater chos dang snyan grags sogs phyogs bcu kun tu sgrogs shing spel ba/ yul mi rnams kyi sems bsgyur te sde 'khrugs dang chom rkun sogs zhi bar byed pa dang / sngom tshogs dbang du sdud pa dang lung sgyur ba) phyi snod yo byad dang bcas pa dbang du bya ba/ mi chos kyi yon tan brtan mdzangs sgam gsum dang btsan phyug 'phan dar gyi dngos grub len pa/ g.yul sgom byed pa'i sde dpon ma rungs pa sogs la nang 'thab dang brel zing brgya phrag slong ba/ shags dang tshong dang dmag dang shwa rgyan rgya'/ bar bya ba/ mkhar las dang chu rags skye shing 'dzugs pa sosas(rwa lor sham pos btsun pa brgya phul ba dang / 'jam dbyangs chos rjer btsun pa lnga stong phul ba'i lo rgyus ltar dge 'dun gyi sde spel ba) brtsams pa don yod cing chud mi za bar byed pa sogs mtha' yas so /yang longs spyod rdo rje'i rta skad bton pas gang 'dod kyi yul du sman gyi nags tshal dang ldum rwa dang / skyed mos tshal dang / khang brtsegs dang / tshong khang gi phreng ba dang / gtsug lag khang gsung rab kyis phyug pa dang rin po che'i 'byung khungs sogs bzang la rgya che ba'i gnas mang po byung bar blta ba'ang 'thad de/mdor na rta skad de ni kun tu bzang po'i bum bzang du shes par bya'o/ /lkog gyur mthong ba'i las sbyor ni/ dzab dgongs dang po'i thugs kyi dngos grub sdud skabs/ mngon shes thogs med kyi 228

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6khyodangos grub bsdu dmigs rtsal du bton pas rab mngon shes/ tha ma 'dod don la mi 'khrul ba'i rmi lam khyad par can 'byung ngo / /'di dang gtor zlog sogs kyi yid nyams gsal ba dang dpa' ngar sogs gang skye ba la yang 'khu 'khrigs re dogs sogs kyi bcos ma shor ba'i shes rig so ma'i steng nas de dang de la dgongs pa gtod rgyu yin no/ /bdag la gzhan gyis byad kha byed pa'i rmi ltas byung na: zhabs g.yas pa'i 'og tu gnod byed kyi sa bon bsam: dgra'i rnam shes bkug la sbrul gyis dkris la zhabs kyis mnan par bsam nas sngags bzlas na phyir zlog zab mo yin no: zhes skyer sgang lugs kyi rtsa gzhung du gsungs so/ /bro'i las tshogs la/ rab dga'i spyod pa 'di ni dbang gi phrin las la khyad par du bsngags te/ 'jig rten na yang bro gar dang glus 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog par byed pas de dag gar yod na ltad rno/ ba'i skye bo me tog la bung ba bzhin du dga' nas 'du ba ltar/dbang chen yang gsang gi bro chog las/ rta bro 'khor gsum mam skor gsum gyi/ dang pos steng lha khams/ gnyis pas 'og klu khams/ gsum pas bar gyi lha srin dbang du sdud par bshad cing /kasang rdzogs rtsa rgyud las/ glu bro skor gcig gi gzugs med khams/ gnyis pas gzugs khams/ tha mas 'dod khams zil 229

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyogyis gnon par gsungs pa dang / zhabs g.yas thabs kyi bros khro bo'i tshogs dang / g.yon shes rab kyi bros khro mo'i tshogs dbang du sdud pa dang / g.yas g.yon thabs shes kyi bros bdud dgra dam sri thal bar rlog ces gtso bo che mchog gi bro la sbyar te bshad pa'ang 'dra bar sems/ 'di nyid las kyang / sa gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams: dbang med 'du zhing yid 'phrogs pas/:zhes so/ (sa paṇa gyis/ gang na thod dang skra gsar dang / /gar dang rol mo'i sgra yod pa/ /de na mya ngan yod min pas/ /des na rol mo bsngags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / rol mo gnyis las der lhan skyes rol mo zhes dbyangs la sbyar ba ltar glu gar 'di mya ngan med pa'i bde ba'i rten 'brel du bsngags pas byur dang mi shis pa sbyong ba dang bkra shis spel ba la'ang zab)rta mchog rol ba'i tan+d+ra las/ bro ni brtul zhugs chen po ste/ /zhes so/ /lha'i nga rgyal dang / dngos sam mos ngo'i bde stong si ngang nas gang snang la thog brdzis sam brtul zhugs byas pas//rbab dang / g.yang sa dang / sa g.yo dang / shwa 'ud sogs chu bo'i 'jigs pa dang / thog dang / ser ba dang / sad dang / rlung dang / me dang / mtshon cha dang / gcan gzan dang / g.yul gyi stobs dang / dpa' ba dang / chom rkun dang / phyogs ngan dang lo zla zhag dus dang gza' skar dus sbyor ngan pa dang / sri kegs 230

ming〉pho ru〉da zhu〉 ཿpa//pa/ཿpa( /re)(5/ 2// ///ཿba// casdosaspre da/ (33dang / byad phur rbod gtong dang / gdon bgegs ma rungs pa dang / nad yams dang / ltas dang rmi lam ngan pa dang / gnas dang rdzas dang 'khor mi shis pa dang / grib dang / gyod dang /grags pa ngan pa dang / cher rlom gyi khengs dregs gzi brjid dang / phas rgol gyi spobs pa dang / gros ngan dang / klu rigs bzhi'i dug sogs dug rigs sogs pham par bya ba'i dngos po kang dang gang yin yang shin tu gsher ba'i 'jim pa la stobs ldan gyi rkang pas brdzis pa ltar byed de/ rnal 'byor pa'i nus pa'i bye brag gis rim pa mang po yod do/ /der ma zad bar chad kyi ru 'dren la brtul zhugs btang bas de dag nyid dngos grub kyi grogs su 'gyur ba'ang yod de/ rta mchog rol pa'i tan+d+ra las/sgrub pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa'i drod nyul ba'i phyir/ dang por klu'i bu mo mdzes shing rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / phra men ma mi sdug cing 'bra tshags sa lta ba mi thod mang pos brgyan cing sod chod kyi ༄༄ ༄sgra 'byin pa dang / bar du gnod sbyin ral pa 'bar zhing mi'i rgyu ma dang mgo dang sbrul nag gis spras pa drag po'i nga ro can du ma dang / de'i 'og tu bar snang gi lha drag shul can 'jigs shing mi bzad pa'i nga ro 'don pa/ kha nas sbrul dang me dang dug skyug pa/mig nyi ma ltar 'bar bar bsgyur nas lta ba dang / rang gi khog pa 231

21rngad/ (‘ therdo sdispyings khur:jitha/thag byasputshosno thaspubaltazud rta):re tha/sdo/padro khuradra/zug/ ra〉phye ba'i nang nas mi ro mang po ston cing / rkang pa phur bur bsgyur zhing lag na rdo rje sogs thogs nas bdag la 'debs par byed pa'i tshogs lhags te/ de dag kun la chags pa dang 'jigs pa med par lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang lta bas zil gyis mnan na mthu bo che'i 'khor de rnams kyi bdag por 'gyur bar gsungs pa dang /gsang rdzogs dam sri 'dul thabs las dam sri bya mchu ma legs par thul na drag po mthu'i sna khrid dang / nor gyi lha mo chen mor 'gyur bar gsungs pas mtshon no/ /bro mnan skabs/ rta bros sa/ la sna tshogs rdo rje 'bri ba sogs bshad pas/ spyan ma'i mkha' dbyings rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pa'ang yin te/ sa chog gi skabs gar gyis sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rlob par gsungs pa dang phyogs 'dra/ don du dgra bgegs rdo rje'i sgrom du bcug pa/ zhes par 'gyur/ tshul des sa g.yo gnon pa la'ang lhag par bsngags sam snyam/ brtags gnyis las/ glu gar gyis tshogs srang zhing / bdag nyid kyang srang zhes gsungs pa'i rigs pas ra 43 ra 47rang dang 'khar srung ba la'ang zab par snang / nus pa ba pa sa ni tshogs spyod dang 'brel bar/ dkyil 'aṭor gyi 'aṭor lo'i rna'/ 'byor la gnas te bro gar gyi 'du 'phro las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrub/ slar 'dus pas 232

7zhu〉34ཿmi :pa//tshospro/:spraku /re)()/ 2rtan ////snarwa/// /rdope/sprerwaḥ// // rdodakyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal bar byas te dbyings su bcug slar yang snying rje'i dbang gis rim gyis sam lhag par mos pas lhar langs te/ bro gar gyi sgo nas bsgrub na dngos grub chen po 'thob bo/ /yang sa gzhi yi ge sgyu 'phrul du bsgoms te/ de la lha ma yin gyi gnas la sogs pa'i lam du brtags nas/ bro sar gyis zhugs nas sa 'og gi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya ste/ tshul 'dis lha dang klu'i ba mo dgug pa sogs kyang byed do/ /lce'i pad+ma la hrīḥyig ༄ bsgo mas te/ de'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba rnams la so so'i skad du chos sgrogs pa dang / bdud dang mu stegs zil gyis gnon pa la sosas pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs thisneng / slar sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung gi yon tan gyi tshogs bsdus te lce la thim par basbo zu sa nas glu blang ba la brtson na chos snra ba la dbang thob pa'i dngos grub 'thob pa ni/ glu tshig sgra yi phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di ni rje rong zom pa'i rgyud 'grel las bshad do/ /bro gar gyi 'gros kyis sa dang nam/ mkha' thogs med du gcod pa 'di ni ral gri'i dngos grub dang byed las mnyam pa zhig snang ngo / /rta bro ston pa'i rta rgyud du/ngan song gnas 'joms kyi bro zhes mang du gsungs shing / rta 233

pasarngan/ (3 jordo sdo/rngaku 'o/:zub/ba/ byaspustan nga/bltazud rta):re ba/sdo/jing 'o/dra/zug/ sko004tsharamachog rol pa'i tan+t+ra'i le'u brgya re gnyis par/ 'khor ba ru nas bzlog pa'i bro/ /ngan song gnas nas 'joms par mdzad/ /ces gsungs te/ sdug bsngal tha shos/ rigs drug gi ru ste dang po'i stosna la bgrang rgyu ni sa 'og ngan song gi 'jig rten yin te/ de la bde chen gyi spyod pa 'dis bsnun pas gting sprugs par byed par bstan no/ /zur 'khod/ thugs rje'i rta skad rigs drug 'dul/sogs dang / theg pa rim par bgrod pa'i rta skad kyang / don du/'dir shog dang ngas khyed chos dbyings sgrib pa med pa'i grong khyer du sgrol lo zhes lus can rnams 'bod cing skul bar 'gro bas/nus pa thob pas ni ngan song ba'i sems can la dmigs nas glu bro byas na gnas lung khyad par can du 'gro bar gsal lo/ /rta skad kyis dbang drag rol pa'i las byed tshul ni rdzogs ldan 'dzin ma dbang byed kyi 'khor lo'i skor du lta'o/ /bla ma zhi ba'i gzhung du/ rab gnas sreg blugs skor la sogs: zhes gsungs pa'i rab gnas ni dkyus su mi gsal bas/skyabs rjes spyi la sbyor rgyur mdzad pa'i dge legs char 'bebs bzhin bya ste/ der chos dang zang zing gi 'byor ba rgyas pa'i phyir gtsug lag khang dang / mtsho rdzing lu ma 'bab chu sogs phun sum tshogs par bya ba dang skyed tshal dang ri dang de'u dang nags la 234

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6sogs pa gzi brjid spor ba dang bkra shis shing yun du gnas pa'i phyir de dang de dag dang / sa bcud gso ba'i don du gter bum dang / yul gyi bkra mi shis pa zhi ba'i ched du dril bu dang /g.yul gyi nang du brdung bya'i rnga bo che dang / dge 'dun bsdu ba'i don du dung dang / nad mtshon gdon dug srung ba'i don du sngags mdud lhag par gnas par bya ba sogs 'di gcig pus kyang dgos pa mang po byar yod do/ /gnas bya gang la rigs gang si/sa rab tu gnas pa ni/ rje dang mchog gling thun mong gi zab sater mnyam sbyor rab gnas rin dra ltar ram/ gter bdag gling pa sogs kyis spyi'i cho ga phreng ba ltar mdzad pas yang na de ltar bya'o/ /sbyin sreg mdor bsdus ni phag mo'i gzhung ltar bya la/ rgyas par spro na tshar chen gyi yang gsang sbyin sreg lta bu la gzhi byas nas brtsam du rung ste/ rat+na gling pas rang gi rta gsang la yang gsang dang gsang sgrub kyi cho ga las kha bskangs pa dang / gsang sgrub mkhan po mkhas pa du mas yang gsang dang gsang 'dus kyi tshogs mchod dang gtor bzlog sogs nas gsang sgrub la mang du sbyar ba bzhin te/ de 'dra mang ngo / /slob ma sta gon sgyu 'phrul las len par gsungs pu'i rigs pas/ sgyu dra'i sbyin sreg sbyar na'ang 235
