pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4'brel che'o/ /skong bshags ni rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub gzhung ltar bya'o//rta skad kyis grub chen brgyad kyang dbang du byed par zur 'khod kyis shes/ de sgrub lugs la 'dir ni/ phrin las bzhi dang grub pa brgyad: ces dngos grub gsol tshig tu 'byung ba las gzhan mi gsal yang / dbang po skal ba'i khyad par bzhin: dman 'bring mchog gi dngos grub 'thob: ('di la dpyad tshul 'di las zhib pa gcig zur du bris yod) ces dngos grub 'bring po skabs 'di'i dngos grub len chog dus 'thob pa zhig kyang bshad do/ /mchos gi dngos grub der 'thob pa ni gzhan las/ mchog la dgongs nga/ g.yo 'gul med: ces pa ltar btags pa ba tsam la dgongs par mngon/ rgyud sde du mar bskyed rim pas mkha' spyod sogs 'grub pa la/ bskyed rim rags pa tsam mthar phyin pa'i sngags pas ni/ rdzas dang sreg blugs sogs mang po la brten dgos par gsungs pa yod de/ rang nyid kyis nus pa khyad par can rten pa'i sgo nas de dag sgrub pa la dgongs so/ /de dag gzhan stobs la brten nas 'grub pa la ni de tsam mi dgos te/ mdzod las/rdzu 'phrul gzhan brten ma gtogs pa/ /de dag gong ma mthong ba med/ /ces tshul gnyis bshad pa lta bu'o/ /rang nyid kyis nus pa/ snga ma lta bu ma rnyed par gzhan stobs kyis dngos grub chen po la 236

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6po〉spyod mi srid pa min pa ni/ phyag rdor dbang bskur las/ zhing ba dang / 'khor sgyur dang / dbang phyug chen po'i dpe gsungs pa bzhin no/ /klong snying yum bkar/ mkha' spyod la sogs yon tan brgyad: dngos su grub cing / zhes dang / na ro mkha' spyod ma'i mkha' spyod sgrub tshul sogs kyang gzhan stobs la brten pa 'dir snang ngo / /des na lha sngags kyi nus pa cher skyes pa'i mtshams shig nas yi dam dngos la dngos grub len chog gi bslang ba tsam gyis mkha' spyod dang / mi snang ba dang / 'chi med la sogs pa 'thob pa zhig kyang yod par mngon pas/ gzhung 'dir bstan tshod ni de la bya'o/ /lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor yod na las bzhi'i dngos grub sgrub pa la'ang khyad che ba ni sgyu 'phrul mkhan po rnams la yang ma grags pa min te/ ljon pa dang ni lcugs phran tshal/ /sogs kyi nges don las bzhi'i gzungs ma la bzhed pas shes so/ /thun mong gi grub pa chen po sgrub na tshogs spyod sngon du gtong ba yang de dag la grags pa yin te/ bskyed rim pa'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub zla drug sogs byas pa'i mthar 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa de yin pa'i phyir/ dam pa rgyan las/ gdug pa srid gsum 'dul ba yi/ /nga rgyal chen po bstan pa'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ting 'dzin sgom/ /zhes pa — 237

21rngad/ (( :rdo sdispying/ 'o/:drope/bzhi cesarngasno nga/bstazud rta):re ba/ṭa/ngang khurasdo/zug/ r+sha074ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i dngos po shin tu bsgyur nas khro bor mdzad pa'i sgos mdzad ni bdud sde'i dkyil 'khor brlag par byed pa de yin pas (gsang 'dus le'ur/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes// gsod la rtag tu brtson pa dag /grub pa mchog gi chos can la/ /gsod pa'i don gyis grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ grub par 'gyur/ zhes pa ni 'grub par 'gyur zhes pa min gyi/ dngos grub tu 'gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /) shin tu cher khros kyi he ru ka 'di lta bu'i las sbyor la drag po'i phrin las gtso che ste/rgyud kyi bcu bdun par/ smug nag sngo nag ser nag /sogs la so so'i rigs mi 'gyar bas na sngo ser dmar po sogs so so dang /༄drag po'i las gtso bor mdzad pas thams cad la nag po 'bre'/ bar bshad pa lta bu dang / sgrub chen bka' brgyad las kyang dras po'i gzer kha kho na las sbyor thams cad kyi rtsa bar gsungs so/ /de ni dzab tu yang 'byung la/ zur du sgrub lugs ni/ gtor zloka gur drag nas sbyor bar gsungs pa de dang / mnan pa dkyus bshad dang / sreg (don du dbang chog na hom mchod kyi las rim sho lo ka gcis bzhugs pa de la rtsa tho byas na smin gling drag mar sogs kyi hom chog dang / sgyu 'phrul lugs kun dang shin tu mthun no/ /) pa zur tho ltar de 'di rnams yin no/ /de las gtor zlog ni bar chad kyi dmag dpung la rdo rje'i skyog sa(grub thob bka' brgyad du/ drag sngags 'ur zhing skyogs su 'phang ཿ zhes so/ /)238

phuḥr :pa///spro/15pa/ /bye/shā/tre/sdu //// ////:pa/// /rdo/rgosprerwaḥ// //smo 'phang ba'i cho ga ste/ brgya byin g.yul ngor 'jug pa na dam bca' gsum ldan gyi rdo rje 'phen pa'i dod yin pas/ dbang chen gyi rgyal thabs bzung nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung na 'gal zla lha min gyi sde dang g.yul 'gyed pa'i man ngag 'di gces pa'i mthar thug mtshon cha'i nor bu yin no/ /gshin rje dregs 'joms las zlog pa'i man ngag gis sred med bu'i stobs kyang 'joms nus par gsungs pa ltar/ gshin rje'i be con dang / drang srong gi dmod pa/ lha ma yin gyi sgyu thabs sogs gdug rtsub ngar shugs ser sprin khol ma lta ba rnams kyang sos ka'i than sprin ltar byed do//༄de'ang sog sbur bye ba ther 'bum gyi gdong du 'dug mkhan la 'thor rlung drag po'i 'khrul 'khor gcig kho nas chog pa ltar/nad rims/ mdze gdon/ smyo 'dre sogs gdon rgod/ 'chi bdag gi sun ma/ kla klo'i srung ma sogs nag phyogs kyi nyul ma/sde brgyad 'khrugs pa'i dmag dpung / dgra jag dmag sde/sad ser btsa' 'bu sogs lo nyes/ gzhan yang 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa/ byad kha phur kha/ gtad dang 'khrul 'khor/ mtshon g.yang sogs gri rgod/ dgra dur phung gsum sogs sri rigs/rgyal po'i chad pa/ 'bangs kyi gros ngan/ gyod dang mi kha (mi kha gleng gzhi'i nus pas bsod nams dang tshe srog glo bur du 'grib cing bkra mi shis pa 'du bar 239

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+shathugs sgrub zhal gdams snying byang sogs las gsungs pas las sbyor spu gri dang gtor zlog gis de 'dul ba gal che) bra mchu/ bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs sgrub pa la gnya' mnan nas rang dgar byed du mi ster ba'i gzhan dbang mang po sogs mtha' yas pa zhig la 'di phog pa tsam gyis chog pas/ nad bdag stobs 'joms dang / dmag zlog gshin rje tshong zlog sri zlog 'gong po bskrad pa/ byad zlog dgra rkun 'ching ba/ gri 'dul sogs kyi go thams cad 'di gcig pus chod par shes nas/ dpe mang 'tshol ba'i ngal ba bzhag ste 'di ral gri phyungs rdeg tu srel bar bya'o/ /jag chings lta bur/ lam du 'jug grabs byed dus nas dgra jag sogs 'byung 'gyur la dmigs nas gtor zlog byas pas/ phyis rang thad du rtsol ba gzhan mi dgos par rlung nub tu rgyu ba na rdul shar phyogs su 'ong mi nus pa ltar 'gyur ba ste/ dgra phyogs su rdzas gtor ba dang mdud pa'i rten 'brel la sogs pa'i jag chings rnams las kyang tshan ni 'di che zhing / 'dir las rim gcig po des nad dang don nyams sogs res de'i nyer 'tshe mtha' dag 'ching nus la/jag chings gzhan la de med pa sogs shes par bya'o/ /mnan pa / sogs la'ang zab gnad de bzhin yod de zur tho'ang khyad 'phags yod/ rta mchog gi rgyud dang man ngag na bzhugs pa'i 240

mngaswā :pa///spros:spro( /bye/shā()// //// ////:pa/// /rdo//rdo pa// //smonalas tshogs gzhan yang 'dir sbyor zhes/ gzhan yang las tshogs rab 'byams rnams: sogs kyis bstan mod/ 'on kyang 'dir ni rang gzhung gi dzab dgongs dang bro chog sogs las phyogs mthong zin so che ba rnams kho na gzhir bzung ste/ rtsa ba'i khungs rnams la yang bltas nas rigs pa 'phrul tshul gyi sgo tsam bris shing /shangs lugs rigs mthun gyi gter kha yin pas de nas kyang legs par kha bkang ba'o/ /rdo rje snying bo rgyan gyi rgyud kyi rta mgrin sgrub thabs las de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyag gyar/ /rta mgrin zhes su 4 char rabye )rdo ri zurabashad pa yan/ /zhas pa nas/ pad+ma' dbang phyug rgyal pa 'ad/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug ste/ /rta yi mgrin pa stobs po che/ /stobs kyi sbyor bas bsgrub par bya/ /dbang phyug chen po la sogs lha/ /tshogs kyi bdag po gzhan dag dang / /mi dang gdug pa'i bsam pa can/ /sa rnams thams cad dgug par bya/ /zhes sasungs te/ dregs pa dang / ma rung pa dang / sa thams cad dbang byed la lhag par bsngags pa'o/ /glu gar tsam gyis dngos grub mang po byed pa ni ngo mtshar zhing bsam mi khyab pa ste/ klu'i rgyal po rnams dga' ba'i sems gzugs med las gzhan 'phrul 241

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tradabang byed man chad kyi lha dang mi'i gnas thams cad du sprin dang glog dang char dang 'brug sgra'i rol pa sna tshogs shing tshad med pa gzugs can 'byung ba bzhin te/ 'dir grub pa bzhi'ang dran par bya'o / /spu gri'i sngags sgrub kyi thad du/ thugs sgrub zhal gdams snying byang las/ dngos grub chen po sgrub pa dang / /gzhan don las la 'jug pa sogs/ /gang la'ang sri yis bar gcod na/ /rnam pa kun tu don nyams shing / /mi mthun kho na'i dbang du 'gro/ /zhes/ so/ /yang der/ 'gong po 'khrugs byed lo nyes gtong / /mi nad nor nad chag sgo ngan/ /ltas ngan dam nyams dbyen sbyor byed/ /bse rag byed dang dgu bo ni/ /zhes 'khrugs byed kyi 'gong bo spyang mgo ru dar can sogs dgu ste/ ma 'ongs bod khams mtha' dbus kun/ /'gong po spun dgus dbang byas te/ /dus 'khrugs/ nad yams lo nyes gtong / /kun kyang snying 'phyo yid mi dga'/ //sogs dang / ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /mtha' bzhi'i 'gong pos bod khams khengs/ /dbus kyi dam sri glo bur ldang / /bar chad rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i tshe/ /tshe dang nor dang shes rab sogs/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /rlung dmar dbus kyi mar me ltar/ /'gal rkyen du mas glo bur gsod/ /tshe 242

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6thang nor rgud shes rab 'grib/ /blo sna 'gyar zhing mi rung spyod/ /༷༷ r+sār char rtsa'irtsar la sna ༄shi rtsar 0gcas ta/ da ltar mtha' bzha' 'byung dang / /dbus kya dam sra glo bur bsdong / bod khams chu ltar 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /zhi ba'i thabs kyis mi 'dul bas/ /zhes mtha' dbus bsdong ba dang /de gdul dka' ba ra bshad/ de ltar mtha' dbus kyi 'byung bo bsdeb pa'i dbang gis/ mi rnams kyang mtha' dbus 'dres/chas spyod 'gyur/ grub mtha' 'chol/ bod khams sil bur 'thor/lha rgyud chad/ sngags rgyud nyams/ chos srid gang yang rang tshugs shor/ brtan pa bral te/ sdug bsngal gyi mtsho chen rdol bar bshad do/ /dpal 'dus su'ang / ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma'i tsheḥ mtha' yi rgya 'dre 'byung po dngaḥ /dbus kyi dam sri glo bur bsdongasaḥchos pa'i snying zhugs mi dge spyodaḥ skye bo'i snying zhugs sdig rgyud spelaḥ rmi lam btsun pa bya sprel rmiḥ bag mi phebs shing snying rlung ldangaḥ zhes dang / ma 'ongs bskal pa'i tha ma laḥ sngags la spyod cing dam tshig bralaḥ de dag 'gong po'i dbang gyur teḥbya ru mi rung sna dgu spyodaḥ de yi rgyu 'bras 'joms pa laḥ gnyen po 'di las gzhan du medaḥ ces bshad de/ de 'dra ba la stong nyid snying rje khros pa'i lha sngags 'di lta bu zhig dgos pa yin no/ /mthu chen gyi 'byung po gcig tsam btul ba la'ang dgos pa mang du 243

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tra'abyung ste/ dbang chen gyi mi dpon re re btul bas kyang yul khams chen po bde skyid chos gsum la sbyor nus pa bzhin no/rang brag phug tu yibs kyang gdul dka'i 'gro ba rgyun mi 'chad du 'dul ba'i thabs shig 'di na yod pas/ lhag bsam dang snying stobs kyi dpung ba brtan par byas te/ sngags kyi ral gri 'di phyungs rgyag chog pa bya'o/ /mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba ris med la snying rje chen po'i stobs bskyed de/ de rnams kyi phan bde'i ched du/ bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rgyal bstan srung ba dang /bstan don bya bar go bgo de'ang chos kyi dbyings ji srid pa 'i yul dus kun tu/ bstan pa mdo sngags kyi cha mtha' dag dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa'i mdzod ma lus pa dang /snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i zhing du byung ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi sde dang gang zag yod dgu/ srung ba'i rten skye ba thug med du/ rnam/ pa'i sgo thams cad nas srung zhing rgyas par byed nus pa'i mthu sgrub bo snyam du snying stobs bskyed na/ chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro zhing / /yid gtso yid ni mgyogs pa yin/ /zhes bsam pa'i khyad 'di dang po sa bon dang / bar du chu/ tha ma smin pa dang 'dra bas stobs gtan nas mi mtshungs pa nam mkha' dang yungs 'bru bzhin no/ /dmigs pa rgya che na sgrub pa rgya che/ de che na 'bras bu 244

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6trat+yā rgya che zhes pa dang / nyi tshe ba las nyi tshe dang / /mtha' dag pa las ma/tha' dag pa'i/ /'bras bu 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /zhes nga/ 'di rkyen ltos kyi rten 'brel smra ba'i rtsa ba'i grub mtha'o/ /ston nga/sa rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i dbus su phyag rdor la rdo rje gnang ste mthu sto bas kyi bdag por dbang skur dus kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam/sa kyis khyod la bstan pa srung ba dang / bstan pa'i don bya bar gnang ngo zhes bstan pa gtad pas/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i nus mthu sgrub lugs ma nor ba ni 'di ltar yin nges/ / gu ru zhi ba'i rgyu'i sa bon dang thugs srog la hūṃ du byed pa so/gas kyang yod mod/ hrīḥyig la mdzad pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags te/ hrīḥsher phyin pad+ma'i rigs kyi sa bon du bsngags pa thugs rje chen po'i zin tho ltar dang / sha 'ug gter byon gar dbang tshe sgrub kyi lo rgyus las/ rgya gar mkhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas nga: gdul bya'i mos ngor ji snyed sprul pa'i gar: chu zla'i rol par bsam mi khyab ston te: ngo bo mi 'gyur kun bzang sna nga mtha' yas: rgyal ba rgya mcho re khyab bdag spyi mes yin:nge phyir nga bsgrub sangs rgyas kun bsgrub 'gyur: lha gzhan bsgrub kyang nga nyid bsgrub pa ste: bzang ngan phyogs ris 'a di zhes dbye ba med: 'on kyang sngon gyi smon lam khyad par gyis: pad+ma'i 245

1sprorngad/ (lta lngardo sdispyirngan 'o/:jib/05 byaspucad ngasabastazug /):re ba/sdosaparngo 'o/sdo/zug/ 〈mirigs su bsgrub na dngos grub myur: phrin las mtha' rgyas gzhan snang dbang du sdud: 'gal rkyen mi 'byu nga byang chub go 'phang nye: zhes gsungs pas gu ru'i rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags su pad+ma'i rigs kyi rtsa ba'i yi ge nyid ches 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'di'i gtso bo 'od gsal rdo rjer gsangs pa ni/ ris/sa ༄re re'ang rigs drug ka'i bdag nyid dang / ye shes re re'ang ye shes drug ka'i ngo bo nyid yin pa/ phreng ba las rigs re re'ang lnga lnga'i rang bzhin du bshad pa lta bu ste/ de las 'dir pad+ma'i rigs la rigs drug tu phye ba'i rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /hrīḥyig gi bshad pa gzhan yang tshe sgrub ye shes 'od mchog las/ bzhi ba bsnyen pa srog gi bzlas pa ni: thugs kar hrīḥgasal trīḥyig mang du bzlas: de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi srog yin no: ha ni rlung yin longs sku kun gyi sngags: de nyid bzlas na rlung sems gnyis med grol: ra ni sprul sku smin byed de yin te: de bzlas drod kyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur: a ni skye med chos kyi sku yin te:i ni don dam ngo bo nyid dang ldan: rtogs shing bzlas pas bde stong mchog tu 'gyur: des na bde gshegs yongs 'dus sngags 'di bsnyen: hrīḥ zhes rlung sems thams cad gtum mo'i 246

mdzoji ཿpa//〉pa//ཿpa/ /bye/shā/byed/ //// ////:pa/// /rdo//4ཿཿ// //sgyu dbyings su zhugs pa las bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes 'char zhing /nge las rdo rje gsum mam sku gsum dbyer med pa'i go 'phang la /༷// /lnga// /bye/misbyor ba rdo rje lam gnad sa rmad du byung ba bstan no/ /'di'i dzab mjug bsdu ba'i dngos grub skul ba dang 'brel bar thrus/sa rje skul chog rgyas par spro na bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum ltar byed btub cing / mchod phreng rgyas spro byed na'ang de nas len no// //trīḥyig ni ha dang ra dang i gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kyi yi ge thig les brgyan pa ste/ ye shes thig le'i dka' 'grel las/'dab ma gnyis pa'i bzhi ba'o zhes bya ba ni yi ge ha'o/ /de'i 'og tu me'o zhes pa ni ra dang ldan pa'o/ /dbyangs yig ces pa ni yī'i bdag nyid dang sbyar ba'o/ /rigs pa'i rgyal mo mchog ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying bo yi ge trīḥ'o/ /thig le steng du ldan pa ni trī gyi don no/ /de rang dang nye ba ni trīḥste gnyis pa'o//zhes rig sngags kyi rgyal mo yi ge gcig ma'i sngags btu tshul kasungs pa ltar ro/ /de'ang g.yung drung 'khyil ba gsum gyi zhal kudams las/ hrīḥni thig le gsum du bzhugs/ /i ni rlung gi thig le ste/ /ha ni byang chub thig le'o/ /rak+ta'i yi ge ra yig ste/ /'e/sa pa ltar/ srog 'dzin shin tu phra ba'i rlung dang / khams 247

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyodakar dmar ro/ /tsheg drag gnyis kyis dhu tir byang sems dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod mtshon gsungs te/ mdor na khu rdul rlung gsum bde stong du ro gcig 'dres pa'o/ /tsheg drag thig le yin pas bde ba la bshad kyang rung ngam dpyad/ gzhan yang trīḥyis gis gzhi la khams dkar dmar gyi dbus su rlung sems zhugs nga/ dang / sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum/ rtsa thig rlung gsum sogs sbyang gzhi dang / rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor sogs sbyong byed kyi lam dang / sbyangs 'bras sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum sogs mtshon tshul mang du spros kyang chog ces thu'u bkwan pas so/ dper na myu gu'i cha shas thams cad rdzogs par skyed pa'i nus/ pa dang ldan pa'i chos zhig la myu gu'i sa bon zhes 'dogs pa ltar/rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang skyed pa'i nus pa thams cad trīḥyis la tshang bas sa bon gyi yi ger bzhag par 'chad do/ /'di'i las/ sngags skabs/ byer gtub sogs bod skad 'dres pas sngags su mi 'thad do zhe na/ dpal ldan lha mo'i sngags bh+yo bdun mar yang /kha la raka chen mo zhes yod pa sogs bshad nas/ mdor na sngags gsungs pa po dang sngags su byin gyi rlob pa pos skad sang dang gang du byin gyis brlabs pa de kho na dbang btsan par byed dgos kyi/ thams cad saṃ skyi ta'i skad kho na dang mthun dgonu/ 248

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6trapa'i nges pa med pas 'di 'dra la sgra bas dpyod mi nus shing dpyad pas skyon du song ba'ang mang ngo zhes kyang thu'u bkwan pas so//sgra bzang po smra ba rnams kyi zhen pa dgag pa dang / sgra ngan pa smra ba rnams la thugs brtse nas de dag gi skad byin gyis brlabs pa'ang yod dam snyam/ bod kyi 'byung bo rnams kyi skad phar la rang gshed du skor ched de dag gi skad du gnyen po 'i drag sngags byin gyis brlabs par bshad lugs kyang yod dam snyam ste/ lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi gter khar pu tra ming sring gi sngags zhang zhung gi skad du mdzad pa la rin bzang dgyes pa'i lo rgyus bzhin no// rnam snang mngon byang 'grel bar/ chos la 'bigs pa'i ye shes rta dang 'dra zhes gsungs pa ni sor rtog ye shes kyis shes bya'i gting la myur zhing mgyogs par sleb pa ste/ shes rab kyis ni brtags na phung po'i gting mi rnyed/ /ces pa ltar chos kyi gting ni stong ba nyid de/ chos kyi gting la phug pa ni stong nyid la zug pa'o/ /'jig rten kun rdzob thal mar phyung nas/ de phan chad kyi gting mthar thug la 'jug pa ni chos la 'bigs pa'o/ /de'ang sa bdun par mtshan med thob pas 'gog pa la 'jug pa'i shugs myur/ brgyad par de 'bad rtsol phal cher dang bral/ dgu bar stobs kyi phar phyin gyi mthus de bas kyang tshabs cher chos dbyings 249

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shekyi gting du 'gro/ bcu bar ye shes lhag ces shes rab de'i 'od zer gyi snang ba'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin chos dbyings dang mnyam pa mched/ rgyun mthar shin tu rnam dag gi dbyings la 'bigs pa'o/ /sems can gyi don bya ba la mgyogs pa/ zhes par yang / bdun par thabs kyi phar phyin gyi mthus 'gog pa'i dbyings nas skad cig kho nar sems can gyi don la ldang nus/brgyad par rnam par mi rtog pa la dbang ba dang smon lam gyi phar phyin lhag pas gzhan don la rtsol med du ldang / sa der de ltar ldang ba byang bas dgu bar brtags pa mtha' bzung gi zhi mtha' las 'das tshar ba'i sgo nas gzhan phan la dbang 'byor/ de'i dbang gis bcu bar sems can sgrol ba'i phrin las sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par 'thob/ lar sa dang po nas skad cig gcig la sems can brgya smin par byed kyang phal cher don yod tsam las mi 'jog la/ brgyad pa nas dbang bcu thob pas rnam kun don yod zer te skad cig rer sems can ci tsam 'dul ba'i myur khyad kyang stong gsum gyi rdul tshad la ma gzhal bar bstan mi nus pa de'o/ /'di dag hang 'gros tsam ste/ 'phags pa 'di bar chad med lam gyi rang bzhin du gsungs pa dang / dkyil 'khor nang ma 'a/ 'god pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs bsgrigs nas dpyad rgyu yod/ mdor 250

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6na blo kun rdzob pa'i spyod yul nas phar don dam pa'i dbyings su mngon sum du sleb myar ba dang dbyings de nas tshur kun rdzob kyi dmi mi//bye/ //shegaspyod yul sleb myur ba shes rab dang thabs — rtogs pa ring du song tshul gnyis te/ phyi ma 'di ni/ mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyir/ /rtogs pa bul ba yin par 'dod/ /ces pa'i bzlog zla ste/ 'jam pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i rnal 'byor snying rje'i khyad par ro/ /snga ma yang stong nyid rtogs pa spyi ldog ma byas par sor rtog ye shes la sbyar na pad+ma'i rigs kyi sgos chos su 'grigade ltar na spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan la 'chad tshul gnyis yod pa ltar/ rig pa'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi mtshan gyi don yang gnyis yod do// //rta skad skabs/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ zhes mang du 'byung ba ni/ dbang du bsdus nas gdul bar bya ba rnams sdud pa dang / de ltar mi thul ba rnams spa bkong (rgyal po'i mthu dpung gi zil bstan nas pha rol kyi rgol ba spa gong bar byed pa lta bu'i zil gnon ni dbang sdud kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin no) bar byed pa'i khyad dam snyam/ yang na phyi ma/ dbang du bsdus pa de las slar 'phar ldang mi nus par byed pa'o/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dru gu 'dzings pa dang / thag 'khrugs pa lta bu rnams 251

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trakyang / rta skad kyis bde ba'i bdud rtsi dang / lha sngags kyi dpas bsam dga' ba'i tshal du sgyur ba ni/ rma bya dug gi ldum rwar phyin pa'am dug sbrul me tog gi phreng bar sgyur ba'i man ngag ltar ya mtshan che'o/ /de ltar bsgyur nas kyang de dag las dngos grub len pa la slob tshul bcas/ 'di dag mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog tu yang yod de/ shin tu ches cher bya'o/ /de'ang rtsing bar rtog pa dang / bar chad kyi ngo bo rab dbye bya byed las gsum skye 'gas gnas gsum sogs ngo bo dang ldog cha'i sgo thams cad nas dag nga/ rab 'byams su rgya cher dpyad de blo rgyas par byas na de snyed kyi lag rjes 'byung ngo / /gal che bas yang zlos byas so/ /yang bar chad de dag gi de kho na nyid la/ thog med nas grub pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rta skad kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi snang bas khyab pa'i tshul la blo bzhag ste bsgom pas/ thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam 'phrul du 'char la/ de'i tshe rang gi rta glus de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo de rnams bskul bas/bar chad byed du 'ong ba'i dngos po de dag gi sgo nas kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang dang dngos grub stsol te/ ci 'di ngo mtshar mi che'am/ brtan g.yo'i dug dang / rims dang / dmod pa dang /mi bzad pa'i las kyi mthu thams cad zil gyis gnon pa dang /252

dbang chen rta skad/ pod/ 6dgra 'dre gcan gzan rngon pa sogs rmongs rengs byed pa/ rang gi nor dang 'khor sogs zil gyis mnan nas gzhan du mi g.yo bar byed pa/ nad pa'i nad skyugs par byed pa/ lcags sgrogs dang btson ra rdzas (sel dang / gtad dang / pha rol gyi gdug pa'i sems dang / lta ba ngan pa dang / mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul sogs) sngags phyag rgya 'phrul 'khor gyi sbyor ba la sogs pa'i rgya bshigs pa/ gzhan gyi sngon gnas kyi dge ba'i bag chags skul zhing sad du gzhug pa dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i chos mdzod dang / gnod sbyin dbang po'i nor g.yang sogs 'bod pa/ gdul bya mchog la rnam g.yeng dang rmongs pa'i g.yogs pa dral nas nang gi he ru ka skul zhing sad par byas te byin rlabs 'bebs pa dam pa'i chos spyi dang bye brag pa'i rang sgras yangs pa'i sa chen po 'gengs pa sogs las tshogs byed tshul zad mi shes te/ dper brjod tsam mo/ /gzir ba'i bsam pas gzir bar 'gro lugs shes nas rta skad kyis gcun na/ ri rab gzir yang ral/ rgya mtsho gzir yang 'phyar thub/ brgya byin gzir //re/ ri ri /sdu/dena'ang skra ga gos nyil nas lhung yong sa/ gong smos las yang na khams gsum gyi srog 'dren pa dbang sdud dang / srog de gzir ba zil gnon du bya'o// //'di dag rje nyid nas zin tho lta bur btab yod pa rnams gzhan du 'khyar gyis 253

pod/ 6gyi/ /rdo rje rta skad kyi zin bris dngos grub gsum gyi rdzogs ldan 'dzin ma dbang byed lha'i 'khor lo la nye bar mkho ba'i dpyad rten dran tho bzhugs/tha ram las gsungs pa'i theg rim dang sbyar ba dang / sa lam dang sbyar ba gnyis kyis rim bzhin gar dang glu'i de nyid du sbyar na'ang rung ngam dpyod//'gros dgu'i theg rim dang sbyar ba sogs rta skad kyi bshad par gsung ba ni/ bka' gdams dpe 'grel las/ a pha'i skad du/zhes pa ltar rta skad byas pas rtar mtshon la/ rta'i mtshon don la de rnams yod pa'i don te/ de dang 'dra bar rta zhal gyis kyang rtar mtshon te/ thags rje chen po'i dab la a mi tā bha dang de'i zhal rigazi risir+shagadam nga can du byed pa bzhin no/ /'gros dgu theg dgu dang sbyar bas ni lam 'og ma thams cad kyi byed las rta mchog gi lam mam lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i chags lam nyid la tshang zhing / de'i byed las mtha' dag par ma tshang bar bstan/ sa lam skad 'gyur dang sbyar bas ni thabs shes phul du byung ba'i lam 'dis sa bcu lam lnga bde myur du bgrod tshul ston par rta rgyud dang tha ram las so /255

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/r+sha'agros dgu'i dang po ni/ sgrog gsum lag tu tshud pa'i 'gros/gnyis pa lag gnyis lcags sgrog gis bsdam pa'i 'gros/ gsum pa 'ching byed med par rang nyid dal bus 'gro ba/ bzhi ba rta mabo 'phang bsgrim nas cung zad mgyogs par 'gro ba/ lnga ba gom pa'i 'gros su mgyogs par 'gro ba/ drug pa 'dur 'gros/ bdun pa lding stabs kyis 'gro ba/ brgyad pa shin tu mgyogs par rgyug chung byas te 'gro ba/ dgu ba rgyug rtsal ci yod phyungs te thag thogs med par 'gro ba rnams dang / skad kyi yon tan gsum pa rgyang ring du thos pa/ bzhi ba sgra gzhan dang nag nog med par sang nger thos pa//lnga ba dbugs sna ring ba/ bdun pa gdangs che chung sogs cha snyoms par 'brel ba/ brgyad pa skad gtong theb gcig po der sgra bar ma chad par sgrogs pa/ bcu ba skad che chung ji ltar 'byin 'dod pa bzhin bde blag tu 'byin ba'i rtsal yod pa/ bcu gcis pa sgra gdangs che ba zhes bla mas gsungs/ gzhan sla/ skad kyi chos mthun lnga ba thugs rje ngang ring ba ste skyo dub med pa/ bdun pa thugs rje rgyun chags pa/brgyad pa thugs rje'i mdzad pa rgyun chags pa yang skad bcu gsum skabs/ thun mong ltar na/ ye shes thig ler/'di kun dga' ba'i bye brag ste//zhes pa ltar don gyi lhan 256

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6skyes nyid la sa bcur phye ba ste/ 'tsher skad rjes chags kyi bde ba'i glur gsungs pa dang 'grigs/ thun mong ltar na/ phal bo cher/ byang sems kyis rnam par dgod pa thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas gzhal med khang lta bu/ zhes dang / sems bskyed la sa mtshams dang grogs kyis dbye ba nyer gnyis phye ba'i rigs pa ltar dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po gong 'phel gyi cha bcu gsum dang sbyar ba ste/ sbyor tshul tsam las khyab mtha' mi dgos te/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir//sogs lta bu ste/ sems can smin byed chos mchog man chad du'ang yod kyang chos mchog las ma sbyar ba bzhin no//dbyings shes rab stong pa don dam bzhi rang bzhin ngo bo don gyi rta skad dang / ye shes thabs snang ba kun rdzob bzhi rig pa ngo bo don gyi rta skad du bshad pas mdor na thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs shes gnyis la rta zhal du bshad de/ bskyed rim pa'i thabs shes nas/ mi slob zung 'jug dang / de'i ya gnyis kyi bar dngos dang rjes mthun ci rigs su sbyar ro/ /de rnams rta zhal du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ chags pa che ba(nges par 'byung ba phyi ma'i rgyud las kyang / dag pa'i 'dod chags kyi sgos sgrub la pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa 'jog par le'u bdun pa'i thad du gsungs)skad ring / shugs che ba sogs dang / rta dbu'i kha dog gi de nyid/ phrin las bzhis 'gro ba sgrol tshul so so dang sbyar ba dang 257

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bka' sgo las gsungs pa'i dbye ba rnams gsang sngags la shan dbye ba'i skabs su sbyor/ gsang sngags la shan dbye ba zhes pa ni 'di'i zab lam theg pa dang rgyud sde 'og ma'i skor rnams las 'phags pa'i che ba ston pa ste/ bla med kyi lha gzhan las kyang myur ba yang bshad rung ngam dpyad/ yang snying 'dus par/ rta dbus gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par mtshon zhes gsungs pa'ang de ka'o// zhal gsum gyis kyang zung 'jug mtshon pa sgyu 'phrul ltar yin mod/ skabs 'dir rta mgos mtshan pa'i g.yas zhal gyis sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor mtshon/ zhes sogs su sbyar nas/rta mgos mtshan par bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan/ khro zhal gsam gyi nges don nam de kho na nyid ༄gsum po rjes chags kyi rigs las skyes par mtshon pa'i ched yin no//dpal gyi rta skad skabs/ snying rje'i 'tsher skad kyi sngags sgra dang po bsgrags pas snang srid thams cad pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du sprul par gsungs pa 'di rta skad kyis dbang sgyur lugs khyad par can te/ gsang rdzogs rang shar gnyis las 'di kho na rta skad thengs gsum du bshad tshul 'byung ngo / /('dir snang srid thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i dmigs gnad la snang srid thams cad rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du sad par bsam tshul 'di ni/ rnal 'byor bla med spyir/ gang du bde chen zhes bya 258

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6sa/cig pu nyid/ ces pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yul snang zil gyis gnon lugs dang shin tu mthun no/ /)'di ni gang snang bde stong gi rnam rol dang / de'ang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du lta ba ste/ 'di dang ldan na bsod nams chung ba'i mis kyang tshe 'di nyid la mchog 'grub par brtags gnyis las so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ bde 'dus dbang chen rtsa rgyud las/sems can khams kun thams cad la: nga yi sku ni re re gnas:gol te 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur bas: ma mthong ma rtogs las kyis nongs: zhes gsungs pa ltar lus can thams cad kyi snying dbas ༄na gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i rta mgrin re yod de/de ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis rang gi gnas lugs stong ba nyid las gol te gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i phyogs su yengs nas rtsal bden 'dzin du shar te 'khor ba'i 'khor lo skor ba de sangs rgyas kyi gsung rdo rje'i rkyen las rang gi de kho na nyid lta ba'i dran pa rnyed cing shes rab kyi mig gnyug ma rang gi steng nas sad de/ kha phyir phyogs pa'i kun rtog gi g.yeng ba rten las rlung dang bcas pa rang sar sdud pa dang / de las stong phyogs bde stong ye shes kyi rta mchog dang /snang phyogs bde chen sgyu ma'i rta mchog je sad je dag la 'gro ba yang rta skad kyis sems can thams cad dpal he ru ka'i 'khor lor sprul par byed pa'i gnad do/ /tshul 'di legs par bsgom na 259

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phamilha sngags kyi nus pa cher song ste rta mchog dngos dang mjal ba na rta zhal bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs thos pa tsam gyis snying dbus mi shigs pa'i nor bu yid bzhin gyi nang nas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang spyod pa rgya mtsho'i dngos grub kha phye bar 'gyur ro//bka' sgo'i rta skad lta bar dgongs pa'i skabs/ dang pos gdul bya thun mong gi lam gyis snod rung du byed/ gnyis pas dbang dang dam tshig la 'god/ gsum pas spyi sbas mthar thug si mngon rtogs la 'god ces bshad na lam rim 'gangs che ba 'dra ste dpyad /rta skad don bsdu'i thad/ ngo bo don skad ni lta bar dgongs/ pa'i rta skad dngos yin te/ snang phyogs/ stong phyogs/ zung 'jug si rta skad gsum mo/ /gsang sngags gnad skad ni/ de dag rta skad du 'jog pa'i 'thad pa brda don gnyis chos mthun sbyor tshul gyi sbo nas bshad pa'o/ /spyod par dgongs pa'i skabs su/ dpal gyi rta skad ni he ru ka'i rta skad nyid ngos bzung ba/ gzhan gnyis sla//dpal chen che skad ni/ de'i che ba bstan pa ste dbang gi phrin las khyad par du mdzad tshul gyi sgo nas rta skad mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan bshad pa'o/ /de'ang mthun rdzas bsags nas yun ring du bsgrub kyang 'dul mi btub pa'i sde brgyad che dregs kyis 'gying ba 260

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6trarnams rta bsnyen thems nas ting nge 'dzin gyi 'tsher skad phyungs pa tsam/ gyis de'i mod la rang dbang med par rkang ba'i drung du bkug 'ong ba ni rta skad dbang che zhing mthu myur ba'i che ba yin te/bsnyen bkur rgya chen dang bcas te 'dod don la gsol ba ring du btab kyang grogs byed pa lta ci/ snyan g.yar ba tsam yang dka' ba'i stobs ldan gyi sde dpon chen po rnams la mi'i bdag po'i bka' yig rtags ldan khyer te 'ong na 'khyer mkhan gdol ba tha shal cig yin yang mthong ba'i mod la dregs pa'i ral ba bsnyil nas spyi bos nod par byed pa de rgyal bo chen po'i dbang phyug gi mthun yin pa bzhin no//rta skad kyi bshad pa'i skabs du mar bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sa/sum zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyud kyi gzhung zur du bris pa ltar spyi sbas mthar thug gi lam gsum la bshad na/ man ngag lta phreng dang bde 'dus bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi gdams pa la 'grigs shing /mdo sngags smon lam las de ltar gsungs pa de/ phreng po ba'i rnam thar du rin chen phun tshogs kyi gsung / kho bo'i rdo rje slob dpon mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che de'i mkhyen rab la mtha' med/de'i bka' las/rnying ma lugs mthun zhig byed na gsang sngags snga 'gyur rang gi bstan pa'i babs la bka' gter zung gcig gces/261

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/jizher+shabaka' ma ni mdo sgyu sems gsum la bka' babs chu bo bzhi'i sgo nas bshad rgyun rnam par dag pa 'dug pa bzhin bshad pa las len dang bcas pa bka' ma ltar byed dgos/ chos kyi zab gnad rnams ni brgyud pa dang chos la sel med cing mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs chi le ba de gter ma yin pas gter chos tshad ldan ltar dgos/ de ltar byas na rnying ma tshul mthun cig yod gsung / zhes/ sogs 'byung ba ltar paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po sogs rig 'dzin gong ma'i man ngag mnga' ba'i bshad srol yin pas ches bzang bar mthong ngo /gsang rdzogs dang rang shar gyi rta skad rnam bshad las/ rang sems dri ma med pa dang //rang rig ces gsungs pa ni 'od gsa'/ mi shigs pa'i sems yin te/ gsang rdzogs lus gnad rtsa'i ma na ngag las/ dhū ti 'chad pa na/ rtsa yi gtso mchog he ru ka zhes kyang bya ste rang sems rnam dag gsal ba'i man ngag go: zhes rang sems rnam dag de rtsa dbu ma'i gnad la brten nas gsal dgos par bshad pa dang / 'gyu byed rlung gi gdams pa las/ yang rngub yang bskyil yang 'phang bar bya ste gnas pa'i rlung la bskyil yun bsring ba ni dhū tir tshud pa'i gnad do:de ltar zhag nyer gcig tshun chad 'bad pas rlung zin rtags ni rlung 'gyu ba mi tshor: gar spyin la 262

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6sbrang bu 'byar ba ltar g.yo 'gul mi nus pa 'byung: de'i tshe bla mas ngo sprad pa'i chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid rig pa byang chub kyi sems rtogs te: nyon mongs rnam rtog thams cad rang sangs nas rang byung ye shes mtha' rgyas par 'gyur ro: zhes srog dhū tir tshud pa las rig pa ngo 'phrod par gsungs pa dang / 'bar 'dzag gtum mo'i gdams par 'khor lo bzhi'i lte bar thig le'i rang bzhin gyi ye ge bsgoms nas sems 'ching bar bshad pa'i skabs su/rang rig sprin med bar snang bzhin: dwangs la gsal ba rang sar zhog: me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar: sa le hrig ge 'dzin med du bzhag go: de kho na ngo sprad pa ni: de ltar srog 'dzin byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin: bde stong 'dzin med du snying dbus su sad pas: 'khor 'das thams cad ye shes kyi rtsal du shes: lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngos zin: zhes gsungs shing /srog 'dzin byang chub sems kyi ngos 'dzin yang de nyid las/ srog 'dzin byang chab sems ni: snying dbas khrag gi dwangs ma bye'u lco raring niring ka'i sgo nga tsam gyi nang na: 'od kyi ga'u sran ma tsam pa'i dbus na:dran rig shes pa gnas so: zhes so/ /de 'dra ba'i rang sems dri med de nyid bde ba'i chags nyams dang ldan pa dang / de'i steng nas lam bsgrub na sgrub gzhi rlabs che ba'i dbang gis sa lam ches 263

21jid/ (( lngardo sdispyings khur:drob/thag bya)rngasno ngasabaltazug rta):re ba/sdosarngaba'o/sdo/zug/ po〉bde myar du bgrod pas na rta'i zhal lo/ /'tsher skad ni 'bod cing ༄skul bar byed pa'i chags skad de/ gang snang brtan g.yo thams cad lhan skyes ye shes kyi mdangs su kha dog bsgyur te/ ma rig pa'i gnyid kyis non pa'i 'khrul snang 'di dag lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyag gcig tu sad par byed cing / de'i tshul gyis snang grag rtog gsum bde chen bsam mi khyab kyi thig ler bsdus nas 'od gsal dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ltad mo gnyis la rtse gcig tu byed pa'o/ /yul snang gang shar gyi steng du bde ba'i rtsal 'bar ba'am rgyas pa la bde chen bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs su 'jog pa ni/mtshan brjod las/ gad rgyangs ha ha nges par sgrogs/ /sogs dang yang phyogs mthun no//sems can gyi dus na shes pa yul la g.yo ba'am yul bgrod par byed pa la rlung zhes zer la/ de'i rtsa ba mthar gtug na 'od gsal gyi bzhon pa'am 'od gsal spro('gro)bsdu('ong)byed mkhan gyi rlung mi shigs pa la thug go /'bras dus su de 'dra'i g.yo ba de gtan nas med kyang / de'i dod du ye shes rang gi steng na brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten mtha' dag la khyab par zhugs nas de thams cad bde ba'i ro nyams su 'char bar byed pa'i rtsal shugs mthar phyin pa yod pas/ de nyid la sngon gyi rjes su 'brangs pa ste/ rgyu dus 264

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6kyi shan gyis ye shes kyi rlung zhes tha snyad byed pa tsam mo sems can gyi ngag dag pa ni gsung rdo rje yin cing / ngag gi rtsa ba rlung yin pas/ de'i shan gyis gsung rdo rje'i 'char gzhi'ang ye shes kyi rlung de'o//'di la sgyu dra'i le'u bzhi ba la sogs par shes dang shes bya mtshams sbyor ba'am brda sprod par byed pa la gsung zhes bshad pa sogs la brten nas zhib tu bsam mo/ /da lta nas sangs rgyas pa'i ye shes kyi rtsal lam mtha'i khyad par de lta ba de lag rjes su rigab rigashā'ajog byed kyi rgyu mthun sgrub tshul ni/ brtan g.yo thams cad 'od gsal gyi rnam 'phrul gyi lha sngags rab 'byams su dbang bsgyur bar byed pa'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid yin cing / 'di'i sgo nas yang dang yang du 'od gsal mngon du byas te/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pus nyams ni du mas gar mdzad do/ /zhes pa'i bag chags 'od gsal la yang yang bzhag ste stobs su gyur pa na/ mi shigs pa'i rlung sems rang gi steng nas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gnas lus longs spyod 'byams klas pa smin cing spro ba'i nus pa'ang thob 'ong bas/ gsang rdzogs sogs su ye shes kyis yul la longs spyod tshul khyad par ba'i steng nas pad+ma gsung dbang chen gyi rta skad la bshad pa mdzad do/ /de ltar byas na gsung rdo rje mi shigs nā da'i dbyangs zhes pa lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i gdangs nyid 265

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la 'jog pas/ rjes chags kyi 'tsher skad du ches 'thad do//mtha' bral stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad kyi gting mthar thug yin te/ sdud par/ shes rab kyis ni brtags na phung po'i gting mi rnyed/ ces dang / mthar thug bden pa/ zhes dang / don dam bden pa ni kun rdzob kyi gnad gsang de phan chad du 'byed rgyu med pa yin pas de rtogs pa la shin tu rnam par phye ba'i blo zhes bshad par sa bcu pa'i dbyig 'grel las gsungs pa rigs pa mtshungs so/ /de lta bu'i gnas lugs kyi gting phigs pa'i rnal 'byor bla med pa'i bde chen gyi rta skad ni rdo rje rta skad ces bya ste/srid zhi'i chos gang la yang thal byung thogs med du 'jug pa'i phyir dang / shin tu tshabs cher 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na dngos po thams cad kyi rang dbang gi rgya gtan nas bshigs te/ gnad sroka nas bzung ste 'dren par byed la pha lam gyi kyo bas lcags 'bigs pa la rtsa'am shing gi go chas srung mi nus pa ltar/ de la bar chad kyi rnam pa gang gis kyang bgegs byar med pa yin no/ /bde stong si rnal 'byor gyis yul snang zil gyis gnon pa'i nus pa klong du gyur pa na/ dbang gi rgyal srid thob pa yin pas than mong gi dngos grub ༄dam par bsngags shing / rta skad kyi dgongs pa de dang mi mthun pa'i yid byed mnyam rjes thams cad du bkag ste/ lhan skyes kyi 266

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6bde ba'i steng nas de kho na nyid la sems brtan par byed pa ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi rtsa ba dam pa yin pas/ rta skad kyi rnal 'byor dngos grub rgya mtsho'i srog tu gzung ste/ bde 'dus ma tshang kha skong ba'i rgyud kyi le'u dgu ba dbang chen sgrub pa'i kha skong gi le'ur/ rtogs pa'i ri bo sems nyid du: snang ba thams cad dbyer med na: thun mong dngos grub dam pa yin:dbang gi dkyil 'khor rang la snang: rig pa'i rgyal po rang dbang thob: rang rig bde bar gnas pa ni/ dbang gi sgrub pa'i mthar thug ste:mchog gi dngos grub rtsa ba yin:zhes so//snang ba dbang du gyur na snang srid tshur 'du ba'i tshul khyim ga/sum zin thor sde brgyad dbang sdud la sbyar ba de gzhan rnams la'ang 'dra bas/rang snang dbang du 'dus na gzhan snang zil gyis non ces rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung sgros las 'byung / des na bka' brgyad bsdus 'bring gnyis las gzung 'dzin dbang byed kyi gnad 'di dbang gi rta skad kyi dgongs par gsungs te/ shin tu gces par snang ngo //rje grub thob chen po'i pad+ma sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i gzhung 'dir rta skad bshad tshul ni/ rta skad kyi dbye ba/ de nyid/ mdzad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bro chog las rigs drug gi rta skad so sor 267

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsungs pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ spyi dang / bye brag gi de nyid gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil chog las/ ye shes gzi 'bar rngams shing bzhad pa'i sgras: 'khor 'das thams cad dbang sgyur zil gyis gnon: zhes gsungs pa de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bde chen gyi ye shes la ldog chas phye ba'i ye shes drug rta skad so so dang sbyar nas bro chog tu gsungs pa rnams so/ /gsum pa la/ spyi'am gtso bo'i mdzad pa ni dkyil chog gi gzhung des/ bzhad sgra'i gzi byin gyis 'khor 'das thams cad zil gyis gnon par bstan no/ /so so'i mdzad pa ni/ rigs so so'i rta skad zhi sogs las so so dang sbyar nas bro chog tu gsungs pa rnams so / /de ltar rta glu de nyid rigs kyi dbye bas sgyur lugs re byas pas rnam bzhi'i phrin las rab 'byams byed par gsungs pa ni/rta glu'i de nyid rjes chags kyi bde ba gcig pu de nyid sgyur lugs re byas pas las tshogs rab 'byams byed cing de'ang thun mong bi dngos grub kha cig ni de med par gtan mi 'grub pa'ang yod la /las phran tshegs rnams kyang / de yod na dus thung ngu dang / tshegs chung ngus/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par/ 'gal rkyen gang gis kyang bzlog tu med pa'i tshul gyis 'grub par byed pa'i mthu phul du byung ba yod pa la dgongs nas/ bde stong gi ye shes la las sngags 268

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6su rgyud las gsungs pa dang sbyar nas nges pa drang ngo / /dngos grub bsgrubs kyang ma grub na spogs chog bya ba'i skabs su spyod rgyud las/stong nyid sgom pa spogs chog gi mchog tu gsungs pa dang / stong nyid sgom byed kyi yul can la lhan skyes kyi bde ba bsngags pas/ de dang yang snga ma sbyar na dga' ba ster te 'di gzhan nas blangs so//rta skad kyi gsal byed dran tho mkhas pa'i yid 'phrogs 'di la zhar byung gces pa 'di lta bu yod de/ 'jig rten dbang po'i mtshan brgya la/ mchog chen rdo rje'i glu la bstod pa/ zhes gsungs pa dang /kye rdor brtags pa phyi ma'i lnga bar/ klu gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis blang / zhes gsungs la/ khyad par 'tsher skad ni rjes chags kyi glu dbyangs yin pas 'dod chags rdo rje'i rigs so/ /'dus kye sogs las/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi phyag rgya gar mkhan gyi bu mo zhes bshad pa dang / 'od dpag med la gar dbang zhes rgyud mang por grags/ rta rgyud rnams su bro kho na rnam grangs du mas yang yang bshad yod pa'ang 'di ltar yin/ gsang rdzogs las/ glu bro gar la/zhes dang / sgyu dra las/ bro gar 'du 'phro'i yo byad/ ces pas bro gar 'dra'o/ /de ltar na pad+ma'i rigs rnams kyi rigs chos kyi las(sgo gsum gyi bya ba mtha' dag glu gar gyi ting nge 'dzin kho na'i steng nas skyong ba ni/ bde mchog pa'i g.yon pa'i kun spyod ltar 'di'i sngags pa'i bslab pa'i kun spyod bla na med 269

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par snang bas pha'i rigs kyi las la bu nges par spyod pa bzhin du yi dam bya'o)ni glu bro'o/ /des na de gnyis kyi sgo nas dngos grub sgrub pa 'di rta rgyud las mang du gsungs la/ gzhung 'dir yang rta bro rigs drug dang / de dag gi sgos mdzad drug spyi'i che brjod dang bcas pa gsungs so /grol thig rta mgrin dregs 'dul las/ 'khor 'das dbang du sdud pa'i gdeng ni0dbang chen rta mgrin gyi ye shes kyi rol ba chen copo gcig las nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i ngang las gang la yang nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba med par gdon bgegs kyi steng du thos brdzis bya'o:de lta bu'i dgongs pa dang ldan tsa na lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: dregs pa can rnams las la bkol nas bran bzhin du las byed do: gal te bran du mi khol ba'am las byed du ma 'dod na: oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥsogs/ zhes rtsa sngags la btag nas bro brdung bas bar chad gdon bgegs rdul du brlarga par the tshom med do: zhes snang srid thams cad bde chen gyi rol bar lta ba'i sgo nas mi phod pa'i yul du thog brdzis gtong bar bshad de/ 'di ni brtags gnyis las spyod pa'i skabs su/ nges par sngon du lha min gang / /brgya byin lta bu yin na yang / /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /seng ge'i gzugs kyis rnam par rgyu/ /zhes 270

/ sbyiji //// ////:pa// /lnga ///sdu //dro/lhas// /rdordo/2ཿཿ// //sgyu gsungs pa lta bu ste gal che'o//de dang 'dra bar rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las kyang / thag phrad kyi dngos po gang la yang mi bzar zhing the rigazu shā/jordo//re/ skur mi//de/tshom med par smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis ༄ nga rdeg pa sgyu gdug pa dang dregs pa can mtha' dag thogs med du 'dul ba la nges par bsten par bya ba'i brtul zhugs su gsungs te/ bar chad kyi rkyen gang dang phrad kyang de ma thag sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rdzi zhing 'gro ba dang / de'ang yang dang yang du rdeg pa'am rdzi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis brtul zhugs byed pa nyid do/ /de dag kun kyang rta bro'i dgongs spyod nyid 'chad par snang ngo / /dang po nas mos sgom tshun chad kyis goms par byas na mthar yul rkyen bzang ngan thams cad zil gyis gnon nus so/ /dus ngan gdon bgegs/ sngon las/ dus kegs sogs gang la'ang bdag gnyis kyi srog dang ldan par mthong ba'i log shes ci tsam shugs che ba de tsam du de'i rang mdangs yul la shar nas bar chad gang yang srog dang ldan pa dang / de'ang rdo rje ltar brling ba'i srog dang ldan pa bzhin du mthu che zhing gzhom dka' bar 'gyur la/ de lta bu'i 'dzin pa phyin ci log gi 'khrul 'khor zhig nas/ bar chad de dag thams cad rang sems kyi gshis la gtan nas ma zhugs pa'i log rtog glo bur ba kho na'i rtsa ba can gyi rgyu rkyen dang cha shas mang po la 271

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brten nas ming dang rtog pa 'ba' zhig gis bzo sbyar ba'i gsorga nyag gcig tu mthong nas goms par byas na/ de thams cad kyang ri mo'i mdung ltar mthu med pa dang / lbu ba ltar nyam chung ba sha stag tu 'gro bas gzhung 'di'i gtor zlog las/ dgra gsum/bdud bzhi/ chag che nyam nga thams cad bde stong gi rtogs pas pham par bya bar gsungs pas rta bro'i dgongs pa bshad ma thag pa'i ngang nas thog brdzis gtong ba ni rig sngags 'chang gi lag cha bla na med pa'o/ /der ma zad sngags kyi skabs 'dir rkyen snang de dka thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su bltas nas slob rgyu yod pas/de'i lag rjes la 'bras bu'i dus su rnam dag gi lha sngags phyag rgya'i 'khor lo rab 'byams shig 'byung zhing / lam dus su'ang bgegs yi dam gyi lhar bltas nas dngos grub len par gter gzhung(byang gter gegs sel nor mdzod dang / grol thig thugs rje chen po sogs te/skyabs rje'i bsam lhun zin bris sogs mang po mang por snang)tshad ldan nas bshad pa lta bu du ma zhig yod do/ /yul gyi steng gi ma dag pa'i dus phrogs nas dag pa dngos grub kyi sgor byin gyis rlob pa 'di ni rta skad kyis snang ba zil gyis gnon tshul yang yin no/ /bsam rgyud 'di ni rnal 'byor bla med pa'i lam gyi gces nor cig ste/ rdo rje phreng bar/ rnal 'byor dbang po gang gang 'dod/ /de de thogs pa 272

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6med par bya/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs so/ /de ltar glu gar gnyis kyi de nyid gcig yin kyang / rkang stabs dang sngags tshig gi sgo so sor shar nas rim bzhin sku'i mdzad pa dang gsung gi mdzad pa'i sgos dngos grub kyi re ba rdzogs par mdzad pa'o/ /bro phyag rgyar 'jog na'ang rung ste/ (bro gar gnyis kyi khyad par ni/rkang pa'i bro dang / lag pa'i gar zhes pa ste/ bros ri brag dang / sa 'og gi 'phrul 'khor sogs la thogs pa med par 'dzul lam gar gyis nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur zhes sgyu 'phrul ba rnams gsung ngo / /'di ni rgyu 'phrul las bshad tshul yin gyi rnam pa kun tu 'khyer mi btub snyam/)sgyu 'phrul las/ rkang gnyis chos dang las kyi sems dpar gsungs nas/ yan lag thams cad dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs nas phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u/ zhes gsungs pa sogs kyis rkang ba bsgul bskyod phyag rgyar bya ba bstan cing gsang zhabs kyi lam rim las kyang gsal lo/ /'jig rten na skyid pa'i rkang bro zer ba ltar lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i nyams 'bar ba'i spyod par bro gar byed pa dang spyod pa des kyang nyams de spor bar byed pas de gnyis phan tshun grogs su 'jug pa ste/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i skabs kyi gar dang yang tshul 'dra'o/ /rje dang mchog gling thun mong gi gter kha gar chog rin chen rol ba sogs 'ga' re 273

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/na gsal lo/ /bde chen gcig pu de nyid/ zhi zhing dang ba dang /dga' zhing spro ba dang / chags shing zhen pa dang / khro zhing rnam pa ste las kyi stong sems tha dad du nyams bsgyur ba'i bsam pa'i khyad par bzhin du bro gar gyi spyod pa yang rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du mdzad nas gzhung 'dir gsungs shing / dngos grub kyang so sor gsungs so/ /bro 'dis snang ba dbang du byed par ma zad dbang du byas pa de las mi 'da' ba'am mi ldang bar zil gyis gnon cing rengs par yang byed do/ /phyag rgyas btab pa'i don du 'gro ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ glu bro'i de nyid kyi khyad par/ glu ni yul snang thams cad bde nyams su myos par byed pa'i bde ba de yin cing / bro ni bde ba de nyid yul gyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su shar ba'i cha ste/ 'di/ gar mkhan dag dang ri mo bzang ltar snang //gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pus nyams ni du mas gar mdzad do/ /zhes par yang mthun/ de'i tshe blo ngor snang ba thams cad bde ba'i gar du byed pas bros brdzi bya zur du mi 'char mod/ gnas tshod la/ de 'dra'i rnal 'byor gyi bro 'dul byed dang / yul gyi phra men ma 'dul rgyu/ yul gyis rgyud phung bar byed pa'i gdug rtsub bro'i de nyid kyis bcom nas dngos grub kyi grogs su 'khol bar byed pa 'dul lugs su song yod do/ /'di ni rnal 274

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6'byor bla med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i rol rtsed sbyong tshul rmad du byung ba'o/ /'di klong du gyur pa na lha dbang dang / mi'i rgyal srid kyi gnas dang / mkha' spyod dang / sa 'og bde ba can sogs gang du bgrod par 'dod kyang / de dang der dgongs pa gtad de bro gar byas pas thogs med du mnan 'gro ste/ mnan zhes pa ni sa nas sa mnan zhes pa ltar der slebs pa'i don to/ /sgyu 'phrul las/bro gar tshogs kyi sprin phung la/ /hūṃ du shes pas rab spyad na/ /zhes dang /bro gar 'du 'phro'i phyag rgya yis//'dzul lam nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes bro gar la nges don gyi sngags kyis rgyas btab nas spyad na/ mkha' dang sa 'og spyod pa la sogs pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur bar bshad do/ /lhan skyes kyis mkha' spyod la sogs pa de dag gi gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag pa na gnas lugs dang bde ba chen po'i ro gnyis tha dad du snang ba phal cher log pa'i dbang gis/ mnyam bzhag las langs pa na gnas lugs de'i rnam 'phral thams cad bde ba'i rnam 'phral du yang 'char la de'i rig rwa tsho lha/de/ ma rig chosing zu rin zurangamathus mkha' spyad gas da dag la yul dang rang bzhan gyas bskal pa'i 'char tshul zil gyis gnon pa'i nus pa rnyed 'ong ngo / /tshul 'dis bsam sleb bam yid mgyogs kyi rdzu 'phrul sgrub pa ni bro gar gyi man ngag dam pa'o/ /gter gsar mnyam sbyor las/ gar gyi 275

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phan yon 'chad pa na zhing mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa'i lha mor bcas pa rnams dang thabs cig tu 'dug par gsungs pa'ang 'di dang mthun no/ (glu ni 'gro ba'i yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs dang / gar ni gdul bya ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pa zhes bshad tshul yang yod 'ong ngam dpyad dgos) slar yang dkyus la 'jug ste/sngags bla med ltar na'ang / skyob 'dod kyi brtse ba dang / sbyin pa sogs dang / ting 'dzin rnam thar gyi sgo mtha' yas pa 'bras dus na yod par ni 'dod la/ sems gzhan ni 'bras dus na med par 'dod pas/ de thams cad rgya che ba/ gya nom pa/ zag pa med pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba stong nyid dang sbyar ba kho na'i steng nas 'joka go /des na sgra rtog sel 'jug yin pas sangs rgyas sa'i 'od gsal zhes zer tshe khol bu pa zhig ltar snang yang ma 'dres pa'i chos sum brgya lta bu mdo phal bo che la sogs par rgya gang cher bka' bstsal ba thams cad de'i cha shas re yin pas chung chung zhig tu mi gzung ste/dper na sems rags pa zhes byas tshe 'ol le ba du ma cig ltar snang yang / las dang nyon mongs lam dang dmigs pa sogs kyis phye ba na mtha' klas pa zhig 'ong ba dang 'dra'o//des na 'bras dus su/ gang snang bde stong gi rol bar 'char ba na yang /der stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa'i sbyin pa dang snying 276

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6brtse sogs kyang yod pas/ stong pa'i rnam 'phrul thams cad bde ba'i 'phral du 'char ba ltar/ bde ba de'i char gyar pa'i sbyin pa zir /༷ /spri) lha du /bye/1)peshāje/ :de/dang tshul mas — gsal ba mtha' yas pa stegs nga 'ang 'phrul du 'char ro/ /'di ltar bsam na rigs drug gi rta skad byed dus su'ang / ser sna rdo rje lta bur mtshon na/brtan g.yo'i 'khor lo mtha' dag /rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu sbyin pa rnam bzhi dus drug tu gtong ba mthar phyin pa'i nus pa lhan skyes kyi sems steng nas smin pa'i sbyin pa mthar thug dang sbyor ba dang / tshor phung la sems can rnams kyi longs spyod du gsungs pa de sgrib bral du byas pa'i lhan skyes kyi tshor phung rat+na'i rta glur bzhag pa'i rnam 'phrul du lhag par sbyar nas snang zhen bskyed pas rgyas las la dbang ba sogs kyi rnam gzhag gsal bor 'thon 'ong ngo / /bla med kyi dkyil chog kun tu gzhal med khang gi cha rnams byang phyogs so bdun dang /gzungs bzhi/ so rig bzhi sogs dang sbyar nas gsungs pa'ang tshul 'di 'dra yin no//rta skad du 'jog rgyu'i bde ba'i dper/ dbang chen yang gsang las nam mkha' bstan cing / snyan brgyud rta mchog snying tig gi gzhung zur gsal gyi dgongs pa'ang de ltar mngon pas mnyam bzhag nam mkha'i dang rjes thob sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis las snga 277

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mar byed dam snyam/ gsang rdzogs las rta zhal gyi de nyid gnyug ma 'od gsal ba'i sems su gsungs pa dang 'di dag bsgrigs na/rta zhal gnyug sems/ rta skad sems des stong nyid rtogs pa zhes par 'gyar bas/ ji srid du 'od gsal gyis shes bya'i de kho na nyid nges ༄mi nus pa'am/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i mthu ma skyes pa de srid du/'od gsal gyis shes bya'i gnas lugs brjod mi nus pa dang /'od gsal gyis sngags pa dang brtan g.yo'i de nyid brda sprod pa'am mtshams sbyor bar mi nus pa yin pas/ 'od gsal gyis skad mi thon pa zhes bya la/ nam bsgom stobs kyis rlung dbu mar thim nas mi shigs pa'i sems de'i rang zhal dmigs rnam shin tu gsal bar phyungs te/ des shes bya'i gnas lugs brjod nus pa na 'od gsal gyis skad 'byin nus pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar sems des lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i chags nyams dang sbrags nas dngos po'i de kho na nyid glur blangs pa na/ snang srid thams cad rang dbang med par phyag byed pas na/ bde stong sbyor ba'i rta skad snang srid kyi sroka sngags mthar thug pa yin no/ /des na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog sngags rnal 'byor ba rang nyid la yod pa yin no/ /rta skad 'di dngos rdzogs rim nas dang / bcos mas btags pa dang rjes mthun rim pa dang por yang yod do/ /stong pa'i nam mkhar bde 278

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6ba'i 'a tsher skad 'byin par bshad pa'ang 'di dang gcig ste/ dril bu'i brjod pa sgra'i rnam gzhag dang 'dra se zhig snang ngo / /dbang chen gsung gi sngags pa'i nang mdzod chen mo gu h+ya rgya rgya rgya/ sgyu 'phrul sogs las chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa zhes mang du gsungs pa'i don ni/ der rnam rtog glo bur ba'i dbang gis ma dag pa'i snang ba bskyed par gsungs pa'i shugs kyis glo bur ba'i bslad rkyen gyi gzhan dbang med na ji lta bu zhig ce na/ gdod ma nas sangs rgyas pa zhes gnyug ma'i gnas tshod bstan pa yin no/ /gnyug ma byas tshad mi shigs pa la go mi dgos te/ sgyu ma'i khang bzang sprul pa na yang khang bzang gi snang cha de glo bur ba dang /snang gzhi'i gnyug ma'i ngo bo nyid rde'u shing sogs su gnas par 'dod pa yin no/ /sngags kyi skabs 'dir gnyug ma'i gnas tshod mthar thug de sgom par byed pas rang bzhin gzhi'i he ru ka sgom pa dang 'bras bu lam byed gnyis kar 'jog pa 'di pha mes kyi kha phor yin no//de la mnyam bzhag tu bshad ma thag pa'i rta skad kyis gnyug ma'am gdod ma'i stong phyogs bzlas pas/ rjes thob tu yang dag pa rab 'byams gnyug ma'i snang phyogs la rig pa bde blag tu 'jug ste/ 'di ltar/ bde stong mkha' ltar dag pa'i ye shes de nyid phung po lngar shar bar snang ba dang /de'i dbang gis phung po lnga yang 279

〉 21khud/ (( lngardo sdispyitshob khur:drob/thag byaspurngasno jur+shabastazud rta):re ba/sdosajib khuradra/zug/ rishin tu dag pa'i rigs lnga ye shes lngar mthong bar 'gyar ba ni/ rdo ༄rje rta skad rnam shes thugs nyid de: sogs kyi don de rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rta skad kyi skye gnas par bstan no//de ltar rjes snang la mnyam bzhag gi rgyas thebs pa'i stobs kyis/gang snang ci shar thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu bzlums te/ de ltar bzlums pa de'ang lha'i de nyid gcig pu la yid gtad pa'i sgo nas bde stong la bsdu/ de ltar snang grag rig gsum rim gyis bde ba'i rang bzhin du dril nas bsgom pas bsgom pa de dbang du gyur pa na snang ba thams cad kyang dbang du 'gyur ro//de'i tshe na tha mal pa'i yul snang cham la pheb pa'am zil gyis non pa zhes bya bas na/ de tshe 'khor ba zil gyis non: zhes dang / bde chen byang chub sems su sangs rgyas so: zhes gsungs/sangs rgyas so: ni grol zhes pa'o/ /'di skabs yul rkyen ci tsam rags la rgod pa de tsam du de thams cad dag pa rab 'byams bde ba chen po'i yo langs kho nar 'char bas/ ji ltar yo langs chen po'i nang du 'du 'dzis blo phrogs tshabs che ba ltar/ rta mchoka gi glu gar byang ba'i sngags pa 'du 'dzi'i nang na bde chen sgyu ma'i nyams ches lhag par 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /de'ang rta skad sgrogs pa'i dus dang / de'i byin rlabs kyi zil yul snang la phog pa'i dus 280

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6gnyis so sor cha shas su ldan pa'i dus la ltos te/ rta glus snang ba dbang du sdud pa'i rnam gzhag byed chog pas/ de gnyis dus mtshungs mi dgos te/ sngags bzlas pas dngos grub dbang du gyur zer tshe sngags bzla ba'i dus dang / dngos grub dbang du gyur pa'i dus gcig mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /'di dang sngar bshad la mi mthun pa yod kyang dpyod rten tsam yin/ tshul de ltar byas na mnyam bzhag gi rta skad ci tsam shugs che ba de tsam du/rjes thob tu gang snang stong pa'i rol par 'char stobs che/ de ji ltar che ba ltar bde ba'i rnam 'gyur du'ang 'char phul che/ de che ba ltar shin tu dag pa'i lhar lta ba'ang khyad par can du 'byung / de 'byung ba ltar des drangs pa'i mnyam bzhag gi rta skad de tha mal pa'i 'chi srid lta bu'i snang zhen gyis dag tshabs che bas shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sgrang 'em mthar phyim pa'i stsong phyogs kyi he ru ka h+ya r+sha ba dang ri na / / / 34 / / ༷//spamathun shugs che/ dus der sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal kun rdzob rnam can mngon du gyur pa med kyang / nga rgyal de 'dra'i shugs ma nyams pa/ da lta rang re gnyid dang rmi lam gyi skabs tshun chad du tha mal pa'i zhen pa dang mi 'bral ba lta bu ni yod dgos te/ rdzogs rim pa'i sku gsum lam khyer gyis skye 'chi bar do'i tha lam gyi snang zhen gcod par gsungs pa'i 'chi srid 281

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lam 'khyer gyis ji ltar gcad dang / de chos sku la ltos te 'bras bu lam byed du 'gyur tshul dang / lha sgom pa dang / lha'i de nyid sgom pa gnyis ka lha'i rnal 'byor yin mnyam yin cing bde stong sbyor ba'i mnyam bzhag lha'i de nyid sgom pa yin zhes pa'ang mnyam bzhag de lha'i de nyid du dmigs pa'i steng nas rtse gcig tu dran par byas stobs kyis drangs pa'i 'od gsal la dgongs pa yin gyi/ de lha'i de nyid du blo ngor bzung ma bzung ji ltar yang / lha'i de nyid du 'gro rgyu yin pa tsam gyis 'od gsal bsgom na lha bsgom pa'i go chod par 'grub na mi 'grigs pa mang du 'ong ba sogs bsgrigs nas shes par bya'o//stong phyogs kyi rta mgrin nam rta skad de nyid ji ltar shugs che ba de ltar yang rjes thob dbang chen gyi rnal 'byor phul du byang bar 'gyar ba snga ma'i 'gres te/ tshul 'dis rta skad la skur /re norami /rje)byang bar byed pa rta lam d+ngha srog go/rje grub chen nyid kyi snyan brgyud kyi gcod yul las phaṭa kyis las rab 'byams byed pa la sngon du phaṭa bsnyen dgos par gsungs pa ltar rta skad kyis dngos grub sdud pa la sngon du de'i bsnyen pa bya dgos la/ de'ang yang gsang gi rta skad gcig mar rta skad hrīḥyig tu bshad pa dang / (spyi mdo las kyang / rta mgrin gyi rdo rje stam bha na'i stobs kyis khro bo theg chen kun kyang 'dur thag gcod pa'i 'dur glu/ trīḥzhes pa 282

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6yin par bshad/ rta mgrin dgongs pa lung ston las/ muñdza'i gseb nas ljang zhur can/ /gyen du kha gdangs trīḥsgra 'byin/ /zhes 'byung ste shin tu gsal/) grol tig las kyang gnyis med trīḥhūṃ/ sogs zur bris dang / bde 'dus ma mo'i skabs su gtso bo'i dbu gtsug rta mgrin gyi zhal nas hrīḥzhes rta skad sgrogs par gsungs pa rnams dang / bde 'dus dbang chen 'dus rgyud las/ rta mchog gi gsung rig pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtha' dag gi rtsa ba dang / srog ni hrīḥyig yin par gsungs te/ de sogs dpyad na bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags kyi thog ma'i trīḥde rta skad du yang 'gyur bas 'di'i grangs bsnyen thems na rta skad 'bum phrag nyer gnyis kha skong bcas 'gro bas ngo shes par bya'o/ /'dar phyar bas dbang chen bsnyen skabs/ gu ru rin po ches/thog ma'i oṃ de trīḥr sgyur la zlos zhes gsungs par grags/ rta mgrin gsang ba phrin las kyi rgyud las/ dpal gyi rta skad thengs gcig gis: khams gsum ma lus dbang du bsdu: ma mo'i bh+yo skad thengs gcig gis: srid pa'i ma mo las la bkol: rnal 'byor trīḥskad thengs gcig gis: srid gsum gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol:zhes bshad de dpal gyi rta skad de/ rnal 'byor bas trīḥr(nyang gter mkha' 'gro chen mo dang / mkha' 'gro snying tig ma bu sogs las rta mchog gi sngags su srog sngags 'bru gcig 'di rang las gzhan ma bshad) zlo ba'i don du 'gro'am 283

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yonadapyad do//dzab las gzhan pa'i rta skad 'don dus ni/ bro chog gi skabs te/ shin tu gsal/ de'ang sgrub gzhung 'dir mnan pa'i las sgrub zur ba dang sbrags nas gsungs kyang / de las tshegs chung ba rgyun 'khyer byed na ni tshogs mchod kyi gtor mnan mthar/ rigs drug gi bro glu rgyas pa btags pas rung ba 'dra ste/ dbang chog tu de gnyis sbrel mar bya ba zhig bstan yod cing / rje blo gros mtha' yas kyi snyan brgyud rta mgrin gyi chog bsgrigs las/ de'i rtsa gzhung du las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i bro chog gsungs pa de tshogs mchod kyi bro mnan du bsdebs pa bzhin no/ /tshogs mchod kyi skabs kyi bro mnan dang / bro chog rgyas pa gnyis bsdus rgyas kyi khyad yin pas/phyi ma byed tshe snga ma mi byed kyang rung ngam snyam ste snyan brgyud rta mgrin chog bsgrigs der/ yang dag zab tig gi bro mnan med do(rat+na'i rta gsang du/ dbang gi rta bro dang glu'i mchod pa zhes mchod phreng gi nang du gsungs pa'i rigs pas bla ma zhi ba sogs dang thun mong ba'i phyag rgya gar mchod la tshang bar byed na'ang rung ngam snyam zhing / tshogs mchod kyi glu gar skabs rta skad dang bro'i de nyid bskyangs pa'ang rung ngam snyam)'gros dgu rta skad kyi mtshon don du 'chad skabs sngar bshad las yang na/ 'tsher skad ni grogs kyi drung lta bur 'gro 'dod kyi 284

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6gdung ba 'bar ba'i nga ro yin pas/ 'dod pa'i gnas su bang 'gros kyi shugs phyungs nas 'gro ba mtshon no/ /thub pas gsungs pa'i theg pa mtha' dag rang rgyud ldan gyi gdul bya dngos sam brgyud nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khyer ba'i theg pa'am bzhon par gcig kyang / de'i nang nas go 'phang der bde myur du dkri ba'i thabs mkhas kyi shugs gting nas phyungs pa ni/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rta mgrin nam/ bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi rnal 'byor yin pas de ni myar mgyogs kyi mthu phul du byung ba'i mthar thag go/ni pa ///sto dmi pho //khye) //khye)yang gong du/ snang nga zung 'jug dang / ya ga sa — rta skad gsum gsungs pa de la/ zhal dang skad gnyis so sor bshad pa ni ches mi gsal yang / 'gro sgrol gyi snying rje chen po gcig pu de zhal gsum so so'i glu skad du 'gyur bar 'chad dam/ yang na/ stong phyogs kyi rta skad gong gi rta skad thengs gcig ltar dang / snang phyogs kyi rta skad ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung mi shigs nā da'i sgra dbyangs chos phung rab 'byams su 'char ba de dang / zung 'jug/ gi ni/ snang stong gi rta skad de gnyis gcig tu sbyar ba ste/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad khyab par bzhad pa'i sor rtog ye shes de nyid gsung dbyangs kyi rnam par shar ba/ zhes par 'gyur/ zhal gsum yang / thugs 'od gsal/ sku bzhin lag can/ de gnyis zung 'jug 285

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang gsum mo/ /'di 'bras dus dang sbyar ba ste/ lam dus la yang bsgre/ gzhan rang bzor 'gro dogs che bas ma bris/ dbang skad du 'gro lugs sla/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i man ngag lta phreng gi brjod bya rta skad kyis 'chad tshul ni/ theg dgu'i rnam gzhag ni 'gros dgu dang sbyor ba bde 'dus tha ram ltar dang / de las khyad par gsang ba sgyu 'phrul gyi lam rim ni rta skad thengs gsum gyis mtshon te/ rta skad dang po ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid de bsgom bya'am nyams len gyis sbyor bas 'jug yul shes par byed/ rta skad gnyis pa ni 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid de sgom byed nyams len gyi sbyor ba ste/ 'di la lam rim ye shes snying po ltar bskyed rim pa'i stong chen dang snying rje sgyu ma sogs lnga dang / rdzogs rim pa'i de lnga dang / bskyed rim nas rdzogs rim du 'pho byed kun tu bzang po'i man ngag sogs gsang thig ltar yod pa sogs spros pas chog mtshan nyid de gnyis ni mngon rtogs rgyan gyi/ 'jug yul mkhyen gsum/ nyams len sbyor bzhi zer ba lta bu'i bshad tshul du snang ngo / /rta skad tha ma ni mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid de/ bsgom bya de sgom byed des bsgoms pa las gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'grub tshul lo/ /mtshan nyid phyi ma 'di rgyas par ni skad 'gyur bcu gsum dang sbyar nas shes te tha ram bzhin no//tshul 'di ni snyan brgyud rta mgrin la 286

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6brten nas bshad pa ste/ snyan brgyud kyi gzhung de dang sgyu 'phrul gsang thig sogs kyi ye shes kyi sku sgrub lugs 'dra bar snang ba'ang yin te/ rags pa tsam la bsams so/ /rdzogs rim pa'i stong chen sogs lnga'i thad nas dpyad na sgyu 'phrul ba'i bzhed pa yang tshul gnyis su song ba 'dra ba zhig snang ngo //'on kyang 'di'i rdzogs rim pa'i snying rje sgyu ma dang / rgya gcig rlung sems kyi lha sku gsungs pa sogs man ngag sde ba'i lugs dang phyogs mthun par rlung gdangs stong gzugs kyi lha sku la bzhed pa 'dra zhig snang zhing sku gsum lam khyer so sor sbyor tshul la'ang dpyad rgyu 'dug pas rtsad gcad par bya'o/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dang yang cung zad sgrigs chog gam//snang ba dbang sdud kyi gnad mthar thug snying por dril na/thabs mkhas dang mi ldan pa la nang rig pa la ltos med kyi yul nang mgo rgyal bar shar nas sems kyi dbang phar 'phrogs pa de thabs mkhas dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ba la bde chen gcig pu nyid kyis nyams ji ltar bsgyur ba de ltar snang ba'i rang sems kyi gar stabs nyag gcig tu shar nas mi shigs gnyug ma'i rta zhal gzi brjid rgyas byed kyi bcud len dam par 'gyur ba ste/ sgyu 'phrul gsang snying du/ srid zhi'i chos thams cad sems dang ye shes 287

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zherang snang bar gtan la phab pa'ang rta skad kyi de nyid 'di 'chad byed yin no/ /de la nges don shing rta chen po'i le'u dgu par/dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i lugs kyi gtum mo'i 'khor lo bzhi ba rgyas par bshad nas/ le'u bcu bar gzhi rtogs pa'i shes rab mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa zhes lta sgom gyi gnad rgya cher bstan pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes 'char ba'i thabs dang / thabs des grub pa'i ye shes gnyis las/ snga ma le'u dgu ba dang /phyi ma bcu ba /de 'phros dang bcas pa bcu gcig pa sogs kyis ston par gsal te/ bcu ba'i klad du rdzogs rim gyi snying po'i ye shes 'chad par gsungs pa'i phyir ro//le'u der dbu ma'i lta ba sgom dgos pa dang /de'ang dpyad sgom bya rgyu ma yin tshul sbrags nas bshad de/ mnyam bzhag 'od gsal gyi steng nas rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings la 'jog pa'i dbyings rig sre ba la gdams pa'o/ /der phyi nang yul sems thams cad dang sbyar te bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab rtsal sbyong tshul dbu ma'i skabs dang mthun pa 'dra ba zhig bshad pa'ang / nang 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa las ma g.yos pa'i ngang nas gzung 'dzin bden med du lta lugs kho na yin te/ de ltar bltas pa tsam gyis gdod ma'am gnyug ma'i rang klong du phyin nas dpyad mkhan rang dag la 'gro bar bshad pa'ang de'i gnad kyis 288

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6yin no/ /lugs 'di la bslad ma bslad kyi khyad tsam ma gtogs mnyam rjes gnyis 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa skyong rgyu yod pa la khyad med par bzhed de/ 'di ni rdzogs chen gyi skor du rgyas so/ /der chos thams cad stong nyid las ma g.yo tshul dbu ma nas bshad pa 'dra ba re bshad nas 'di ltar rtogs na rdzogs chen du chos kun rdzogs tshul rtogs pa yin zhes mang du gsungs te/ rig pa dbyings thog tu 'khyil ba'i rdzogs rim pas bltas na gang snang stong pa'i rol bar gnas pa de nyid gang snang 'od gsal gyi rig pa'i rol bar gnas pa'i don du'ang 'gro ba/ dper na dbu ma pa'i ngor stong ba rten 'byang gi don du 'gro ba lta ba zhig yin pas/de bshad rir rig mipa yin gyi/ spyir de ltar bshad pa min te/ dbu ma thal 'gyur pa'i lugs kyi thad du'ang / stong nyid 'di ltar rtogs na rdzogs chen rtogs pa yin zhes kun mkhyen rang gis kyang ma bshad do/ /de'i phyir gang zag de 'dra'i ngor/ chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po'i klong las ma g.yos tshul 'chad pa na/ de 'dra'i ngor chos thams cad stong nyid las ma g.yos tshul 'ba' zhig bstan pas chog par byung ba yin te/ da dung zhib cha mang ngo / /(mdor na rdzogs chen ka dag gi dbyings rig gnyis so sor ma phye ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ res stong nyid dang / res rig pa la rdzogs chen du gsungs pa yin no) kun mkhyen gyi sems phyogs skor 289

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/na 'od gsal ngang bzhag gi ting nge 'dzin ma brjed pa'i ngang nas yul gang snang dang blo gang shar la blta ba goms pas/ ji zhig na/bya gar song yang nam mkha' zer ba ltar/ rnal 'byor bas gar bltas kyang rig pa las gzhan med pa zhig 'ong tshul yang yang gsungs pa rnams kyang de ltar yin pa ni/ zer sa gang rnyed nas sra sre byas pa min gyi rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bslad med du snang bas lam gyi gnad 'di ni rje btsun tsong kha pa'i sngar yang rnying phyogs la ma grags pa min no//mang du bshad pa'i bsdu ba ni/ rta skad kyis dngos grub dngos su sgrub nus pa la ni/ sgrub thabs thun bzhir bsgom pa'i sgo nas rta zhal la reg mthong gi mtshan ma brtan po rnyed cing / rta skad la'ang gsal brtan de 'dra thob pa dang / rta skad kyi de nyid las su rung ba'i dbang gis skad de'i snang zhen gnyis ka ches phul du byung ba'i ngo bo nyid du bogs thon pa gnyis tshogs dgos so/ /de gnyis tshang ba na ni rta skad stobs su gyur pa dang / rta skad la nus pa rnyed pa/ yin pas/ gsung rta dbyangs kyi nga ro tsam gyis dngos grub rab 'byams byed pa'i dbang dang ldan pa yin no/ /de'ang las kyi phreng ba ltar sgrub thabs kyi sbyor mchod dang / tshogs mchod kyi gsang tshogs dang / thun mtshams bro rdung gi skabs sogs su bskyed rim 290

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6pa'i bde stong ci nus su sgom zhing / de nyid rta skad du 'char ba la slob/ dzab dang bro'i dus su rta skad 'don pa rnams rtsa ba'i man ngag go /rta skad kyi de nyid brtan pa'i drod tshad ni nyams dang rmi lam tsam las shes par bya ba min gyi/ 'jigs pa dang / khro ba dang /mya ngan sogs skyed pa'i yul rkyen chen po rnams kyang rnal 'byor des zil gyis mnan nas de thams cad bde chen sgyu ma'i kha dog gcig tu sgyur nus pa zhig dgos te/ 'di la yul snang rta skad kyi dbang du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /de 'dra zhig ni bskyed rim pa'i tshogs sgrub kyi sngon nas 'ong dgos par mngon la/ sngags kyi gdul bya tsan+dan lta bu sogs ni mtshams de shed nas tshogs spyod byed do//rta skad snang ba thams cad la bde chen ye shes kyi byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i thabs su bsngags pa ni/byin 'bebs dus/ badz+ra dharma raṇi ta sogs kyis rol mos byin dbab par bshad pa lta bu'o/ /phyi nang gi bar chad gang byung yang de ltar byin 'bebs byas pas ji ltar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis bdud sdig can byang sems rnams kyi bdud kyi lcags kyu spong ba'i chos ston pa por byin gyis brlab nas mdo sde bshad du bcug pa dang 'dra bar/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal mi zad pa dag gi sgor snang bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di ni sngags bla med pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i 291

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ting nge 'dzin gyis bar chad 'dul lugs yin te/ rta mgrin gyi sngags pa ni gdab las sogs la gtso bor mi byed/ 'di kho na byed snyam/ zhi sogs las bye brag pa sgrub pa'i rta skad so sor yod kyang /'di ni las sgrub tsam gyi dbang du byas pa min par rgyun 'khyer du skyong rgyu'i rta skad spyi'i khog tu bar chad 'dul lugs so/ /rta skad rang nyid dbang gi rigs yin kyang / de la brten nas zhi drag sogs las gzhan yang byar yod pa ni sbyin sreg dus dbang thabs las thams cad pa zer ba lta bu'o/ /rnam pa gcig tu na dbang du gyur pa'i dngos grub dang / dbang gi las ni las dang dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang srog lta bu yin te/ dngos grub gang yang dbang du ma gyur pa ni dngos grub de las su ma rung ba yin pas /de srid du dngos grub kyi bya ba mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang gi rta skad ces pa'i tshig zur gyi dbang dang / las bzhi'i nang gi dbang las gnyis la rgya mtsho dang ya mu na lta bu'i khyad yod pas/ lha 'di mchog sgrub dang las sgrub kyi lha gnyis las snga ma yin pa dang /'on kyang las bzhi'i nang nas dbang las la bsngags pa mi 'gal bya ba sogs dpyad dgos/ bshad tshul gcig la/ ji ltar mi bskyod rdo rje zhe sdang gi rigs yin pas mtshan yang zhe sdang rdo rje zhes grags shing / de'i gnad kyis las bzhi las mngon spyod la bsngags kyang 292

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6las tshogs kyi lhar mi 'dod pa ltar/ dpa' bo'i dbang po 'di yang lus can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyong phyir rjes chags kyi rigs kyi rgyal por bzhengs pa yin pas las sgrub kyi tshe dbang gi las la bsngags kyang mchog sgrub dang las sgrub kyi lha gnyis las snga ma yin te/ 'di ni rin po che lta ba'i gang zag rim gnyis kyi lam ༄gyis lha 'di'i gzugs su 'tshang rgya ba'i dbang du mdzad nas rgyud sde chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsa ba'i bdag por bzhengs pa yin gyi/gtso bor las tshogs sgrub pa'i skabs tsam du gsungs pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /rta skad la'ang / lta bar sbyar ba dang / spyod par sbyar ba zhes lam gyi gzhung shing ye shes kyi don la dgongs pa dang /lam gyi cha lag phrin las kyi spyod pa'am mdzad pa la dgongs pa gnyis las/ snga ma'i skabs su dbang las dang mi sbyor gyi/ lam gyi snying po rjes chags lam byed kyi bde stong dang / de'i steng nas sa lam bgrod tshul sogs la sbyor ba tha ram bzhi'i dang po gsum ltar te/ rta skad kyi tha ram don bsdu'i thad dang bsgrigs na gsal lo/ /des na dbang gi rta skad ni rta skad spyod par dgongs pa'i skabs yin no/ / 'di bzang ngam dpyad/ gong 'og na mi mthun pa bag tsam yod de dpyad pa rtsing zhib las byung ngo / /de ltar he ru ka 'di ni bde ba chen po'i rnam 'gyur gsal shos yin pas/ rdo rje phur ba'i skabs 293

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sa yang ye shes sems dpa'i srog la lhan skyes ye shes kyis dbang ༄bskur ba zhes rdo rje sems dpa' la rta mgrin gyis dbang skur ba'i tshul bshad do//sangs rgyas gsang bas rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel bar bshad pa'i zla la drang na rta skad kyi don yang / srong btsan bka' 'bum gyi cang shes bā la ha'i thad ltar/ mi 'jigs pa'i gnas su 'gro bar 'dod pa su yod/ ces mthon por sgrogs pa la bshad dgos pa 'dra/rta mgrin dgongs pa lung ston sogs las/ mnyam dang skul dang rtags tsam 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ dbang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal brtan tshad la phebs pas rta skad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin dngos su thon pa tsam gyi spyi ldog nas dpal khrag 'thung dbang po dngos dang mnyam pa ni dang po ste/ 'di ni dngos grub la gtso bor rang stobs kyis mnga' dbang thob pa ste/ rig 'dzin grub pa'o/ /dngos po la rta skad de ltar mi thon yang / ting nge 'dzin las su rung bas bsam gtan gyi rta skad tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dngos grub la skul ba'i dgos pa dngos su byed nus pa ni gnyis pa ste/ gtso bor gzhan stobs kyis dngos grub mang po la dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs so/ /dbang chen gyi lha sngags ye shes la 294

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6rnal 'byor byed kyang / rta skad kyi drod de 'dra gang yang ma rnyed pa ni gsam pa ste/rnal 'byor ba'i brda skad du 'jog rgyu dngos ni/rta ༄ skad dngos su grub pa dang / de ma grub kyang nus pa cung zad rnyed pa'i bzlas pa'am bshug glu sogs dang / nus pa ma thob pa las dang po pa'i rta mchog gi brda skad rnams te/ rnal 'byor pa'i gsung rdo rje rim pa gsum po 'di ni bskyed rim pa kho na la yang yod do//'di ltar bshad rung ngam dpyad dgos//rta skad yi ger brjod na ji ltar yin pa ni/ bka' brgyad bde gsang sogs su bshad tshul sngar bstan zin pas gong 'og sgrigs la ltos/rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel bar/ rta mgrin gyi rta skad la i hi hi zhes(snyan brgyud rta mgrin gyi'ang skabs gcig na 'di bzhin yod)pa bshad cing / klong snying rig 'dzin 'khrul 'khor las kyang de ltar bshad/ spyir ni/ gzhung 'dir/ ye shes gzi 'bar rngam zhing bzhad pa'i sgrasaḥ zhes rta skad bzhad sgra yin par gsungs te/ gsang sgrub kyi bstod par/ rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ces sogs de 'dra gzhan yang ches mang ngo / bzhad tshul yang 'di'i bro chog tu/hi hi hi zhes pa la yang yang bshad pa snyan brgyud rta mgrin dang yang ji bzhin du mthun no/ /de'ang bsnyen sgrub ci rigs 'khyol ba na/de'i skabs rnams su rang gi ngag rlung rdo rje rta skad du 295

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'char ba'i bag chags brgyud mar bzhag pas/ ngag la rta skad kyi snang zhen shugs je cher 'gro/ /des rkyen byas nas dpal gyi rta skad dngos rang 'bab cing / de'ang phal je cher rim gyis 'gro/ de'i tshe ༄slar yang rang gi ngag rlung hi hi'i gad rgyangs kyi rnam par bcos pa 'di nyid sgrub rten du bzung nas/ bro rdung dang sbrags nas zhag/ bdun la sogs par bsgrub pas/ mkha' 'gro ma dang / srid gsum dregs pa'i rgyal srid la dbang sgyur zhing / bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i mthu grub par 'gyur ba ni/ sgrub lugs 'di'i smad las thun mong ma yin pa ste/ che mchog bdud rtsi'i bsnyen pa song ba'i slob dpon gyis rtsi sman gyi sbyor ba sgrub gzhir bzung ste zhag bdun la sogs par bsgrub pas grub pa'i bdud rtsi dngos sam rjes mthun par gyur nas/ skong dang gzi mdangs 'chi med sogs stsol nus pa dang 'dra'o/ /deng sang rta skad kyi sgrub lugs 'di rnams sa 'og gi gter bzhin song 'dug kyang / bla ma'i drin kho nas bdag gis gter rdol ba bzhin du byas yod/rta skad bro gar dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rta skad ni gzhan la 'bod cing skul ba'i sgra kho na min te/ shin tu chags ldan 'ga' zhig bde bas myos pa na rta skad 'byin par grags pa yin te/ bde skad dam chags skad do/ /bro yang sgyu 'phrul lugs zur 'khod ltar 296

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6rig ma dang lag pa'i pad+ma lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas 'khrab cing rtsa ba'i rjes chags kyi spyod pa yin la/ de'ang snyoms 'jug gi dga' ba'i ros myos dus kyi chags skad rta mchog 'tsher ba'i nga ro dang sbrags na dga' ba 'bar ba la mthu shin tu che bas/ lus bro gar dang / ngag 'tsher skad/ sems rjes chags te gsum dang ldan pas rig ma la rtse bar bstan te/'dod chags rdo rje'i rigs la ci ste mi bsngags/ mdor na bros bde ba rgyas pa'i grogs su rta skad dgos pa'o/ /rta skad 'don pa dang bro rdung gi dus gcig ni/ mchod pa'i skabs te/ rat+na'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus su/ dbang gi rta bro dang glu'i mchod pa zhes rta rgyud nas bshad pa'i glu drug dang bro drug gis mchod pa (der glu'i sngags dang / bro'i sngags gnyis tha dad du 'byung ba las/'di ni bro'i sngags su byas nas gsungs so) te na te te'i sngags dang bcas pa gsungs te/ 'di ni rta mgrin gyi thugs dam rtsa ba yin tshul bshad zin ltar mnyes pa'i mchod pa mchog go /de ltar sbyor na ni kha skong phrin las kyi phyag rgya gar mchod la ye shes glu'i mchod pa'ang yod par mchod sngags kyis shes pas/der rta bro dang 'tsher glu'i mchod pa'i dmigs rim bskyang bas chog pa 'dra la/ de las kyang spro na thags tig 'di ka'i bka' brgyad kyi glu gar mchod pa'i ༄297

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skabs su/ ma hā dz+nyā na te na hūṃḥ te na te te hūṃḥ zhes 'byung ba de gdangs 'gyur mtho dman ring thung ji ltar 'dod pas glur len cing / bro gar yid la gang shar bzhin byas nas nyams spar ba yang rung ba 'dra ste/ thang stong snyan brgyud las kyang / te na te te'i sngags kyis bro gar snang ba la gang dran byas pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams chags shing gdung bar 'gyur bar phag mo'i skabs su gsungs so/ /'di ni las sgrub kyi rta bro gtan min te/ rta gsang du'ang bro mnan gyi tshig lta bu ye med do/ /mchod pa'i glu bro ni sgyu 'phrul las/ glu tshig bro gar rol mo yi/ /sprin phung tshogs kyis rab tu mchod/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /('di dag ni/ spyir 'di 'dra'ang rung ngam zhes dpyad gzhir bkod kyi/ gzhung rang na gsal kha mi snang zhing / bka' brgyad spyi'i khog nas kyang cher ma thon pas/ phyag rgya gar mchod ces pa'i gar gyi don dngos ni lag pa'i phyag rgya sogs sgyu 'phrul pa'i phyag rgya bdun sbrags la bya dgos) bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi sgom khog sogs las kyang bshad de/ der ni/ phyag rgya gar mchod la phyag rgya'i mchod pa rgyas par spros nas/ de'i 'og/ tu glu bro'i mchod pa dz+nyā na te te'i sngags dang bcas pa 'byung ste so sor mdzad do//bde 'dus bro mnan chen mor/ dbus kyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: zhal nas mya ngan 'das pa'i chos kyang ston:298

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6g.yas kyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: rnal 'byor yal gam can la dngos grub ster: g.yon gyi rta skad lhang lhang thengs gcig gis: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud: ces gsungs te bskul chen dang mi 'dra'o//spyi mdo'i gsang sngags 'byung ba'i gnas skabs bcu gnyis kyi drug pa/gdul bya'i skabs la babs pa na yang 'byung /zhes pa'i rgyas bshad du/sngon ru tras 'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur ba na/kho'i mthus 'gro ba rnams kyi sems dang spyod pa shin tu 'khrugs te phyin ci log tu song zhing / de'i dbang gis snod bcud thams cad ches cher snyigs shing rgud par gyar pa'i tshe/'jig rten dbang phyag ra༅ rangardo rje rta'i gdong ba can sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul te/ rgya mtsho'i do/lang ka'i grong rdal gyi dbus/ri'i rgyal po ma la ya'i rtser byon nas/ khams gsum yongs sgrol/ dug gsum gtan sprugs pa'i spyod pa mdzad tshul rgya cher gsungs pa'i skabs su rta skad bshad pa'i tshul ni/ ru tra la gdung ba bskyed pa na/ khos rang gi bka' 'og gi 'jig rten gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams dmag sde dang bcas pa/dmod pa grub pa'i mthu 'byung bo thams cad kyis bzod par dka' ba'i ngag gis ram zlar bskul te/ dpung tshogs bye ba dpag med kyi sprin gtibs nas/ bdud kyi sgyu 'phrul gyi drwa ba 299
