pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bkram pa na/ rta mchog he ru kas rdo rje sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gnon pa'i 'dur glu blangs par gsungs te/ de'ang trīḥzhes blang bar bshad do/ /'dur glu'i bstan don ni/ dga' rab dbang phyus sogs la 'dod dbang stong las lhag par sgegs pa'i gar dang /gshin rje'i rgyal po sogs la gshin rgyal stong las lhag par 'bar zhing khro ba'i gar dang / tshangs pa sogs la tshangs chen stong las lhag par zhi ba'i gar ram nyams kyi 'gyur ba ste/ mdor na rgyal ba kun gyi sku/ mthun pas mthun pa 'dul ba'i nyams tha dad du shi na tu bsgyur ba'i sprul pa'i rgyud kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyas par bkang ste/ ru tra dang / de'i dpung dregs pa'i gtso bo thams cad shin tu zil gyis non cig de dag gi dga' ma'i tshogs rnams drongs shig gam 'gug par gyis shig nyon mongs shin tu shugs drag la spyod pa'i sems can rnams gdul dka' sla'i nges pa la mi ltos par sngags kyi thabs mkhas kyis thul cig ces pa yin par bshad/de ltar 'dur glu blangs pas/ bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams ni rengs te bag 'khum/ mtshon cha'i sprin phang ni stong pa nyid du ༄sangs/ mi snyan pa'i ngag rgya mtsho ni theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgrar snang bar gyur to zhes bshad do//dge byed lo mjug nas dpyad pa gtsang du song ba rnams slar 300

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6yang mthud de bris pa/ lar dogs pa che ba ni/ sgrub sde 'di la pad+ma gsung rta skad kyi sgrub pa zhes grags pas rta skad kyi ting nge 'dzin rgyun ldan du skyong ba zhi ga la bsnyen sgrub kyi srog 'chol dgos par snang yang / 'di dang snyan brgyud rta mgrin sogs su dzab dgongs spyi khyab ltar las ma bshad pa ci zhes pa ste/ 'di la spyir thun re bzhin rta skad kyi snang zhen skyong rgyu ni dngos bstan la'ang mi gsal ba min te/ spyi gtsug rta gdong rngam bzhad 'tsheraḥ zhes so/ /'on te rta skad de nyid dzab dgongs su byas nas skyong rgyu bstan ma bstan ni cung dka' bas dpyad na/spyir he ru ka 'di rjes chags kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa dang /'gro sgrol gyi shugs che zhing myur ba sogs kyis rta mchog tu bshad de/ tshul des rang nyid rta mchog yin pa'i mtshon byed du dbu gtsug nas rta gdong zhal gyi phyag rgya phar sprul pa yin gyi/ rta mgo yod pas rta mgrin du tshur bzhag pa ye min no/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das 'di'i gsung yang ril gyis rta skad du bshad rgyu yin gyi/ rta skad ces byas tshe rta gdong gi kha las skyes pa 'ba' zhig mi dgos te/ rta bro zhes pa'ang rta mgrin gyi zhabs bro la zer gyi/rta rmig gi rnam pas 'khrab par sgom mi dgos pa bzhin no//de ltar 'phags pa 'di'i gsung thams cad rjes chags kyi glu'i rang bzhin gyi rta skad kho na yin pa'i mtshon byed du/ dbu gtsug gi 301

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rta zhal las rta skad dngos 'byin par zad de/ sgrub thabs sgom dus su'ang rang gi ngag rlung thams cad rta sngags su blta zhing / rta sngags kyang rta skad kho na yin pa'i brda rtags su spyi bo nas rta skad dngos 'byin bzhin par blta yi/ rtsa zhal sogs nas 'byung ba'i sngags sgra rta skad min pa dang / rta skad rta gdong kho na las 'byung dgos par ni mi bzung ngo / /mdor na lha 'di'i gsung gsang sngags kyi brjod pa thams cad chags pa'i rta skad kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa 'di ni gsang sngags de dag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos chen po yin la/ de'i rang rtags su spyi gtsug tu'ang rta skad dngos rang bzhag la/ de nyid rta dzab rta skad yin pa'i dran pa'i 'dzin phur du byas te dzab bzlas la brtson pas/ nam zhig bzlas brjod la rta skad dngos kyi nus pa skyes pa na/ de'i rtags mtshan du spyi gtsug nas rta skad sgra(rta sngags kyi brag cha)brnyan lta bur thon 'ong ba yin gyi/ dzab la rta skad du shes pas rgyas btab nas bzla ba min pa'i rta skad gtsug 'byin gyi gnad zur du 'tshol ba ngal ba tsam mo//des na rta mgrin gyi dzab 'di dang po zlo dus nas sgrub sde gzhan las kyang ches lhag par lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can thams cad rang 'khor du 'ong tshabs che ba'i gnad gcig yod de/ dzab rta skad dbang gi glur byas nas zlo ba 'di sgrub sde gzhan la med pa'i 302

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6phyir ro/ /(mkha' 'gro dam can rnams dgyes nas 'dus pa tsam gyis bdud bgegs bar chad byur dang mi shis pa thams cad drag shul gyi gzi brjid rnon po can de dag gi mdun du gnas mi nus shing / me phung gi 'khor du grang reg ltar mthu med par 'gyur bas bar chad sel thabs kyang zab pa'i phul phyin yin no) bde 'dus kyi ma tshang kha skong rgyud las rta mgrin gyi sgrub lugs la bsnyen sgrub gsum gyi bzlas dzab gtso bor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsung gi sgrub par bshad ces gsungs pa'ang de la dgongs shing / 'di nyid las/dbang chen rta skad bzhad pa'i sgra: nus pa sngags kyi phreng ba yis:zhe sa bzlas sngags nyid rta skad du gsungs so/ /de'ang bdag don ye she sa sgrub pa stod las kyi dzab kyi tshe/de'i rang rtags sa spyi gtsag rang no༅gi rta mgos kyang lta bar dgongs pa'i rta skad rtsal bton du sgrogs pa dang / gzhan don phrin las sgrub pa smad las kyi dzab kyi tshe rta mgos kyang de'i rtags su spyod par dgongs pa'i rta skad 'byin te/dzab ji ltar bsgyur ba de ltar de'i sgra brnyan rta mgo'i 'tsher skad kyang 'gyur 'gro'o snyam ste da dung dpyad/ 'o na bde 'dus tha ram sogs las spyi gtsug rta zhal gyi 'tsher skad kho na bshad pa ci zhe na/('di'i lan 'debs tshul/ de kho na bshad pa ma grub ste/ spyi bo'i rta skad bshad pa nyid kyis rta sngags spyir bshad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zur 'khod ltar dgos kyang 'dir thag cha 'dzings pa ltar song yod) der ni sngon byung he ru ka nyid kyis sgra 303

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshig thams cad 'dod chags chen po'i ye shes kyi rang sgrar 'char ba'i rnal 'byor la sbyang ba mthar phyin pa'i rgyu mthun rtags kyi phyaka / rgya thun mong ma yin pa ji lta bu brnyes pa de gtso bor byas nas bshad cing sgrub thabs su ni rjes 'jug rnal 'byor sa rtsom pa dang po la rta skad sgrub tshul gtso bor mdzad nas bshad pa'i khyad do/ /de'ang spyir pad+ma gsung gi khyad chos gtso bo de gang yin 'chad pa yin na/ de rtsom pa dang po la gang gi steng nas sgrub pa dad bstun te 'chad mi dgos kyi/ spyir de la gsung gi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa ji lta bu yod pa de 'chad dgos la/ de'i tshe gsung rig sngags kyi rang ldog tsam nas bstan na ni sgrub sde gzhan dang thun mong bar 'gro bas rta skad kyi ldog pa nas bstan par bya zhing / sku gsung gnyis gdul bya gzhan snang gi yon tan yin pas gsung rta skad du 'jog pa'ang gdul byas rta skad du gsal por shes pa zhig la byed pa'i phyir rta skad kyi de nyid tshang ba tsam gyis mi chog rnam pa'ang rta skad yin pa zhig gi steng nas gsung gi sgos(de 'di'i gsung gi sgos chos gtso che shos sam gsal shos yin pas so) bstan dgos so/ /da lta rnal 'byor pas gsung de sgrub lugs 'chad pa yin na ni/ spyir 'di la sgos chos ji 'dra yod bstan pa tsam gyis mi chog gi da lta nas rang gi ngag rlung 'di gsung de'i bzlas brjod kyi ngo bor sgrub 304

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6pa'i tshul dang / de las pad+ma gsung zhes pa'i gsung gi khyad chos thun min de'ang 'grub 'ong ba zhig bstan nas/ de dang gtso bor sbyar ba'i 'chad tshul la rtsal 'don dgos so/ /des na spyi'i 'chad thabs su spyi bo'i rta skad dang / sgrub thabs su bzlas sngags la sbyar nas bshad par shes par bya'o(mdor na dpal he ru kas sngon spyi bo'i rta skad kyis dam can las la bkye ba'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa ni/ rjes 'jug la dngos grub kyi sgo byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ 'di ltar rjes 'jug rnams rta skad kyi sgo nas khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i srid thob par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i ched du rta skad de nyid bzlas sngags kyi rnam par byin gyis rlob par yang mdzad de/ sngags 'di bzlas pa las rta skad de thob par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /'di spyir yang mkho rgyu zhig red do)ci ste dbu gtsug gi rta skad kyis lha 'di nyid rang dang / 'di'i sku dang / sngags dang /ye shes thams cad rta mchog dang / rta mchog gi rigs kyi sku dang sngags dang ye shes su bstan nas/ 'di'i lam rim gyi khog thams cad rta mchog gi rigs kyi de nyid kyi sgrom du bcug nas sgrub tshal ༄gsal bar mtshon nus pa ma yin nam/ de'i phyir de thams cad kyi snang zhen brtan pa'i 'dzin phur du spyi gtsug gi rta gdong bzhad pa'i dbyangs de btab nas bsgom pas/ de rnams kyi snang zhen la nus pa thon pa na/ grub rtags su dpal gyi rta skad spyi gtsug nas rang gi ngang gis thon(phur ba'i skabs bsnyen phur 'bar dang bzhad pa sogs kyi 305

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dod yin)'ong ba yin pas/ de bzlas brjod kho na la sbyor ba ci ltar rigs she na/de la'ang zhib cha phye na/sku'i snang zhen grub rtags su rta zhal rma bya'i mdog can spyi bo nas dngos su thon pa dang /gsung gi snang zhen grub rtags de las rta skad kyi rol mo 'khrol ba dang / thugs kyi grub rtags bde stong gi nyams tshad bzung med par 'bar ba'i khyad yod pas/ gtso che ba'i dbang du btang ste gsung bzlas pa sngags la sbyar ba 'thad do/ /'on kyang spyir rta mgrin gyi sku dang thugs dang phrin las sogs kyang gsung gi rigs yin pas/ de dag gi mtshon rtags su rta skad 'jog pa'i rnam gzhag kyang 'dod par ni bya ste/ gsang sngags la shan 'byed pa'i rta skad kyis shes/ de'i dbang du na sgrub lugs 'di'i sku phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor sogs kyang gsung rta skad sgrub byed du 'gyur te/ de dag gi rtags tshad mthil gtad sa'ang rta skad la byed pa'i phyir ro//de'i spyir yang sgrub lugs 'di la gsung rta skad kyi sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /yang na tha ram gyi dgongs pa 'di ltar bshad de/dpal he ru ka'i(sku phyag rgya'i dang / gsung bzlas pa'i dang / thugs 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor sogs)lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang / lam gyi cha rkyen phrin las kyi sbyor ba yongs rdzogs rta skad kho na'i steng nas bshad pa 'dis sgrub lugs 'di la gsung dang / de las kyang rta skad gtso sdu06 4—

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6bor byed par ston la/ byed tshul yang lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa thams cad rta skad kyi de nyid du byed pa dang / rta skad de rnams kyi mtshan mar 'dzin tshul dang(tshul de gnyis ni 'di'i lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa gang la bslab kyang spyi bo'i rta skad sgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu hril hril 'gro ba'i gnad dmar bcangs mar bstan pa ste/ zhes pa lhag par je gsal du btang ba'o)de ltar 'bad nas slob pa ni sgrub sde 'di'i grub rtags kyi gtso bo rta skad gtsug nas 'byin pa'i gnad dngos gzhi yin par bstan pa ste(rta skad la bzlas sgom byed pa ral gri sgrub pa dang 'dra/ rta skad spyi bo nas thon pa de ral gri 'bar ba dang 'dra/ de ltar grub pa'i rta skad thob nas las dang ye shes kyi dngos grub rab 'byams la de nyid kyis dbang sgyur ba ral gri dngos grub tu 'gyur tshul dang 'dra bas/ rta skad dngos grub kyi rtags mtshan nam phyag rgyar bshad pa ni rtags mtshan gzhan dang mi 'dra'o/ /'di'i khyad par gyi dngos grub gtso shos rang yin pas so)'di'i rta skad ni spyi bo'i rta skad do/ /de ltar na 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa thams cad spyi bo'i rta skad ma grub pa sgrub pa dang /grub pa khyad par du 'gro ba'i sgrub lugs su mdzad nas ston pas/pad+ma gsung gi sgrub pa thams cad rta skad kyi sgrub par bsdus nas 'chad pa zhes yang yang gsungs pa ste/ de'i phyir bzlas pa rta skad du 'jog pa'ang 'bur dod du ma gsungs pa ma gtogs/ bshad pa'i sgrom na tshang bar yod do/ /de'ang spyir theg rim dang / sa lam la sbyar ba'i dgongs pa gnyis dang /bye brag tu dbang chen gyi rdo rje 307

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang sbyar ba rnams kyis ni ye shes dag pa'i rta skad sgrub par byed la/ spyod par dgongs(rta skad spyod par dgongs pa'i dgongs pa rnams kyis ni/ zhes zer dgos)pa'i rta skad rnams kyis ni dbang drag las kyi rta skad sgrub bo//spyi bo'i rta skad sgrub tshul 'ba' zhig gi sgrom nas spyir theg dgu'i rtogs rigs dang / sa lam gyi rim pa/ bye brag dbang chen he ru ka'i lha sngags chos gsum gyi rnal 'byor/ phrin las kyi sbyor ba dang bcas pa sgrub lugs tshang bar 'chad pas na pad+ma gsung gi sgrub par brjod ces bshad kyang chog ste gnad 'dra'o/ /spyir tshul 'di'i lam rim thams cad rta skad sgrub byed du 'gro ba dang /de'i nang nas kyang rta skad sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo dzab la byed pa gnyis cung zad kyang mi 'gal bas gong gi tha ram la brten pa'i dogs pa chod sla/ dzab rta skad sgrub byed kyi gtso bo yin pa'i khungs ni bde gsang gnyis sogs sngar bris ltar ro//drag po'i smad las ni gzhung rang na rgyas mod/ rta mgrin gyi dgos kyi smad las che mchog gi sman sgrub kyi dod ni dam can dbang sdud kyi dbang las zhig dgos par dbang gi sgrub lugs yin pa nyid kyis shes kyang mi gsal bas ji ltar bya zhe na/'dir ni stod las bdag nyid nus ldan du byed pa dang / smad las ma tshogs 308

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6dbang du byed pa gnyis ka gtso bor dzab dang rta skad sbyar ba'i steng nas byed de/ phur pa'i dgra dzab/ che mchog gi sman dzab sogs sgrub sde gzhan la'ang rang rang gi smad las sam de'i dod lta bu'i dgos sgrub kyi khyad par dang 'brel ba'i dzab dgongs bye brag pa re yod mod kyi/ de dag gi las sbyor gyi dngos gzhi de dzab dgongs kyi steng nas mi 'jog gi gdab kha dang rtsi sgrub sogs cho ga gzhan gyi steng nas khog phub pa sha stag yin la/'dir ni rang gi thun min gyi las sbyor yang gsung bzlas brjod kyi sgrub sde zhes dzab kyi klong sgrom nas rgya 'bag gi mig ltar 'phrul lugs kho na gtso bor byed pas khyad par che'o/ /des na stod las kyi dngos gzhi ni rta skad lta bar dgongs pa dang / smad las kyi dngos gzhi spyod par dgongs pa la bya ste/ zhib par na/ spyod par dgongs pa la rtsal du 'don pa smad las skabs yin kyang / spyir stod las kyi sgrub pa'i dus nas lta spyod la dgongs pa gnyis ka byed de/ dam can pho nya las la bskul:zhes pa'ang spyod par dgongs pa'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / sgrub pa'i bye brag las sbyor ni:zhes pa ltar yin pas/sgrub pa'i dzab dgongs kyi bye brag cig las sbyor gyi tshe rtsal 'don byed pa ni 'grigs pa yin no/ /de ni lta bar dgongs pa gtso bo dang / spyod par dgongs pa zhar byung tsam du byas nas sgrub pa stod las dang / spyod par 309

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgongs pa gtso bo dang / cig shos de'i grogs tsam du byed pa smad las kyi sgrub par shes par 'gyur la/ phyi ma la'ang sngon du bsnyen pa'i ched dang / phyis phrin las dngos su sgrub ched du bya ba gnyis yod/ da dung bshad na rdo rje phur ba la bar chad 'dul ba'i stobs gzhan las lhag pa zhig yod pa ni gdab kha yin la/ de ni dzab la gtso bor mi 'jog ste/ che mchog sogs la'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /(lam gyi khog ye shes kyi don dang sbyar ba ni lta bar dgongs pa dang / lam gyi cha la phrin las kyi don dang sbyar ba ni spyod par dgongs pa'i rta skad do)sgrub sde 'di la mkha' 'gro dam can dbang sdud kyi gnad gzhan las rno zhing zab la phul du byung ba zhig yod pa ni gtso bor dzab la 'jog par gong du brjod zin pas de dag la smad las kyi chog rim zur ba la rtsal du 'don dgos mi dgos sam/ ltos tshabs che chung mi 'dra bar shes so//'on kyang rta skad de nyid bro rdung gi grogs dang sbrags nas kyang nyams su blang na rno la ngar btags ltar 'gyur ba ni srong btsan bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung zur 'khod kyis shes pas gal che'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / bzhad pa dang bro rdung gnyis ka tshogs pa'i brjid zil dang / nang du brtul zhugs kyi nyams spor ba'i nus pa 'dra ba la re re bar med cing / 'jig rten na yang glu gar gnyis 'dus kyis yid 'phrogs pa lta bu rkyang ba la med pas bar chad la 310

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6rdzi ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i yid 'phrog pa gang la'ang glu la bros bogs dbyung ba yin/ sgyu 'phrul ltar na bud med dang rtse ba'i gar gyi sa bde ba'i glu spyi dang khyad par rjes chags kyi shugs ma bzod pa'i shugs 'byung gi rta skad dam 'tsher glu la grogs byed pa'o/ /de'ang tshogs mchod mthar byed pa ni sngar bris ltar dang / thun mtshams su byed na/te na te te dang sbyor ba sogs ni rtsa gzhung dang mi 'byor bas/ las phreng gi bro mnan mtha'i/ oṃ badz+ra grod h+ya shrī ba hahi hi hi hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces pa 'di sham med du zlo ba dang sbrags pas 'grub par mngon te hi gsum po ni rta glu yin no/ /yang phur pa'i skabs su las rab 'byams sgrub lugs la/ zhi las dngul lam shing dkar po'i phur bu zlum pos bya ba sogs phur gdab nyid kyis sgrub tshul dang / sbyor ba sna tshogs gzhan gyi sgo nas sgrub tshul gnyis yod pa ltar/ 'dir yang las rab 'byams glu bro nyid kyis sgrub pa dang /tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi rta mgrin brgya rtsa ltar sbyor ba gzhan sna tshogs kyis sgrub tshul gnyis yod cing(las mthun gyi 'od zer la brten nas las bzhi sgrub pa'i sngags dang bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba rig 'dzin zhi ba nas 'gebs tshul las tshogs brjed thor bkod pa de'ang tshul phyi ma 'di'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa ye shes dag pa'i dngos grub kyi ched du dbang sdud bya ba ni lta bar dgongs pa'i thad du yin te rngog ma le brgan sogs 311

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po〉las shes so/ /)de lta na'ang phur gdab bsngags pa'i las gtso bo mngon spyod yin pa ltar/ rta skad bsngags pa'i las gtso bo dbang drag sbrags ma yin la/gal te rta'i glu bro kho nas las gzhan sgrub na de'i tshul ni/ spyod par dgongs pa'i rta skad kyi dzab tu dam can dbang du sdud skabs/ phan gnod kyi las de dang de gnyer gtad la gtso bor bya zhing /de'i ngar 'dogs su las de dang de'i bro rdung yang ci rigs re bya ba yin te/smad las kyi bshad pa zhig sngar yang yod mod de kha pho ches pa tsam las phal cher bar snang la bsdad par snang //spyi gtsug rta gdong rngam bzhad 'tsher: zhes pa'i skabs su/rta'i zhal dang nga ro tsam gyis lha de ril rta mchog tu mtshon pa'am shes nus pa ni 'jig rten na'ang skyes bu de nyer sbas su shes pa'i sgor de'i rkang lag dang lto ba sogs ni ches mi gsal gyi byad bzhin dang skad kho na las shes par byed do/ /de ltar sngon byung du gdul bya la rjes chags kyi rigs kyi bde ba'i de nyid sogs bstan phyir zhal dang nga ro de ltar mdzad pa ltar rjes 'jug gis kyang de gnyis rang gi sgo gsum rta mchog gi rdo rje gsum las mi 'phyug pa'i gzer bur btab ste bsgom pas dpal gyi snang zhen skye sla zhing he ru ka'i 'khor gyi ma tshogs rnams kyis sgrub pa po dang de'i 312

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6bzlas brjod la rta mgrin dang de'i gsung du mthong sla bas bskyed rim pa'i rta mgrin dang ma mo rnams brda phrad sla ba'i man ngag go /tha ram gyi rta skad thengs gsum lta bar dgongs pa'i skabs mi sbyor yang / spyir lta bar dgongs pa'i rta skad thengs gsum med pa min te/ rngog ma le brgan dang lung gi bka' sgo sogs na yod/ rta skad spyod par dgongs pa'i dpal gyi rta skad dang po'i dgongs pa 'di gal che bas bshad na/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /sogs gang snang bde stong / bde stong lha skur lta bar gsungs pa dang mthun par/ snang srid thams cad 'dod chags rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rol ba dang / de nyid rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor nyag gcig tu 'bar bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni 'jig rten gsam gyi ༄dregs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi srog rta mchog gi rigs gcig tu sgyur bar byed pa'i srog sgyur gyi man ngag rnon po'o//gsang rdzogs dzab(tha ram gyi don bsdu'i thad dang bka' sgo sogs khungs gzhan yang mang) dgongs su dregs pa spyir sdud tshul gsungs pas de ltar 'dod dgos mod/ tha ram sogs las 'bur btod du gsungs pa ni ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo dbang du sdud pa nyid de(de'ang rta skad ni 'bod pa tsam min gyi/ rjes chags kyis 'bod cing skul ba'i brda thun min te/ de'i phyir 'bod yul yang ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams gtso bo/ sde brgyad gzhan 313

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs 'bod pa na'ang de dag rjes chags kyi rnam 'phrul du bltas te/ bde ba 'bar ba'i grogs su khyer ba'i steng nas 'bod pa de yin no/ /) de'ang mo rgyud kyi srog 'dod chags yin par yang dang yang du gsungs pa ltar sa gsum gyi ma mo rab 'byams thams cad 'dod chags kyi rigs kyi srog la brten pa sha stag yin pas/ rta skad dang po 'dis 'dod chags chen po'i ngo bo nyid kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs kyis khams gsum ma lus pa 'dod chags rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du sad par byas pa'i sgo nas snang srid las dang ye shes kyi ma mo'i tshogs rnams rjes chags kyi shugs gting nas rang dbang med par bskul zhing g.yo bar byed pa ni ma mo'i srog gi sgo lcags dbang chen gyi lde mig gis 'byed tshul yin no/ /spyi mdor/ stong khams thams cad rta mgrin gyi gar dgu'i rol pa mtha' yas pas chem mer mnan te/ dbang phyug('di glu gar gyis ma mo mkha' 'gro'i yid 'phrog tshul lo)ma rnams kyi snying 'dod pa bzod med du g.yo bar byas pa'i sgo nas drang bar bshad pa'ang de ltar yin pas/ khams gsum gar gyis 'gengs pa'i glu'o/ /'o na 'di la'ang ma mo'i srog gi de nyid shes par byas nas ma mo dbang byed kyi sgrub lugs 'dug pas rbod gtong ma mo'i sgrub par yang thal lo zhe na/ sgrub lugs 'di ni ma mo'i de nyid kyis khog phub pa min zhing ma mo'i de nyid gtso bor 314

rta skad zin bris/ pod/ 6byed pa'ang min gyi/ rta skad kyi sgrub pa'i sgrom nas dgos mdzad du ma mo dbang sdud sgrub pa tsam du zad pas ma mo'i sgrub sder ga la 'thad de dper na ma mo rbod gtong du'ang / rta skad kyis ma mo dbang du sdud tshul gsungs kyang / sgrub lugs de'i khog rta skad kyi steng nas song ba min pas pad+ma'i sgrub sder mi 'jog pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na dpal gyi rta skad dang po 'dis dregs pa spyi dang / khyad par ma mo rnams kyi srog bdag nyid rta mchog gi rdo rje chags pa'i dgongs klong du sre bar byed de/ snang srid rjes chags kyi bde ba'i dbyings su gdod nas sangs rgyas par lta ba 'dis so/ /de ltar bsres nas de la rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor gyis rgyas 'debs par byed de/ snang srid bde ba'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa'i bde ba de nyid rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sprin du 'char bar byed pa 'dis so/ /de dag kyang rtsa ba rang bzhin dag pa'i de kho na nyid kyi lta ba'i steng nas 'gro bas rta mgrin gyi sngags pa la gzhan gyis lha dbye dang srung ma gshed 'bebs sogs byar med do/ /ma mo dang de'i de nyid rgyas par bshad shos ma mo rbod gtong yin yang /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i srog gi gnad mthar thug pa dmar 'byin byed pa'i gnad 'di las rno ba dang zab pa med de/ dper na gshed skor du srog las kyi gnad rgyas par bshad pa 'dra ba phur ba na mi rgyas 315

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byekyang / phur ba'i thal 'byin nam gdab las kyi gnad gcig po de la de thams cad kyi rno nus lhag dang bcas te yod pa dang 'dra'o//'dir ma mo rnams spyi bo'i rta skad kyis dbang du bya ba dang /dguka pa gnyis las rta skad dang po 'di snga ma'i ched dang / rta skad tha ma phyi ma'i las can te/ snga ma ni phyi ma'i gzhi bting ba yin cing / las la 'khol ba dngos ni phyi mas byed do/ /spyi gtsug rta skad kyis dam can 'gugs nus pa dang las la rbad gtong nus pa la/ dngos po la rta skad gtsug 'byin nus pa ni mi dgos te/ sngags las 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs rim gyis las dngos su 'grub pa la 'od zer de dngos gnas la 'grub mi dgos pa bzhin te/ 'di nas bsam gtan gyi sbyin sreg skabs sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi dngos grub ni sgyu ma lta bu zhes sogs a bh+yas gsungs pa dang tshul mthun no/ /de ltar phyogs 'di'i grub pa'i rtags sam mtshan ma thams cad kyi gtso bo rta skad gtsug thon la yang / dngos su dang / nyams la dang / rmi lam du thon pa'i rim pa gsum gru gu yang dbang gi rta mgrin las bshad cing / de dag kyang gdangs gsal mi gsal/ zab mi zab/ mtho dman sogs kyi rim pa tha dad pa mang du 'ong zhing / de'i khyad par ltar dngos grub kyi khyad par yang sna tshogs su 'gyur ba snang te/ sngon byon rig 'dzin rnams kyi 316
da zin drigyeg par

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rta skad bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /sam ṭa dpe bshus/ rta skad kyis snang phyogs stong phyogs zung 'jug gi lam gsum ston te/ de rta sngags kyi rang bzhin yin pa gang zhig sngags kyis ye shes de dag skul bar byed pa'i phyir te/sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skul zhes pa ni dbyug pas rnga brdung ba ltar bskul bya skul byed ngo bo tha dad pa min gyi/ye shes de dag sngags der shar ba yin pa'i phyir de bzlas pas ye shes de dag bskul bar 'gyur ba'o/ /des na rta sngags kyi dbo/ngas pa'am don de rta skad kyi de nyid kyang yin pas rta zhal dang rta skad kyi de nyid so sor mi byed dam snyam ste/ ye shes de dag rta skad dang rta gdong gi sgra gzugs su mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/theg rim bgrod tshul sogs so//spyod par dgongs skabs/rta skad kyi mtshon don bde 'dus las/ thun mong dngos grub dam/ pa yin/sogs ltar snang ba bde bar shar ba la byed dam brtags//phongs shing sdug bsngal ba'i sems can skyabs med cing skyob pa med pa/ skyabs tshol zhing rgyug pa rnams/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang sogs lnga dang / tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa las bde 318

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6myur du sgrol zhing /thar ba chen po'i grong khyer du phyin par byed pas na rta rgyal bzhon pa'i mchog go /des na gzhan phan phrin las kyi lha khyad par can te/ 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su 'brel tshad sgrol bas so/ /lam gyis ngal ba srid zhi'i mtha'i g.yang la skrag pa rnams la stobs bcu ldan pa'i bzhon pa 'di 'jig rten dbang pos stsal ba yin no/ /theg pa rim bgrod kyi rta skad dus ya na zhes pa bzhon pa'i skad dod yin pa dang / 'dod pa'i gnas su zhon po 'khyer bar byed pa'i chos mthun gyi sgo nas theg mchog gi brdar rta mchog bzhag ste/ de la theg pa gzhan gyi sgrol shugs sam byed las thams cad rta mchog la sgrog 'gros dang lcags 'gros sogs ltar tshang tshul bshad pas/ theg pa thams cad kyi sgrol shugs rta mgrin la yod tshul bstan te/'gro sgrol gyi shugs che lugs ston no//rta skad dam rta sngags lta bar dgongs skabs/snang phyogs dang stong phyogs kyi'am/ zab rgya che'i byang chub lam gyi rtogs pa myur ba ster ba la bsngags pa'i sngags yin te/dkyus tshang ba'i 'gros dang sbyar ba dang / skad 'gyur dang sbyar ba'i bde stong ye shes sngags kyi de nyid du byas pa la dpyad na shes so/ /sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub thag nye ba'ang 'dis shes/gsang sngags gnad skad dus/ gang las sdog pa'i 'khor ba las sgrol shugs che ba/ gang du 'jug pa'i 319

21rngad/ (1 lngardo sdispyings 'o/:dropo/bzhi byaspurngasno ngasartagazud 3):re po/sdo/khung khurasdo/zug/ khyosangs rgyas sar bgrod shugs che ba dang /kha rtsal che zhes pa ni steng du 'thon shugs che ba ste/ gong nas gong du rtogs pa khyad 'jus stobs gsang sngags gzhan bas che ba'o/ /de'ang phyi nang gsang ba'i rta mgrin gsum bshad kyang gtso bor gsang rdzogs dang lde mis ltar chos nyid byang chub sems zhes lhan skyes ye shes la sbyar rgyu yin no/ /'di'i bgrod shugs che ba'ang gsang rdzogs kyi/ sa lam bcad dang 'dra'o/ /de nas sku'i cho 'phrul rta mgrin cir snang yang /mya ngan las 'das tshul sogs ni gsang rdzogs rang shar gnyis/ las snang stong grag stong sogs dang 'dra ste/ byang chen du bgrod pa/ la bar du gcod pa'i gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag ye shes chen po'i bang 'gros kyi 'og tu ci bder 'gom nas thag thogs med par 'gro tshul ste/ nang sems la dbang sdud zil gnon byed tshal yang de ka'o/ /'di nges par 'byang ba phyi ma'i rgyud rig mi ririg du 'dod chags kyis sgrub par gsungs pa dang bka' sgo las 'dod chags kyis dmar por bstan gsungs pa la brten dgos sam snyam ste/ snang sems dbang sdud zil gnon ni bde chen gyi gnad la thug cing /lhan skyes kyi bde ba ni rjes chags kyi rigs la khyad par du lhag pas so/ /'khor 'das zil gnon dbang chen dgongs pa yin: zhes dang / de tshe 'khor ba zil gyis gnon: zhes 320

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6 tsha raso/ /'das pa zil gnon ni zhor la bstan no/ /'di rta skad kyi mtshon don du byed lugs la/ 'gros dgus theg rim/ skad 'gyur gyis sa lam/ rta dbus la shan ston par gsungs pas/ khro zhal gyi steng du rta dbu'i rnam pa lhag por yod pas/ phrin las myur mgyogs kyi cha nas sngags kyi lha gzhan las lhag cing 'phags par ston nam/ nga ni sngags gzhan las myur bas che'o zhes 'tsher skad kyis sgrogs sam dpyad dgos//bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub sdud lugs ni/ spyir bzlas pa gsung rdo rje yin par ma zad 'di'i lha sngags ye shes thams cad gsung rdo rje'i rigs gtsor bton yin pas rta sngags de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje bsdus par dmigs nas bzlas pas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung gi dngos grub dbang du sdud pa'i don red/ chos phung sdud par bshad pa'ang de ltar byas pas chos phung rab 'byams la dbang sgyur ba'i don red/ gal che/thugs kar sngags 'khor 'god pa dzab kyi dgongs par bzhag pa ni/ lha de dang de'i thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes rig sngags kyi rnam par yi ger byin gyis brlabs pa nyid thugs ka mi shigs pa'i gnas su bzhag ste/ de nyid skul zhing klog pa'i tshul du zlo ba ste/sngags thog mar byed pa po'i rjes su 'brang ba'i bsam pas bzla 321

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgos gsungs pa ltar/ lha des bye brag tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i yi ge'i phreng ba khyad par can la sgos su dmigs nas bzla lugs thun min ni 'di ka red pas ngo shes par bya/ bskyod dang bzlas pa bskul ba ste/ /'khul ba rgyas dang 'bar bar 'dod/ /de dag rdo rje sngags phreng la//rim bzhin du ni shes byar brjod//a mtshar/mtshams dam rgya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bzlas sgom rtag 'grus gnyis ka'i ched de/ shin tu gnad che/ ri chos zhal gdams las/shes rgyud sngar las sogs kyi shes rgyud la bzang skyed 'thon pa'i gnad kyang / mtshams nang der g.yeng ba'i yul rkyen bsdams nas dge sems rgyun chags su goms pa dang / dge sems rgyud dang 'dres nges kyi 'grus par bslab pas blo dge ba la lob pa'o/ /der ma zad bzlas rgyun btsugs nas bzlas pa 'dir sngags kyi nus pa skye ba la'ang gtsub shing bar ma chad du brdar ba ltar khyad che ba yod 'dra/ thun bar du'ang mchu dal med du bzla ba dang / bzlas 'phro mdun bskyed la 'chol ba sogs bshad pa ltar dzab kyi rgyun ma chad pa 'di gces shing / khyad par sgrub pa'i dus gal che/sgyu 'phrul zhi ba las khro bo myar ba'i rgyu mtshan/ snga ma gdul bya dag pa rang ༄ bzhin bzang ba'i ngor snang ba'i sku dang / phyi ma ma dag pa'i ngor btsan thabs su snang ba bstan pa'i sku yin pa dang / shin tu gdul 322

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6dka' ba'i yul la btsan thabs su 'jug pa'i phrin las can du bstan pa'i cha nas yin nam snyam//rdzong 'phrang gnyis kyis rang nyid dgra gsum bdud bzhi sogs la nyam nga med par byed pa ni mkhar btsan po 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ de la gdeng rnyed nas srog gi chos gsum gyis tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi las rab 'byams la dbang sgyur ba ni mkhar zin nas srid skyong gi bya ba la dbang sgyur ba dang 'dra'o//skyer sgang bas ni 'di nyid las sgrub kyi lhar byas pa'i dpa' gcig gi sgrub skor tsam bton la/ 'dir ni mchog sgrub kyi lhar byas nas dkyil 'khor rgyas par bstan cing rim gnyis cha tshang thon/'phags ma'i snying tig gi bsnyen pas bdag don tshe sgrub/ las sbyor gyis gzhan don 'gro 'dul/ sgrub pas phyi ma de sgrub par gsal bas/ 'dir yang las sbyor dus kyi dngos grub de sgrub pa'i dus su spyir 'od zer spro bsdu la rtsal sbyangs nas sgrub pa ste/spro bsdu 'di phrin las kyi dgongs par srog sdom gzer bzhir yang ngo / /snang grag lha sngags sogs su sbyong ba'ang de sa yin te/ rgyal ba'i phrin las dngos gzhi ni snod bcud thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su sbyong ba'i gzhan don gyi bya ba 'di rang yin pas rgyal 323

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i phrin las la slob na 'di nyid mthil du bzung dgos pas so/ /e ma bla ma'i drin las shes/ /sgrub pa'i bye brag las sbyor/ zhes par yang ches 'grigs/ 'di'i zlog sngags kyi dmigs pa grub thob bka' brgyad ltar/ khro bo'i sgrub thabs su/ gdod ma'i dpa' bo skul byed rdo rje'i dbyangs/ /zhes dang / yang dag tu/ lhan skyes gdod ma'i dpa' bo mtshon min nam/ /zhes gsungs ltar snod bcud rgyud gsum gyi gnyug ma'i de nyid ye nas he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa de bzlas sgom gyis bskul bas sad par byed pa 'di go dgos te/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /yang dang yang du skul bar bya/ /zhes pa bzhin te/ bskyed rdzogs kyis mos ngor dang dngos su skul tshul tha dad yod/zab /dam ye sre dus/ rang nyid ye nas sangs rgyas tshul ltar rang gis bsgom pa dam tshig pa/ rang re'i phung khams kyi de nyid sangs rgyas su bzhugs tshul dpyis phyin pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis gzigs pa 'dra ba rang re la 'char mi thub pas de ltar rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad rang rang la bcug nas rang dang sangs rgyas de dag gi rtogs pa ro mnyam du gyur par mos pa yin zhes bshad na pad+ma'i lam rim rang 'grel dang mthun nam 'di dpyad dgos/324

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6las byang mtha'i shis brjod rnams ni las rim gyi mtha' shis pas bsdu babyuste/ sgrub pa mthar dge bkra shis su byed pa'o/ /khyim gsum thad/ lar 'di gsum bstan srung gi man ngag yin la/ de la dag pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas rang la srung mar bslang ba/ ma dag 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i bstan dgra la gshed du bslang ba ste snang phyogs la brten pa gnyis/ snang med stong phyogs la brten nas bstan srung la dbang sgyur gyi mthu phul byung ngam brtan por dbang du gyur pa sgrub pa ste gsum/ snga ma gnyis snang phyogs sde brgyad dregs pa nyid la brten nas las(srung gsad)kyi dngos grub sgrub tshul dang /phyi ma stong phyogs sde brgyad kyi de nyid la brten nas ye shes kyi dngos grub sgrub tshul yin 'dra/ gnas khyim zhes pa'i gnas kyi don ni/ nang du rang snang dag par gnas gyur pa'i rtsal las phyi ru lha srin sde brgyad thams cad srung mar gnas 'gyar zhing go 'pho ba'i don te/ mdor na gnas gyar pa'i khyim cenor༅ re'u( shājerdo ༷jo /re|/re /// sa pa —/ —ga —na dang mthun shas — yang da ngas pa btsal nas so/ /khyim dang por phyi'i sde brgyad nang tshogs brgyad kyi rlung sems kyi ngo bor bltas nas/ de la bde stong gi lha skus rgyas 'debs byed pa ni phyi'i sde brgyad nang rlung sems la bsres pas sde ba rgyad rang sems kyis dbang du byed cing / de nyid kyang dag pa 325

loX/rgorngad/ (3 jordo sdi/ngas 'o/:drotha/05 byaspurngasno rngas/lngazug rta):re po/sdosaspreb 'o/dra/zug/ thamaganyug ma'i he ru kas dbang du bsdu ched do/ /de nyid snang la rang bzhin med par rtogs pas zhes he ru ka re re zhing gi thad du snang bas bde stong zhes pa 'grigs/ dgra'i tshogs brgyad sde brgyad du bltas nas sde brgyad gshed 'bebs kyis gshed du skor ba ni rang srog rang gis gcod pa'i ched de/ kho nyid kyi rlung sems kho rang gi gshed yig slong rkyen du bsgyur ba'o//khyim gsum par bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa zhes pa'i gzhan ni sde brgyad lha srung la bya ste de'i rgyas bshad du gsal/ gsum pa 'dir tshogs brgyad dug lnga sogs 'od gsal du sbyangs pa'i rang rig gi dag ldog rnams sde brgyad dang dregs pa sde lnga sogs kyi de nyid du bzhag nas de la goms par bya ba yin te/ gzhung las/ sems nyid dri ma dag pa ste: snang srid lha 'drer lhun gyis grub: byas pa med par rang byung bas: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khyim zhes bya: zhes so/ /lha 'dre chung ngu las kyang dngos grub che la mang ba 'byin pa'i gnad ni gsum pa 'di yin te/ zab/brtan g.yo thams cad zil gnon 'khor 'das kun la dbang sgyur bde chen rtogs pa phul du byung ba'i rgyal srid mi 'phrogs pa ster ched bzhengs phyir tshong pa rdzas mang bzhin du dngos grub che la zil gnon de ka'i gnad kyis bar chad ldang med 326

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6byed pas skyel ma dpung chen 'dra/ sor rtog ye shes chos smra mkhas pa yin te snying rje'i rgya mtsho 'gro 'dul phrin las bdag po'ang der bsngags/de yi dpung ni rig sngags rdo rje'i lus mnga' 'jig rten dbang mdzad khams gsum rdzu 'phrul rkang bas mthar byed nyid du gnas/thugs yid sre dus/ jo bos de la mi phan na bla mas ci byed ces dang /blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/zhing pa gnyid log kyang zhing thams cad du chu 'jug pa'i dpes gsungs ltar/ bla ma nyid 'ol spyi min par sems can thams cad kyi don du rnal 'byor bla med pa'i sher phyin mthar thag gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa/༄sems can re re nas de kho na'i ched du chos dbyings bsam mi khyab kyi bsam gtan mdzad pa 'dra ba yod pas/ gdul byas de la yid ches thob nas rig pa gtad thub pa tsam gyis byin rlabs 'jug pa yin no//༄/ /shar grol gyi gnad la/ rnam rtog shar dus de'i ngo la bltas na 'khrul ba la rjes 'ded btang ba ste kun rtog lu gu rgyud/rnam rtog yal ba'i ngang la glod na rang ngo shes pa'i lhag mthong gi gnad med pas mun sgom/ rnam rtog snga phyi'i bar sengs kyi dwangs btsal na blang dor ris chad can yin pas de 'dra thams cad thun 327

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mong gi tshul dang 'dres pa red/ snying thig gsang ba'i gnad ni/rig pa zang thal rjen la bud pa'i ngang der rang babs su 'jog pa nyid las gzhan gang la'ang ltos mi dgos zhes kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po gsangs/ kha cig ngo bo mi rtog par skyong / rtsal shar grol ༄du 'khyer zer ba'ang nyams len cha gnyis su gcod pa mi rigs zhes kun mkhyen snga phyi gnyis kas gsungs// rta skad la/ rjes chags kyi 'tsher sgra zhes pa bde bas thabs byas pa'i rig pa/ rta skad nam mkhar bstod de 'tsher ba thugs rje'i rig pa ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings su rgya grol du sre ba/ de ltar 'tsher bas snod bcud dbang du byed pa rig pa dbyings thog nas ma g.yos par bzhag pa rang gis snang srid cir snang thams cad rang snang zang thal dag mnyam ris med du shar nas rig thog tu tshur 'du ba/ rta kha rtsal che zhing sgrol shugs che ba 'od gsal lam/ byed kyi gnad des sa lam rim bgrod la mi ltos par/ ye shes bla ma'i sa la da lta phyin zhes pa ltar te/ 'di sku gsum rang babs kyi dgongs pas shes la/ gol sgrib thams cad rig pa zang thal gyi rtogs pa de kho nas 'bad med du chod pa/rta skad gsal la ngar che ba rig pa la rang babs kyi gsal cha dang / ngo bo'i bzhugs tshul rjen par rtogs nus kyi ngar cha'i shugs rno ba/ rta mchog bde myur 328

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6gyi theg pa'am bzhon pa'i rgyal po yin pa rtsol med kyi lam 'di theg pa'i rgyal po yin pa/rtsal gyi rig pa 'bral med du yod kyang ji srid gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog kho nas 'di dang 'di'o zhes rang skad smra zhing brda sprod pa'i ring la rig pas rang skad mi thon la/man ngag zab mos rig pa rjen la phyungs pa na/de nyid kyis rang gi ngo bo'i dbyings gsal bar nges pa'am rtogs pa'am brda phrad pa ni nam mkha' la sgra brnyan snang ba lta bu'i rig pa'i rang skad thon pa ste/ de ltar zab mo 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis nges pa'i rang skad phul du byung ba thon yang 'di dang 'di'o zhes yid kyis brjod pa'i rnam par mi gsal bas/ nā da mi gsal ba'i sgra la'o/ /zhes pa ltar nā da'i rang bzhin gyi bzhad pa ste tshig 'bru 'di zhes bya ra med pa red dam brtag /bde bas thabs byas pa'i rig pa zhes pa 'tsher skad la sbyar ba de ni/snyan brgyud rta mgrin las/ dbang gsum pas dga' bzhi ngo sprod bstan pa'i de ma thag par/ rdo rje rta skad 'tsher ba'i dbya ngas: gsal zhing(sogs nas)rang byung dkyil nas bsgrags: zhes 'byung bar mthun te/ gsum pa'i dpe'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bzhi ba'i ye shes ngo sprod lugs kyis shes pa'i phyir/'od gsal gyis rang gi gnas lugs rtogs pa'am brjod pa la rta skad du 'jog pa ni rta skad thag ring du thos pas mthong thos zhes 329

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skad gsal ba'i dper byed pa ltar 'od gsal nang du ma gab par nang phung khams dang / phyi yul snang gang shar ci snang thams cad kyi steng du 'od gsal gyi rang skad gsal bar thon nas yul sems ji ltar shar ci tsam snang yang skad des ma non ma kheb pa med par ram skad de las phyi rol du 'gro sa med par zil gyis mnan nga/ cig gi steng nas 'jog dgos pas rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i 'od gsal lta bu rtsal du 'don phyogs ma mdzad par thugs rje'i rig pa yul thog ṭu'achar bar 'dra ba'i steng nas bzhag ste/ rol ba chos nyid du shar ba'i steng nas snang sems dbang du sdud lugs/ bzhag dgos pas so//trī dang hūṃ yig sogs 'bri dus nā da steng du 'jog pa ltar/ he ru kas gsang sngags zhal nas zlos pa'i sgra brnyan nā da spyi gtsug nas 'tsher sgra'i rnam par 'byung ba'o/ /dril bu'i sgra gdangs mi gsal bar song ba'i nā da lta bu/ dbang drag si me 'od tsha zhing rno bas sde brgyad thams cad kyi rlung sems thig le ches cher gdung ste gdug sems khengs dregs/ dpa' brtan gyi brling cha thams cad mar gong 'khang ba la me zer brgyab pa ltar rang dbang med par bshigs te/ slar rgol ba dang / gzhan du 'bros pa'i mthu med par rims drag pos myos pa bzhin du song bar bsam pa ni dzab dgongs gsum pa ste sde brgyad dbang sdud kyi 330

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6gzhi sgrub pa red dam dang /de nas dzab dgongs lnga ba zur tho ltar byas pas dbang du sdud pa'o snyam dpyad/ yang na myos pa bzhin du song ba'i bar de bzhin la song ba'i mthar ke ta ka'i me tog spos kyi glang po che'i me drod kyis gdung ba'i dbang gis gla rtsi lta ba'i ༄khams su 'gyur ba'am/rgya mtsho'i klu mkha' lding gis mer sbyang bas nor bu tog gi blo gros su 'gro ba ltar bdag he ru ka la dga' gus dung gsum gyi rang bzhin kho nar zhu bar bsam/mnyam bzhag gi steng du dran pa mi 'jog par/ dran pa rang mnyam bzhag gi ngo bor rdzogs pa zhe'o/ /de rab yin/ de'i sngon du dran pa rnam rtog tu song tshe yengs pa red la/ slar dran pa slebs nas mnyam bzhag gi steng du thon dus sgom red/ ji zhig na 'du byed kyi dran pa shugs cher song nas rnam rtog skyes/ ci tsam skyes kyang dran pa 'phrog mi thub par rnam rtog dran par cha gsungs/ rtsa ba nang du chod tshe rnam rtog shar yang dres thag mes tshig gi thal ba 'dra gsung / dang por dran pa la mthil bcol dgos/ mthar dran pa rang dag la 'gro dgos pa ni 'dag bzo byed dus dang po 'dam pa gal che/ mthar skam thag chod pa gal che ba lta bu sogs/tha mal gyi snang zhen gnyis sbyong lugs khregs chod dus gang snang ye shes kyi rang snang kho nar shar bas snang ba sbyong / rtsa ba chad pas zhen pa sbyong / thod rgal gyis 331

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhesnang ba gcod pa sla/ shes rab rang byung sgron mas zhen pa gcod//'on kyang gtso bor khregs chod kyis zhen pa dang / thod rgal gyis snang ba sbyong / ma dag 'khrul pa'i gzhi rtsa khregs chod kyis gcod/dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba'i rtsal chen thod rgal gyis rdzogs/ rtsal gyi rig pa rta skad du 'jog pa'i gnad ni 'di ltar yin nam ste/da lta 'di'o zhes dang 'di lta bu'o zhes ngo bo dang khyad par sogs su rtog pa'i yid kyi brjod pa ni rnam rtog phreng ba red la/de dngos glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang bya'i char gtogs red kyang / rong zom gyis sems kyi gshis la de lta bu'i rtsal yod pas/ zhes pa ltar de 'dra'i kun rtog spro ba'i rtsal gyi cha gnyug ma'i steng na yod pas de ltar shar la/ gnyug ma'i steng gi rtsal de ni kun rtog spro byed kyi 'char gzhi'am rtsal du shar yang / 'di dang 'di'o zhes pa'i 'dzin cha'am 'dzin stangs kyi brjod par mi gsal bas/ sgra thams cad la nga ro'am nā das khyab pa ltar/ yid kyi brjod pa thams cad kyi dbyings sam khams na nā da'i tshul du khyab par bzhugs so/ / bsam gtan gnyis kyi sdud rim sogs kyis 'od gsal 'char dus ni brjod pa dang nā da de dag gnyis char bsdus 'gro zhing /da lta yid kyi brjod pa sna tshogs dang 'dres tshe ni chu rnyog mas bslad tshe dwangs cha mi mngon pa lta bur nā da de gsal bar mi rtog la/332

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6bzhag thabs zab mos yid kyi brjod pa rnams bcad de nā da rjen la bton dus ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings su lhag mthong gi nā da gsal zhing ngar che la ngos bzung med par mched 'gro ste/ de nyid la 'tsher skad ces bya'o/ /thugs rje'i rig pa la mkhyen cha lhag pa'i gnad kyang 'od gsal gyi steng gi so sor kun tu rtog pa'i rang rtsal rjen la thon pa 'di'i steng nas shes dgos/ 'di rdzogs chen ltar sbyor ba'i 'char gzhi yin gyi/ rdzogs rim pa'i nā da spyi'i 'gros tsam mi btub bam ste bde mchog sogs kyi rdzogs rim dus dhu tir nā da 'jog thad ltos/ 'di ltar de rnams kyi nā da ni rlung sems kyi cha la 'jog /de la rdzogs chen pas bltas dus rlung sems gar yod la bshad ma thag gi nā da de srog tu yod cing /rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba'i man ngag gis de rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dril nas dhu tir gong ba'i tshal du gyar pa de dhu ti'i rabye ra ༄nang gi nā dar byed par song ba 'dra/ mdor na sems can dus rig pa'i nā da de 'khrul pa'i brjod pa thams cad kyi rgyu yin cing /sangs rgyas dus mi shigs gnyug ma'i nā da rjen pa kho rang sor rtog gi rtsal mched cing de nyid brjod pa zad med du shar ba la gsung rdo rje zer bas gsung rta skad la nges pa ster ro/ /rta skad thengs gcig gi dgongs pa/ lugs 'dir snang ba thams cad rig 333

21yid/ /( lngardo sdispyirngaku 'o/:drotha/bzhi byaspuspyasno ngas/lngazug rta):re tha/sdosajib 'o/dra/zug/ 3〈copa'i rang rtsal du lta ba go ba de yang / snang yul de ltar lta ba mi gsal bas snang srid thams cad rang snang ris med du mi 'char ram zhe na/ skyon med de/ snang ba rig rtsal du shar ba nyid kyis snang yul yang de ltar 'char thab pa'i phyir te/ 'dir snang yul gyis ༄ snang ba tshur ma sprul gyi/ snang bas snang yul phar bzhag pa'i phyir te/snang ba dga' nyams sdug nyams kyis snang yul yid 'ong yin min sprul zhing ngam 'jog cing / snang ba phyin log pa'i dbang gis sna nga yul bslu ba dang rdzun par 'jog pa sogs lta bu'o/ /'di la phan pa'i lung zhig ye shes klong rgyud na yod snang shar/ bla med rgyud gzhan du rdzogs rim lam gyi 'od gsal 'char ba la sngon du rags pa'i rtsa rlung thig le las su rung bar sgrub dgos pas ye shes skye ba la cung zad yun ring dgos/ de dag las rung phyogs thams cad nas phul du byung ba thob pa la mi shigs pa'i sems 'dzin/ rdor bzlas/ dhu ti'i yar sna mar sna/ lte ba'i gtum mo sogs kyi sems 'dzin sna tshogs dang / las rgya'i thabs sogs brten dgos pas tshegs kyang che/ thun bar du las rlung lang yong bas 'od gsa' brtan dka' ba sogs red/ 'di'i rig pa rang snang gi blo can 'khrid dus/ 'od gsal rtsal thog nyid nas thad kar ngo sprod pa/'od gsal lam byed rkyang bas rlung sems rags pa thams cad 334

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6las rung du byed pa/ 'od gsal ngang sgom brtan nas mnyam rjes kun tu dwangs cha dang gsal cha che chung tsam las 'od gsal ris med du 'char ba'i khyad sogs yod/ āng rtags can la/ gzhan gyi gtum mo dang /rdor bzlas sogs sems 'dzin de tsam mang ba las/rlung sems 'dul ba rig pa rkyang ded cig pu rang rno la mthu che ba ni/ rtsa rlung thig le thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gnad mthar thug 'od gsal gcig pu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so//lugs 'dir so rig bzhi dang mngon shes drug sogs mthar thug mngon du nam 'gyur zhe na/ chos zad kyi mthar sgrib pa kun bral gyi'am shin tu rnam dag gi ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings mthar thag ༄mngon du gyur pa dang dus mnyam du me long g.ya' dri phyis ma thag gzugs brnyan bkra lam me 'char ba ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon gyur du 'ong ste/ de'i dus su rang bzhin gsal ba'i snang cha spro sdud dang / thugs rje'i rig pa spro sdud byed pa'i rlung gi cha ma lus par dag nas/ gdod ma'i gshis la ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i cha ji ltar yod pa mtha' dag 'char nub 'phel 'bri med par lhang la bud pa'i phyir te/ ye shes gcig nyid ye shes rnam pa thams cad par song ba'o/ /ngo bo'i dbyings mngon du byas stobs kho nas snang phyogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du 'gyur 335

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba 'di ni ji lta ba'i ye shes nyi ma'i snying po dang / ji snyed pa'i ye shes sam mkhyen cha de'i 'od lta bur rgyud bla'i thogs 'grel du gsungs pa dang / chos kyi dbyings zhes pa'i sgra don sogs dang ches 'grigs so//gzhi las 'phags dus kun bzang khyad chos drus gis sangs rgyas te/ thams cad mkhyen pa dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis grub tshul theg mdzod gzhi snang gi rim khang las bshad pa sogs dang yang sgrigs/ ngo bo dang rang bzhin gnyis ka blta ba'i mig mthar thag ni thags rje'i rig pa ste/ 'dis ngo bo'i sir+sha sir+sha dbyings la 'jug tshul khregs chod kyi man ngag dang / rang bzhin gsal ba drungs bton nas blta ba ni rig pa de rgya mtsho gser gyi nyi ma'i rtsa nas nam mkha' la gtad pas 'grub bo//snying rje can yin yang snying rje'i shugs phyung ma phyung gi skabs mang po yod la/ snying rje'i dbang gis ba spu g.yo ba ni snying rje'i shugs phyungs pa yin te/ snying rje lpags la bab pa red/ ngus nas mchi ma 'byin pa ni de bas kyang shugs phyungs pa yin te/ sha la babs pa zhes bya/ tshig tu rang dbang med par 'byin pa ni de bas kyang shugs phyungs nas rtsal sprugs su byas pa yin te/ snying rje rus la babs pa'o//de'i rigs pas dpyad tshe/lha mo sgrol ma ni 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bshum pa'i spyan chab las 'khrungs 336

rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6 pa'am sprul pas 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams la thugs rje chen po'i shugs lhag par phyungs pa'i rnam 'phrul yin la/ rta mgrin ni thugs rje'i shugs kyis skad phyangs pa'i rnal 'phral yin pas myar ba'i da rikhroṭa char theṭi rabye zir rtsa'i༄shimi nang nas kyang mgyags / /das na mas can sgral ba' stabs mtshungs med 'phags pa lo ki shwa ra ni 'khor sgyur gyi glang po rin chen ltar gzhan phan gyi stobs kyi rtsa ba'i bdag po dang / pad+ma'i rigs kyi lha gzhan yang de'i snying rje'i rtsal shugs las sprul mod kyi/glang po rin chen bang ha cang btang ste gling bzhi ri mtshor bcas pa rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo ltar snang ba'i gnas skabs las kyang brgal nas/mi g.yo bar lhan ne gnas par snang ba'i gnas skabs su 'dug pa lta bur thugs rje'i shugs phyungs pa'i gnas skabs mthar thug la bzhugs pa ni sgrol ma dang / rta mgrin te/ de las kyang brtse ba'i nyams skad kyi sgor thon pa'i sprul pa phyi ma'o/ /thugs rje'i rtsal shugs ma lus pa rdzogs par phyung ba'i sku'i rnam 'gyur thun min yin pa 'di 'dra'i gnad kyis/ dpung bzang las 'di nyid pad+ma'i rigs te snying rje'i rigs kyi lha thams cad kyi dbang phyug yin par gsungs snyam/khregs chod du rig cha ngo bo'i dbyings su 'dres pa'i rigs pas/ thod rgal du rig chas gsal dwangs phul byung rang bzhin gyi cha mngon du byed phul che/ de'ang rim bzhin 337

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rig pa mi rtog pa'i ngo bor skye phul dang / gsal dwangs kyi ngo bor skye phul che ba'am/ mi rtog pa 'thag tshabs dang / gsal cha 'a thalga/ /rere 1rngo/ (1she nisir+sha /re)/ri hāX ra mitshabs te ba'o/ / ltar ga cha la rang ba na gsal ba sna ngar phul byung thogs pa 'di rig pa'i dwangs ma bsam gtan gyi thig ler 'dus pa'i don te/ rig pa ngo bo'i dbyings su zhugs tshabs che rim ltar gsal mdangs che bas dbyings sgron gyis lug rgyud thig spron du 'dren 'gro ba red/ rang bzhin gsal ba 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi cha'o/ /de ltar na lug rgyud thig sgron du tshud pa ni/rig cha la gsal dwangs kyi ting 'dzin gyi rdzong thob pa ste/ rig cha gsal mdangs su 'bar ba 'di'i dbang gis khregs chod las thod rgal shes rab lhag pa ste/ de la shes rab rang byung sgron ma zhes bya/ rig pas ngo bo'i dbyings rtogs zhes pa ngo bo'i dbyings ngos zin pa nge/ bzhin du rang bzhin gsal ba rtogs pa'ang de ngos zin nas rang nyid der 'dres pa red/rig chas gsal mdangs de rjen la bton nas 'bar bar byed cing rgyas par byed/ gsal cha des kyang ris cha gong 'phel du smin par byed/ de dag gi rtsa ba rig cha gsal mdangs kyi thig ler bcug nas sgom pa la thug ste/ de'i phyir lus rgyud kyis thig sgron rgyas par byed/thig les lug rgyud smin par byed/ gnyis ka'i rtsa ba lug rgyud thig ler bcug nas sgom pa'o/ /gsal 338
rta skad bsdus pa/ pod/ 6cha'i bcud rig char smin pa 'di nyams gong 'phel nas dang / ngo bo'i bcud rig par smin pa tshad phebs// 339

21rngad/ (3 lngardo sdispyings khur:drob/thag byaspuḥde rngaku/lngazug rta):re tha/sdosasprang 'o/dra/zug/ 〈mi༄khya/ /rta skad kyi dka' gnad bzhugs so/ /phur ba phrin las zhes phur ba ni phrin las kyi sgo nas 'chad cing / de'ang thal 'byin gyi phrin las su rdzas phur gyi brda rtab/sa las ston te/ rdo rje phur ba zhes pa'i mtshan las kyang shes so/ /de bzhin du pad+ma gsung zhes sgrub lugs 'di ni gsung gi sgrub lugs kyi sgo nas 'chad de/ de'ang 'dir gsung ni rjes chags kyi bde ba'i rang bzhin dang / dbang byed kyi las can du dbu gtsug rta skad kyi brda rtags las ston cing / gsung de la brten pa'i sgrub lugs kyang spyi bo'i rta skad kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa nyid kyis ston to/ /rta mgrin zhes pa'i mtshan gyis kyang shes so/ /rnal 'byor bas rdo rje phur ba'i thal 'byin gyi phrin las grub pa na phrin las kyi dngos grub de sngags pa'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa yin yang /de'i grub rtags su rdzas phur bzhad pa dang me 'bar ba sogs 'ong ba ltar/ sngags pa'i ngag la 'khor 'das dbang byed rjes chags kyi bde ba'i rigs kyi gsung grub pa'i tshe na'ang der grub rgyu ni sngags pa rang gi ngag rlung nyid yin yang / de'i grub rtags su rta skad gtsug 'byin 'ong bas/ de ni ngag la gsung rdo rje grub pa'i drod 340

rta skad dka' gnad/ pod/ 6rtags yin no//des na dbang chen he ru kas rang nyid kyi gsung de rang bzhin dang byed las ji lta bu zhig yin pa brda rtags kyi sgo nas gdul bya la gsal por ston ched rta skad gtsug bzhad kyi rnam par mdzad pa yin pas spyi bo'i rta skad kyi rang bzhin dang byed las rgya cher bshad pa nyid kyis/ ngag la pad+ma gsung grub ces pa'i gsung de'i ngo bo nyid dang mdzad pa ji lta bu yin pa mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs nus pas spyi bo'i de kho na bshad pa yin pa la/rang bzhin dang byed las de dag spyi bo'i rta skad kho na'i yin par go ba ni mdzub mos zla ba bstan tshe mdzub rtser lta ba dang 'dra'o/ /rta skad kyi don ni rjes chags kyi dbang skad ces pa yin pas tshul 'dis dpyad na rta sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs rta skad du mi shes par rta mgo'i kha nas byung ba kho na rta skad kyi don du bzung na/ rgya mtsho las rlangs 'phyar bar bltas nas chu ni skya rdzas 'di nyid do /re/ 31(sir sa pa dang 'dra byu/('dir bris pa 'di ltar shes na rta sngags la bsnyen pa btang ba nyid rta skad la bsnyen pa btang bar 'gyur bas sngar trīḥbazlas rta skad kyi bzlas par bshad pa'i skor sogs ni byis pa'i gtam mo)dpal he ru ka'i dbang drag gi gsung gi che rtags rdzu 'phrul gyi bzhad sgra spro tshul la ltos te dpal gyi rta skad/bzhad pa'i yul ma mo mkha' 'gro de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag brnyan chen mo rnams 341

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang du 'du tshul gyi rim pa la ltos te ma mo'i 'gying skad/ rjes 'jug rnal 'byor pas rta skad de nyid bsnyen sgrub kyis grub pa'i rim pa la ltos te rnal 'byor brda skad ces byas na rngog ma le brgan sogs la 'grigs sam dpyad/ phyi ma 'di'i thad/ bsnyen nga/ thems par gyur pa na/ zhes gsungs pas mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab 'bring tha ma'i tshad kyi khyad par bshad pa ste/ bzlas pa la rta skad kyi drod rtags dngos rang thon pa dang / rjes mthun tsam thon pa dang /drod ma thob kyang rta skad du mos pa brtan pa tsam la brten nas rta skad du bzhag pa'o/ /phyi ma 'di la rtags tsam 'dzin pa zhes bshad pa'i zlas drang na/ snga ma gnyis rta skad kyi drod thob par gsal lo// /de'ang dang po ni rta skad kyi dgongs pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzokas/ pa la rtsal thon pa ste/ dgongs pa de mtshan nyid rdzogs par grub pa'i rtags su rta skad dngos su thon pa yin pas so/ /'dir sku gsum dang mnyam par gsungs pa/ bskyed rim pa'i sku gsum grub pa yan chad la byed rung ngam brtags/ gnyis pa ni de ltar mchan nyid ma rdzogs kyang rta skad kyi de nyid cha 'dra tsam grub pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud 'khul ba sogs rta skad kyi byed 'a/sa/ rjes mthun tsam thob pa ste/ 'di'ang lhas byin gyis brlabs pa/'i mtshan ma ci rigs mthong ba'o/ /gsum pa ni rta mchog gi rdo rje 342

rta skad dka' gnad/ pod/ 6gsum gyi snang zhen brtan pa tsam ste/ sems brtan pa'i mtshan ma rnyed pa'o/ /'di la bskyed rim pa'i lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa thob mi dgos la/ snga ma gnyis la de dgos sam snyam ste dpyad do//༄༅/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la brten nas rta mchog gi go ba blang tshul ni/ rta ni 'gros sna tshogs dang ldan pas gar mkhan te/gar mkhan ni cha byad nyams 'gyur du mar snang ba ltar zhi drag gi nyams sna tshogs mnga' ba ste/mdor na rta'i 'gros stabs sna tshogs ltar rnam 'phrul sna tshogs su ston pa/ mdzad pa sna tshogs 'dres pas ljang gu/ rta mchog bskul mi dgos par bdag po'i yid bzhin du 'jug pa ltar/ gzhan don gyi bya ba sgrub pa la nus sam mi nus snyam du sngar bag med par spro shugs kyis 'jug pa'i ldang ba yang ba/rta mchog bdag po sgrol ba la spro ba'i snying stobs mtshon chas bsnun yang mi nyams pa ltar/ gzhan don sgrub la spro ba'i snying stobs phyir mi ldog pa/ phyi ma 'di ni/ mdza' bo'i mi la bya'am mi bya yongs rtog de dag med kyang bla/ /de 'dra'i mdza' bo sgyu ma yin te de la mdza' zhes su zhig zer/ sogs ltar rtul phod pa'i dpa' ba dang brtan pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /le lo med par snying stobs drag po'i shugs kyis sgrub dka'i bya ba thams cad kyi thog mar slebs pa ni myur mgyogs te drag shul gyi mthu yang yin/ /grangs med gsum du'am 343

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4de dang dod thub tu brtson 'grus de sbyangs pas brtul zhugs de shin tu grub pa na srid zhi'i 'khor lo mtha' dag rtul phod kyi spyod pa des 'dod dgur gnon cing ngo mthon du gnon nus pa'i mthu grub pa ste/ de'i phyir 'dul dka' gdug pa can rnams kyang bshilge cing gnon pa'o////344

pod/ 6 ༄/ /rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas srid dang zhi ba'i shes bya kun/ /mkhyen rab ye shes me long 'od po ches/ /stong nyid nam mkha'i thig ler sdom mdzad pa/ /bla ma brtan pa'i 'khor los dge legs stsol/ /shar phyoṭa gnam skyong rgyal po'i yul gru ru/ /gtsug lag ma gros chu gter 'khyil ba'i gzhi/ /srid pa rus sbal khog pa'i me long la/ /spang blang ri mo 'bum phrag pra ru 'bebs/ /de la gnyis de/ bsdus bshad sdom tshig tu brjod pa dang / spros bshad ngag 'gros su bkod pa'o/ / dang po ni/ brtsi gzhi rus sbal gan rkyal te/ /mgo bo lho la gzhoṭa g.yas shar/ /mjug ma byang dang gzhoṭa g.yon nub/ /mtshams bzhi 'ang de yis zhor la shes/ /de rnams me shing chu lcags dang / /sa lnga go rim bzhin sbyar nas/ /ma bu dgra grogs nges pa yis/ /lo zla zhag dang dus tshod brtsi/ /gzhi phywa lo dang mgron phywa zla/ /dgra phywa zhag dang srog sogs dus/ /rnam par sbyar ba'i rigs pa dang / /rdel zhag gzhan yang mang du dbye/ /gnam lo'i 'byung (dgras zla ngos 345

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bzung / zla 'byung steng nas zhag mgo 'dzin)ba gang yang rung / /zla zhag de yi dgra nas 'dzin/ /zhag gi bu ni dus tshod de/ /dus tshod ma gtogs sbrags mar brtsi/ /zla ba'i thog ma sprel gyi zla/ /zhag la pho drug stag gis tshes/ /de bzhin mo drug sprel gyis te/ /rim bzhin 'brug dang khyi yis nya/ /de ltar brtags nas brtsi tshal dngos/ /brtsi bya de nyid ༄lo sogs 'thab/ /srog lus dbang thang rlung rta yi/ /sa mal lo mal kun la dpyad/ /grogs phrad rab la ma bu 'bring / /me lcags shing nang ngan pa la/ /sa chu nang bzang dgra phrad ngan/ /bye brag gzhan yang rab shes bya/ /gtso bor dus tshod la sogs pa/ /rang rang gang la gang bsngags pa/ /de nyid gzhir bzung spar sme yi/ /rno khyad 'don pa 'di yi lugs/ /na shi dgra dur gegs rnams dang //bdun zur bzhi gshed dgu mig sogs/ /rgya cher pags rus sha gsum gyis/ /brtsi ba don gyi snying rno yin/ /gzhan yang dpyod tshul khyad par ni/ /rus sbal lus la 'byung lnga sbyar/ /de rnams dbyibs mdog grangs phyogs sogs/ /so so'i rnam par blan las shes/ / gnyen phyogs ma phyi 'og rta khyi/ /rang dang grogs yin dgra phyogs dgra /de bzhin sgro ni rang dang ma/ /gdon dang rang dang dgra phyogs la'o/ /'di dag blor bzung na 'og nas 'chad pa'i rtsis 'bras rnams kyang yid la 'dzin sla ba yin no/ /346

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6gnyis pa ni/ nam rten 'brel gyi rtsis bya bar 'dod pa'i dus der/ thog mar skyabs sems sngon 'gros 'byung ba'i lha dang gtsug lag gi ston pa rnams la gtor rmā phul/bden pa bdar/me tog la/a kar kha yer ya wa yang ur te tai ta/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te 'thor/ de'i 'og tu skor mgo la 'jug go/ de'ang rtsis kyi skor mgo dngos ni/ gnam lo'i 'byung ba gang yin gyi dgra thog nas zla ba'i skor mgo bya ste/ de'ang 'di'i lugs kyi lo mgo hor zla bcu gnyis pa sprel zlas 'dzin rgyu yin la/ zla ba bcu gnyis po'i nang tshan pho mo'i zla ba phrag gnyis re 'byang ba gcig cing brtsi dus kyang de ༷༷/rdo chosing 1)re/ rir //khye/ rngu'iltar ba 'o/ / ltar zla ba gar sleb — steng nas zhag ge skor mgo ni/ sprel sogs zla ba pho drug stag gis tshes shing bya sogs zla ba mo drug sprel gyis tshes rgyu yin pas/ de dag gzhir bzung la/ zhag gi nges 'dzin dngos ni/ gcig bcu gsum nyer lnga zhes pa'i sde tshan gsum po gang rigs skabs bstun gyi steng na g.yas su bskor bas rtogs nus/ de la zla ba gnyis ni 'byung ba'i skor mgo dang sbrags mar brtsi lugs gcig tu bya dgos pas/ gcig gnyis rang /gsum bzhi bu/ lnga drug grogs/ bdun brgyad dgra/ dgu bcu ma zhes bgrang ngo //dus tshod kyi skor mgo ni/ zhag gi bu thog nas bya ste nam lang yos/ nyi shar 'brug nyi dros sbrul/ nyin gung rta/ phyed yol lug 347

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khudagong chen sprel/ dgong chung bya/ mun rub khyi/ srod 'khor phaganam gung byi ba/ nam phyed glang / tho rangs stag ste dus tshod bcu gnyis po'i nang gar bab ngos 'dzin/ 'di la ni 'byung ba rkyang ded bya'o/ /de dag rtsis thang gi spros pa la mi ltos par lag pa'i sor mo 'ba' zhig gi steng nas brtsi lugs blo chung las dang po ba rnams kyi don du gnam lo shing bya khyi'i zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyi shar lta bu la dpe brjod byas na/ lag pa'i gung mdzub srin gsum re'u mig dgur phye ba'i shar shing / lho me/ nub lcags/ byang chu/ lho nub sa sgo che bar dpyad la/ thog mar gnam lo shing bya zhe sa shing khams su blan nas slar yang lcags sprel gyi zla ba lo mgor bzhag ste nub tu 'phos/ de'i steng nas zla ba'i skor mgo lcags kyi sprel bya/ chu'i khyi zhes snga ma las gnas gcig bgrod pas byang du sleb/ de'i rang thog nas zhag gi brtsi lugs chu'i stag yos/ shing gi 'brug sbrul/ me'i rta lug sa'i sprel bya bgrang bas lho nub tu phyin/de'i bu thog nas nam langs lcags yos/ nyi shar chu 'brug ces de nyid du rang sa 'dzin pa bzhin no/ /de ltar mgyogs rtsis kyi rnam gzhag chags par byas nas da ni bye brag tu/ gzhi phywa lo/ mgron phywa zla ba/ dgra phywa zhag srog chos srid don sogs dus tshod dang sbyar te brtsi lugs rags pa tsam brjod na/348

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6gzhi phywar brtsi bya'i srog lus dbang thang rlung rta rnams gnam lo'i srog sogs bzhi dang 'thab la/ slar yang rang dus kyi zla ba'i srog sogs bzhi bo brtsi bya dang 'thab/ de bzhin du zhag dang brtsi bya/ dus tshod dang brtsi bya bcas legs par lto sbyar la/ ma phrad dang grogs phrad rab/ bu phrad dang shing lcags me gsum nang phrad ngan pa/ sa chu nang phrad bzang ba/ dgra phrad shin tu ngan pa ste 'di dag gi go ba gzhir bzhag nas/ bzang phyogs mang na dge zhing /bzang ngan mnyam na 'gyur ldog the tshom can dang / ngan phyogs mang na mi dge ba'i ltas yin/ 'di la zhib tu na srog lus dbang thang rlung rta so so'i sa mal lo mal rnams la byang ba zhig gnad du che bas/ de bshad par bya'o/ /spyir btang du srog ni gang la'ang gal chen dgos mod kyi/khyad par gyi sa dang lo'i mal ni 'tsho 'chi gnyis kyi la shan phye sa/'og rta dang skyes pa'i sa mal/byi 'brug sprel gsum gyi lo mal/ gzhi sa la lhag par gtso ba yin no/ /lus ni na tsha 'byung mi 'byung brtags sa lug dang rgan byis kyi sa mal/ khyi rta stag gsum gyi lo mal/sgo them gyi sa dang phyi sa yin no/ / dbang thang ni phyug dbul gnyis kyi so mtshams phye sa/ nor 349

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4zhing bud med khyim gyi sa mal/ bya glang sbrul gsum gyi lo mal/ blo phywa dang don phywa la lhag par gnyan pa yin no / /rlung rta ni dgra rkun gyi 'jigs pa brtag sa/ ban btsun dang gtso bo rgan rab rnams kyi sa mal/ phag lug yos gsum gyi lo mal/chos phywa dang lha sa drag zhan dpyod pa'i gnas che sa yin no/ /de rnams re re nas 'bras bshad bzang ngan 'bring gsum bshad ma thag pa ltar brtags la/ ngan 'bring gnyis la bcos ka bya ste/mthun phyogs lo ba yod na de dang bstun/ khyad par lo mal gang zhan gyi mi de 'dra khyim der med na/ brtsi bya'am de las gzhan pa'i sa mal dbang btsan du bya zhing / yod na de nyid gtso bor byas te /lo kegs che chung dang spar sme'i 'bras rtsis re re nas bskor la/do'i sgo nas 'khyug dpyad kyi sbyor ba gang 'os su dkri ba ni rno ltangs spar smes gcod do zhes rtsis rig smra ba'i ngag sgros las byung ba'i don no/ /gal te rlung rta'i sa mal lta bu zla zhag dus tshod gsum ngan zhing gnam lo'i rlung skal dang grogs 'phrad lta bu'i dge ltas snang na/ gzhi phywa gnam lo gtso ba dang / bzang ngan gyi phyogs gang na mang ba de nyid dbang btsan dgos pa gnyis ka bshad zin pas de la ji ltar lung du ston zhe na/ de ni gnas skabs su dgra yod kyang nam phugs su dgra'i gzhan dbang can du 350

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6mi 'gro ba'i ltas dang / rim gro rgya cher byas na bzlog nus pa'i ltas yin gyi/ dgra phywa ha cang 'khrugs pa'i rtags su mi bzung ngo / /'on kyang gtso bor ni rtsis mkhan nyid kyi zhe 'dod la rag las pas/rten 'brel de brtag pa ni/ dang por lo dbang btsan gyi steng nas brtag go snyam na lo nyid gtso che zhing / dus tshod 'ba' zhig dbang btsan du byed par spro na de nyid gtso bor 'gyur ba sogs 'di 'dra'i rigs mang po zhig rtsis pa'i blo'i g.yo ba la thug par bla ma rnams gsungs so/ /yang gzhi phywa'i legs nyes kyi rten 'brel de bas kyang bsdus te brtag par 'dod na/ gnam lo'i srog sogs bzhi dang brtsi bya'i srog sogs bzhi 'thab pa'i 'og tu dus tshod kyi 'byung ba rkyang ded byas nas dbang thang gi skal ba dang phan tshun 'thab pas kyang / spyir btang dus mal drag zhan dang / dmigs bsal du skyid sdug gang stong rnams legs par shes nus te/de'ang gnam lo'i steng nas spyir btang gi legs nyes 'jal tshul ni gong du bshad pa rnams kyis rtogs par snang bas/ 'dir dus tshod kyi dbang skal nas dmigs bsal ba'i legs nyes brtag lugs tsam zhig 'chad do/ /de ni ma bu dgra grogs nang 'phrad dang lnga'i sgo nas phye ste/ spyir ni ma phrad ni phyi 'jigs tsam dang / bu 'phrad 'gyod ngo / grogs 'phrad dge ltas sogs yin pa gzhir 351

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/trabazhag la/bye brag tu shing ma chu 'phrad la/ gzhi bya cung zad 'khrugs ltas dang / byang phyogs nas lhags pa'i gdon ngo che zhing / rang dang nye 'brel la rkyen ngan 'ong ba'i ltas yin/ me ma shing 'phrad 'a lha srung 'khrugs pa'i bka' chad dang / nyi ma shar phyogs kyi gdon ngo yod/ gzhan yang nye du sogs la dmar bshal lta bu'i yams nad 'byung ngo dang / dmar ngo yod/ sa ma me 'phrad la/ phug lha btsan 'gong med na btsan dang sa bdag gi gnod pa dang / lho phyogs kyi gdon ngo yin/ lcags ma sa 'phrad la/ pha myes kyi dur sa lad nas shul phyi dbul zhing phongs pa dang / mtshams bzhi'i gshed kha lta ba'i ngo / lo tog la 'tshe ba'i ltas yin/ chu ma lcags 'phrad la/ dme 'khrug nang 'thab dang gnam lcags 'bab pa'i ltas/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi gdon ngo ste ma 'phrad skor gyi 'bras bshad zin to/ /shing bu me 'phrad la/ lho gdon dang btsan gshed kyi kha lta/ rta nor dang zhing la bkra mi shis shing / nad yams mched pa'i ngo me bu sa 'phrad la/ ma'am sring mo la ngan/ mtshams bzhi dang / khyad par lho nub kyi bgegs ngo yin/ sa bu lcags 'phrad la/ g.yang si khang sgo ral/ mi nor gang rung rbab 'og tu ltung / dgra rkun dang nub phyogs kyi gshed ngo yod/ khyim gyi bud med 'chi ba'i ltas yin/352

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6lcags bu chu 'phrad la/ shi chad dang / khyad par du byang phyogs kyi chu rgyud nas gshin po'i lag pa zed pa'i rtags te/ de'i dbang gis 'khrug sa rtsod dang god kha 'byung ngo yod/ chu bu shing 'phrad la/ shar phyogs nas shi gshed kyi kha lta bas mi dang nor la 'tshe ngo yin/ de dag ni bu phrad kyi sde tshan no/ /shing dgra lcags 'phrad la/ shar ram nub nas 'ong ba'i phu nu'i rus 'dre dang gri gshed gdon/ yang na yul de'i gzhi bdag gam khyim bdag gam khyim lha btsan po la phog thug song ba'i ngo dang / rdzas shing lcags sprad ma'i phyir 'brang ba'i gdon rgod ngan pas smyo 'bogs gtong ngo yin zhing nor phyags la god ngo che/ me ༄dgra chur 'phrad la/ lho phyogs sam byang phyogs nas 'ong ba'i rdzas dmar po'i rigs kyi phyir 'brang gi nye du'i rus 'dre dang btsan 'gong dang mo sris gnod ngo / khyim der sha dmar pags dmar 'dra da lta med na nges par phyugs la god 'ong / sa dgra shing 'phrad la/ mtshams bzhi 'am shar phyogs kyi shag po las blang ba'i rin po che'i rigs sam grogs kyi rjes 'brang gi rgyal po dang / mi kha gleng brjod/ bza' mi phye bral sogs 'byung ba'i ltas yin/lcags dgra me 'phrad la/ nub bam lho nub nas 'ong ba'i mgar skyes dar ma'am mi'i gtso bo'i rigs dang lcags cha'i phyir 'brang 353di

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga〉gi gri btsan nam shi gshed gnod/ lha 'khrugs dang byad phur rbod gtong gi ltas/ lho rgyud nas dgra rkun ngo / yang na glo bur gyi 'ur ngo chen po yod/ chu dgra sa 'phrad la/ byang ngam lho nub gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshams bzhi gang rung nas ma dang bu mo sogs bud med kyi rigs 'ga' zhig gi phyir 'brang mo sri gdon/ god ngo dang nad ngo /khyad par du bza' mi nang rtsod dang rkyen ngan glo bur ba/ mya ngan dang snying stong chen po'i ltas/ de rnams dgra 'phrad kyi dum bu'o//shing gnyis nang 'phrad la/ pha khu sogs nye du 'am/ shar dang lho'i phyogs kyi gshin lcags rgyal po'am gnyan rigs dang bsdong nas 'tshe ba'i ngo / me gnyis nang 'phrad la/ btsan gshed kyi gdon ngo dang / rta pho grir 'chi ba'i snga ltas/ 'go ba'i nad yams mcheng/ ltas sogs yin/ sa gnyis nang 'phrad la/ rgyal gdon dang sa bdag 'khrugs pa'am/ yang na ban bon sngags pas gtad mnan byas pa'i ngo yin/ gtad byed pa'i ngos 'dzin ni/ mtshams bzhi'i dus tshod las dpyad de/ sa glang ri sna dang / sa 'brug brag sna/ sa lug thang chen po'i rngam zhol/ sa khyi chu mig dang mcho'i 'gram lta bur gtad yod ngo yin/ de 'dra'i byad gtad med na mkhar gyi las 'ga' zhig nyes zer/ lcags gnyis nang 'phrad la/ phal cher byad phur che ba'i ngo yin zhing / yang na gri btsan 'khri/ de dag gang 354

pham lhanathag /) byepu tha/rbetsub/ 95tha/ /glu zugabyedzahāre cosgo cesakhung / rjesproshad/ ((yang med na dgra dang rkun ma'i ltas/ chu gnyis nang 'phrad la/ byang phyogs kyi chu rgyud nas lhags pa'i mo 'dre 'am/ klu gnyan sa bdag gam chu'i yul 'dre lta bu'i ngo / chu mig la phog thag sngar song yod ༄na de 'dra'i rtags mtshan yin no/ /'di dag ni nang 'phrad kyi gras so/ /de'ang gdon ngo gang babs kyi 'dre bgegs de 'dra khyim du med pa'am ma byung na dgra ngo yin pas de 'dra'i rigs gzhan yang zhib mo'i blos dpog shes par bya'o/ /shing grogs sa 'phrad ni/ sa bdag rgyal pos phyi lam 'ded pa dang / lha srung gi 'khu ldog rang zhir song ltas/ phung sel gyi ngan sngags las grol ba'i dge mtshan khyad par can yin/ me grogs lcags 'phrad ni/ gri gshed rang yul blang ngo dang / nad pa 'chi bdud kyi khrims 'og nas thar ba'i ltas/ phyugs kyi god zag dang /yul khams kyi bkra mi shis pa thams cad rang zhir thal ba'i ngo /sa grogs chu 'phrad ni/ mo sri kha dmar rnams rang yul snyegs ltas dang / khyim bdag gi nor skal 'phel zhing lo legs skya rgyal chen po'i ngo yin/ lcags grogs shing 'phrad ni/ gdon dang rgyal pos phyi lam snyegs ngo / lha rnams dga' zhing sdong grogs la yong ltas/ ban bon sngags pa'i byad thag la rtsang zor babs pa'i ngo yin/ chu grogs me 'phrad la/ btsan god rang gnas su ldog pa'i mtshan ma/355

casabran/ (rngo lngardo sdi/rngan shādi:drothanabasdo byaspuspyad rngan/lngazug rta):rno ba/sdo/cardo 'o/dra/zug/ po〉mi nor bde zhing dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dus te grogs 'phrad kyi le'u tshan no/ /de ltar phrad nyi shu rtsa lngar phye ba las/ bzang bo'i phyogs la grogs 'phrad kyi bshad pa ni shin tu gsal zhing / ma 'phrad ngan pa sha stag ltar bshad pa yang phyi 'jigs tsam yin gyi/brtsi yul dngos la ni skyon med par bshad de gzhan go sla'o/ /don gnyis pa mgron phywa zla ba dang 'thab ste brtsi ba ni/ spyir mgron po phar 'gro tshar 'ong gnyis kyi phyi ma dus tshod kyi sgo nas rno ༄ltangs gcod pa'i phyogs nyid phyag bzhes su mdzad pas/ de ni 'og tu bshad par bya zhing / 'dir snga ma zla ba'i ltangs gcod du sbyar te 'chad pa ni/ 'di'i zla ba zhes pa brtsi dus kyi de'ang yin mod/ 'on kyang gtso bor ni 'gro dus kyi zla ba nyid dbang btsan pas de nyid dang brtsi bya'i srog sogs bzhi 'thab la/ srog ma'am grogs dang 'phrad na tshe ring / lus ma'am grogs dang 'phrad na nad med/ dbang thang ma dang 'phrad na don 'bring / grogs dang 'phrad na rab/ rlung rta ma'am grogs 'phrad la dgra med/ bu 'phrad bzhi la tshe nyams dang / na tsha phran bu/ phyugs god don shor med pa'i dgra ngo / dgra 'phrad go nus/ nang 'phrad 'byung ba rkyang dpyad thun mong ba ni/ 'byung ba shing gi dus yin na shar phyogs su 'gro ba dge shing ban bun yod sar mdza' bos grogs byed/ nor ljang 356

ra〉 lhan05 /) lces ba/rbetsubaka 95pe/ sbyo1 zugaḥdzahāre byaspu cesaspyang / sprusprojid/ (1rigs sam shing spyad bzang po rnyed ngo dang / zas shing thog sogs la spyod ngo yod/ lho ru 'gro na spyir kha 'gyod dang / khyad par brag dmar sa dmar yod pa'i logs su rkun po 'byung / nor dmar mtshan can mi lag tu 'gro ngo yod/ mtshams bzhi gang rung du 'gro na ri mthon po'i rtse mo'am/ thang chen po'i dkyil nas grogs rnyed/nor gser mardog can dang zas 'bol zhing snum bag can la spyod ngo yin/ nub tu 'gro na/ mgron po spyi dang khyad par jag mgron la ngan/ rdza brag dkar po'am dkar shal yod pa'i sar chom po rta dkar can yod/ nor dkar mtshan can dgra lag tu 'chor nyen chezas dkar gsum dang bca' ba'i rigs las nad 'byung / byang du 'gro na phyi 'jigs yod kyang don pham med/ mi phal ba'am bud med rigs kyis grogs byed/ des mtshon te me sogs lhag ma rnams kyang rang phyogs dang ma grogs bzang ba/ bu dang dgra phyogs ngan par shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa dgra phywa'i ltangs zhag gis bcad de brtsi ba ni/ brtsi bya'i srog sogs bzhi dang zhag gi srog sogs bzhi nang phan tshun 'thab la/ sngar bshad pa'i srog lus dbang thang gi sa mal dang lo mal gyi steng nas rno khyad 'don pa ni srog dgra dang 'phrad na byi 'brag sprel gsam lo ba la nyi ma nub phyogs kyi dgra ngo dang / lho ra༅ dag 357

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nas rkun ma 'jab dogs yod/ srog la chad 'big 'gro/ lus dgra dang 'phrad na bya glang sbrul gsum gyi lo ba la mtshams bzhi'i phyogs nas dgra ngo dang / shar nas rkun ngo yod/ lus la rmas 'gram 'byung / dbang thang dgra dang 'phrad na khyi rta stag gsum lo ba la lho nas dgra dang byang nas rkun ngo / snying nor mi lag tu 'gro dogs yod/ rlung rta dgra dang 'phrad na/ phag lug yos gsum lo ba la byang nas dgra ngo dang / mtshams nas rkun ngo dang / khyad par du rang mgo dgra zhabs su tshud nyen che/ des na rlung rta ni shin tu gtso che ba yin no/ /srog sogs bzhi ma'am grogs dang 'phrad na spyir btang bzang / dmigs bsal ma 'phrad mang na phyi 'jigs dang / grogs 'phrad mang na 'ud ngo yin la bu 'phrad snying 'gyod kyi ngo zhes grags shing / nang 'phrad la/ shing gnyis ni mtshams bzhi'i lo ba yod na/ shar ram nub nas dgra dar ma'i ngo dang / lho phyogs kyi rgyud nas rkun po 'jab pa'i ltas yin/ med na nub nas dmigs bsal can gyi dgra ngo cung zad yod/ de min gzhan du dgra med pa'i ngo / des mtshon te/ me nang la bya'am sprel lo yod na lho 'am byang nas dgra dang / lho nub sogs nas rkun ngo / med na byang phyogs nas dmigs bsal ba'i dgra ngo / de min skyon med/ sa nang la/ byi phag lo ba yod na mtshams bzhi dang shar gyi phyogs nas 358

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6dgra ngo dang / nub nas rkun ngo / med na shar nas dmigs bsal ba'i dgra ngo cung zad tsam yin mod/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges/ de 'dra med phan chad skyon med/ lcags nang la/ stag yos lo ba yod na nub bam lho nas dgra ngo dang / byang nas rkun ngo yin/ de dag med na lho nas dmigs bsal ba'i dgra ngo / lhag ma gong bzhin/chu nang la/ rta sbrul lo ba yod na byang dang mtshams nas dgra dang /shar nas rkun ngo / med na mtshams nas dmigs bsal can gyi dgra ngo / lhag ma gong bzhin/ mdor na dgra phywa la lhag par gal che ba ni rlung rta yin pas gtso bor de nyid kyis ltangs gcod bya'o/ /bzhi ba srog chos srid don sogs dus tshod las rno ltangs gcod pa la/ srog phywa/ srid phywa/ bu chung gi mthu phywa/ don nam blo phywa/nad phywa/ gdon phywa/ bor stor rnyed min/ mgron phywa/ chos phywa rnams su yod pa'i dang po ni/ dus tshod kyi srog sogs bzhi dang brtsi bya'i srog sogs bzhi bo dang 'thab la/ 'phrad kyi 'bras bshad 'ba' zhig gis legs nyes lung du ston pa ni/ 'byung ba ma 'phrad grogs 'phrad rab/ bu 'phrad 'bring / nang 'phrad 'gyur ldog can/ dgra 'phrad shin tu ngan pa ste spyi khog de ltar dpyad la/ khyad par dus tshod de nyid brtsi bya'i lo'i bdun zur dang bzhi gshed la babs pa'am na shi dur kegs dang srog dgra gshed du song ba rnams shin 359

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /tu ngan pas de dag la zhib tu dpyad/ 'di dang gong smos kyi gzhi phywa gnyis kar pags pa lo'i 'bras bshad dang / rus rtsis swar kha'i rnam gzhag dang / sha rtsis sme ba'i rab dbye ste 'di gsum shin tu gal che bar yod pas gtsug lag pad tshal las shes par bya'o/ /de'ang skyes dar srog rgan byis lus/ bud med dbang thang yon tan can la rlung rta gal chen bya zhing brtsi ba ni/ sngar nas kyang shugs bstan du gleng zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang por brtsi yul khyo shug gnyis ka'i srog sogs bzhi re re nas dus tshod dang 'thab ste brtsis la/ dpyad lugs la spyir pho mo gnyis ka dang khyad par pho'i srog rlung gnyis dar na/ srid du bu btsa' ngo / gtso bor brtsi bya'i lus dbang dar zhing srog rlung gi khams rnams zhan na/ srid du bu mo 'byung ba'i ltas yin/ srog rgud na lus dbang thang rlung rta gsum dar yang srid la rkun bu med pa'i snga ltas tsam las/ srid bu 'byung ba'i ltas ma yin la/ brtsi bya'i srog dbang rlung rta gsum rgud cing lus 'ba' zhig dar na srid cung zad 'byung ltas yin yang mi mthun pa'i 'gal rkyen mang bar lung ston/ dbang thang kho na tsam zhig dar yang lhag ma rnams rgud na srid myur du mi 'byung yang rim gro rgya cher byas na 'byung ba'i ltas yin/ de sogs gzhan yang rig 360

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6 pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis dpag par bya'o/ /gzhan du na srog sogs thams cad rgud na rab chad dang / thams cad dar na srid shin tu rgyas pa'i ngo yin no/ /yang shing sogs 'byung ba de rnams brtsi bya dang grogs 'phrad du gyur na srid kyi grangs 'dzin bya ba ni/ shing gcig chu gnyis/ me gsum/ sa bzhi/ lcags la lnga sogs ma nges pa'i sgo nas lung du ston mod kyi/ ha cang yang nges pa med do/ /gal te rtsis mkhan gyi 'dod pas 'byung ba rkyang dpyad byed par spro na ni de ltar bya ste/ 'byung ba shing dang me gnyis ni dus nye bar bu 'byung ba'i ngo yin zhing / sa dus phyi dal che ba'i ltas dang / lcags dus srid dkon pa'i ngo / chu dus bu mo btsa' ba'i mtshan ma rnams su bzung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ brtsi bya bu chung gi srog sogs bzhi dang dus tshod kyi srog sogs bzhir 'thab la/ rtsis 'bras ni/ srog ma dang 'phrad na tshe ring / lus ma dang 'phrad na nad med/ dbang thang ma dang 'phrad na longs spyod 'phel/ rlung rta ma dang 'phrad na gdon las grol ba'i dge ltas dang / de bzhin du srog sogs bzhi bu 'phrad la/go rim ltar/ srog la sri rkun 'jug lus la nad gzer phran bu/dbang thang la sdug bsngal sna tshogs/ rlung rta la byad gdon sna tshoṭa te spyir btang dang / de dag las kyang khyad par ba'i rno ltangs 361

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang thang gis gcod rgyu yin pas/ de bye brag tu bshad na/ shing bu me 'phrad rims ngo yams ngo dang chung sri kha dmar gyis 'tshe ba'i ltas/ me bu sa 'phrad/ spyir ma la ngan zhing khyad par du sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gdon ngo / sa bu lcags 'phrad/ g.yang sar lhung ba dang btsan thel gyi byur ngan sdang ba'i ltas/ lcags bu chu 'phrad/shi 'dre gnod cing gshin po'i shi rgab ma chod pa'i ngo / cha ba shing ༄༄'phrad/ pha mes kyi shi gshed gnod de srid phywa shin tu gzan pa'i rtags so/ /'on kyang pha'i srog sogs bzhi dang dus tshod 'thab na dbang thang yang gtso cher byed mod/ bu chung kho rang gi srog sogs dang 'thab na lus kyi sa mal nyid dbang btsan par mthong ngo / /yang srog sogs bzhi bo dgra dang 'thab na go rim bzhin du/ tshe la bar chad dang / lus kyi na tsha/ bkres ltog gi dbul phongs/ gdon bgegs che ba'i rtags yin/ 'byung ba nang 'phrad la/ rig pas dpag ste gdon ngos 'dzin dang / de dang bstun pa'i rim gro lung du ston zhing / nam phugs su skyon med par ltangs gcod byed do//bzhi ba ni/ don 'di la dbang thang gi khams 'ba' zhig gtso che bas/ brtsi bya dang dus tshod kyi dbang thang 'thab ste brtsis pas/ma dang 'phrad na lar bzang yang cung zad phyi dal che ba'i ngo yin zhing / bu dang 'phrad na don dang byur gnyis ka med pa'i ngo yin/362

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6dgra dang 'phrad na bsam pa'i don tshur mi 'ong steng du mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gnya' bar 'bab pa'i ltas yin/ grogs dang 'phrad na ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos po de nyid myur du 'grub bo zhes lung ston/ nang 'phrad la/ shing myur/ sa dal/ chu mchog me bzang yang 'gyur ldog can/ lcags shol sdod dam dka' las chen pos 'grub pa'i ltas te/ 'di dag ni rags pa tsam mo/ /gzhan du na shing grogs sa dang 'phrad na shar phyoṭa kyi pha khus don sgrub/ grub don 'bring / me grogs lcags dang 'phrad na lho nas zhang nye'i rigs kyis grogs byed/ grub don myur zhing bzang / sa grogs chu dang 'phrad na shag po'am ban+dha'i rigs kyis grogs byed/ phyi dal chelcags grogs shing dang 'phrad na dme pho'am mgar ba'i rigs kyis grogs byed/ grub don mi 'byang / byar ngo yod/ chu grogs me skyur ziza thos ra ra char 05 'ju ri dang 'phrad na byang ga mgran dang bud mad rags kyas dan sgrub/kha grogs che/ don grogs chung / don myur/ kha 'gyod phran phrin gyi ngo /de sogs mang po zhig rigs pas dpyad de rtogs su yod mod kyi kun kyang rtsis mkhan gyi bsam pa nyid la thug par sngar brjod zin to/ /lnga ba ni/ shing gi dus tshod la bab na nad pa'i lus kyi g.yas phyogs/ glo ba dang / rtsa rgyus mi bde ba las gyur pa/ g.yo zhing bskyod 363
