pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa rlung gi rigs te/ rgyal nad dang gnyan rigs kyi nad/ bcos sla zhing 'tsho sla ba'o/ /me'i dus tshod la bab na/ mgo bo dang byang khog stod kyi nad/ snying nad dang khrag mkhris tshad rigs/ gnyan dang btsan grib/ drag cing rtsub pa'i gzer rgod bcos thabs sla ba'i ngo / sa'i dus tshod la bab na/sha lpags chu ser dang /yan lag bzhi/mchin srog pho mtsher sogs don snod phal mo che'i nad/ yang cham rigs sam sna 'gags/ rgyal po dang sa bdag gi nad ngo / lci zhing 'thib pa/ bcos thabs dka' ba'i khams so/ lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na rtsib ma g.yon phyogs sam/ mchin pa dang rus pa'i nad/srin nam skyug sbyong gi ngo / bad kan las gyur pa/ gri btsan gdug pa'i rigs kyi gdon/ nad yun ring ba'i ltas/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ byang khog smad kyi phyogs/ mkhal ma dang lgang ba'i khams mi mnyam pa las gyur pa'i ngo / khyad par du klu nad/ grang ba dang /dam chu/ chu 'gag rtsa 'gram chu ser gyi nad rigs/ mo gdon dang ༄ dmu thel gyi grib/ bcos thabs sla zhing sos lam snyogs pa'i ngo /nad slong ba'i zas rkyen ni/ shing gi dus tshod du byung na shing thog dang shing mngar sngo ldum nas sran gro 'bras tshod ma'i rigs gang rung ngam/ shing mkhan bzo bo'i rigs las blang ba'i rkyen byas na de grib/ me'i dus su byung na/ ja sha rngon zas/ stod sha khyi spyang gi 364

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6thed ro sogs dmar ngan gyi rigs bzo bo'i lag nas byung ba yod na de grib/ sa'i dus su byung na/ mar thud khur ba khog sha'am lhu sha tshil bu sogs snum 'bol bcud chen gyi rigs/ rdza mkhan las blang ba'i grib ngo yin/ lcags kyi dus su byung na/ dkar gsum rigs sam/ bca' ba dang sgog pa'i rigs/ dme mgar las blang ba'i ngo / chu'i dus su byung na/ bur kar dang chang sogs mngar skyur btung ba'i rigs sam smad sha lta bu mo btsun bud med sogs las blang ba'i ltas te/ 'di dag gdon phywa dang yang 'brel mod kyi/skabs 'dir ni nad phywa'i rten 'brel gyi zhar la 'ong bar byas so//drug pa ni/ shing gi dus tshod la bab na/ rgyal gdon dang / rdzas shing gi nyer spyad dam ras sogs ljang gu'i rigs/ dbyibs nar mo dang grangs gcig pha tshan dang phu nu'i phyogs nas blang ba'am/yang na de 'dra'i mi rigs shig gnod zer/ me'i dus tshod la bab na/ btsan gshed gdon/ rdzas su zangs kyi spyad pa dang sha dmar lpags dmar sogs dmar po'i rigs dbyibs gru gsum mdog dmar po/ grangs gsum can lta bu yod na thang / ban+dha zhang blon rig gnas mkhan gyi mi rigs sam/ de las blang ba'i dkor cha gnod/ sa'i dus su bab na/ rgyal 'gong dam sri dang khyad par sa bdag gnod/ rdzas su lha cha mchod cha'am/ ras dar sogs mdog 365

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ser po/ dbyibs gru bzhi grangs bzhi can/ phyag po gtso bo'i rigs ༄las rtsib ma g.yas phyogs kyi sha lta bu zhig blang ba'am/ yang na de 'dra'i mi rigs gnod/ lcags kyi dus su bab na/ gri shi gri gshed dang pho 'dre gri bo gnod/ rdzas su mtshon lcags/ rin chen rigs/dkar 'od can/ dbyibs zla gam/ grangs lnga/ yang na pho skyes gzhon dar las rnyed pa'am/ de 'dra'i mi rigs gnod/ chu'i dus su bab na/ mo 'dre'am chu gri'i rigs gnod/ rdzas su thab kha re hrul zhon pa mchil lham sogs dbyibs zlum po/ mdog sngo nag gang rung /grangs gnyis can yod na thang / sman dar ma'am gzhan yang bud med kyi rigs las blang ba'i rdzas spyad dang mi rigs de 'dra gnod/ gdon nor gar yod kyi phyogs dang snod spyad ngos 'dzin ni/ shing la bab na khyim gyi shar/ sbra'am khang ba'i g.yas phyogs/ lus kyi log 'gram g.yas/ mal sa'i g.yas ngos lta bur/ shing snod kyi rigs shubs/ sgam/ par bu sogs/ yang na shing gi khams gang rigs dang lhan cig par yod zer/ de 'dra med na ras dril dang gal lta sngon po'am ljang gu'i nang yod ngo yin/ me la bab na/ khyim gyi lho/ sbra'am khang ba'i phug lus kyi mgo dang rke/ mal sa'i sngas phyogs dang /snod du wa spyang gi pags pa'i rkyal bu'am ljon dmar dang zangs kyi gar tshe zhwa gos sogs dmar po'i rigs me cha dang me mda'i cha 366

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6lag lta bu me'i rdzas dang / yang na thab ka'i zur sogs na yod/ sa la bab na/ spyir khyim gyi mtshams bzhi gang rung / khyad par lho nub kyi phyogs/ lus kyi yan lag bzhi/ sbra'am khang ba'i zur mchog mal sa'i zur bzhi lta bu'i phyogs/ dngos rdzas gdu bu dang chun 'phyang sogs rdzas snod dam sa rjen la bsten pa/ lcags la khyim gyi nub phyogs/ sbra khang dang lus sam mal cha'i g.yon/ ras sogs dkar po'i snod dam/ khro lcags sogs rin po che'i snod du yod na thang /yang na lcags cha dang lhan cig yod zer/ dngos rdzas 'od can dang phra rgyan can gyi rigs yin/ chu la bab na/ khyim gyi byang / sbra'am khang ba'i sgo 'gram/ lus kyi smad cha/ mal sa'i rten ma sogs phyogs dang / snod dril sngon po'am chu rlung mi chags pa sgye hrul lta bu/ yang na rdza bum sogs chu snod du yod/ yang na 'byung ba lnga go rim bzhin du/ shing gnyan bcad pa sogs shing gi las/ ri gnyan la me btang ba sogs me'i las/ sa lad dur lad dang sa rko rdo slog sogs sa'i las dang byad kha dang brag gnyan gshig pa/ chu mig gnyan po dkrug pa sogs chu'i nyes pa las gyur pa ste/ de sogs mang po zhig 'byung ba dang spar kha'i skor mgo las rtogs par bya ba ni/ rtsis gzhung baiḍūr dkar po nas zhib tu shes par bya la/shin tu rags pa re gtsug lag pad tshal du'ang ston no/ /367

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bdun pa ni/ stor ba khyim du yod na sgo phug log zur la dpyad lugs gdon rdzas ngos 'dzin gyi skabs su bshad pa 'di nyid las shes shing / phyi rol gyi sa phyogs la dpyod pa ni/ shing gi dus tshod la bab na/ g.yas phyogs kyi ri'am/ ri'i g.yas ngos/ shing tshab tshub ci rigs pa'i nang na yod de myur du rnyed/ me'i dus tshod la bab na/ lho phyogs kyi ri mthon po'i rtse'am/ sa shal dmar po'am brag gi rgyud dmar po yod pa'i zhol sogs na yod de rnyed sla/ sa'i dus tshod la bab na/ lho nub gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshams bzhi gang rung ngam/ ma phyogs kyi ri rgyud na yod de dka'/ lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi ri'am/ ri'i srib ngos/ yang na ri bo'i g.yon log gi rdza rgyud na yod/ rkun pos khyer yang thang ste rnyed shin tu dka'/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ mdun ri'i zhol sogs ri'i cha'am/ byang phyogs kyi chu rgyud mig mthong gang gi sa na yod de myur du rnyed/ gal te ma rnyed na rkun po'i mi ngos 'dzin bya ste/ shing gi dus tshod la bab na/ mi grangs gcig shar nas 'ong zhing / lus bong ring ba/ blo sna mang po can gyis khyer te shing nang du bskung / bongs kha gru bzhi'i rnam pa can gzuṭa po thung la snying khams che ba'i rig/sa kyis myar bar btsal na rnyed zer/ me'i dus the bye/ zur tsho rir 1rngo// (1〉〉 la tsho nod la bab na/ lha nas rkun sha rtsa dmar zhang gas dmar can 368

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6gsum mam gcig sogs kyis khyer te/ lho phyogs kyi rdza dmar po'i nang du sbas pa'am/ yang na bshas te bzhag pa'i ngo / rtsad gcod ma 'gyang na rnyed kyang srid/ sa'i dus tshod la bab na/ lho nub sogs mtshams bzhi'i rkun ma mi grangs bzhi sogs kyis khyer te/ri chen po'i rgyud na sbas yod/ btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba'i ngo /lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na/ rang gi dgra zla'am rigs mi mthun pa'i rkun po lnga sogs phye bral gyi rigs grangs ma nges pa sha mdog skya zhing gyong bas nub tu khyer/ rdza'am brag nag po'i khrod du bskungs te rnyed shin tu dka'/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ sha mdog sngo zhing rid pa kha chu sna chu dang mig chu mang ba'i rkun ma mi gnyis pa zhig gis byang phyogs kyi chu rgyud nas khrid de song / rnyed ngo chen po yod//brgyad pa ni/ 'dri ba po dang mgron po gang yang rung ba'i srog sogs bzhi dang / dus tshod kyi srog sogs bzhi nang 'thab/ khyad par du mgron po kho rang brtsi byar bzhag pa 'di rno tshabs che de la srog ma 'phrad dang grogs 'phrad mgron po 'tsho/ lus ma 'phrad lus zungs bde/ dbang thang ma 'phrad don bzang 'grub/ rlung rta ma 'phrad dgra'i nye zho med/ spyir ma 'phrad la rang sa ma mnan na phyi dal che ba'i ngo yin/ srog bu 'phrad sngangs skrag gi ngo yin/ lus 369

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma 'phrad nad ngo che/ dbang thang bu 'phrad gyod god kyi ngo che/ rlung rta ma 'phrad rkun ngo yin/ bu 'phrad myur du sleb min ma nges pa dang / slebs kyang kha 'gyod yod ngo yin/ srog dgra 'phrad mgron po rang yul du thon dka' ba'i ngo /lus dgra 'phrad nad ngo shin tu che/dbang thang dgra 'phrad nor gyi stor brlag dang pham stong 'byung ba'i ngo / rlung rta dgra 'phrad dgra kha btsan can gyi ngo / dgra 'phrad kyi spyi bshad phal cher bu 'phrad kyi phyogs dang 'dra ba la/ 'dir ni kha 'gyod phran bu tsam zhig min gyi/ de las che ba'i byar ngan 'ga' //re/ rwa//go 1 /༈ risi mi /sho(( ga ltas so/ / sags 'phrad rnams ma 'phrad dang 'dra / /nang 'phrad ni gong du smos pa'i 'byung ba rkyang dpyad kyi skor mgo dang sbyar bas chog de rnams thag ring gi mgron po do gal chen po'i dbang du byas nas bshad la/ thag nye'i mgron po nyi tshe ba yin na ni/dbang thang la brtsis pas 'grub ste ma 'phrad phyi dal/ bu 'phrad kha 'gyod/ dgra 'phrad don med stong pa'am gtam ngan/ grogs 'phrad kha gsal dang don 'grub pa'i ngo / nang 'phrad kyi shing chu me gsum myur/ sa lcags dal ba'am/ yang na rang sa non ngo / 'byung ba rkyang dpyad dang 'phrad kyi 'bras rtsis gang la'ang sbyar du rung ba ni/shing gi dus la bab na mi ljang rta ljang gi mgron po yin na thang ste zhag gcig tshun la sleb par 'dug zer/ me'i dus la bab na/ mi 370

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6dmar rta dmar can yod na thang ste zhag gsum nas sleb ngo yin/'on kyang dang po grogs se lang / bar du tsen ner bsdad/ tha ma yul gzhan du song ngam ma song cha med de 'pho 'gyur che zer sa'i dus tshod la bab na/ mi ser rta ser can yod na thang ste/ de sngon rtso rang sa ma non na phyi dal che/ yang na zhag bzhi nas sleb zer/lcags kyi dus tshod la bab na/ mgron po mi dkar rta dkar can yod na thang ste phyi dal shin tu che/ yang na zhag grangs lnga'i 'phror sleb zer/ chu'i dus tshod la bab na/ mgron po mi sngon rta sngon can yod na thang ste/ mgyogs ngo yod/ zhag gnyis nas slebs so/ /'byung ba'i kha dog gi dbang du de ltar bshad kyang gzhan du na nag po dang ngang ba la sogs pa 'og rta'i pags mdog tha dad pa rnams kyang kha dog gi sde tshan 'di dag gi khongs su bsdu la/ yang mgron po myur du sleb min la/ shing grogs sa lta bu zhig byung na —grogs 'phrad kha gsal dang / sa phyi dal yin pas gtam gsal thos shing mgron po myar du mi 'ong ba'am/ lar dal myar gnyis kyi ra༅ ༄shinang nas myur tshabs che yang / da lta da ltar sleb yong zer rgyu tsam rngo mi thogs pa zhig yin no/ /de sogs rigs pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis dpyad shes par bya'o/ /dgu ba ni/ brtsi bya'i rlung rta dang dus tshod kyi rlung rta 'thab/371

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'bras bshad ma 'phrad dang rkyang dpyad gnyis su phye ba'i dang po ni/ma 'phrad dang grogs 'phrad bzang / bu 'phrad 'bring / dgra 'phrad ngan/ nang 'phrad rnams kyi rnam gzhag rkyang dpyad ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shing bab skyes bu dar ma'i chos phywa la bzang zhing /des mtshon te btsun pa'i chos phywar me/ 'phan phyug can la sa/ dme pho sdig can la lcags/ jo mo dang bud med la chu nyid mchog go /gzhan yang 'byung ba'i kha dog mthun sdeb la brten nas tshong nor shes pa dang mi shes pa'i shan 'byed bya ba sogs mang po zhig yod de/ bri bar ma nus so/ /de ltar rtsis 'bras gtso bo'i rigs rnams brjod zin nas/ da ni rno ltangs gcod pa'i thor ba'i rigs ༄'ga' zhig mdor bsdus su bshad par bya ste/ gang gi tshe rten 'brel zhu ba po de'i gnyen 'dun dang 'og rta sogs gar yod kyi phyogs bstan pa la/ dus tshod kyi 'byung ba gar babs de'i ma phyogs sam bu phyogs gang rung gnyen 'dun tha mal ba'i sa dang /grogs phyogs mdza' bo snying dmar can gyi sa yin/ sgo khyi rang phyogs dang 'og rta grogs phyogs/ rta dang khyi'i kha dog dang lus dbyibs rang mthun/ khyim gyi sgo rang ngam ma phyogs/ gdon bgegs rang dang dgra phyogs/ dgra phyogs su mi mthun pa'i dgra yod pa ste/ dper brjod byas na/ 'byung ba shing gi dus su rten 372

rtsis kyi mo gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long / pod/ 6she'abrel zhu mi byung na de'i gnyen 'dun byang dang lho na yod/ shin tu sdug pa'i grogs gcig lho nub gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshams bzhi gang rung zhig na gnas/ sgo khyi lus ring ra sngon mdog can gcig shar na yod/ 'og rta ra sngon mdog yod na thang ste/ grangs gcig gam/ bcu gcig dang / nyer gcig sogs gcig can gang rung zhig yod/ rta 'dogs sa lho nub lta bu 'am mtshams kyi gra zhig tu byed/ sgo byang ngam shar du lta ba yod/ gnod pa'i gdon shar nub gang rung dang / nub phyogs na dgra zla skyes bu dar ma'i rigs shig yod zer/ de bzhin du me la sgo khyi lus dbyibs mtho zhing mgo che ba dmar po'i rigs/ sa la bab na sgo khyi lus bong thung zhing sha 'thug pa rgya ser/ lcags la sgo khyi dkar po 'am dkar mtshan can lus bong che zhing gtum pa/ chu la sgo khyi lus bong chung la mdog sngon po khyi mo'i rigs/ de sogs lhag ma rnams go sla'o/ /gzhan yang bya ra dang phyed yol/ thig sdong ste de gsum brtsi gzhir byas nas gcod 'bral dang dar rgud kyi rtsis 'bras brtags pa sogs ngo mtshar can gyi gtam dang / khyad par man ngag gi rtsis 'di'i rnam gzhag rgyas pa rdel zhag bcu gsum pa/ 'bring bo rdel zhag drug pa/ bsdus pa rdel zhag bzhi ba/ shin tu bsdus pa rdel zhag gnyis pa ste/ don gyi rlabs che zhing blo gsal dga' ba bskyed pa'i 373

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshul mang po zhig bshad pa yod mod kyi/ re zhig de tsam mo/ /dril na sor gsum rtse mo'i 'phrul 'degs te/ /bkral na rten 'brel sgo brgya'i don ston pa/ /'byung rtsis gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me long 'di/ /blo gsal blang dor blta ba'i mig kyang yin/ /de slad sngon byung mkhas pa'i man ngag 'dir/ /dga' dang gus pa'i nyams brgyas 'dar bzhin du/ /chu skyar chu bo mthong ltar zhugs shig dang / /lung ston bden pa'i tshig 'byung bslu ba med/ /zhes pa'ang rang nyid gtsug lag gi sgo 'dir bag chags 'jog pa dang / khyad par da lta'i dus na g.yo can gyi zog po phal cher zhig mngon mkhyen du snyad btags pa'i stong zob kho nas snang ba brid de lag rtsis 'di tsam la'ang dpe mkhyud kyi nyes pa mi bzad par gsog par mthong nas de dag gi rdzun khungs 'don pa'i phyir rdo shod srin mo'i rdzong gi sprang rgan gsal byed kyi nga ro gsum pa'i yi ge srog tu zhugs shing / de 'og lnga ba'i dang po dbyangs bcu gsum pa'i snying bo can gyi grags pas bcings pa'i bhu su ku zhig gis sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/ sarba maṅga lam̐ dge'o// // 374

pod/ 6༄/ /rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi bka' srung sman btsun ma'i shwa mo dus gsum kun gsal zhes bya ba/na mo gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha be/ 'bum phrag dpa' bo bo ḍak+ki'i ye shes srog /bde stong thig le gcig tu zlum pa'i dbyig /klong chen sgyu ma'i gzugs can 'jigs bral gling / /byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bsten/ /de yang ji skad du o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ ma 'ongs lta sgom ting 'dzin gyi: drod tshad med par 'ol tshod kyis: mngon shes cal col sgrogs pa'i tshe: sman btsun sems kyi cho 'phral lngas: the tshom mdud pa rang sar grol: 1111 ri pa zhes rus grol rdo rje'i gsung gis rjes su bsngags pa ltar sman btsun mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i phrin las kyi gab yig don yod zhags pa'i lugs kyi rno mthong zab mo lag len du bstar ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar stegs bu khebs ldan mañdzi dang bcas pa la sman btsun ma'i bla rdo srog 'khor gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin bstar ba'i mdun du 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu'i khar/ dung shwa gtsang 375

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma tshul bzhin bzos pa'i shwa mig can bsham/ mtha' skor phyi nang gi mchod pa spyi dang / bye brag gser skyems/ phye mar/ 'o chol sogs tshar du dngar/ gzhan yang dgos pa'i yo byad tham sa cad tshang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ thog mar rig 'dzin yab ka dang yum ka ging rung la brten 5'i r+pādag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'khro bas phrin las dpag bsam yongs 'du rgyas par btang rjes/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ /'od zer drwa ba rab 'phros pas/ /sman btsun 'khor bcas thugs rgyud bskul/ /'dod don mngon du sgrub par gyur/ /zhes dmigs te rtsa ba'i rigs snga phyi kha skong bcas bzlas brjod bya/ de nas las sbyor gyi tshe/ mdun bskyed thugs ka'i baṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros snang srid gsal bar byas/ /tshur 'dus bdag la thim pa yis//rno mthong dngos grub thob par dmigs/ /hri badz+ra pra mo ha lo ka sarba mu mu phye phye swā hā/ stong phrag gcig bzla/ stong tshig gis mchod bstod bya zhing spro na tshogs kyi 'khor los kyang mchod/ brtags pa bya tshul dngos ni/ gzhung las/ de nas me long g.ya' bral steng: gang 'dod don smos shwa sgril bas:zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dod don la dmod bor bzhin the tshom med pa'i yid kyis shwa sgril bas/ dang po thig le (3)shar na/ bstan pa'i chus phywar/ mi khyod kyi chus srid ma smin smin 'dra'i a mra/bltas na mdzes/ don rtsa nag sogs zhig snang ste/ thabs la mkhas 376

bka' srung sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma'i shwa mo/ pod/ 6na bzang bor 'ong / khyim phywar/ mi nor la gang stong bag tsam 'ong ste srid pa'i nyi zla 'pho 'chugs 'gro ba mi snang / srog phywar/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chad/ sa'i rtod phur thon te shin tu ngan/ chos phywar/dang po chos byed 'dod kyi nges 'byung spu su de nam zhig rang mtshang rdol ba'i dus mchi/ don phywar/ bang gang gi rta brgyug nas/kha gang gi rgyal za ba lta bu'i don gcig yin na mchi ste/ rngams chen mi 'ong / grog phywar/ grog sha dum tsam la dgra bya glag tsam gcig 'ong ba'am yang na lag stong du 'khor/ mgron phywar/ yong kha la btags nas mi yong lag tu len par 'dug dgra phywar/ bdud kyi bla shing la lcags nag gi sta re thebs pas bzang / gnyis pa tshom ba (4)shar na/bstan pa'i chas phywar/chos srid sman gyi sdong po rig mi rigang gzhi brtan yang 'khor nang 'thab 'ong ba'i sri zhig 'dug pas de 'dul ba la drag po sngags kyi 'phrul 'khor dgos so/ /khyim phywar/gtso bo'i 'dun khang ma mdzes pa'i mkhon 'ga' zhig ldang ba ma gtogs par phywa g.yang longs spyod kyi char ba 'bab pas bzang /srog phywar/ che'i dmu thag dkar po la 'chi med kyi mdud pa dgu yod de shin tu mchog chos phywar/ lha'i rnga sgra dbyangs thag ring /chos kyi mar me 'bar yun ring bas bzang / don phywar/ blo don yod zhags pa'i skor mgo 'di gang du babs kyang dngos grub kho na 377

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yong / grog phywar/ grog 'bras dkar gyi snye ma de brer blug na mi gang /phur tu blug na mi shong 'bring tsam/ mgron phywar/ mgron po dal myur gnyis kyi sa mtshams na yod de dus re zhig nas sleb/ dgra phywar/dgra'i mgo la dmu gab kyi zhwa nag gyon pas nges par thub/ gsum pa tshangs pa (5)shar na/ bstan pa'i chus phywar/ bsod nams las kyi she mong dar drags la yun thung bas rim gro la 'bungs/ khyim phywar/ mar me 'da' kha na gsal/ la 'dzad kha na mtho ste nam phugs mi bden/ srog phywar/ shi'o zer ba'i srog bam med kyang 'chi 'am snyam pa'i 'jigs ngo cig 'dug pas bsrung bzlog gi ri chen snyil/ chos phywar/ ska rags kyi tshos mdog kho nas ming rab byung du btags pa'i g.yon can sgyu ma mkhan zhig 'ong mchi/ don phywar/ sa gom gsum spos na don gsum/ mda' thengs gsum 'phang na 'ben gsum chod de bzang /grog phywar/grog gi g.yu ri phyug mo nas/dngos grub rin po che'i gter kha rdol bas nges par brtson 'tshal/mgron phywar/ chang sings/ gdan thing la ltos dang /zhwa thod kyi rtse mo mthong / dgra phywar/ dgra mgo lcags las sra/ dgra dpung stag las ngar/ mi khyod kyis mi tshad khyod 'dra brgyas rgol kyang thub pa'i sa na mi 'dug bzhi ba sgrom bu (6)shar na/ bstan pa'i chus phywar/ chos 'khor gan dzha la'i dbu rtser grags pa dkar po'i dung 'bud cing 378

bka' srung sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma'i shwa mo/ pod/ 6bstan pa'i gdugs dkar bla nas blar mtho/ khyim phywar/ phyugs kyi g.yang ra ma zhig rtse 'dzin gyi ba gam ma ral bar skyid chi le 'ong /srog phywar/ston brgya'i ltad mo ma mthong /mi brgya'i tshe tshad ma rdzogs bar khyod mi 'chi/ chos phywar/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi chos gzugs lto 'bol ba zhig 'ong / don phywar/ lag stong khar bcugagal stong phrag la gzad de skyo glu ring mo zhig len zhing mchi/ grog phywar/ phyug dar ma'i gzhon nu gser rna can des/ dngul dkar gyi bam pa zhig rum nas bton te ston tsag sbed tsag byed de mi rib rgya riri shi ri bzubartan 'gyur ldog che ba'i ngo / mgron phywar/ khyod kyi mgron po de byis pa ltad mo la yengs pa ltar yong snyam yid na med de thang / de min na gtam ngan khur bo gang khyer nas sleb 'ong / dgra phywar/ da res rtswa ltar zhum pa'i dus min snying stobs me ltar sbar ba'i dus yin te/dgra lha'i dbu rmog brtsan/lnga ba rmig pa(2)shar na/bstan pa'i chus phywar/ mthon po'i gnam ral/ yangs pa'i sa grum/ dpal gyi nyi ma thang la lhung bas shin tu ngan/ bdud bzlog dang bsrung ba la rem/ khyim phywar/ phyug po'i g.yang sgo ral/ btsan po'i ru dar chag 'dug pas gsung rab klog sgrogs dang mchod sbyin rgya cher gyis/ srog phywar/ tshe bdud kyi zhags pas btab kyang bsha' gris ma thebs pas da dung 'chi bslu dang srog 'don sogs rim gro rgya cher 379

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byas na 'tsho tsam/ chos phywar/ sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa nyi ma 'dra ba de mi khyod kyi thod la 'char/ don phywar/ thog so brgya ba'i mkhar las ltar brtson 'grus kyi yun ma song bar nyin gcig la hur thag byas pas mi yong / lar 'gyang sa zhig nas 'grub srid/ grog phywar/ nor bdun rgyud 'tsheng nus med de/ zas nyin gcig 'grang ba yod zeramagron phywar/ dga' ya le/ 'dzum mu le/ phyi lam thag pa bzhin du bsdogs nas sgo rtsa na slebs 'dug dgra phywar/ dpa' bo'i go ral/sdar ma'i bang zad/ srid pa'i mda' mo sked nas chag 'dug pas dgra brub dang rlung rta bskyed pa sogs bya/ 'di rnams phal cher gzhung gis dngos bstan du byung zhing / de las gzhan du nad phywa dang srog phywa khog gcig nor phywa dang mtsher phywa sogs khyim phywa dang khog gcig tshong phywa dang rta phyugs 'phrod min lo legs nyes mdza' bo e rnyed rnams grog phywa dang khog gcig blo phywa dang stor ba rnyed min zhu ba e gnang sman dpyad 'phrod dam sogs don phywa dang khog gcig pa lta bus mtshon te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ slar yang gtor phud kha gso zhing gtang rag gi mchod bstod phul te phrin las bcol/ gtor ma'i ras ma cung zad dngos grub tu shes pas longs spyad/ tshogs mchod dang 'brel ba yin na mnga' gsol gtor ma bstab pa sogs rjes kyi las rim yongs su rdzogs pas 380

bka' srung sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma'i shwa mo/ pod/ 6mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /'di nyid tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas rtag tu gsol kha la brtson pa dang / dung shwa mi lag mi 'grim pa sogs gzhung nas gsungs pa'i spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig ma nyams par bsrung na blang dor bslu med du ston pa ni sangs rgyas pad ma'i lung gis yid ches shing rigs pas kyang grub pa kho na'o/ /rtog ge 'chal ba'i tshig gis ma bslad cing / /ḍāk+ki'i zhal gyi drod rlangs ma yal ba/ /zab don man ngag zil ba 'di rnyed pas/ /slan chad zog po 'i ngag la dga' ba spangs/ /de ltar bod yul gyi lhan cig skyes ma rdo rje sman btsun ma'i shwa mo 'di ni gzhung 'di la grub dbang byang chub rdo rje'i man ngag gi yig cha yod kyang tshig tshogs mang ches par mthong nas yi ge nyung la ngag don go sla bar kun mkhyen bla ma'i chos sras kyi gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa pad+ma khyab bdag rdo rjes sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //381

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄/ /bla ma rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo /re zhig dang por gnas khang mun pa med cing shin tu gtsang la nyams dga' bar/ gza' skar mig dmar dang / pra nye skag snon sa ga rnams med cing / nya stong brgyad dang / dgu gsum byi ba'i nyi ma dang / ma rig rnam shes sred tshor rga shi'i rten 'brel sogs ma yin pa'i dus bzang po'i snga dro nyi ma rtse shar gyi skabs/ mo gdan phying dkar gtsang ma gru bzhi ba'i steng du 'bra tshom lnga bkod de/ dbus ///tre ri cam ri khar me long bsham/ mtha' skor du mchod pa lnga dang / phye mar/skyems phud bcas bkod/ byung na rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs chab kyis khrus bya/ de nas spos dkar sogs gu gul med pa'i spos dang bzang shing gi dud pa gtong zhing / spos me'i pra brtags/ du ba dkar na rgyal po/ dmar na btsan bdud/ sngo na klu sman/ ser na mi kha/ sna lnga rgyun ring byung na/'khyil ba'i tshul de zas nor 'phel/ 'tshub pa'i tshul de dar rgud che/ brkyang pa'i tshul de lam ngo yin/ bkug pa'i tshul de dgra ngo yin/ 'chil zhing kun khyab dus bde yong /'khril ba'i tshul de 'chi ngo yin/ bslang ba'i tshul de lha ngo mtho/ mchan bu/ rten mchod byin gyis brlab/ mda' dar g.yob cing / lha 'bod bden bdar 382

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6zhergyas par bya/mo nas dang skyems phud gtor/ ye rnyarmā mang du bzla'o/ / de nas dung ngam/ lha shing gtsang ma las bzos pa'i shwa/ shar du zla ba/ lhor chu gter/ nub tu mda'/ byang du me/ bla 'og tu mig dang ngo bkod pa zung gcig 'byung lnga'i sngags ā li kā li dang / rten 'brel gyi sngags ye dharmā ci mang bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/gcig brtsi bya dang / cig shos legs nyes lung ston gyi mtshan mar bzung la/ phan tshun mi nor bar byas te/ phywa dkyil du sgril lo/ /de'ang sgril thengs bzhir bskyar ba'i/ mdzod mig dang po klung rta'i rgyal mtshan yin te/ gtso bo yon tan can dang / dgra lha'i sa/ phag lug yos gsum gyi lo mal/ mo'i mig yin/ gnyis pa srog gi ka ba yin te/ mi pho dang rta bong gi sa/ byi 'brug sprel gsum gyi lo mal/mo'i srog yin/ gsum pa dbang thang gi gdung ma yin te/ khyim bdag mo dang gnag phyugs kyi sa/ bya glang sbrul gsum gyi lo mal/mo'i snying yin/ bzhi ba lus kyi gtan pa yin te/ rgan byis dang ra lug gi sa/ khyi rta stag gsum gyi lo mal/ sgo them phyi nang gi sa mtshams yin/ des na gnas mal dang po bzang na/ ban+dhas chos mgo dang / sngags pas mthu rtsal thon/ mkhas btsun gyi yon tan brin/ gtso bo'i gros phugs legs/ dbang phyug dang snyan grags chen po 'thob/ dgra 'dre'i gnya' brdog pas rdzi/ khyim mi spyi la 383

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/btab kyang pha khu che rgan nam/ bla mchod rigs dang / klung rta me khams pa la sgos sa bzang zhing / dgra lha'i dab rmog mtho ba'i ngo chibasi༅ rigasir+shayin/ gnyis pa bzang na/ tshe'i dbang skal mi dman zhing / bar chad kyi rkyen med/ cung zad yod kyang srog gi gser zam mi 'chagam bsgrigs lhun grub kyi ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel mang / che'i srung pa gang byas smin sla/ skyes dar ma dang klung rta shing khams pa/ rta pho'i mo la khyad par du bzang / gsum pa bzang na/ nang gi dkor mdzod dang / phyi'i rmo zhing / bar gyi gnag lhas thams cad phyug dar 'dzom/ nor g.yang gi lha 'go bud med la srid dang / bza' btung la bcud 'chag gsog srung spel gsum gang byas chud mi za/sman dar ma dang / rlung rta chu khams pa/ gnag phyugs kyi mo la khyad par du bzang / bzhi ba bzang na/ lus la nad gdon sogs kyi nyer 'tshe med cing / dbang po gsal/ bkrag mdangs yang rtsal phun sum tshogs/ lto gos sogs 'tsho chas thams cad lus dang 'phrod/ sgo them brling bas dpal 'byor brtan/ gdon dang rkun po'i rgyu srang 'gag rgan byis dang klung rta lcags khams pa/ ra lug khyi gsum gyi mo la lhag par bzang / de bzhin du mdzod mig dang por sdig ltas shar na lha srung gzi byin nyams/ lha 'khrugs song ngam/ pha mes kyi dur sa ldang na'ang thang / gnam sgo ral ba'am 384

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6gnam gyi 'ju thag chad pa yin pas thog ser dang khyim gyi thog rdib/gong ma'i bka' chad la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung / mthon po gnas nas lhung/ btsan po'i kha drag nyams/ bzang byas kyi dge mi thon/ dgra gnyen tshan dang / gyod rdog sne nas lang / yon tan can dang / lo klung me khams pa la rtsub/ gtsug tor dang rgyal mtshan rtse mo/ lha gsol dang bsang mchod/ klung rta ka 'dzugs/ mchod rten chen por gdugs 'dogs pa/ sats+tsha lo grangs/ lha khang mchod rten mang por dkar me snyan shal/ khams dang mthun pa'i dar phyar 'dzugs/ lam 'phrang dang zam pa 'chos pa/ mi kha bzlog gto dang /dgra mnan sogs gnas mal rang dang bstun pa'i bcos chog bya/gnyis par shar na/ srog gi 'khrul 'khor shugs bri bas 'phel chung zhing nyams sla/ bar chad kyi rkyen mang la rgod/ khang sa grum pa yin pas mkhar rdzong 'chor ba'am/ gnas khang bkra mi shis/ bya bzhag gang yang 'dun ma'i khog shing 'chug stag shar dpa' bo'i gra mdangs nyams/ rta bong rngog 'phru can la gzan/ lo klung shing khams pa la rtsub/ gso chog tu/ tshe lha'i sku gzugs bzhengs shing /tshe'i mdo gzungs sgrogs pa/ gsung rab rdo la rko ba/ srog bslu nye'u 'don pa/ srog bskyed pa'i 'khor lo bcang ba/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sregakhram zlog tshe dbang / bla bslu/ brgya bzhi'i cho ga sogs bya/ gsum 385

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par shar na/ nor bu lon du 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma yin pas/ tshong nyes dang dgra la 'jal stong / phyugs god dang shid kyi gtor brlag sogs gyong sgo 'byung / za 'dre 'gong bo'i rgyu lam thod cing /sa'i rten phur thon pa dang / zhing sa stong pa'i mo/ bya ba gang brtsams la snying stong 'ong / yul 'pho yul 'chug dang sa g.yo'i 'jigs pa 'byung nyen yod/ ma bang stong pas srid la ngan/ khyim 'dzin gyi bud med dang lo klung chu khams pa la rtsub/ dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen/ bya khyi sprang gsum la sbyin pa/ byis pa lo grangs la ston mo/ gser 'od dam pa sogs gsung rab 'bri klog chos smra ba la mchod ston/ gtor ma/ g.yang chog sa bdag 'khrugs bcos/dbang thang bskyed pa'i 'khor lo 'dogs pa sogs bya/ bzhi ba shar na/ lus la sngar med kyi na tsha 'byung / sngar yod gting lci/ sgo them zhig pas nang g.yang phyir thon/ gcan rkun gyi za kha 'dzugs/bran g.yog mtha' 'dab la ngan/ byis pa'i rtse ra shod/ ra lug gi lhas mal stong / rgan khog dang lo klung lcags khams pa la rtsub/ sku gzugs mchod rten la dkar gsol dang zhig gso/ 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma dang sats+tsha/ gsung rab rdul sprug sman bla'i cho ga byab khrus/glud dang changs bu bsngo ba/ ming spo lus bsgyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo 'dogs pa/ ma mo'i khrag mdos sogs bya/ khyad par du phye na/ gzhi 386

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6phywa dkyus la bshad ma thag pa ltar mdzod mig bzhi ka dang / chos phywar dang po gtso/ srid phywar gsum pa ma bang dang bzhi ba chung tshang gtso/ bu'i thog mar pho mo gang 'byung la gnyis pa pho sa dang gsum pa mo sa ngo gang mtho blta/ mtho dman mnyam na 'byung ba pho mo'i steng nas bshad/ blo phywa dang don phywa tshong phywa nor phywa lo tog gi mo rnams la gsum pa snying khyim gtso/mdza' bo e rnyed la sgo them dang /rnyed na legs nyes dpyod par snying khyim gtso/ sa cha yul bzung la gsum pa sa sgo gtso/ mtsher phywar gnyis pa khang sa dang gsum pa lhas mal gtso/ dur khang zhing gsum bshad zin/ nad pa 'tsho 'chir srog mkhar gtso/ nad yun ring thung la lus mal gtso/gdon phywar khyim sa ste gsum pa dang lo mal gtso/ le'u sman pa'i mo la dang po rtse 'dzin dang gsum pa sman phor gtso/ sman e 'phrod la lus mal gtso/ zhu ba e gnang la rtse 'dzin dang snying khyim gtso/mgron po e yong la sgo them gtso/ rta phyugs ra lug mor so so'i sa mal gtso/ sgo khyi dang ra lug gnas mal gcig bor stor mo la snying khyim dang them pa gtso/ srog chags stor ba la nyer 'tshe e 'byung rang rang gi sa mal gtso/ chang dang zho 'o'i mor skyems lang dang them bu gnyis ka gsum pa yin pas de gtso/ chang 'tshod mkhan pho mo'i sa mal gang dar de shis/ kha char mo la gnam sgo gtso/387

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dgra phywar klung rta gtso bor bzung ngo / /'on kyang gzhi phywa dang / dgra phywa/ thag ring gi tshong phywa dang / mgron phywa/ blo phywa don phywa rgya chen po'i skor sogs la mdzod mig bzhi ka dang / de las gzhan pa'i phran tshegs kyi skor rnams la de dang de'i gnas mal khol du bton te gdab pa sogs skabs dang 'tshams par sbyar ro/ /gnas mal de rnams su legs nyes kyi 'byang 'gyar lung ston byed dngos ni/ shwa zur 'ju yir tshor chag dedroX ra༅ zipa'ajumag gcag shang bzha ma gnyas drug sa/ /lnga lcags gsum chu ga rarme/ bzhin/ /yar ded ma la mar ded bu/ /a phyi dgra la tsha bo grogs/ /zhes nges par byas te/ sngar bshad pa'i sho gnyis po nang 'dzom tshul gyi steng nas 'phrad de dag brtsi bar bya'o/ /de la grogs phrad bzang la/ ma phrad rab ste/ lhag par ma phrad lci bas brtan las kyi rigs la bsngags shing / grogs phrad yang bas g.yo zhing myur ba'i las la bsngags te/ des 'phral mgyogs su sgrub rgyu'i rigs la ma phrad phyi dal lam bul ngo yin pa dang / lci brtan gyi rigs la grogs phrad gzhi mi brling bar bshad pa'i skabs kyang yod par shes so/ /gzhan yang ma phrad mang ches na skyid kyi la brgal dang /nad pa ha cang zungs zad lta bu'i yul mi 'tshams pa la byung na g.yul log rjes dgra ngo zhi ba ltar mo mig nas thon pa'i nyen yod cing / grogs phrad mang ches na brel zing gi ltas su 'gro ba'i gnas 388

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6kyang yod do/ /sa ma me phrad lta bu 'phrad la dpyad na brtan pa dang /'byung khams la brtags na g.yo ba yin pas khog brtan la cung zad g.yo ba rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs lta bur bshad de/ gzhi phywar 'phral mtho dman mang po 'ong yang phugs chus brtan pa dang / mgron phywar phyi dal che yang myur du kha skad gsal po thos par ngos 'dzin pa la sogs pas mtshon nas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /'byung ba bu 'phrad du byung na nyer 'tshe phra mo dang kha 'gyod yin te/ gso chog nyung ngu'am phra mos zhi bar nus shing / dgra phrad byung na 'jigs pa chen po dang snying 'gyod yin te bcos thabs chen po dang mang pos zhi ba'i khyad ma gtogs de gnyis phyogs mtshungs su bshad rgyu yin no/ /sa nang ma phrad dang / chu nang grogs phrad dang phyogs mthan pa /re/ rang la/ ma grogs las dman pa tsam du bshad par bya nga / shing lcags me gsum nang phrad bzang ngan 'dres ma dang / rgyal pham gnyis med/ lha 'dres 'then rtsod lta bu'i dbye bsal dka' ba dang / rim gro'i rgyab dpung drag zhan gyi rjes su 'gro bar lung ston no//'byung ba so so'i sgos bshad kyis shin tu gsal bar lung ston tshul ni/ thog mar spyi'i 'gro phyogs ma bslab na mang du bshad pas mgo rmongs par 'gyur bas 'di dag blo la byang bar bya ste/ rus 389

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sbal gyi rtsib g.yas shar shing khams/ mgo bo lho me khams/ rtsib g.yon nub lcags khams/ mjug ma byang chu khams te/ lung ba dang /khyim dang / mal dang / mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pa'i lus la'ang de ltar sbyar ro/ kha dog ljang gu shing / dmar po me ser po sa/dkar po lcags/ nag mthing chu'o/ /grangs sho mig bzhin te/ mnyam pa gsum dang / mi mnyam pa gsum mo/ dbyibs 'jong nar shing /gru gsum me/ gru bzhi sa/ zla gam lcags/ zlum po chu'o/ /gnas lugs ke re lang ba shing / lhab lhub 'bar ba me/ ca re bsdad pa sa/ rno zar rog pa lcags/ zhod de 'gro ba cha'o/ /lci yang shing me cha gsum chosi me rabasir+sha rir payang ba/ sa lcags gnyis lci ba'o/ /mgo dbyibs mgo phrug shing /ral ba me/ rbad mgo sa/ co breg lcags/ ltag skra chu'o/ /pho mo shing lcags sa gsum pho/ me chu mo'o/ /mi rigs rgyal rigs sa/ rje rigs me/ bram ze shing / dmangs rigs chu/ gdol ba lcags so/ /yang rgyal po shing / bud med me/ btsun pa sa/ byis pa lcags/ bon po chu'o/ /ban+dha me/ phyug po sa/ stag shar lcags/ bud med chur bshad pa'ang yod do/ /nye du pha khu shing / bu tsha me/ ma phyi yul mkhar sa/ nor grogs lha srung lcags/ gnyen lam mtha' bzhi chu'o/ /brjod pa skad 'gag gre 'dar shing / so bar sgra 'don me/sna skad 'don pa sa/ kha gdangs lce 'phyar lcags/ mchu rub mchu 'dzum chu'o/ /mtshan ma lba 390

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6ba shing / ngo rmen can me/ rgur po sa/ mchan khung sme ba can lcags/sho re cha'o/ /las yang zhing g.yo ba shing / tsha bsreg me/ li 'thib sa/bsgo sto rte /nurno zur lcags/ rlan gsher chu'o/ /bzo shing mkhan shing / rdza mkhan sogs me/ gyang mkhan dang zhing pa sogs sa/ mgar ba lcags/ gru ba dang lham mkhan sogs chu'o/ /longs spyod ra dang bong bu shing /ras snam gos dar rta sogs me/ zhing dang g.yag lug sogs sa/rin po che dang go mtshon sogs lcags/ sbra phyar ja sig sogs chu'o//zas shing tog sngo tshod shing / bsreg sha mgo sha khrag tshod me/ khur ba dang rkang lag gi sha sa/ rtsib ma'i sha dang dkar gsum lcags/ chang dang chu dang dar ba chu'o/ /ro kha ba shing / tsha ba me/ mngar ba sa/bska ba lcags/ skyur ba chu'o/ /bro ba rengs pa shing / skyur ba me/ bska ba sa/ zhim mngar lcags/ sla la bsing pa chur bshad pa'ang 'byung ngo / /nad rtsa rgyus rengs pa dang rlung nad shing / mgo nad dang tsha ba me/ shad dang lci 'thib sa/ gzer zug rnag dang rus nad lcags/grang ba ro smad na ba chu'o/ /don snod mchin mkhris shing / rgyu snying me/pho mtsher sa/ glo long lcags/ mkhal lgang chu'o/ /sgo mig shing / lce me/mchu sa/ sna lcags/ rna ba chu'o/ /'dre gnyan dang the rang shing /btsan dang gri bo me/ sa bdag yul 'dre sa/ dkor bdag rgyal po lcags/ klu dang ma mo chu ste lcags gri gshed dang / shing rgyal por 391

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yang bshad do/ /lo zla zhag dus ni stag yos shing / rta sbrul me/ sprel bya lcags/ byi phag chu/ gshed bzhi sa ste/ srog chags bcu gnyis po yang de ltar sbyar ro/ /de dag kyang / phyogs mdog grangs dbyibs gnas lugs dang / /lci yang sgra tshad pho mo rigs/ /nye du brjod pa sha mtshan las/ /longs spyod zas bro nad 'dre lo/ /zhes sdom du dril nas bzung ngo / /de ltar shes pa na phrad dang 'byung ba rkyang dpyad gnyis sbrags nas ston tshul dngos ni/ re zhig yig tshogs nyung ba'i3phyir bshad pa bzang ngan 'bring gsum du rigs bsdus nas/dgra grogs nang phrad gsum gyis mtshon te brjod par bya'o/ /shing grogs sa phrad du byung na/ khyim phywar srid pa'i ri rab rmang 'gram brtan pas bzang yang mang drags na nyi ma lho nub nas 'byung ba sa khams pa'i phyogs kyi skad cha 'ur zing can yod ngo yin/bstan chus dang chos phywar yang gser gyi sa gzhi la dpag bsam gyi shing skye ba'i ngo yin pas bzang / srid mi nye mi ring ba'i dus su thon/ bu bu pho sa'i mi rigs shig 'byang ltas dang bu tsha ming sring ༄gnyis sam bzhi sogs mnyam pa'i grangs shig skye ngo yod/ mi rabs gcig pa'i spun grangs de 'dra zhig ma byung rung rgyud kyi phyi mtha' de 'dra zhig tu sdud na thang / blo phywa dang don phywa gtan las rigs la shin tu bzang ste/ mtha' bzang la yid brtan nyan pa 392

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6'ong / de min 'phral gyi bya ba la dal ngo dang phugs su dge zhing legs pa'i mtshan ma yin/ de'ang nyi ma lho nub nas rdza mkhan nam phyug po gtso bo'i rigs kyis grogs byas nas sa yul gru gad pa ser po yod pa'am thang chen po'i dkyil du don chod/ tshong phywar longs spyod gzhi brtan cing khe spogs kyi 'phel ka che/ khyad par du rdzas ser po'i rigs las khe skyed chen po 'byung / nor phywa dang lo tog legs nyes la'ang shin tu mchog zhu don gnyer na/ brtan chags kyi las don zhig yin na shin tu 'grub/de min na phyi dal che/mdza' bo e rnyed na khyod kyi mdza' bor 'ong rgyu'i mi de mdog ser ba/ lus po lci zhing bongs thung la sha che ba/ kha nyung ba gtam bden pa zhig yod na thang / de med na de lta bu'i mi rigs kyis grogs byas nas nam phugs dbang du 'du ngo dang mdza' ba brtan chags 'ong ba'i ltas/ dur mo dang khang sa mtsher sa'i mo la sa dpal che zhing skyid kyi dmu thag yod pas shin tu bzang / zhing sa bzang ngan la zhing gru bzhi ngos mnyam/ khang pa'i lho nub sogs mtshams bzhi'i gang rung zhig tu yod na thang ste gang ltar yang 'azang / nad phywar zhag bzhi tshun chad kha ga sal zhig 'dug de ma byung tshe gting cung zad lci yang nam phugs skyon med/ gdon phywar mtshams bzhi'i gang rung nas gzhi bdag dang rgyal po gnod de da lta 'byung pos 393

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyi lam snyog pa'i ngo yin pas bzang / le'u sman pa'i mo dang sman bsten na 'phrod min 'debs na/ sa bzang po la shing n+ya gro dha'i sa bon btab pa dang 'dra ste/ srog lus gnyis ka'i sa na skyed che/mgron phywar/ mgron po mi rig zhwa thod rig pa'i ngo yin yang thang /zhag bzhi'i mtshams tshun chad ma thon na shol 'gyang che/ lar byes bgrod nye zho med cing rdzas spyad ser po'i rigs kyi rnyed pa dang /mngar zhing zhim pa'i bza' btung gi pham phab 'ong / rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor srog chags de dang de sha 'thug cing kha dog ser po zhig yod shas che ste/ dge zhing phan thogs 'ong / bor stor mal sa dang khyim gyi gru bzhi gang rung zhig tu rdza snod dam sa rjen la brten pa'am gdu bu dang phu dung lta bu'i yan lag gi chas ci yang rung ba'i zur dril thum ser po can zhig na yod/ phyi rol du stor na lung ba'i g.yon phyogs kyi phu lta bur yod dam/ thang chen po dang ri'i mtshams bzhi gang rung nas rnyed ngo yod/ lar rang sa ma bor na ma gtogs rnyed cung zad dka'/ chang dang zho 'o snyol na phyug po gtso bo'i khyim nas phabs dang zho gta' longs la tshul bzhin snyol dang ro bcud nus pa phul byung 'byung / chang btso mkhan mtshams bzhi'i lo ba dang rdza mkhan lta bus btsos na bzang / kha char mo la sprin gyi zo ba la them bu bcug pas re zhig mi 'bab/ 'on kyang 394

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6dus char 'dod na sprin chen po'i mdo klog sgrogs dang gzhan yang 'byung ba chu'i rten 'brel mang po bsgrigs na rnyed ngo 'dug dgra phywar/ lcags ri'i shing rdo ma 'gul bas dgra med/ yod kyang mi mgo lcags las sra bas don pham med do/ /me grogs lcags phrad/ khyim phywar/ mnga' thang stobs kyi 'byor ba rdo rje'i brag ltar sra bas bzang / ha cang mang na nyi ma nub phyogs nas 'byung ba lcags rigs kyi 'ur ngo yin/ bstan chus dang chos phywar/ lha srung bzang pos mgon byed pas bzang 'on kyang dka' tshegs chen pos 'grub pa'i ngo zhig 'dug srid phywar/bag tsam ring ba'i dus su thon/ bu bu pho lcags khams pa zhig 'byung ltas dang grangs mi mnyam pa skye ngo yin/ bu tsha cung zad gso dka'/ blo phywa dang don phywa dka' las kyis bsgrub rgyu zhig yin na thang / de min na dka' dka' ltar rim gyis 'grub/ lar bzang /de'ang nub phyogs nas byis pa'am stag shar mgar ba bya sprel lo ba lta bus grogs byas nas sa yul zla gam mam mtshon cha'i dbyibs can sa shar dang gad brag dkar po yod sar don chod/ tshong phywar/tshong ra mang po 'grim/ rmed mang po bcol ba'i mtha' zhig na khe spogs 'ong / khyad par du rdzas spyad dkar po'i rigs las rnyed pa 'grub/ nor phywa dang lo legs min la'ang spyir bzang mod kyi lo 395

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tog skye tshan chung / zhu ba e gnang na/ kha sra bzhin don la snying dga' 'ong / mdza' bo 'tshol na/ mi de mdog dkar po/ sha gyong ba/shes pa gsal zhing skad 'thug pa/ khro zhing kha tsha ba zhig yin mchi/de min na de 'dra'i mi rigs zhig gis grogs byas nas mi rnyed 'dra ba'i ngang la rnyed par 'gyur/ dur mo dang khang sa mtsher sa zhing sa bzang ngan rnams la sa de zla gam brag chung dkar po yod pa zhig yin na thang / mtsher sa'i rtswa 'brog dang zhing nub phyogs na yod de bzang / nad phywar zhag lnga tshun la kha gsal cig 'dug de min na sman dang sman pa bsten 'tshol sogs dka' ba du ma'i mthar nad sos 'khun pa dengs/ gdon phywar/ nub phyogs nas gri bo dang dkor bdag gnod de skyon chung / le'u sman pa'i mo sogs la/ khyod kyi le'u slob dpon dang sman pa de dag mi khug pa'i nyen cig 'dug khug na lcags las me 'byung / sman las nus pa 'thon sngags las byin rlabs 'grub pas ches bzang / mgron po e 'ong na/ mi khyod kyi mgron po de la dka' tshegs mang po'i yus cig 'dug ste don pham mi 'dug rdzas spyad dkar po'i rigs kyi rnyed pa dang / bza' btung ro bska ba zhig kyang gsar rnyed yod/ zhag lnga tshun la ma sleb na bul ngo yin/rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor/rta rgod dang g.yag rgod/ khyi gtum bag can lta bu kha dog dkar shas 396

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6che ba yod na thang ste bzang /bor stor mal dang khyim gyi g.yon ngos khro lcags lta bu'i snod nang ngam lcags spyad kyi zur dang dril thum dkar po'i nang du yod/ phyi rol du na lung ba'i g.yon lag nub phyogs kyi ri'am ri'i srib/ rdza brag chen po'i rgyud dang / rdo khrol ba'i khrod sogs na yod/ tshegs chen pos btsal na rnyed mchi/ chang ༄ dang zho 'o'i mor/ zhim mngar gyi bro ba bzang dgu 'byung bas rab yin/ chang btso mkhan stag shar bya sprel lo ba lta bus bzang kha char e 'bab la/ re zhig 'bab dka' yang gnyug bsring na gangs dkar mu tig gi dog pa lta bu 'thor ngo yod/ dgra phywar/dgra lha phrag na bzhugs pas mdzub mos bsnun na mdung dang khu tshur brdeg na tho bar 'gro ste gyen du mi 'bur/sa grogs chu phrad/ khyim phywar srid pa las kyi rgya mtshor phywa g.yang gi nor bu 'du bas shin tu bzang / mang ches na 'byung ba chu khams kyi 'ur ngo yin/ bstan chus dang chos phywar yang bzang lha srung mo rgyud rigs kyis grogs byed/ srid phywar dbang thang rin po che'i gzhong bar/ srid kyi g.yu mtsho 'khyil bas bzang / dus nye ba'i sa nas thon/ bu bu mo 'ong zhing lar mnyam pa'i grangs 'byung / blo phywa dang don phywa myur du bsgrub rgyu zhig yin na 'grub/ de min na yongs rdzogs 'grub dka' yang cung zad 'grub/ de'ang byang 397

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phyogs nas gru ba'am bud med gos sngon po can byi phag lo ba dang sho re yod pas grogs byas nas sa yul zlum po gad brag sngon po'am nag po yod pa dang mtsho'am chu bo'i 'gram lta bur don chod/tshong phywar 'byung ba chu'i mi rigs las tshong spogs myur du 'grub/khyad par du zong sngo nag gi rigs las khe 'byung / nor phywa dang lo legs nyes la dpal cho ga shes dang nor rgyun ma sogs g.yang lha bud med rigs kyis mgon mdzad pas shin tu bzang / de dag si/ gzungs 'don zlos dang zhing dkyil du klu'i gter bum sba/ zhu don 'dod na kha grog che ste don grog gi ngos na mnog che rgyu mi 'dug mdza' bo 'tshol na/ mi de mdog sngo ba/ ku co mang la gtsang sbra chung ba/ 'brog sbra nag can gyi rigs shig yin na thang / de min de lta bu'i mi rigs kyis grogs byas nas myur du rnyed/ dur dang khang mtsher zhing sa rnams byang gi phyogs na dbyibs zlum po yur srub dang ko mog yod pa'am na spang mang po dang chu'i 'gram lta bur yod na thang / ji ltar yang bzang / nad phywar/ zhag gnyis tshun la ri rtse'i smug pa yar dengs su 'gro bas bzang / gdon phywar byang phyogs nas mo gdon nam dam sri gnod/ gdon ngo yang bas snying stong mi 'gro/ le'u sman pa'i mo la 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter rnyed pas shin tu bzang / mgron 'ong ngam zhe na/ mgron po mi nag rta 398

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6nag can nor spyad sngon po'i rigs dang bza' btung skyur po'i rigs kyi rnyed pa dang / kha dga' gtam snyan dang bcas te myur bar 'ong / de min yang byang phyogs kyi mi byi phag lo ba'i ngag lam na gtam gsal yod/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor rgod ma ba 'bri khyi mo sogs sha rid cing bongs chung ba zhig yin shas che/ kha lta bed sbyin 'ong / bor stor khyim mam mal sa'i sgo'am rten ma'i phyogs chu'i nang dang chu snod kyi zar/ sgye nag lta bu chu rlung mi chaṭa ༄sa'i snod dang dril sngon po'i nang na yod/ phyi rol du lung ba'i sgo gzhug dang ri'i byang ngos/ chu 'gram mam/ sa brag sngon po yod pa'i nang du rnyed de mgyoṭa ngo yod/ zho chang mor/ dung g.yu'i skyems bum du bdud rtsi'i g.yang zhag 'khyil bas bzang / chang btso mkhan sman shar byi phag lo ba lta bus btsos na bzang / kha char e 'bab na/ sprin dkar gyi rkyal ba kha ral/ chu'i gter rdol bas shin tu 'bab/ kha chas chugachar zon gyis/ dgra phywar/ rang mgo ri las mtho/dgra mgo chu las dma' ste skyon med do/ /lcags grogs shing phrad/ khyim phywar/ 'khor 'dab longs spyod n+ya gro dha'i yal ga ltar rgyas pas shin tu bzang / mang che na shar phyogs nas shing khams pa'i skad cha 'ur can 'ong / bstan chus dang chos phywar legs dgu'i yon tan yar 'phel du 'gyur te rab 399

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yin/ srid phywar/ shin tu myar ba'i dus su thon/ bu bu pho shing khams shā)(/)she /)she /)sher mi hāX/pa dang nga sring mnyam pa ༄ grangs su 'byung ngo yin/ blo phywa dang don phywar bzang g.yo drag myur ba'i las la khyad par du mchogade'ang shar phyogs nas phu nu'am shing mkhan stag yos lo ba dang rgyal po lta bus grogs byas nas sa yul nar 'jong ljon shing gi dbyibs lta bu'am shing rtsib na bun yod pa dang brag gad sngo ljang rigs yod par don 'grub/ tshong phywar/ tshong ya shing gi mi rigs las khe spogs chen po 'ong / khyad par rdzas spyad sngo ljang rigs sam shing chas rigs las rnyed pa 'grub/ nor phywa dang lo legs nyes la bzang rab kyi rtse mo yin/ zhu ba gnang ngam zhe na/ gtsug na zla ba'i dbang sdud rlung gi zhags pa de mi khyod la yod pas 'dun ma'i jus legs/ mdza' bo rnyed dam na/ mi de mdog sngo zhing kha blo mang ba/ bongs ring rgur po/ 'gros mgyogs shing spun zla mang ba zhig yin mchi/ rnyed kyang rnyed la phan thogs kyang 'ong ngo / /dur dang khang mtsher zhing sa rnams la dbyibs nar mo/ shing rtsi mang po yod pa shar gyi phyogs su yod na thang ste bzang / nad par zhag gcig tshun la kha gsal yod/ nad rgyun ring zhing gting can yin na yang ches bas mi bzang / gdon phywar shar phyogs nas gnyan dang rgyal po the'u rang gnod de nyes skyon med/ le'u sman pa dang sman bsten 400

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6na 'phrod min ni/ khyod kyi le'u slob dpon nam sman pa de nyi ma shar gyi phyogs su yod na thang / da res kyi gdam kha 'di ma nor 'dug pas brtson pa bskyed cig mgron phywar/ me bus/ shing shogaskyems skol la sdod dang mig mthong gang gi sar sleb la khad du 'dug nor ljang sngon nam shing spyad bzang po dang / bza' btung ro kha ba'i rigs kyi rnyed pa yod/ yang na shar phyogs kyi mi shing khams pa zhig gi kha nas ngag gsal thos ngo yong / rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor rta 'do ba 'gros ldan dang khyi dbyibs 'jong ring sogs yod shas che/ don la bzang / bor stor mal lam khyim gyi g.yas ngos par bu lta bu'i shing snod kyi nang ngam ka ba dang shing spyad ci yang rung ba'i zur dril thum ljang sngon sogs na yod/ phyi rol du na lung ba'i g.yas phyogs/ ri'i nyin dang shar phyogs kyi ri bo'i ngos/ shing rtsi ban bun yod pa nas stag yos lo ba dang skad 'gags gre 'dar rigs kyis rnyed de myur du tshol/ zho chang gi mo la'ang shin tu bzang / chang btso mkhan 'byung ba shing khams pas byas na bzang / kha char e 'bab na/ khyim gyi shar phyogs su chu mig bcu gsum gyi zla ba lta ba zhig yod srid pas de'i ngogs su klu ༄gtor rgya chen btang na nyi ma shar phyogs nas chu rlung chen pos bskyod pa'i kha char 'ong / dgra phywar/ mi khyod la rno zur lcags kyi 401

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stobs yod/ dgra phyir rgol la rgya lcang phra mo'i stobs las med pas rgol ba yong snyam mi dgos/chu grogs me phrad/ khyim phywar/ skye bo che dgu'i rigs kyis 'gram btegs te chus srid btsan dar che ba 'ong / bstan pa'i chus phywa dang chos phywar dge sbyong ngur smrig can dang blo gsal rig pa mkhan rgyun mi 'chad pas rab yin/ srid phywar/ mi ring ba'i dus su thon/bu bu mo 'byung / yang na 'byung ba me khams pa'i bu zhig 'ong / srid mi mnyam pa'i grangs zhig skye ngo yod/ blo phywa dang don phywa gang yin kyang myur du 'grub/ de'ang lho phyogs nas ban+dha gos dmar can dang gos bzo'am zhang nye rta sbrul lo ba lta bus grogs byas nas yul gru gsum sa brag dmar po yod pa/ lung phu lhor bstan zhig tu don 'grub shas che/ tshong phywar/ yul mkhar dmar po'i nang du tshong ya rigs mthon po dang gzhan yang me khams pa'i phyogs shig las khe 'ong / rdzas spyad dmar po'i rigs las khyad par du rnyed/ nor phywa dang lo tog legs nyes la/ khyod kyi phyugs mkhong dang lo zhing de dag nyi ma lho phyogs su yod na thang ste/ phra mo cher smin zhing nyung ngu mang por 'phel bas bzang / zhu ba e gnang gi mo la mchog yin/mdza' bo 'tshol na/ mi de mdog dmar la bongs 'tshams pa kha 'phang mtho zhing blo rno la cho rigs btsun pa zhig yin shas che/ de 402

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6min na de 'dra'i mi rigs shig gis grogs byas nas myur du rnyed/dur mo dang khang mtsher mor yang bzang / zhing sa bzang ngan la khyod kyi sa zhing de lho phyogs sa dbyibs gru gsam zhig yod na thang rigang rigang ste/ kha dge bkra shis 'ong / nad phywar/ nad kyi gzhi yang bas skyon med/ zhag gsum nang du kha gsal yod/ gdon phywar/lho phyogs nas bdud btsan dang / bsen mo gnod/ gdon rang lam 'ded pas bzang / le'u sman pa sogs la/ skyid kyi nyi ma lho phyogs nas 'char/pad+ma kha 'bus pa la nyi zer phog pa dang 'dra ste mchog slob dpon le'u ming ga ge mo bya ba gnyis las gang drag zer na/ me khams 'di mi mnyam pa'i grangs shig gi ngo yin pas 'dri byed kyis thog mar smos pa de dga'/ mgron phywar/ mgron po mi dmar rta dmar can da lta sleb na'ang thang / zhag gsum tshun chad nges par 'ong /de ma thon na rje'u rigs rta sbrul lo ba las gtam gsal thos/ byes bgrod kyi rnyed nor rdzas spyad dmar po'i rigs dang bza' btung ro tsha ba 'ga' re 'dug mo 'di babs grangs mang na nyi ma lho phyogs kyi 'ur ngo yod/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug 'di bsten na 'phrod dam mi 'phrod ce na/ spu rtags dmar po can mgo cung zad che ba/ me khams pa'i mi lag nas brgyud pa zhig yin na thang / shin tu 'phrod do/ /bor stor khyim mam mal stan khug dang sngas mgo me 403

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mda' dang me cha lta bu'i me'i rdzas kyi zar/ dril tham sogs snod 1(thohāX 1nges byebyebye/ ra mi /༷/spyad dmar ri nang du yod rnyed/ d+ngha rol du stor na lung ba ri phu/lho phyogs kyi ri'am ri'i rtse rdza brag dmar po yod pa'am/ lam ja bskol ba'i me sol dang sgyed rdo nag su re ba yod sar so bar sgra 'don lta bus rnyed/ zho chang mo la/('dir chad snyam) chang btso mkhan bu tsha rta sbrul lo ba lta bus btsos na bzang / kha char e 'bab na/ 'bab mi 'dod nas 'dri na sprin med nyi ma 'char bas shin tu bzang / kha char 'dod thog yin na rang dbang du mi 'bab kyang char byung bgyis na ngo snyi bar 'dug dgra phywar/ me 'bar ri lung tshig kyang rgya mtsho chen po'i klong rum na yang med pas ci bder sdod/ 'byung ba ma phrad kyang des 'gres/shing dgra lcags phrad/ khyim phywar/ phyi rol du mtshon dang gnam lcags 'bab pa dang rbab rgod kyi 'jigs pa 'ong / nang du 'og nas 'byung ba'i nad rigs skye/ pha khu che rgan la rtsub/ sngags pa ber phur can gyi byad kha yod/ gri 'dul dang gdugs bzlog bya/rig sngags zab mo'i rlung 'khor bskor/ bstan chus dang chos phywar/chos dang 'dod pa/ nor dang thar ba ste sde bzhi'i ljon shing la bdud kyi sta gri thebs pas shin tu ngan/ gnas brtan phyag mchod dang mdo sde klog sgrogs sogs bsags sbyang gi bsrung ba gyis/404

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6srid phywar/ srid kyi sdong po skam pas shin tu ngan/ blo phywa dang don phywar gong du bshad pa'i mi rigs lcags khams pa zhig gis bar chad byed ngo yod/ de min na mi blo 'dres brkus/ don chung chung gi rjes na byur chen po yod/ tshong phywar/ mkhar dkar po dang pha bong thag thug yod sar tshong byas pa mi 'dra/ jag nyes pa 'dra ba'i lo rgyus 'byung / nor phywar/ nor dkar mtshan can mi lag tu shor bas rkyen byas g.yang gi sgo ral/ ri spyang gi za kha dod pas ngan/ nor gzungs dang g.yang 'bod thongs/ lo legs nyes la zhing dgra ser ba'i gnod pa 'ong bas ser gcod kyi bsrung ba gyis/ zhu ba gnang ngam na/ zhus don mi gnang gi steng du da dung mi snyan pa'i tshig ngan sta re lta bu zhig kyang thos ngo yod/ mdza' bo 'tshol na/ kha grog dang ma phrad par/ sna rdo la thug pa'i nyen cig 'dug pas bya ba ma mang / dur phywar/ dur sa phu nub bstan gri shi gri gshed mang pos tshang bcas pa zhig 'dug ste mi 'phrod/ khang phywar/ khyod kyi khang ba de sgo nas bltas na lam skya thang nge mthong ba zhig 'dug der bsdad na bkra mi shis pas spos dang dga'/ zhing gi mor sa zhing zla gam cig yong na thang ste ngan/ bcos ka sla/ nad phywar/ phyi yul rgyus pa/ nang yul glo long me tog sna ste de rnams gang rung gi nad/gnyan srin lnga bu shin tu thu ba gcig 'dug yang na bad rlung dang rmo405

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skran rigs yin/ lar shin tu ngan/ rta phyag khyung gsum gyi sngags sgrub sogs rdzas sngags kyi bsrung ba rnon po me lta bu mang du bsten/da lta gad brag gam mchod rten dkar zhing ring ba'i gsham cha ther dkar po lta bu'i nang du gnas bcas yod na thang bas de 'dra na re zhig sdod mi rung / gdon phywar/ brag gnyan bshig pas nyes na thang / de med na dme mgar lta bu'i 'grul sna dang / sgam khom phad sgye sogs snod dkar po/ dar ram snam ras dang rin po che dkar po'i rigs sam/ shing lcags sprad ma'i rigs khyim gyi g.yon phyogs na yod rgyu zhig grib/ yang na dang po nub phyogs kyi sa yul zla gam sogs nas byang ba'i 'bra dang shing thog dkar po'i rigs dang /zi pa skur rigami mchog zuring zi sna zur〉zha dar mar thud khur ba phrum dang bya zal gya sha'am srag chags ca yang rung ba'i rtsib ma g.yon phyogs kyi sha sogs kha nub tu bltas nas lcags snod lta bur zos pa de nyes/ rdzas spyad de dag gi phyir 'brang yin na gdon rigs ngos bzung mi dgos kyang / gtso cher dkor bdag rgyal po dang gri gshed gnod/ de dag la mdos yas thongs/ gri 'dul gnad smin sgrub/ lha srung khros pa'i zur ngo zhig kyang 'dug pas bskang bshags la brtson/ le'u sman pa'i mor/rang rdung gi tho ba yin te shin tu ngan no/ /mgron e 'ong na/ mgron po dgra dang phrad/ ral gri'i kha dbrag dang mda'i so dbrag na yod 406

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6de/ da dung mi sleb/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor/ gtum bag sogs grogs phrad skabs dang 'dra yang 'di khog ngan pas spangs/bor dor shin tu rnyed dka'/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi rkun po co skra breg pa khro gtam can sogs sngar bshad pa'i lcags kyi mi rigs lnga la sogs pas rdza khrod lta bur bskung yod na'ang thang / dka' tshegs chen po byas pa'i mtha' zhig tu rtsad chod 'byung srid/ chang dang 'o zho'i mor/ skyems 'dre can du 'dug pas mi zhim pa'am/zhim kyang de'i sna la byur cig 'dug chang btso mkhan me khams pas byas na bzang / kha char 'bab bam zhe na/ mi 'dod na 'bab/'dod na mi 'bab pa'i phyin ci log tu 'byung / dgra phywar/ dgra lha'i ru mtshon chag pas ngan/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi dgra kha btsan can 'ong nas gnod pa byed/ khams dang mthun pa'i dar 'phyar ba dang / lha gsol dgra brub 'byung ba'i rten 'brel sogs bya'o/ /me dgra chu phrad/ khyim phywar/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang 'byang ba chu'i :) nyu) sir+sha157nad rigs skye/ bu tsha ma smad la rtsub/ sab — re sgye nag sa mgo la gyon 'dug pas ngan/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg ('dir mchan bu/ 'byung ba me khams pa'i gza' skar tshes grangs 'dzoms dus rta sbrul lo bas gos dmar po gyon nas dgra 'ong phyogs su me brab bya/) dang / rnam 'joms byab khrus lha bsang chen po sogs bya'o/ /bstan phywa dang chos phywar/ lha'i nor bu me shel 407

21jid/ (( zerdo /spyirngaku 'o/:drob/bzhi cesatshod nga//nyazud rta):re tha/sdosathab 'o/dra/zug/ ra〉gcin 'dam du lhung ba'i ngo zhig yod/ lha gsol dang bar chad sel ba'i lha bsnyen sgrub la 'bad/ srid phywar/ khyod kyi mchis brang de mo gsham mam yang na mngal 'dre can du 'dug pas ma'i bang dang byis pa'i rtse ra gnyis stong bar 'ong / blo phywa dang don phywar/ 'byung ba chu'i mi rigs kyis kha 'gog byed/ de ma byas rung don nyams zhe 'gyod chen po 'ong bas mi bzang / tshong phywar/ gru zam chen po'i 'gram la sogs par chu'i mi rigs las don pham 'byung / nor phywar/ ma 'bri sogs la god kha 'ong bas rim gro bya/ lo tog la 'debs na 'khyag sad chen po 'ong / sad srung nan tan gyis/ zhus don gnyer na me chu nang du 'bud pa dang 'dra ste mi 'grub/ mdza' bo 'tshol na/mi 'di la blo gtad mi 'dug mdzod nas mi ldang rkun po ldang bya ba yin pas bshol dgos/ dur dang zhing khang gi mor/dur sa phu byang bstan dang gnas khang mun pa can sogs yod thang /klu srin ma rungs pas bdag byas pas mi 'phrod/ nad phywar/ phyi yul ro smad/ nang yul mkhal lgang / sgo rna ba gang rung gi nang / bad kan grang ba dam chu chu 'gag chu ser sogs bsil zhing 'jam pa'i 05 rten:sku ra༅ rags tsho khyod la ram 'bar thum shi 'ong / phyag skor gtar dpyad sogs nad babs dang bstun pa'i bcos ka bya/ da lta sa yul dma' zhing nag la snum pa/ khang khung dang chu mig mang po yod 408

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6sa sbra nag lta bu'i nang du yod na yul brje gyis/ gdon phywar/ mtsho sman klu dang chu 'dre dam sri gnod/ de'ang chu mig gnyan la phog thug song ba'am/ mi rigs chu khams pa'i 'grul sna dang / sgye phyar sgam khom sogs snod dang spyad pa ngam gnag dbyibs zlum po khyim gyi sgo 'gram na yod rgyu zhig grib/ yang na byang phyogs kyi rgyud nas byung ba'i bza' btung sla la bcud chung ba'i rigs/ nya phag dang byi ba'i sha'am gzhug sha sogs zas spyod nyes/ grib ngo shin tu che bas bsang khrus dang / gzhan yang / rgya chen shugs ldan gyi chu sbyin klu gtor dam sri mnan pa 'dre mo bkar yas sogs gdon rigs dang bstun pa'i rim gros bcos/ le'u sman pa'i mor/ bdud rtsi'i snod du dug 'phyur bas ches ngan/ mgron po 'ong ngam zhe na/ mgron lam kha bas bcad dam/ chu chen brum pas sngun 'gag nas 'dug ste da dung mi sleb/ chu 'am chu khams pa'i dgra bo dang thug nas snying 'gyod chen po 'ong ngo yod/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor yang ngan te mi 'phrod/ bor stor chu nang du chud zos pa'am/ byang phyogs kyi rkun po ltag skra dang sho re can sha mdog sogs sngar bshad pa'i chu'i mi rigs gnyis la sogs pas chu 'gram dang ri zhol lta bur bskung yod/ chang dang 'o zho'i mor/ skyur zhing sla la bcud chung ba zhig 'ong / chang btso mkhan sa khams pas byas na dga'/ kha char 409

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/e 'bab na/ 'bab mod kyi chu'i shwa sna rdol ba sogs chag sgo 'ong /dgra phywar/ gnyen lam mtha' bzhi'i rigs kyi le lan zhig gis byang phyogs nas chu chen dal gyis g.yo ba lta bu'i dgra 'byung /dmag mdos dang 'byung ba sa'i rten 'brel sogs kyis bzlogs dgra shing phrad/ khyim phywar/ phye bral 'thor zhig sa 'pho yul 'pho sogs dang / shing gi nad rigs 'ong / kha smras gleng brjod mang po'i ngo yod/ ri rab sa rdul du zhig pas shin tu ngan/ rten snying srog zhugs kyi sats+tsha 'bum phrag dang / mchod rten gsar bzhengs dang gdan khri zhig gso/ mi kha bra mchu'i bsgyur gto sogs bya/ bstan chus dang chos phywar/ bya ba blo sna mang po shing skam yal ga rengs pa lta bus rkyen byas nas las mtha' sad kyis 'khyer/srid phywar/ srid kyi gzhong bar the'u 'gong gi bshal rgyags 'byung bas ngan/ blo phywa dang don phywar/ kha mang blo mang dang / khyad par 'byung ba shing khams pa'i mi rigs kyis bar chad byed/ lar yang bya ba 'dis phung bshig pa'i thang shing zhig min pa yong rgyur mi 'dug tshong phywar/ shar phyogs kyi grong du rdzun po che'i mgo skor 'ong bas gzab/ ga gon dang bzang po la gsungs pa'i shis brjod kyi mdo stong phrag sogs bklag nor phywar/ rdang chad/ phur ba thon/phyugs khyu 'thor 'ong bas ngan/ lo legs nyes la'ang than pa 'ong /410

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6gnyis kar phyugs glud dang chab gtor sogs mchod sbyin rgya cher sgrub/ zhu ba phul na/ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i nang du sa rdul gtor ba ltar snying po stong thal gyis 'gro/ mdza' bo tshol na/ mi de bsam pa 'gyar ldog che/ rnyed srid kyang rnyed pa la tig tig mi mchi/ dur ༄dang khang mtsher zhing phywa rnams la/ dur sa shar bstan na ri sgo klung sgo yod pa dang / khang ba sgo shar bstan sgo nas bltas na ne'u sing ngam ljon pa sngo phyugs se mthong ba dang / zhing nar mo sogs yod na thang ste shin tu ngan/ sa bcos dang rim gro gyis/ nad par/ phyi yul rked pa/ nang yul mchin mkhris ske so mig gang rung gi nad/'on tig smyo 'bog rlung dang rtsa rgyus rengs pa'i rigs sam gzhogs g.yas kyi nad rigs yin yang thang / sman bla'i cho ga dang mdo brgyad brgya pa klog sgrogs sogs spyi 'gro'am/ bye brag nad khams dang bstun pa'i bcos rim bya/ da lta sa yul gas ral dang gad pa hral tral can nags klung ngam bug pa mang po dod pa dang /ha cang g.yel ba'i shing khyim lta bur yod na gzhan na spos/ gdon phywar/ gnyan dang rgyal po the'u rang gnod/ de'ang shing gnyan bcad pa dang / mi rigs shing khams pa'i 'grul sna'am/ shing spyad dang rdzas sngo ljang rigs cung zad nar ba khyim gyi g.yas logs na 'jog rgyu zhig grib/ yang na byang phyogs kyi rgyud nas 'ong ba'i sngo 411

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshod shing tog stag dang ri bong gi sha lpags rtsib ma g.yas phyogs kyi sha sogs brngos pas nyen/ rgyal mdos dngas thel bkar sogs gto yas mdos rdzong thongs/ le'u sman pa'i mor yang / 'tshub lhong shin tu che bas stabs gzab dgos/ mgron po 'ong ngam na/ 'ong na thang ste/ kha ngan gtam ngan snying mya ngan phyod de ba 'byung / rta phyags khyi dang ra lug mor/ sna 'dres drangs/ byar gyis rjes ded rir 1ngo// zi sna 11〉ri 1zig rir 1(thopas ngan/ ra star rlung pas khyar ram/ nags klung 'thug ra stor te rnyed dka'/ shar phyogs kyi rkun po mgo phrug lba ba can/ smra blo sogs gong smos lta bus khyer te shing nang du bskung na'ang thang /chang dang zho 'o'i mor/ bro ba rengs nyams can shin tu mi zhim pa 'byung / 'gong chings dang dbyug pa me 'bar sogs bsrung ba bsgrub/ btso snyol mkhan la lcags khams pa bzang / kha char 'byung ngam zhe na/ dus min gyi rlung log 'ong nas gnod pa byed/ rlung non gzab la gyis/ dgra phywar/ nyi ma shar phyogs nas dgra ke re langs pa 'byung / gtor bzlog dang 'byung ba lcags kyi rten 'brel la sogs pas bzlog /lcags dgra me phrad/ khyim phywar/ me'i 'jigs pa dang tsha rims 'ong / nor grogs dang lha srung rgud pas ngan/ rje btsun 'phags ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi mchod sgrub sogs la 'bad/ bstan chus 412

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6dang chos phywar/ ral gri'i rno dbal chag pas shin tu ngan/ phyag na rdo rje dang rje btsun ma'i snang brnyan 'bum phrag sogs bzhengs bsgrub bya/ srid phywar/ srid mngal du chags kyang mgo thon mi 'ong /gdon chen bco lnga'i mdos thongs/ tshogs gsog mang du gyis/ blo phywa don phywar/ 'byung ba me khams pa'i mi gdong tshan chen po zhig gis bar chad byed dam/ ji ltar yin yang 'grub ngo zhig mi 'dugatshong phywar/ nyi ma lho phyogs kyi grong ba mdog dmar ting nge bar zong gi 'gyur ldog 'ong / dbang thang skyed pa'i 'khor lo sogs kyis 'chos/ nor phywar/ da lta khyim du sha dmar lpags dmar 'dra med na 'phar gcan dang phyags god chen po 'byang / nor rgyun ma'i snying 1(1shā)( rterdordo byebye/ ri'i re(1 sherdor+sha lha(1— bzlas ba da gas bsrung ba bsgrub/ ga la btsa' rdul dmar po bar snang nas 'phyur bas ngan/ btsa' bsrung gi rten 'brel gyis/ zhu don mor/ mi chen po'i sa nas gnam grum pa lta bu'i tshig ngan thos/ yos bu rngas zan du 'ong bas bya glag dang thug pas bshol cig mdza' bo 'tshol na/ mi rnyed shas che/ rnyed na yang gdug cing snying ring ba zhig 'dug pas mi dge dur khang mtsher zhing gi mor/ dur sa lhor blta ba'am/ ri rtse kha dbrag can dang / khang ba sgo nas bltas na ri dmar po mdung 'dra mthong ba dang / zhing zur gsum sogs yod na thang / btsan gyi rgyu srang 413

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs ngan dgu dug bcu 'dug pas gzhan du bsgyur/ nad phywar phyi yul ro stod/ nang mdzod rgyu snying / sgo so lce'i rigs kyi nad dam/mgo dang mjing pa'i nad rigs/ khrag 'khrugs/ 'brum lhog sogs tsha ba'i nad yin/ bya sprel lo ba yod na sats+tsha dkar po lo grangs dang / glud dkar po lo grangs nub phyogs su bskyal/ da lta sa yul dmar rtsub/ tsher ma dang rdo hral me ri 'dra ba sogs yod pa/ tshad rlangs ha cang che ba'i rigs shig tu yod mdog kha bas de spos/gdon phyar/ ro bsregs dang me nyir nyal ba/ brag dmar gnyan po'i zur du dmar thab btang ba dang / lho phyogs kyi mgron me khams pa'i 'grul sna'am/ rta rkyang gi sha lpags sam/ rta dmar zhur can dang / yang na zhwa thod lta bu'i gos spyad dmar po gru gsum gyi mtshan ma can khyim gyi phug tu 'jog rgyu zhig grib/ khrag tshon dang mgo sha lta bu'i dmar ngan zhig la lhor phyogs pa'i zangs snod sogs su bza' btung byas pas bslang na'ang thang / gdon gyi ngo bo/ dmu btsan bdud dang steng gdon sogs gnod/ btsan mdos dang gza' 'joms kyi bsrang 'bri gdags/ gzangs grwa lnga klog zurag 1rengenor shājekro skur /re)'don sogs ram gro rgya ter bya/ le'u sman pa mo dang dpyad mo la shin tu ngan pas spang bar bya/ mgron po 'ong ngam na/ rma khrag gi ngo'am rdzas dmar 'od can mi lag tu shor ba lta bu'i 'gyod pa 414

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6cig 'dug zhag gsum nang du kha skad gsal po thos/ rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug mor/ spu rtags dmar shas can yin na thang ste mi 'phrod/ bor stor me nang du tshig gam/ yang lho phyogs kyi rkun po ral ba dang ngo smen can grangs sogs sngar bshad lta bus khyer te rdza brag dmar po'i nang du bskung / sgo nor khyer na bshas tshar/chang dang zho 'o'i mor/ ro tsha skyur gang rung gi rigs can 'byung ste mi zhim/ chang btso mkhan chu khams pa'i mi rigs kyis byas na bzang / kha char e 'bab na/ mi 'byung du ma zad sprin med nyi ma'i tsha dbal rnon po 'ong / dgra phywar/ ri klung rta ro dmar bo kha phye ba lta bu'i nang du/ dgra mi dmar rta dmar can 'ong / dmar ngo khrag ngo rmas 'gram gyi ngo yod pas ngan/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan 'bri klog sogs dgra chos rem/chu dgra sa phrad/ khyim phywar/ sa g.yo dang khang ba ral grum/ sa'i nad rigs dang / byad gtad kyi ngo / nyes pa kun thub kyi gser 'khor 'bri 'dogs dang / 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma sogs thongs/bstan chus dang chos phywar/ bdud nag po'i thib kyis non pa'i ngo yin/ bdud bzlog dang tshogs bsags la brtson/ srid phywar/ srid kyi chu mig zhabs rdol bas ngan/ don phywa dang blo phywa'i rigs la'ang ngan/ khyad par du 'byung ba sa khams pa'i mis gegs byed/ tshong 415

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phywar/ rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa khams gang rung gis don 'gyod 'ong /skyabs 'gro kha ton gyis/ nor phyar/ nor ser po'i rigs las gyod pham 'byang / yang na rmig zlum gyi ltas ngan 'ong / za 'dre 'gong po rang 111 711 she|( lha(1 /chen kha bsgyur sogs rungs/ tsho ga la'ang sa ngan/ zhu don gnyer na/ gting lci bas mi 'grub/ mdza' bo 'tshol na/ ri rab zhags pas 'then pa dang 'dra ste mi khug dur khang mtsher zhing gi mor/dur sa khang pa mtshams bzhir lta ba dang / zhing sa gru bzhi sogs yod na thang / sa bdag gdug pa can gnas pas mi 'phrod/ nad phywar/ phyi yul sha dang rkang lag nang mdzod pho mtsher/ sgo mchu ste de rnams gang rung gi nad/ shu thor dang / zha grum/ cham pa/ lci 'thib rigs te bcos dka'/ srog bslu dang tshe mdo kha ton sogs rim gro rgya chen gyis la sman bsten/ da lta sa cha khod snyoms shing mdog ser ba/ gru bzhi 'thug cing skug pa lta bu/ 'thib shas che ba de 'dra na yod mdog kha bas brje dgos/ gdon phywar/ dur lad dang thab 'cha' 'dzugs sogs lci brtan las kyis nongs pa'am/ rdza snod dang nyer spyad ser po'i rigs gru bzhi khyim gyi zur ram mal cha'i zur du 'jog rgyu dang mchil lham sogs grib/ yang na sa khams pa'i mi las thob pa'i zhun mar lug glang rtol bu 'phyi ba grum pa lta bu'i khog sha dang lhu sha de min na bza' btung mngar po'i rigs 416

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6sogs grib/ gdon gyi ngo bo/ sa bdag dang yul 'dre rgyal gdon sogs gnod/ sa bdag 'khrugs bcos dang / gnam sa snang brgyad sogs gang 'tshams sgrub/ le'u sman pa'i mor/ mi rnyed pa'am rnyed kyang phan mi thogs kyi steng du chu sa rdul gyis rnyog pa ltar je thur 'gro bas spongs/ mgron phywar/ khyod kyi mgron po de da lta gzhi nas ma khyogs pas mi sleb/ de min na dgra sa khams pa dang thug nas 'dug rta phyugs khyi dang ra lug 'di bsrel na rung ngam zhe na/ mi rung ba'i don yin te rgyal gdon gyi 'khri ba yod/bor stor rdul khrod du yod na thang ste mi rnyed/ sngar grogs phrad bshad pa'i skabs bzhin yod kyang srid de mi rnyed/ mtshams bzhi'i rkun po lus rgur zhing rbad mgo byas pa gong gsal lta bus khyer te dong nang sogs su sbas yod/ chang dang 'o zho'i mor skyur 'dre can du 'dug pas mi legs/ chang btso mkhan stag yos lo bas gyis/ kha char e 'bab na/ sngags btsun nus pa can gyis char non 'dug pas 'bebs shin tu dka'/ klu khrus dang gtor ma thongs/ dgra phywar/ lho nu ba nas dgra dpung khur du lci ba sa non pa lta bu 'byung /dus 'gyang sa zhig na yod pas da lta nas bzlog thabs rem/'byung ba bu phrad kyang 'gyod phul che chung tsam ma gtogs phyogs de dang 'dra bas rigs 'gre sbyar/417

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shing nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ 'thor zhig dang / 'pho 'gyur mang du 'ong / bstan phywa dang chos phywa rtsa ba g.yo zhing mi brtan pas ngan/srid rgyud chags dka'/ don phywa blo phywa gang yang stong 'ud che ste don la mi 'grub/ tshong phywar/ nor la kha 'thor 'ong bas longs spyod mi chags/ nor phywa dang lo tog mor yang de dang mtshungs/ zhu don la rje 'bangs zhal mi 'cham ste 'grub dka'/ mdza' bo'i mo la 'then 'khyer 'ong zhing rnyed kyang 'dum mo mi 'ong / dur khang sogs la'ang ngan/ nad phywar/ yang zhing g.yo ba'i mo 'tshub nyams can/ gdon sngar bzhin chag sgo smin drug gi rnga tshub lta bu 'ong ngo yod/ le'u sman pa sman dpyad sogs kyis nad nyal bslong nus kyang bslang ba gsod dka'/ mgron phywar/ 'ur zing dang skrag ngo yod de mgyogs par sleb/ rta phyugs sogs mi 'phrod/ bor stor myur du btsal na rnyed thang ste cung zad ral grum dang mang por song 'dug skyur gyi mo la ro ngan/ btso snyol mkhan sngar bzhin/ kha char shin tu dkon/ dgra phywar/ mkhon 'dzing gi ngo yod kyang rgyab bsrung bzang na bsdo thub/me nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ dar rgud zo chun gyi 'khor lo 'dra ste yid rton mi mchi/ bstan phywa dang chos phywa yang de dang phyogs 'a dra/srid phywar/ srid chags kyang nges nges mi 'dug blo phywa don phywa'i 418

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6rigs la 'grub 'grub 'dra bo yod de 'gyar ldog che/ tshong phya nor ༄phya lo tog rnams la g.yang nyams yod/ zhu don dang mdza' bo rnyed min yang don phywa dang 'dra/ 'di dbang sdud rigs la bzang bar bshad pa'ang yod pas de gnyis gung sgrigs/ dur mo la ngan/ khang zhing gi mor 'bring stod yin/ nad phywa gdon phywar/ 'phral sos sos 'dra yang phugs mi bden/ le'u sman pa sogs la/ phan thogs cung zad yod kyang gcig thog tu sdod dka'/ mgron phywar mgron po krong gis lang tsog ger bsdad de sems thag ma chod par gda'/rta phyugs sogs 'phral bzang yang nam zhig lad ngo yod/bor stor bri gang 'phel 'grib kyi ngo zhig yod de lar rnyed/ skyur gyi mo dang kha char la ngan/ dgra phywar/ rma khrag gi ngo cung zad yod/ /sa nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ brtan chags kyi ngo / bstan phywa chos phywa yang de mtshungs/ srid phywar/ dal 'gyang che/ lar rim gro bsgrub na 'byung thang / blo phywa don phywa tshong phywa rnams la phyi dal che yang khog brtan pas bzang / nor phywa dang lo phywa la rab yin/ zhu ba phul na snyan sra bar 'dug phugs 'grub kyang srid/ mdza' bo 'tshol na rnyed dka'/ de min na bzang / dur khang gi mo sogs la sa bdag gzhan gyis bdag byas na thang bas bcos thongs dang bzang /nad phywa gdon phywa phra mo'i rigs la skyon med/ de min gting lci/419

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/le'u sman pa sogs la/ ngang bsring na phan thogs 'ong / mgron po la nye zho mi 'dug kyang shol sdod che/ rta phyugs sogs bsrel na legs par 'ong / bor stor rang khyim nas ma rnyed na 'tshol dka'/chang dang 'o zho'i mor bzang / btso snyol mkhan sngar gsal/ kha char re zhig mi 'byung bas chu 'bod kyis/ dgra phywar/ phan tshun gnyis kar la pham cher mi 'gro ste 'bring stod/ /lcags nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ gri kha lta bas ngan/ bstan phywa chos phywa gang la'ang bar chad mang / srid phyar cung zad ngan/ blo phywa don phywa tshong phywa rnams bsgrub dka'/ nor phywa dang lo legs nyes la dgra mang bas bsrung ba bya/ zhu ba phul na mi 'grub/ mdza' bo mi rnyed/rnyed kyang mi dge dur khang sogs kyi mo la gri tshang yin te ngan/nad phywa don phywar 'tshub cha che bas gzab/ le'u slob dpon sman pa sogs mi 'phrod/ mgron po la dka' tshegs chen po byung 'dug da dung mi sleb/ rta phyags sogs bsrel na mi dge bor stor tshal ri ri dmi rgyubazhin mi rnyed pas 'bad pa ma mang / skyur gyi mo la ro bzang yang kha dge mi 'ong / btso snyol mkhan gong gis shes/ kha char mi 'bab ser ba 'dra 'byung thang / dgra phywar/ mtshon 'khrugs rwa co brdar ba lta bu yod pas dgra chos gyis/ /chu nang phrad/ khyim phywar/ 'jam zhing zhi ba'i mo ste bzang /4 20

zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long / pod/ 6bstan phywa chos phywar lha ngo dma' bas rim gro bya/ ha cang ngan rgyu yang med/ srid phywar/ bu mo btsa' ste srid pa'i lte bsgyur dang rgyab chos dge las la 'bungs/ blo phywa don phywa tshong phywa rnams 'bring tsam 'grub/ nor phywa dang lo tog la bzang / mdza' bo rnyed min dang khang zhing sogs kyi mor yang dge zhing bkra shis/ nad phywar skyon med/ myur du kha gsal 'ong / gdon phywar mo gdon gnod de ngo yang bas bcos sla/ le'u sogs bsten na 'phrod/ mgron myur du sleb bam/ yang na skad snyan thos/ rta phyugs sogs spyir 'phrod kyang rtas cung zad dma' bas rta bdag mchod/ rta gzungs thon/ bor sto/ra myur bar rnyed/ skyur gyi mo la 'bring smad yin/ kha char chen po 'byung / dgra phywar/ dgra snying dar bas 'jam ste skyon med do/ /de'ang 'phrad dang 'byung ba rkyang dpyad la cung zad mi mthun pa byung na gtso bo phrad dpyad kyis byed/ de la sogs pa gong 'og gi lhu legs par bsgrigs nas sgrin zhing zhib mo'i rnam dpyod kyis dpyod pa gal che'o/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gdan bzhi sogs rgyud kyi rgyal po du mar yang mo gdab thabs yod la/ dkon brtsegs le'u gsum par brtag ril sgril ba'i khungs kyang yod pa dang / gzhan yang g.yung drung bon lugs tshun chad kyi mo'i gzhung mang po yod mod kyi/ nyung ngu rnam gsal yang 421

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag rdzogs/ /zhes pa lta bu'i khyad par cung zad kyis brgyan te bshad pa 'di ni blo gsal rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du kho bos byas so/ /rnam dpyod 'o ma'i chu gter 'khyil ba'i ngogs/ /gtsug lag ngang mo 'bum phrag gar rtsen pa'i/ /dbyangs snyan rgyang glu'i 'gyur ba lhung lhung 'di/ /blo gsal khye'u chung rna ba rab dga'i dpyid//ma mthong mthong rdzu 'phags pa'i tha snyad dang / /'gal ba'i rdzun tshig byis pa 'drid pa'i zog /spangs nas lkog gyur blta ba'i me long 'dir/ /yang dang yang du blo gros mig 'bur gtod/ /zab mo rno mthong gi man ngag zla shel nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni mdo khams shar phyogs kyi brnye 'jam dpal rig pa'i ral gris sngon chad rtsis nag gi gzhung la sbyang goms chung yang skabs thog nyer mkho'i dbang gis bi ro rnyi zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo'i nag pa nya ba'i yar tshes kyi rgyal ba dang po'i nyin rdzogs par byas pa da'e zhing shis pa'i snang ba 'bad med du 'jo ba'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga lam /422

pod/ 6༄tsho//sāts+tsha sgrub gdab lag len bzhugs so/ /༄khya/ /'gro 'dul sdug bsngal rang grol la brten pa'i sāts+tsha bsgrub tshul bzhugs/bla ma 'jig rten dbang phyug la na mo/ 'gro 'dul 'phags pa sdug bsngal rang grol gyi sgo nas sāts+tsha bsgrub tshul mdor bsdus ngag 'don du brjod na/ rab tu gnas pa'i sāts+tsha rnams stegs bu kheb ldan la legs par bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bsham/bdag bskyed sngon du btang ste mchod pa rnams/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas ma lus pa: rnam pa rdzas la ngo bo ye shes kyi:bdud rtsi chen po ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin pas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i dpyid du gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pābye puṣ+pe dhubla a lo ke ghadhe nai wi bye shabha sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha lid+dha ma hā su kha pū dza aḥhūṃ:'alan gsum gyis brlab: bskyed chog ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā nā badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma konya haṃ/ chos kun mi dmigs gzhi med rtsa bral ngang: dbyings rig zung 'jug dag pa chen po'i zhing:rang snang lhun grub ri bo po tā la: de dbus rab yangs pad+ma zla ba'i steng: rin chen mchod rten yangs shing rgya che ba: sāts+tsha'i grangs mnyam rnams kyi bum nang 423

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du: brda rtags mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng: trīḥlas 'gro 'dul 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha0sdug bsngal rang grol spyan ras gzigs dbang casku:zhal gcig phyag bzhi mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs:rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar tshul: lhag ma rnam gnyis bgrang phreng pad dkar 'chang: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen mdzes: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: zhi tshul dgu dang rgyan cha bcu gsum mdzes:dbu gtsug rigs bdas 'od dpag med pas mtshan: phyogs bzhir pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du: shar du rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog dkar: lho ru 'od zer can ma gser gyi mdog: nub tu ku ru kul+le pad rag mdangs: byang du nor rgyun lha mo sku mdog ljang: kun kyang rang rang rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: sgo bzhir dbang chen sde bzhi las mdog can: gri gug thod 'dzin dor stabs 'jigs tshul rngams:khro bo'i chas rdzogs me dpung klong na 'gying: bar mtshams sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki dam can sprin ltar gtibs:snang stong sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i dbyings na gsal:kun kyang gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan:de las 'od 424

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6'phros rang bzhin gnas mchog dang: khyad par sprul ba'i zhing khams po tā la: gnas yul nyer bzhi dur khrod brgyad sogs nas:ye shes lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dza:spyana'adren pa ni/hrī: nub phyogs bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: mgon po 'od dpag med pa gshegs su gsol: sprul pa'i zhing khams ri bo tā la nas: 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol: thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus gshegs su gsol:bdag cag sgrub pa po la byin gyis rlobs:mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ lo ki shwa ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma ya dza:dza:bzhugs su gsol ba ni/trī:dmigs med rang grol thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor lhar: gshegs byon bzhugs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang0 gnyis snang glo bar dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir0 75) rig rgya /rdo)dam ye gnyis med ngo bor brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha ho:phyaga'atshal ba ni/trī:bcom ldan thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la:rang shes 'khrul ba bral ba'i brda phyag gar: lha chen 'phrul dga'i rnam 'gyur ji bzhin du: spang blang med pa'i ngang nas btsal bar bgyi: na mo pu ru sha ya ho:mchodapa ni/ trī: kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang:425
