pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhal zas rol mo 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'bul lo bzhes: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nasashabha rū pa shabha ghadhe rā sa par+sha ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hrī: khyad par rmad byung bde ba chen po'i rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta tshogs mchod ngang re spro:shes rab rig ma blo 'das gnyug ma'i gshis:'bul lo bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha li ta ma hā su kha dhārma dhārtu pū tsa ho:bstodapa ni/hrī:chos dbyings spros pa bral ba'i pho brang nas: lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mnga' dbang can:tshad med snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs:sdug bsngal rang grol sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro kun thar lam 'dren:gang la gang 'dul thugs rje rol ba'i gar:cir yang sgyur ba'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can:rigs bzhi'i sems ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam bzhi'i phrin las kun la dbang bsgyur zhing: log 'dren 'dul phyir khro gtum rol ba'i stabs: thogs med bsgyur ba'i rigs bzhi'i h+ya shrī0dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha myolaphyag 'tshal bstod: rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs bzhin pas/ dmigs yul de dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi lha'i zhal nas sngags kyi 426

thagashāsgro /spyorngan tha/rngasno/ba 95ba/ ceskuzug/ 21rngud/ (( 〉ngarasgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod par gyur/ bar dmigs la/ ma ṇi gtso bor bzla zhing mtshams ci rigs par/oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba a su ra ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa0 oṃ tshine tshine sarba ni ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭakya oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta 355 /rdo)ni /bye)ste /rdo sarba su ra ka ga te he dun hūm̐ phaṭa: dmigs bya'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa shir+ghaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pas sngags sham sbyar/ thun mjug tu mchod pa ni/trī:kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin:me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang: zhal zas rol mo 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'bul lo bzhes:oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nasashabha rū pa shabha ghan+dhe rā sa par+sha ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: hrī: chos dbyings spros pa bral ba'i pho brang nas: lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mnga' dbang can: tshad med snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs: sdug bsngal rang grol sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro kun thar lam 'dren: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje rol pa'i gar: cir yang sgyur ba'i mthu 427

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ stobs rdzu 'phrul can:rigs bzhi'i sems ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam bzhi'i phrin las kun la dbang bsgyur zhing: log 'dren 'dul phyir khro gtum rol pa'i stabs: thogs med bsgyur ba'i rigs bzhi'i h+ya shrī: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod0 ces bstod mthar/ oṃ0 bcom ldan snying rje chen po'i (55 /rdorngobadag: sdug bsngal rang grol lha tshogs rnams: mgon med 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs: sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad du gsol :'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal dang: sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar mdzod: yang dag ye shes snang ba yis: byang chub lam la 'god mdzad gsol: zhes pa'i tshig gis gsol ba btab/ nongs pa bshags/ mchod rten lha dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las sāts+tsha'i rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/ bar bsam/slar yang / me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces mchod cing bstod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 428

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du'ang rten 'di la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten 'di ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang dmigs bya'i thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mtha' dag zhi ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'byung zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/zhes brjod rten snying bzlas pas me tog 'thor zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/yang bzla/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu nas shis brjod bar rdzogs par bya'o/ /de ltar zhag bdun la sogs par bsgrub nas sāts+tsha rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab tu bltas la/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung chen por spyan drangs te bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam la sogs pas chu nang spyod pa'i sems can rnams la phan 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bgyis pas phan yon kyang / rgyud las/ de ni nges par dmyal gnas nas/ /de byas pas ni grol bar 'gyur//yi dwags byol song sdug bsngal las//grol te lha yi gnas su skye//zhes sogs rgya cher bsngags pa yin no/ /zhes pa'ang rje bla ma'i smin gling rdor sems cho ga'i kha skong du gsungs pa'i tshig la 'don pa cung zad bsgyur nas bris pa mchog tu dge bar gyur cig ces rdo grub gsum pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas so//429

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ro༅/ /byang bu'i sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ rus bu bsdu ba ni/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas lag gnyis dpung bar bsnol bas se gol gtogs shing / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: zhes brjod ngapres rus bu bsdus la/zangs gzhong sogs su bzhag /gnyis pa rus sbyong ni/de'i steng du mañdzu sman dang dri bzang gis bkang ba'i bum pa dang / nye logs su ba byung dang ga bur gur gum sogs dri bzang gi chu'i snod kyang so sor bshams/ las gzhung sngar bzhin bsrang ngam min kyang rung ste/ rus bu'am/ byang thal gyi steng du zla ba'i gdan la yi ge a:dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī: na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma:ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na bha yu ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/arta te samyak+shi bud+dha ya/na ma:sarba ta thā ga te bh+ya: arta de bh+ya: samyak+shi bad+dhi bh+ya9 na ma9ar+ya a ra༄mi 0 0khurab lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi sa twa ya/ma hā sā twa ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kwa ya/tar+ya thā/oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/dhu ru dhu ru/er+bhe bir+bhe/tsa le tsa le/pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me ba re i li mi li tsi ti dz+wa la mā pa na ye swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te pa ri sho dha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ budha ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/430

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba karma a pā ra ṇa bi shud dhe swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kai ka ni kai ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa ni tā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa ram̐ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa nañtsa swā hā/ 'a a ha sha sa ma/ oṃ pad+mo uk+ṇi ṣa bhi ma le hūṃ phaṭa/ sogs gzungs sngags mang du bzlas pa'i chus rus thal dag par bkru zhing zhib tu btags nas bum chu dang ba byung gi chus bskrun pa'i sa dang lhan cig tu brdzis la/ 'jim pa rin po che'i phung bor bsam/ 'jim pa bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du r+ghaṃ las 'jim pa rin po che'i phung bor gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'jim pa la thim pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ bar bsam la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe chung mnan pa las kha yar bstan la g.yas pa'ang de bzhin byas la kha spub pa'i bar du 'jim pa bzhag la/oṃ na mo bha ga wa te be+e ro tsa nā ya/ pra bhā ra dza ya ta thā ga ta ya/ arta te samyak+shi bhud+dha ya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ susmye susmye/ sa ma sa ma ye/ sharnye darnye/ a sa ma ro se a na laste/ ta raste/ ya sho wa ti/ ma hā de dza/ ni ra ku le/ ne ra wa ṇi/ sarba bud+dha adhiṣ+ṭha na adhiṣ+ṭhate swā hā/ zhes lan nyer gcig gam/ oṃ dzi na dzika swā hā/ nyer gcig dang rtsa sngags bzla zhing byin rlabs gyis/ na ma: sa man+ta bud+dha rna/431

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ rdo rje'i srog thob par bsam la 'jim pa bcad/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa ye swā hā/ ye shes rdo rje 'byung bar bsam la 'bi 'bi bya/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swā hā/ye shes rdul bral du bsam la snum byugs/oṃ dharmā dhartu gar+bha swā hā/chos kyi dbyings kyi snying bo rnyed par bsam zhing brkos phor du bcug oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa: swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgyas btab par bsam la brdungs/ oṃ sarba bibyā swā hā/ ye shes kyi snying po khong du chud par bsam la gur gum gyis bris pa'i yig drug gam rten 'brel snying po sogs gzungs su gzhug pa'am/ ma 'byor na sngags de dag gis btab pa'i me tog gzungs kyi rnam par 'bul/ oṃ dharmā ra te swā hā/chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs par bsam zhing phyir 'don/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad de la brtan par bzhugs par bsam la me tog 'thor/ rab gnas cung zad rgyas par 'dod na mchod pa dang bum pa 'byor na bshams ma 'byor na yid kyis sprul la rang lhar gsal bas sum+bha nis bgegs sbyangs/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/sogs kyis khrus gsol lo/ oṃ swabhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā:swa bhāwa shud+dhinya haṃ/stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing zhi zhing 'dzum pa dar 432

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par ā dmar po thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rnam snang ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+pe dhūbla nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /zhesadang / phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la//zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces mchod cing bstod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ zhesaspyan dbye/oṃ ā:hūṃ/ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ mchod rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 433

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang rten 'di la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten 'di 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog lan gsum gtor/ slar yang gong bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs mchod bstod rten 'brel snying po dang shis brjod ci rigs bya'o/ /de lta bu'i mchod rten gcig btab pas bye ba snyed btab par 'gyur zhing tshe rabs thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur zhing / mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs chog las kyang / 'di'i ming bris pa la gzungs sngags brjod par byed cing / mchod rten 'bum byas pa la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas legs par mchod nas rgya mtsho chen po'am yang na chu klung du btab na de dmyal ba la sogs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de ltar mchod rten byas nas mjug tu lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten chen po byas te sngar bzhin legs par mchod la/ 'phags pa'i gsol nas yon phul te/ legs par mchod nas 'di che ge mo'i dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur cig 'di kho nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na rang gi smon lam gyi dbang gis skye bar 'gyur zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no//ces rdo grub gsum pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas so//434

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6༄/ /klong snying thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas sāts+tsha sgrub pa'i lag len bzhugs/ bla ma pad dkar 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klong snying thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas tshe 'das kyi rus bu'i sāts+tsha bsgrub tshul gyi lag len nag 'gros su bkod na/ rus sbyong phyobyed tshul dang / sbyangs nas sāts+tsha gdab tshul dang / de nyid bsgrub cing mchod pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshe 'das kyi rus bu de nyid zangs sogs snod chen po'i khar ras dkar gyis bkab pa'i steng du blugs shing / de'i steng mañdzu lta bu'i khar dri bzang gi chu dang / ba byung lnga yang bshams/ gong du bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa sman raka gtor gsum dang /rang gi g.yas ngos nas mgo brtsams ste nyer spyod lnga sogs bkod mdzes su bshams/khrus chog dang sbrel na gtso las kyi bum pa bcud ldan yang 'bru'i lnga tshom bkod pa'i steng du bsham/de nas cho ga dngos gzhi la 'jug pa ni/ na mo gu ru we/ 'chi med thog ma'izhes pa nas/ myur thob shog /bar gyi brgyud 'debs dang / dam tshig gsum dran pas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/zhes rdo rje snying gar gsor/ badz+ra gan+ḍi ho/zhes dril bu gsil zhing dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma konyahaṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sogs nas/ sa ma dza: zhes thugs kar se gol bsnol mar gtog na mo: mtha' med 'khor ba sogs nas/ skyabs su mchi:bar lan gsum dang / ho: pha ma rigs drug sogasabaskyed par bgyi:lan gsum/ho: dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/myur thob shog:lan gcig dza9ṭ+wāṃ:baṃ ho9 tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyar/ thags 2)raming rte mi rari mi dming 435

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kar se gol bsnol mar gtog dkar gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa:rang nyid skad cig gis sogs nas skur gyur/ oṃ h+ya n+t+ra wa hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ swā bhā ba shud+dha:sogs/stong ba nyid du gyur/stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du gtsang ldan gyi gtor ma sogasanas/chen por gyur/oṃ ā:hūṃ/ lan gnyis/ oṃ ā:hūṃ ho/ oṃ a kā ro sogs swā hā: bar lan gsum/gang dag 'dir gnas sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ces pas bsngo/bgegs gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha h+ya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du bgegs kyi gtor ma sogasanas/ chen por gyur/ oṃ ā:hūṃ/lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bud+dha a kar+ṣa ya dza:lanagasum/ oṃ sarba bighan na ma:sarba sogs kha kha khā hi khā hi/ b.ralan gsum/ trī: nga ni pad+ma dbang sogs nas/ srung 'khor sogs mthar chags su bton te/ bstod pa'i mjug gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: khrusachog yin na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ trī: r+ghaṃ bi shwa bi shudzhai phaṭa dza:sa dzab kha dbye ba'am bdag mdun gyi rnam pa tha dad du gsal/ kha cig gis khrus chog gi tshe yang dzab kha mi dbye ba yod de/ bdag mdun gnyis me long gnyis la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bsgom pa yin na der zad/ gzhan du na bstod pa'i mjug tu 'dzab kha dbye nas de'i bzlas pa sogs kyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba med mi rung ba yin pas nges par bdag mdun tha dad du gsal dgos pa 'di nyid 'dor ga la rung zhes/ mchan no/ /rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i sogs nas thob par 436

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 644dmigs: sogs kyi bsnyen dmigs gsal ba bzhin/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī: ci 'grub dang / 'phags pa'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: rje btsun sgrol ma'i sogs rtsa sngags la tā re a yudz+nyā na sogs btags pa bdun tsam/ de'i 'gres kyis/'phags pa'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: 'od zer sogs nas/ rtsa sngags dang / rang sngags sbrel ba bdun tsam/bum bzlas ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs nas/ bum pa mi dmigs sogs nas/ spyan drangs gyur/ badz+ra sa mā ya dza:dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shabha a:hūṃ:bar/bstod par 'os sogs phyag 'tshal bstod/ rang srog sngags kyi sogasaro gcig gyur/ ma ṇi ci 'grub dang / bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bum pa'i lha sogs nas/ yang yang bsgom/ ma ṇi/ yig brgya/ sa twa/ kai ka ni rnams sbrel ba tshar re'i mthar/ tshe 'das kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad shir+ghaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ btags pa nyer gcig tsam bzla/las bum du khro rgyal rta mgrin sogs nas gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya m+bhi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: lnga bcu tsam bzlas mthar/ nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sogs dbyangs gsal/ rten snying / yig brgya sbrel ba lan gsum dang / mchod phreng nas oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hrī :ā: lha rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin las sogasagyur cig /na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs dang / pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i lang sogs mchod phreng rgyas pa'am/ stong ba'i ye shes dga' ba 'am ma lcogs na/ hrī:kun tu bzang po'i sogs gong gi mchod pa dang / hrī: chos dbyings spros pa 437

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sogs nas bstod pa cha tshang / phyag 'tshal bstod/ trī: rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku sogs kyis las lha'ang bstod/ yig brgya lan gcig oṃ ā:hūṃ zhes dung chos kyi chu mchod yon du phul bas lha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ las bum gyi lha 'od du zhu ba las khro bo'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ rigamedor ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ:ā:badz+ra sogs sngags tshan lnga dang /oṃ ye shes rgyal bo'i sogasasbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya/ sngags tshan gsum dang / oṃ rdo rje ye shes sogs nas/ 'tshal:dza hūṃ baṃ ho:yig brgya lan gcigade nas rus sbyong dngos ni/ rus bu'i steng du zla ba'i sogs nas/ dag par bsam/ma ṇi/ pad+mo un+ḍi ṣa/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ 'khor ba dong sprugs/snang mtha'i rjes dran sogs gzungs sngags gang shes ci mang bzlas shing dri bzang gi chus rus bu rnams dag par bkru dgos/ khrus chog la rten bskyed ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya skṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa sogasastong ba'i sogasagyar/ trī: bdag ༄nyid thugs rje chen po'i sogs nas bsnyim/ na mo/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum sogs dza: bar lan gsum hrī: 'di snang las thal sogasatiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ bla mas sngar ltar bgegs gtor byin rlabs bton mthar/oṃ sarba bigha nan sogasakhaṃ swā hā/lan gsum dang / oṃ sum+bha ni sogs lan gsum/ hrī: 'khor bar 'khor tshe sogs nas phaṭa: hrī: nga ni pad+ma dbang gi sku: log 'dren sogs nas/ma 'da' zhig: bla mas lhogs na bden brjod/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs/ hrī: snang 438

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6srid thams cad rdo rje'i gur: snod bcud sogasahūṃ phaṭa: ho: skyabs gnas kun 'dus sogs drang du gsol/ b.ralan gsum/hūṃ/ nyon cig tshe 'das sogs nas gsol ba thob/ bar lan gsum/ skabs 'dir lha khrus bya/ hūṃ/'di ni byams dang sogasanas shudzhai ye swā hā:'i bar dang / de'i sngags sham bcas lan gsum re gdon/ hūṃ/ma rig rtsal snang sogs swā hā: bla mas rigs drug gtor ma byin rlabs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs mnyam du gsung /hūm̐/ 'dod pa'i yon tan sogs/de man chad lan gsum re 'dod dgos pa rnams yig chung na gsal/de min ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su/ tshe las 'das pa skad cig gis/ /'phags pa'i skur sogs nas ro gcig gyur/lasabyang gihrī: nub phyogs bde chen sogs cu55 du gsol/ yig drug dang / ār+ya lo ki spyan 'dren 'dzud dgos pa gcig pu ma gtogs lam bstan par mthar chags su bya/ khrus chog zhag sbrel bar mi 'don na/ rtsa sngags mthar/ hūṃ: ka dag spros bral me thab tu/ rang byung sogs kyis byang bu bzhus pa byang thal rus bu dang lhan cig tu bya/ bzang spyod 'don/rjes chog ni/ na raka bskang bshags sam/ ye shes sku mchog sogs/ yig brgya/hūṃ/ bka' gsang sogs nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs/ phyin par shog /gzhung gi hūṃ: bdag nyid thugs las sogs/ hūṃ: 'og min chos dbyings sogs/ spyan 'dren/ hūṃ: rtsa gsum thugs rje sogs phud dang po/ hūṃ/bdag gi tshe rabs sogs phud bar ba/ tshogs 'gugs lan gsum/ hūṃ/ ma rig 439

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las nyon sogs/ khā hi: bar rdo rje'i thol glu'am/ ma nus na/ na ma:sarba ta tha sogs nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum/ hrī: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi sogs rang bskang 'don/ mthar/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol/ /a la la ho: ho/ bdag lus phung khams sogs bsam lhun rgyas bsdus ci rigs 'don/'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs nas shog /bar brjod/ lhag ma ni/ oṃ a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la/ hūṃ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sogs/ khā hi/ gtor 'gugs lan gsum dang / hūṃ/bzhengs shig sogasamadzod/ gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyar/ oṃ a:hūṃ: hūṃ: sngon tshe 'og min sogasamadzod/ bar/༄ bshal chu ye shes sogasagyur/'bru gsum/hūṃ:dpal gyi bka' nyan sogs/khā hi/ 'gugs pa/ trī: 'gro 'dul sogasanan: bar/ bdag cag dpon slob sogs/ swā hā: oṃ hūṃ tram̐ sogs mchod pa byin rlabs/ trī: kun tu bzang sogs hrī: chos dbyings sogs/ skabs 'dir gsol 'debs zhal mthong ma bton na bzang / ho: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: sogs yig brgya/ oṃ/'dir ni rten dang sogs/ badz+ra swā hā/ ho: chu las chu bur sogs/ ho:dus gsum bsags pa'i sogasalan gsum/ ho/ rig 'dzin brgyad pa'i sogs bkra shis shog: de yang khrus chog ma bton na/ dzab kha dbye ba/ bum bzlas/rig me dor ba/ mjug gi brtan bzhugs rnams mi dgos/ de ltar nyin rer cho ga tshar gcig re byas pa'i zhag ci tsam la rus sbyong byed pa thams cad des 'gres so//440

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6gnyis pa de ltar rus sbyong zin nas sats+tsha gdab tshul ni/ sbyar zin pa'i rus bu rnams zhib par btags la sa gtsang gi spyin dang / rin chen phye ma/ ba byung / sngar bsgrubs pa'i bum chu rnams lhan cig tu brdzis la/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag /las sngags bzla zhing las bum chus bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las 'jim pa sogs brgya bcas/ suk+ṣe'i sngags nyer cig /rtsa sngags dang / oṃ dzi na dzika hūṃ: zhes pa dang sbrel ba brgya rtsa bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gzhung gi sngags dang yig chung rnams zhib par ded nas sats+tsha legs par gdab/ gdab zin pa dang /gzhung bzhin rab gnas byas te/ kheb dkar po'i steng du/ 'bru tshom gyi khar bkod la/ steng du 'phan gdugs sogs dang /mthar phyi nang gi mchod pas bskor/ gsum pa gdabs zin sgrub tshul ni/ gdab nyin der bsgrub na mdun bskyed nas 'jug pas chog cing / nyin snga ma lta bu la btab nas nyin phyi ma la bsgrubs pa yin na/sngar bzhin bdag bskyed gsol 'debs nas bzung bstod pa'i bar/ dzab kha dbye mi dgos/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka ru: sogs bsnyen dmigs/ma ṇi ci 'grub/ rigs bzhi'i sems ma'i las sngags bcas song nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod mthar/ yig brgya lan gcig /de nas mdud bskyed bsgrub pa ni/mdun bskyed kyi mchod rdzas rnams la bsang chu 'thor zhing / oṃ ā:hūṃ: phyi nang gsang ba'i sogs/ a:māṃ: sngags lan gsum/ oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/ chos kun 1 shā sa mi dmigs sogs nas/ po ta la: de dbus rab yangs pad+ma sogs nas gzhung bzhin bstod pa'i/ phyag 'tshal bstod:nas/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i zhal sogs nas gyur/ ma ṇi dang spro na gzungs sngags gzhan yang ci mang dang / bar skabs rnams su rtsa sngags la/ oṃ da ha da ha sogs/ sngags sham 441

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/btags pa nyer gcig tsam re bzla/ dgong mo 'jog ran dus/ mchod pa byin rlabs/mchod bstod/yig brgya lan gcig bskang bshags nas bzung tshogs/ chad bstan/ bro mnan/ slar yang mchod pa'i byin rlabs dang / mchod bstod/ gsol 'debs zhal mthong ma/oṃ bcom ldan snying rje chen po'i bdag:sogs gsol:bar lan gsum/co0 thags rje chem po'i ngakyil 'khor ba/ sogs/ gsol0 yig brgya lan 74/rdo) nod ba / / / / rabasgo/ / 75)gsum/ mchod rten lha dang bcas pa sogs nas gyur: bar/ me tog dam pa phreng ba sogasashwalo ka dang / bstod par 'os pa thams cad sogs bstod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs gsol/ bar dbyangs gsal rten snying lan bdun dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭhas metog 'thor/ ho: chu las chu bur sogasadang / ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i sogs lan gsum/ ho:rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sogs/ de'i 'gres kyis zhag grangs ci tsam bsgrub kyang nyin rer cho ga tshar rer byas pa'i thun mtshams rnams su mchod pa gsar bshams dang /bzang po spyod pa tshar re ma chags par byed/ gzungs 'jug gi sngags la ming spel bya bar mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs mdo las gsungs pas nges par 'grub dgos lta bur 'dug kyang / de 'dra ma grub na ming spel gyi 'dod gsol gdugs sam sats+tsha re la dkris nas bzhag kyang chog gzungs 'jug la ming spel bya tshul thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bsgrub na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ trī: chegemo'i las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces bri/ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs sngags bzla bzhin pas rus bu rnams chus yang yang bkrus te sbyang dgos pa dang / sbyangs ba'i rus pa rnams zhib par btags te/ sa gtsang spyin dang / rin chen phye ma sogs dang lhan cig tu yang yang brdzis te kha dog phug ron gyi mdog lta bu ma byung 442

sartso sgrub gdab lag len/ pod/ 6gi bar du zhun thar sprad dgos par yang gsungs pa dang / de rnams kyang dmigs pa dang sngags dang rdzas phyag rgya sogs thams cad tshang ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te rgyud sde nas bshad pa ltar gyi lag len byas na ni/ rgyud sde nas gsangs pa tsam gyi phan yon thob ༄pa yin no//grub chen dgon gyi phyag bzhes so//// mi443

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len bzhugs/'dren pa 'od dpag med pa la btud nas/ bde chen zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas che/ myur lam 'pho ba'i man ngag zab mo'i don/ gsal dang nyung ngu'i tshig gis 'dir bshad bya/ gang zhig gis ngan 'gro'i grong khyer mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi tshong khang chen por shes nas/ bde 'gro'i lus rten rnam par dag pa/ mi khom pa brgyad dang bral ba'i zhing khams kyi 'gro ba bzang por 'khrid pa'i thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba 'pho ba'i gdams ngag nyams su bstar bar 'dod pas/ thog mar skyabs sems sangs rgyas chos tshogs/ sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde dang /sogs tshad med bzhi'i tshig lan gsum brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta/ sogs/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ba'i chos nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi rtsal snang brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dag chen bde ba mchog gi zhing khams ngo mtshar sprul pa'i rol mor rnam par snang ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la baṃ yig 'od du zhu ba las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing / phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum zhing chags pa'i rnam 'gyur can spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du ring ba'i tshul gyis gzigs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum shing g.yon brkyangs pas bam ro'i snying gar brdzis pa/ rdo rje sku yi grong khyer du 444

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pasarngad/ 6 〉zungartsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bor gyar ba'i dbu ma kha /rdo //re/ dmi ba /rdo rdo //rje dog marung ga drang nga mdangs gsal ba/ mnyen nga da bas legs pa/ yar sne spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu gar kha phyes shing mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad kar zug pa/ snying kha'i rtsa sbubs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad kyis bkag pa'i steng du rlung gi thig le ljang skya 'phar ba dang 'phrig pa'i rnam 'gyur can la brten pa'i rnam shes yid kyi thig le trī:yig gi gzugs su gnas pa/ g.yo ba dang 'dar ba'i bdag nyid can du gsal bar gyur/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla seng ge'i khri la 'dren pa 'od dpag tu med pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis mdzes par klubs pa/ zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung gis gdan gnon pa/ 'od zer gyi rnam rol kun tu 'phro ba/ zhing khams rab 'byams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas bskor ba/ byin rlabs kyi sprin phung thibs se dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhag ge bdag sogs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs/ byams pa'i zhal gyis phyogs te bzhugs par gyur zhes brjod cing bsam la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs 445

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa/ sogs/ sangs rgyas mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdun nam nyer gcig sogs brjod cing mos gus kyi gdung shugs bya/ de nas/ e ma ho/ gnas rang snang / sogs/ zin par shog lan bdun nam gsum sogs brjod mthar/ hika gsum sogs brjod la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan ci rigs brjod mthar/ e ma ho/ zhing bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i klong / /skyabs sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang / /don dbyer med 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /sku snang stong ye shes dwangs ma'i lus/ /'od ngo mtshar bkod pa'i gzi byin can/ /sras 'phags tshogs rgya mtshos yongs bskor ba/ /blo dang ba'i mos ngor rab bsam te/ /yid khyed shes gdung bas gsol 'debs na/ /lam zab mo 'pho ba'i man ngag gis/ /sems 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ti la ka /gnas mkha' spyod sprul ba'i 'og min du/ /dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog /ces lan ci rigs su brjod mthar/ trī:hrī:hrī:zhes brjod cing /snying ga'i trī:yig dbu ma'i lam brgyud/rim gyis spyi bor song ba tshangs bug nas mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i thugs kar ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la/ hikaci rigs brjod nas slar yang 'od dpag med kyi mtshan brgya rtsa sogs brjod la/sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs//myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis 446

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6rlobs//'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs//sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshungs med nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtogs ldan saṃṅga bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha rgod dri med blo gros la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin 447

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyis rlobs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sang sa rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshungs med ma ti'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo yongs 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren mchog karma chos rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin kyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags 448

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6'chang pad+ma dbang drag la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs chen karma chags med la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byang tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin ༄gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub thob pad+ma rig 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpal med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren mchog nam mkha' 'od gsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe//bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs//sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /449

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi pa'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma kun grol rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong par byin gyis rlobs//myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs med phrin las 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs//sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs//myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo /'jigs med phun tshogs 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i 450

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang bo la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshal la gsol ba 'debs/ zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs///sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho pa'i mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs///'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /rnam shes bde chen 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lan bdun nam gsum gdab mthar/ hrī:hrī:zhes brjod cing / rtsa dbu ma la lam gyi 'du shes/ sems rnam shes kyi thig le la mgron po'i 'du shes/ bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams la 'gro yul gyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum gyi rtsi dang ma bral bar/ spar chog gi dmigs gnad bcas/ hika brjod slar yang mos gus 451

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyi gdung shugs bskyed de/ mtshan brgya rtsa sogs brjod/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs rjes zungs/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla mas lam sna drongs/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byong par byin gyis rlobs/ /myur lam 'pho bas mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di nas nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /rnam shes bde chen 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ci mang du bskyar nas/ spar chog gong ltar bya/ kun la spar chog rdzogs nas/ skad gcig la rang gi snying dbus kyi pad+ma'i steng du trī:yig rlung gi thig le dang bcas pa krong gis bsgom pa ni mtshungs pa yin no/ /slar yang rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mchog dmar po zhal gcig zhi 'dzum bzhad pa'i nyams kyis sgeg cing / phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe bum dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can 'dzin pa/ sku la dar gyi chas gos lnga dang rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan rgyas pa la bzhugs so/ /thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrī: yig gi mtha' bskor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa bsdus nas bdag la 452

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag nyams len/ pod/ 6thim par gyur/ oṃ a ma ra ṇa dza brnye swā hā/ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ ces bzla/ mjug tu/ 'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung / /khyed kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang / /tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa/ /tshe dpag med kyi bkra shis shog /cesapa brjod/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo/ /don zab thabs kyi lam bzang rmad byung ba/ /ma bsgom 'tshang rgya 'pho ba'i man ngag chos/ /bsnyad las legs byas snang ba gang snyed pa/ /de yis 'gro kun phan dang bde byed shog /ces pa'ang dad ldan gyi slob bu badz+ra a kā ras rin chen gnyis pa'i dngos 'byor dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ gzhon nu kun bzang 'jigs med pas bsrel ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // 453

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhe ༄/ /dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu 'ga' zhig bzhugs/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyud dpyad kyi gzhung mang po las sman bcos thor bu 'ga' zhig bsdu bar bya ste/ sman rnams kyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas gso ba'i gzhung la ma brten na rtogs par dka' ba dang / 'byor ba chung ngu'i sman pa rnams la phan gdag par bsams so/ /mgo bo rlung gis na ba la rdza ma snum can cung dros pa mgor gyon na phan no/ /yang gar chang phul gsum bskol la long gis khol ba dang gu gul nag po ra ril tsam zhig btab la zhag gsum bar bsten na mgo nad shin tu bcos rdugs la phan no/ /yang la ca(cha) gsar ba dang gla rtsi chu 'jam pos phul na mgo nad bcos rdugs rnams zhi'o/ /mgo'i rma la skra 'tshob par 'dod na ba lang gi rwa rus pa rmig pa spu pags pa'i thal ba rnams til mar la sbyar te byug na skye'o//mig ma gsal na ra'am lug nad med kyi mchin pa gtub nas mar khur btsos pa'i nang du go snyod kyi spod btab ste rgyun du zos na 'grib rigs mi 'ong zhing mig shed shin tu skye bar bsngags so/ /lcags phye g.ya' med a ru ra'i 454

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6zlakhu bar bzhus pa'i nang du skyu ru ra dang shing mngar kyi phye ma btab pa'i ril bu sran 'phos (ma)tsam re snga zhogs zos na mig gi rab rib mtha' dag sel lo/ /rgas khar mig mi gsal na rkang mthil chus dag par khrus la phag tshil mar sbyangs byug bsku mnye byas pas shin tu phan no/ /ling tog la tsha la bsregs pa'i lbu ba dang sha pho ru rta bsregs pa'i phye ma cha mnyam khab mig gang gi tshad tsam byugs na mchog go /yang chu tig grib skam byas pa de zhib tu btags la ling tog gsar ba'i steng du skam 'debs byas na phan no/ /g.ya' ma'i khar me rdog du ba med pa bzhag la/ de'i steng du rgya tshwa thun che ba zhig blugs/ de'i yang steng bal ting kha sbubs te bzhag pa'i bal ting nang dud pa chags pa de phug ron dang sgros ling thog gi steng du blugs na'ang 'phral du 'thon no/ /rlung gi ling tog la li shi bdar ba'i khu ba gtig na phan no/ /mig la glo bur du mtshon nam dbyug (pa sogs)babs pas zhar ba dang snad pa sogs la pha long dreg pa dkar po khye'u nu 'thung gi zho dang sbyar nas byugs pas shin tu phan no/ /kha ba'am du bas mig phyid na dri chur ru rta bzang po thun cig sbyangs te thur mgo gang mig tu blugs na bde bar bshad la go snyod me la bdug na yang phan no/ /yang kha ba'i nang du 'gro dus mig lcibs kyi mtha' la snag tsha byug phyid zin na 455

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pho rog gi sgro bzhur ba'i rkang de mer bsregs pa zhib btags mar dri med sbyar nas byug pas phan/ du bas mig phyid na sha gsar dmar po la phyis pas kyang phan no/ /snga zhogs kyi kha rul ba'i mchil ma mig dang rkang lag la byugs na'ang mi phyid do/ /mig tu gra ma shor na nas btsos pa'i khu ba mig la byugs pas 'byung ngo / /mis/ tu rdul song nas tshabs che na chu rgyun phra mo dal gyis rgyun ma chad par mig nang gtigs na 'thon no/ /mig lcibs yas mas skrangs na li shi bdar te byugs pas phan no/ /rna ba'i nad rna ba g.ya' zhing sgra 'ur ba la rab btsan dug rlon pa'am ma rnyed na skam po sbangs nas shing tog chi bha ga'i rus pa lta bur gris bcos la rna bar brdzangs shing yang yang brjes na zhi'o/ /yang rna ba las rnag 'dzag na la phug dang ru rta'i khu ba blugs pas 'chad do/ /rna bar na zug skyes na a ru ra dang ru rta'i thang dro 'jam blugs pas phan no/ /rna ba'i nang du sems can zhugs na mkhan skya'i lo khu blugs pa'am rgya tshwa dang shing kun mar nag rnams bsres pa tshug tshad blugs pas 'byung ngo / /sna shu byung na ti tsha'i thal ba byugs pas zhi'o/ /sna khrag ma chod na khrag de nyid rag snod du bsregs pa'i nag thar re ba de chu la sbyar te btang na chu log bzhag pa rini mi //bye 1111 //bye/ /rdo rdoltar 'gyur ro//byis pa ri ma—ga skra bsregs pa thal ba thun —na 456

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6 zhig chang gis phul la thal ba lhag ma smyug sbubs nas snar bskyal na'ang chod do/ /lce ma bde na nangs par lce sbyar gyis dag par byas nas pho ba ris sam pi pi ling gi phye ma thur mgo gang re byug pa nangs ma bzhi lnga skor byas na phan no/ (zla ba rer thengs gsum re byugs na lce bde zhing ro 'dzin par bshad do)/ lce skrangs nas rdo ltar sra ba la sga skya glan pas myar bar rnag tu khugs so/ /rdza ma'i dud pa dang rgya tshwa 45rig dmi ba 45gling ma rig tshogacing tsho ring /bye sheganyas mnyam pa' phya ma chu mag ga chur sbyar nas byugs kyang ca skrangs rdo ltar sra ba la phan no/ /mid pa lce chung skrangs shing dbugs thon mi thub na mi'i sen mo bregs nas rdza mar ser trab ma song bar brngos pa'i phye ma sog sdug (sbug) nas gre bar bdas pas de ma thag skrangs 'thor 'gro/ yang lce chung la babs na pi ling rgya tshwa gang 'byor zhig gi phye ma mdzub mo la bskus nas lce chung gi rtser thang 'ga' glan pas myur du phan no/ /ni la tho ṭha lcags khrem du bsregs pa'i phye ma btab na'ang / lce bem pa dang lce chung na ba la phan no/ /so ldeg na nangs par lto stong dus kyi dri chu bar ba hub gsum btung zhing kha nang du dkrogs te bor ba rgyun par byas na brtan par 'gyur ro/ /chu bre gang tsam kyi nang du til spar ba gang ngam phyed do btags pa blugs la thang ltar gdus nas gar bor song ba na ril bur byas re re bzhin mur na'ang so shin tu sra bar 457

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad do/ ('di skor ma yig mi gsal bas tshig gcig chad) /mkhal ma ko yu sa rlon du sbangs pa 'gron thal dang sbyar te byugs na so sra zhing dkar ba sogs yon tan che'o/ /so nad rigs la zhun mar rna ba'i nang du byugs na phan no/ /yang so rlung srin gyis na na btsan dug dang pi pi ling gi thum po mar du btsos nas bdug na phan no/ /dkar gong nas tsam brdung ba thun gcig ras su btums la mar khu'i nang du btsos smyug thur gyi rtser bskyon nas so gang na sar bcir ba yun bsring na'ang so srin la phan no/ /yang rag sder gtsang ma'i nang du chu blugs la dkar gong srin can bsregs pa bzhag de'i steng du rgya thang khrom gyi 'bras bu brdung ba bsregs mgo gos kyis btum la kha sna mig gsum du bas bdug chu nang du kha cha sna cha mang po 'dzag bcug pas so srin dngos sa thon yong ngo //riri bye risi bye ribasi༅rnyil la khrag tshad babs pa'i gzer skrangs dang rnyil chad pa la dri chur mtshur nag btabs pas mkhur bkang phyir 'pho'o/ /steng grib lta bu'i rlung gis ngag lkugs pa la lcags btsa' dmar can gyi khu ba chu blangs pa bskol te btung ba na phan zhing khong khrag mkhar ba la'ang 'di nyid mchog go /mchu mdze byung na nangs snga rdo ba mo can lta bu'i grang mo glan pas sel lo/ /rlung gis mchu gas pa dang spyi gtsug dang sen skyi gas na lte khung du mar byugs pas sel ma ne 458

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6'gram rus bud na sug pa'i phye ma snar btab ste sbrid pa byung bas tshud cing rud (dud)rgan snar rngub pa'i sbrid pa las kyang tshud do/kha nas khrag skyugs na rang gi mtshan ma'i spu sran ma drug gi tshad tsam ril bur bsgril ba chus phul bas chad do/ /sprid pa 'don ma thub par gdong pa sbrid na de ma thag nyi ma la bltas pas 'thon no/ /ngo khab (kheb)dang phye ma sel ba la sbrang dang btsod kyi lde gus byugs pa bya'o//sbrul nag pags pa nus ldan du bsregs nas ba ra'i mar dang sbyar ba byugs na sha bkra dang glang shu sel lo/ /gag pas gre ba 'gags na 'khun pa gros 'debs kyi rtsa ba dgun dus su brkos nas rul sungs su ma song bar bskams pa de ngang pa chig thub dang sbyar bas 'joms/ mgul 'gags dang pho thogs la bya rdo bsregs pa chur bzhus te bskol ba'i snyigs ma dor khu ba dwangs bgrung blangs/ slar yang rdza snod du bskol nas bskam pa par bur bcings la kha dam par bcad/ lo bzhi bcu tshun chad kyi dar mar skar bzhi de phan chad la skar do a rag 'thung gang thub kyis phul/ des srin bu skyug bshal byang na phan rtags yin/ de ma rternga ga chosing rwa zigabyung yang nad kya dbal bcag na phan gal ta ma bcag na yang bskyar bya'o/ /mgul 'gags zas ma thar zhing lhag par skyug pa la bye'u leb dkar chung chang skyur khar shi ba'i ro de btags pa zho re 459

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chang gis phul na phan no/ /bad kan mgul du chags nas ngar na sha la yun ring gi me tog gam rtsa ba'am lo ma skam rlon gang rung gi phye ma bskol nas tho rangs 'thung ba mchog go /bad kan smug po'i nad la cong zhi khram khrem brdung pa kho na lo 'khor du bsten na mchog ste cong zhi'i dam tshig tu sha mo mar nag lo tshod shing thog sngo'i rigs thams cad 'dzem mo/ /smug ser 'thab pa la ni lcags dregs gcig pu brten pas nad slong sdud zhi sbyong thams cad byed de myur du phan par the tshom med do/ /byang bul lhad med thun gsum dang star bu thun gcig bsdebs pa chu bskol gyis phul na dbugs mi thon pa'i khrag rlung stod 'tshang dang g.yang lhung rdo dbyug phog pa ma zhu ba dang sha dug sogs sel nus pa zab khyad can no/ /yang sgos phye 'khor gyis zhib btags thur mgo gang chus phul na stod 'tshang la shin tu phan no/ /dres ma'i rtsa lo gang byung rung rdza gtsang mar cung zad yibs su bcug pa phyag gang dang sran ma nag po rdog po nyer gcig rnams thang du bskol nas btang na grod pa cung zad sbos snyam byed cing thar sel 'byang ste de ltar ༷ sgo re du ༄༄pa 1)/ skur 1(rdobyung na stod 'tshang la na tu phan / /byang lan tshwa bzang lhad med phul gang sla ngar nas 'bru bco lnga'i tshos tshad du brngo/ de sder nang du byo ste ngad ma yal ba'i steng du lo brgyad dri chu bzar 460

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6 nas gar sla zho tsam la thar nu bzang po mtheb chen tsam phyed gnyis zhib btags kyi phye ma bsres la ma bskam bar du 'thag de nyid par bu bzang por bcings la dgos dus su thur mgo gang re'i tshad chu bskol gyis phul nas btang na khong du zhu long med par srin dang glang thabs kyi rigs thams cad 'joms nus pa 'chi ba dur slong 'di sman zab/ spang spos kyi rtsa ba zhib btags chang gar mas phul te btang na'ang glang thabs la phan no/ /yang srin glang la lham mthil gyi dreg pa bkrus pa'i khu bar tshwa btab nas 'thung na phan no/ /dres thag rul ba zhib tu brdung la sla ngar bskol ba'i nang du la phug skam po tshag gang gi phye ma btab nas 'thung na phan/ da li'i lo ma dpung chen chur gdus pa'i thang chen mos kyang phan/ dres ma'i (ri klung gi dres ma'i rigs thams cad)lo ma rgyas dus su khaṇ+ḍa byas pa lug ril tsam re cha bskol gyis phul na'ang ༄ srin glang 'joms pa'i rdo rjer bsngags so/ /glang thabs bshal skyug med pa 'chos na chu khol la tshwa btab pa 'thung na skyug nas phan no/ /zas ma zhu ba sogs kyi pho nad la star ka bsregs pa'i nang tshil zos pas phan no/ /sbos khrog zhi ba la bu ram zho gsum tshwa zho gang dang sbyar te sbyangs nas bsten na the tshom med do/ /'khru ba gcod na rab 'brug rus ma rnyed na mi rus btsa' ma rtsi bzhin 461

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ btags te tsha 'khru la chu dang grang 'khru la chang gis phul ba ches cher zab bo/ /sgog skya gcig mar khur gdus nas bsten pa'am ram zan mar khu'i nang du btsos pa zos na'ang phan no/ /gnyan 'bram bu bsrang na dang po 'bram bu tho phyi na yod dus mi rta khyi ༄༄mi yir raXpha ri'i skyur ri sna ri7gsum gya sha sga srang la btags pas thub cang man sran bcas pa skud pa la brgyus te ske la btags kyang srung bar gsungs so/ /lhog rgod thog babs su byung na rta bla'i ro mgo sug ma nyams pa mar gyi dril nas khyur mid byas na shin tu phan no/ /yang lhog pa cis kyang ma zhi na sdom nag la gzhig (gzhib)tu gzhu/ga go /gnyan barba ta'am nag po sum sgril la phur nag gi thang la gla rtsi btab pa kho nas yang yang btang bas 'chos so/ /gnyan 'bar 'bur la nya lcibs me la ser tsam bsregs pa'i thal ba ba'i zhos gta' byas te thun chen re nyin bdun du btang bas phan no/ /me lce'i 'khor lo la tsan dan dmar po dang btsag zhib btags khong du btang zhing gang na sar byug pas phan no/ /gnyan 'bras kyi skrangs 'bur la sgog cig ma ṭaṃ ka gsum brtsegs kyis rngams tsam yod pa gshag nas sbyar ba'i steng du myo4khan pa dkar po'i me sum tshom du bsregade nas sgog pa tshur len/ de byas pas zug med la zug skyes pa'am zug yod la zug chag pa byung na phan rtags yin te nad gsar 462

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6dus yin na nges par phan no/ /ya ma'i nad na sgog gcig ma dang btsan dug cha mnyam brdung ba'i 'dag pa kham tshig gi nang bkang nas 'khyug rtsar blan chu bur shar tshe phan no/ /mtho zhing gtsang la byang du bltas pa'i srib nas dgun stod bskos pa'i thar nu bzang po de rang las bzhi 'gyar gyi ba chur btsos la khu ba rang thim du ri sna mjug1rwag rig zurag zurag 4rwagagatang / da grab skam byas nas zhab btags ral bu dral ba (sran ma'i tshad tsam)chu skol gyis phul na gag lhog gzer thung glang thabs rigs sogs gnyan rigs thams cad gyen thur du 'dren yong ste/ril bu grangs tshad ni gsum lnga bdun sogs sman lto dang sbyar ro/ /yang thang khrom (dkar po)mar khur btsos nas mdog nag por song ba bsten na ya ma dkar nag khra gsum dang glang thabs lce 'bam lhog pa rnams 'joms so/ /rtsa dres ma'i me tog dang 'bras bu gang rung thun lnga zhib tu btags la e dre khyor ba bzhir sbyar de nyid sla ngar tshwa nag blug ma song shar du brngos pa'i rten (steng)sur sgra dang ldan par blugs nas khol bzhin pa de blud na srin nad kyi rigs thams cad 'joms so/ /der ma zad dres thag rul ba rtsi bzhin btags te chu bskol gyis phul na srin nad de ma thag tu zhi bar gsungs so/ /grib dang gdong srin la ra thug gi gcin dang ril ma sa la yun ring por 'jags pa de mes bsreg pa'i thal ba dkar 463

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po sna tha sogs dang sbyar nas rngubs pas 'phral du phan zhes zer/srin bshal byed na nad pa'i dri chu bskol bar tshwa thun gcig btab la grang du bcug de btang bas srin thams cad bshal du 'gyur/bshal rjes spyi dang mthun/ yang byi tang ka'i phye zhib btags sbrang gis ril bu dril ba bsten na khong srin sogs srin rigs thams cad la phan no/ /grang nad kyi khams zag pa rkang sked na ba nyams chung ba stod tsha smad grang sogs la sha ba'i kā dor chang la rlangs tshos byas pa skam pa'i phye ma sbrang gis ril bu sran ma tsam dril lnga bcu re 'bras thang gis phul na mchog go /ha shig cha drug shing mngar dang lde gu gser thig gi thig le gnyis re sbyar ba'i phye ma chang bre gsum nang du blugs nas zhag gsum bzhag pa'i khu ba 'o/ do chu bskol gyi phul na gcin snyi dang rde'u phye ma khrag rnag gis chu 'gags pa la phan/ rta drel la gtong na 'bras khus phul/ gzhan yang 'di'i rtsa nad rde'u rigs kun la phan no/ /dri chen 'gags na dud pa bya bal ma dang bul tog dang bu ram rnams sbyar ba 'phongs su bcug na mi thon mi srid do/ /rdel nad dang chu 'gags la tshwa la mer bsregs pa'i thal ba phye mar byas te gsang gnas kyi nang du cung zad blugs na chu thon zhing than chung re chu bskol gyi ༷༷ nge ///de rig ༅phul btang bas rdel nad ba zab khyad can no//rtsa 'gags na 464

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6 chur khu'i nang du bul tog btab la gtong ngo / /bu dang sha ma thogs na ri bong ril ma bdun nam nyer gcig chu dron dang sbyar te btang na phan par the tshom med do/ /yang bud med bu ro ma thon na khyo'i skra bsregs pa'i gzhob chang dang sbyar ba bsten na phan no/ /bu btsas rjes khrag ma chod na 'dom bar du 'om bu'i dud pa btang bas phan no/ /dwang sa ma 'dzag na byi brun zhib par btags la chus zho tsam sbyar ba lte 'og na spu dkar nag yan la byugs pas sel lo/ /steng grib kyis glo bur du brgyal na dan rog brdung pa shog gur 'phur nas snum blangs ba'i shog gu snum can de mer bcug pa'i du ba snar btang bas gso'o/ /kha mig yo na dan khra brdung nas yo phyogs min par 'byar byed cing lag pas 'phur/yo drang 'phral 'byar len cing chus bkrus/ yang na nya'am sram gyi khrag yo phyogs min par byugs pas phan no/ /khu byug ma sleb gong gi sran ma 'bur skyes btus la grib skam byas te bur dkar rtse 'jam du bsres pa dang sbyar ba chang gis phul na yan lag chag zhom rdib gsum kun la phan no/ /ming can nag po ram dang sbyar ba'i ril ba lo ga'i sgo nga tsam nangs nub tu re re btang na mgo ༄cachag rus skyon rma nad rtsa nad yan lag rengs 'khums rnams sel te thang du btang na'ang nus pa che'o/ /grum stabs rus tshigs na ba 465

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/la rta'i lag pa'i se ra rus('dir ni rta'i rmig chung ngam rta bon pa ru bya'od rang mchan)chang gis byug nas mer ser tsam bsregs pa'i phye ma de chang bre gsum nang du blugs la zhag gsum bzhag pa'i khu ba nyin re snyigs dor phor chung gang tsam re bsten pas sel lo/ /spyi zhur brdung ba'i khu ba btung na rtsa 'chus kyi rigs la phan no/ /mu zi dang btsan dug cha mnyam lo brgyad dri chus 'dam btag ril bu yun bsten byas pas za 'phrug sogs chu ser rtsa tshigs dang pags pa la rgyas pa sel lo/ /sga skya dang g.yer ma zhi btags chur sbyar blugs na'ang za 'phrug la phan no/ /yang za 'phrug me dbal byung na glang rog po'i kha chu yang yang byugs na nges par phan no//brag chung zhib btag pa chu'am rang gi dri chus bran la byug na bzod brlag med pa'i srin nad la phan no/ /glang shu la bong ba dkar po dri chur sbyar ba'am yang na 'om bu'i khu ba la byang bul btab nas nan ltar byug go /rma che chung gang yang mi'i mgo rus dang skra dang rus pa rnams kyi phye ma gcin dang sbyar bas bkrus na sbyor ba brgyas mi 'tsho ba'ang 'tsho'o/ /khrag gcod na ci yang rung bas rus pa bsregs thal dang nas bsregs pa'i thal ba rdza sa bsregs pa'i gyo mo zhib brdung gsum rma khar btab na chod/ rta spu bsregs thal rma la btab na'ang chod do/ /rma rgan yun ring 'tshor ('tshob)ma 'dod 466

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6na bya rog gi brun bdug na sos so/ /khyis rmug na ha la bzang po zhib btags chu dang sbyar bas rma kha dag par bkrus na gnyan sogs mi 'byung ngo / /mes tshigs pa'i rma la bul tog chang sbyar ram/li khri chu gtsang dang sbyar bas shin tu phan no//yang khron pa'i 'jim pa sngon po byug na me dang chu tshan gyis tshig pa la phan no/ /rgya thor la bul tog ba bla dud pa gsum po bsngags shing ni la tho ṭha yang zab par snang ngo / /rkang ba'i ser kha ma sos na spyin bzang pos byugs nas skrad dum zhig glan na sos so/ /lug mur skam po dang ka ra'i phye ma btab na rnag sme sha gso ba la mchog go /thar nu nus bsregs byas pa rdol mi rung ba'i rnag mgor byag na myar du rdol lo//mjug 'tshodza /ste/ zurari zi pa ri'i raXdir/mda'u ma na na bud da kya dar rta khrag can bsrags pa dang thab gong gi sa tshig pa phul do tsam chu bre phyed kyi nang du bgrungs te dwangs par byas nas blud na phyin to/ /des ma phyin na yang mang du bya'o/ /sdom dang sdig pa khong du song na sran ma dkar po'i rtsa ba dang / ram pa'i rtsa ba cha mnyam zhib btags chang dang sbyar ba btang bas phan no/ /gre bar rus pa dang gra ma zug na ras sam dar gang rung gre bar thar tsam bsdams nas dar skud btags la mid par ldad ngo shas tsam mid nas ske'i mtha' rnams khu tshur gyis ran tsam brdung / rke phar log tshur log bzhi lnga tsam bya/ de nas 467

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngar gyi dar skud la 'then pas 'byung ngo/ /rta phyugs sogs kyi khong du kha brgyad pa sogs shor nas sbos na tshwa dang mar bsres pa khar bcug pas kha cag cag byed na mod la 'tsho'o/ /phyugs ci sbos kyang mjug snying bsregs pas phan no/ /sbyar dug gtso bor gyur ba'i dug rigs la zhal shes ltar btus pa'i ko ṭha rdog po gsum tshal brdung byas pa dkar yol gang tsam chu la ja yun zhig sbangs/ mthe bong (gis)drag tu bsnur (btsur)ba'i khu ba de btung na dug thams cad sbyang du 'khrid nus pas shin tu zab/ khyi dug gi gnyen por rta gseb sngon po'i sbang sa la ma lhung ba blangs te bcir ba'i khu ba mar dkar btab ste lhog tsam bskol ba de sna bkag nas blud na dug gsod do/ /btsan dug las gyur ba'i nad tshabs chung na sha mo'i rtsa ba dang yos tshig gi thang btang na phan/ tshabs che na rta sogs kyi gson khrag btang ngo / /chang gi mi myos par byed na mar skya bzhus pa phor chung gang du lan tshwa ro bro tsam zhig btab ste 'thung na ra ro bar mi 'gyar ro/ /yang chang ma btung gong lug ru (seshe 1dro//zurig ra༄mi 1zerar grab skam byas pas thang btang da nas 'thung na chang nad mi 'byung ngo / /sna cham byung phral gzhan la ma brjod gong rtsam pa'i du ba nan cher bdug na phran bu lam nas ldog nus so/ /yang ri bong ril ma bdun dang char nyis khyer ba'i dres ma mtho gang sgog 468

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6skya rdog po gcig rnams sla ngar rdza phor bkab la nus bsregs bya/de zhib btag chu bskol grang mos phul na cham pa'i sman mchog tu gyur ba'o/ /mtshe ldum rkyang pa snod du rtsal (bsnyal)la chu tshan blug kha snod kyis bkab ste chu de bzhag nas ma grang ba ra 'thung na rim gyis lus tshad mgo na glo lu sogs 'ong ba dang rong tshad la phan pa gu h+ya/ pi ling mar khur btsos te bam byung ba dang bton la bsnur (btsur)te rlung glo mar khu/ tshad glo la zho dang sbyar nas lto stong dus btang na cham pa rnying pa la shin tu phan no/ /phyi (phye)yos kyi rlangs bdug mang du byas na'ang sna cham la phan zhing gre che la mtshul bar zhen na la phug gi khu bas bdug go /a ru ra kha mur byas na'ang glo cham mang du lu ba la phan no/ /lug ra bsres pa'i snag tsha dang til mar bsregs pa mgo bo la bskus na skra dkar nag por 'gyur ro/ /dung gi a long zhib btags byas pa zha nye'i chus lag mthil nag por ma song gi bar du mnyes la mgo bor byug dbyar zho dang dgun kha ras kyi btum te khyi mo dkar mo'i nu zho byugs na'ang skra tshos 'gyur ro/ /yang skra bzhar la dag par bkrus te a ru ra'i khu ba lan bdun byug de skam nas mtshur nag gi chus byag de 'dra /rere/ skur 111 ྅rngorngolan bdun bskyar na skra dkar 'gog sa bshad pa'ang mabaing / //khyi'i mche ba du ba'i nang du bsregs nas 'o ma dang mar dang 469

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bcas pas mnye bar byas na skra ma skyes pa'ang skye'o/ /skra bzang bar byed na skyu ru ra a rag tu sbangs la mgo bor byug klung sho kha 'bus kyi rtsa ba gar chang dang sbyar nas bkrus na skra brtan par 'gyur ro/ /rta mig bsregs pa'i gzhob dang / dbyi mong btsos pa'i khu ba glum gyi khu ba mar nag rnams sbyar nas byugs na lus kyi spu rnams skye zhing skra dkar la bskus na nag por 'gyur/ skra med pa'am mes tshig pa'i shul du bskus na sngar bas lhag par skye'o/ /gnyid mi yong na 'o (ma'i )nang du tshwa dang rtsi mar dang til lam til mar gang rnyed de gsum blugs la ran pa tsam btung ba mchog go /gnyid bsrung na me tog lug ru grib skam byas pa dang rta thod spyi gtsug gi rus pa gnyis mar dkar dang sbyar mer bsregs pa'i du ba sna bug g.yas nas btang / g.yon bkag ste g.yas nas (phyir)btang bas 'grub ces bkod pa zhig mthong ngo / /yang lug gi mig bskam nas zhib tu btags pa dpral ba la bskus na rmugs 'thibs chung ngo / /lus la drod 'bebs na thog mar lus thams cad dag par bkrus te shu dag nag po zhib btags mar rnying dang sbyar bas khyab par byug na me tshan 'de ba lta bu'i drod 'bar zhing rkang lag la ser kha mi 'ong zhes bshad/ nan tan du bskyar ba gal che'o/ /bse dri 'don na dang po bul tog gi chus lus bkru ste de'i 470

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6shul du dud pa bya bal ma dang sran ma'i me tog zhib btags bul chur sbyar te byug na 'don nus shing lus rngul ba'i tshe shug pas lwa ba byugs na'ang 'thon no/ /skyigs bu ma chod na tshe la gnod par gsungs pas de la chu skol tshul bzhin byas pa hub dgu dbugs tho gyig gcig nas 'thung na 'chad nges so/ /dbyar sa rlon sa rkang pa skrangs na sman sga'i thang gis bkrus na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu skrangs na btsan dug pi ling mar rnying sbyar ba byugs te nyi ma la bsro'o/ /spu na gu'i gseb tu rtsa'i thag pa bsregs na'ang phan no/ /long nad rtug pa skam na rus pa sna tshogs bsdus pa'i gdus khu zhun mar dang bsres te 'jam rtsir gtong ngo / /mdzer ba byung na tshes bco lnga'i zla 'od kyi nang du lam rgya gram steng rang gi dri chus bkrus na zhi'o/ /re rul lo mang po'i gong nas bor ba la yang yang phyis nas phyi mig mi lta bar dor na'ang phan no/ /yang ba lang gi lces bldag na mdzer ba phra mo rnams zhi'o/ /sne'u bldag na rang nyid kyi dri chu btung bas phan no/ /thog dug gis mi phog par byed na nye logs su chang snod mang po kha phye ste bzhag na phan no/ /yang gong du bshad pa'i dres ma'i khaṇ+ḍa des bad smug dang dug babs stong tshad pho glang sogs 'joms par gsungs so/ /srad dkar gyi khaṇ+ḍa chu bskol mas phul na mtsher nad rnying pa dang dmu rdzing la phan no/ /471

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyung ma'i khaṇ+ḍa chu bskol gyis phul na nyin re'i dug srang zhing mchin ///tre ///te riri byipa ri dug babs sel lo/ /zwa tshod d+ngha khaṇ+ḍa dang sbrang rgod sbyar bas tsha ba med pa'i dreg nad la phan no/ /kyi lce'i rtsa lo'i khalco chu grang mos phul na tsha ba'i rigs la phan zhing mkhris pa snod lhung rnams 'khru'o/ /brag zhun chu grang mos phul na pho mchin dang mkhal ma'i tsha ba sel lo/ /yan lag gi rtsa rgyus 'khums tshad gsar rnying rma dang bud med btsas rjes sked pa na ba sogs la brag zhun thang btang bas phan no//byis pa mtshan ngu byed na mar me'i sdong bur chags pa'i dud ril te slar yang bsregs pa'i phye ma ma'i nu rtser byugs te bsnun na phan no/ /dar ma'am byis pa'i skyugs mer dang skyugs pa gcod na la phug gi lo ma brdung btsur byas pa'i khu ba btang na chod do/ /byis pa mtshi ba(mtshul ba yin nam)lugs la sngo chu srin sder mo'i phye ma btab na phan no/ /byis pa bad kan gyis ske 'gags nas ngar na dan rog rdog gcig pags pa bshu nang tshil brdung nas ril bu bya/ de srin bal gyi dril nas pho g.yas mo g.yon pa'i snar brdzangs na phan/ byis pa'i nad mngal dug gis dmar thig mched nas snying gar slebs na 'chi bas/ de la sman bul tog chur bskol ba'i gar chus bran/ tshabs shin tu che na lug rgod rwa bsregs thal dang sgong chu dkar pos byugs nas zhi'o/ /dpyad la 472

dpyad gzhung mang po las bsdus pa'i sman dpyad thor bu/ pod/ 6 ling tog gsar rnying rwa sogs phyi 'grib grib sogs khrag shas cher med na thog ma nas khrag shas che na gtar rjes su me tshug legs pas/ de la nad pa lus drang por bsrang / mig thad kar drang por bltas pa'i rgyal mo'i steng nas steng 'og bzhir nad pa rang gi mtheb tshon gang gzhal mtshams kyi kha gdang bzhi la bzhag phyi zur du mig gi phyi gsham nas tshon gang mtshams su gdabs/ gser tshug me la bsregs pas bsnum la sgre ba res mos kyi mthar snum la reg pa dang me lhab 'bar na brdeg ran/ rdo ha shig yin na me 'bar yang da dung snum la bsgre ba me la bsregs pa lan gcig gnyis bya dgos/ ling tog bcos gzhan gyis ma thub par rgyal mo'i steng du 'gro grabs byung na ling tog yod phyogs kyi gong bshad gsang gnyis sam re rer btab pas de phyogs su 'then 'gro/'grib la'ang phyogs bzhi gar yod pa dngos su mthong na dang min kyang mthong tshul gyis rtags la dpag na gar yod dngos su phyir la 'then phyir me gdabs na rgyal mo'i steng du mi 'chor/ 'grib mthong byed rgyal mo'i nang ngos su yod na phyi zar rna ba'i ngos lta ༄bur me btab na rgyal mo'i steng du 'grib 'then 'gro bas ma nor ba gal che/ zhar byung 'phrul me byed na la phug skam po mar nag rnying ba'i nang du btsos la sol bar song ba dang rdza bum du blugs 473

pod/ 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/te kha bsdams du ba ma shor bar nus bsregs bya/ de ltar bgyis pa'i phye ma de ga'u sogs rlan mi 'chor ba'i snod bzang por bcug ste dgos dus su me sbar na lo dang zla bar yang mi 'chi'o/ /rta'i sa bon las skyes pa'i sha mong de rgya yul nas byung ba yin tshwa khu dang chang gis bkrus pa rgya thur gyi srang so gnyis chang bzang bre nyi shu'i nang du sbangs nas de'i khu bcud rim par 'thung na ro tsa bar 'gyur ro/ /rtswa dur ba la rten 'brel snying po bzlas te byin gyis rlabs nas zos na srog ring por 'tsho ba'i dga' ston chen por 'gyur ro/ /de la sogs pa'i phan byed kyi rigs pa mang la rgya che bar yod pa rnams dkyus gcig tu rdzogs par dka' bas mtha' dag ni gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /sman bcos nyer mkho sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa 'di ni rdo rol gyi sa'i cha 'chi med sman ljongs su 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/ /474

pod 6bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang /smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log pad+ma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyur ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsum gyi yul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras sa ka0thog bla ma byang chab seng ge'i thags zin gyi slob rini mi (ze ri pa rab mibu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin kar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me karma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs 1

21jid (1 jordo grub 'o/jigs cesad bstan nyi:rnogasdo/nga khuradra/zug/ 40bzhecan bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar wod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang /dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge 2

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 6thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sman gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang gi cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rig gnas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams lho byang 'brel mtshamanu/ su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myur skyob dang zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bal ba dang / sgos than min ra༄1 ra me3

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ 〈mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 4

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 6dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byang ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam ༷༷sgo ri'i /spri) 1)sgogasang ba sngags dang 'a la ba sogs — dbang sa bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 5

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bzhugs pa'i thor bu dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong gis gsab snon byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i〈dpe tshogs〉'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su brtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos sa snang ba de'i sgrig stangs gzhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i ༄steng gcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod /4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing / chad lhag shor ba/ go rim 'chol ba/ ma yig mi gsal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos lcigs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag legs par bcos shing dag par bsgrigs la/ dogs gzhir mthong ba du ma zhig gzigs pa yangs shing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad gzhir zin bris su bgyis thog 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 6

ngas:skyeb/thag rjejothag /) tha/taskya// 21༷/menaX4'jus par ma phyi sor 'jog byas shing / 'ga' zhig la yin shas che bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyim du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsang gang rung re de'i zar rgyan nam gsal rigar+bha sngar 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lags/bye brag rdo grub chen rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum la gsal bshad du zhu dgos pa zhig ni khong la da reb kyi deb bdun po 'dir 'khod pa las gzhan da dung gsung chos mang tsam yod par nges la de ltar du'ang thos mod dus dbang 7

pod 6 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ du gyur bas yid phangs la/ nga tshos rtsad gcod byas pa ltar na'ang khong gis mdzad pa'i rus mdzod deb gcig da dung yod nges sa ༄'dug kyang da reb lag son ma byung la/ dpal ldan bla ma la rdol thabs kyi ca cos bstod pa ces pa'i rtsom de'ang cung zad kha mi tshang bar 'dug pas slad char don gnyer can dag la thugs 'dog do gzigs kyi las su zhu'o/ /mtshams 'dir slebs tshe nga tshos cis kyang dran yul du bslang bar 'os pa ni〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid la thog mtha' gang rung du thugs khur rgyab skyor khyad du gnang zhing 'di nyid kyi ched du sku tshegs 'o brgyal mdzad pa'i 'brel yod 'go khrid dang mkhas dbang blo mthun gyi tshogs dag yin te/ khong cag rnam pa'i rgyab skyor rogs ram dang bral phyin〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du gzigs mor spro ba'i de ring gi skal ba bzang po 'di nyid nyams par 'gyur bas/ nga tshos khong rnam par lhag bsam dag pas bka' drin zhu ba lags/ lhag par du〈dpe tshogs 〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun sogs gang ci'i thad thugs khur dang phyag ston bla lhag gnang zhing / gnad don du ma'i 'gag mdor gyur ba par skrun ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i cha nas bka' drin khyad du thon cing mdzad rjes kun las lhag 8

ba sgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 6pa ni khul a'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khal gna' rtsom dpe tshogs 'tshol rir mi rigatsa sdud dag sgrig par skrun 'go khrid tshan chung gi tshan gtso sku zhabs pad ma rnam rgyal lags yin pas rang re 'brel yod mi rabs snga phyi kun nas khong gi bka' drin yid la 'chang zhing rjes su dran par 'os zhes 'di gar ched du gsal 'debs zhus pa lags/ de bzhin rdzong gtso smug lo lags nas kyang sa gnas mi rigs rig gnas phyogs dgongs klong yangs la spyod pa mdzangs pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba mdzad pa dge ba'i phyag rjes su che/gzhan yang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bod yig rtsom sgrig khang nas nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad bla na med pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun cing mi rigs rig gnas la gcig tu brtse ba'i lhag bsam dkar pos phyogs du ma nas dmigs bsal chen po'i mdzad pa bskyangs pas dngos gnas bka' drin che zhu/ lnga rig mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ju bkra shis bzang po nas kyang〈dpe tshoṭa〉'di la thugs khur sku tshegs kyi mdzad pa bzhes shing / gsung chos sam mdzad pa po so so la 'brel yod kyi dgon sde bla sprul rnam pas rang ngos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba'ang rang re klog pa po dang bcas pas yid la bsrel bar 'os pa nyid do//9
